var_description_zh: 在BCR-ABL融合中观察到ABL1 T315M突变，也称为ABL1 I315M。该突变被鉴定为伊马替尼（PMID:30684523）治疗后BCR-ABL阳性慢性粒细胞白血病患者的获得性耐药突变。用表达ABL1 T315M的BA/F3细胞进行的体外研究表明，通过与野生型相比增加的细胞增殖（PMID:29078326）来测量，该突变是激活的。该突变的临床前研究表明，与野生型相比，通过治疗后持续的细胞活力来测量对阿西替尼和普纳替尼的耐药性（PMID:26511402，31543464）。
var_description: The ABL1 T315M mutation, also referred to as ABL1 I315M, is observed in the context of the BCR-ABL fusion. This mutation was identified as an acquired resistance mutation in patients with BCR-ABL-positive chronic myeloid leukemia following treatment with imatinib (PMID: 30684523). In vitro studies with Ba/F3 cells expressing ABL1 T315M demonstrate that the mutation is activating as measured by increased cellular proliferation compared to wildtype (PMID: 29078326). Preclinical studies of the mutation demonstrate resistance to axitinib and ponatinib as measured by sustained cellular viability following treatment compared to wildtype (PMID: 26511402, 31543464).

var_description_zh: ABL1的融合通常产生于伴侣蛋白的N-末端与保留ABL1激酶结构域的ABL1的C-末端的染色体易位（PMID:21435002）。来自N-末端伴侣蛋白的结构域允许融合蛋白的寡聚化，导致酪氨酸激酶活化、细胞骨架定位和细胞转化（PMID:21435002）。然而，需要额外的研究来充分了解每种特异性ABL1融合蛋白的功能结果。
var_description: Fusions of ABL1 generally arise from chromosomal translocations of the N-terminus of a partner protein with the C-terminus of ABL1, which retains the kinase domain of ABL1 (PMID: 21435002). Domains from the N-terminal partner proteins allow oligomerization of the fusion proteins, resulting in tyrosine kinase activation, cytoskeletal localisation and cellular transformation (PMID: 21435002). However, additional studies are required to fully understand the functional consequences of each specific ABL1 fusion protein.

var_description_zh: BCR-ABL1融合蛋白（也称为费城染色体）将丝氨酸/苏氨酸激酶BCR的一部分与ABL1的SH2/3、酪氨酸激酶、DNA和肌动蛋白结合结构域并置（PMID:3460176，2825022）。这种融合常见于慢性粒细胞白血病和急性淋巴细胞白血病。这种融合被充分研究，并导致组成型下游JAK/STAT和PI3K信号传导，导致生长因子独立性、抑制凋亡、改变细胞运动性和转化（PMID:11345193）。ABL1的小分子抑制剂，包括FDA批准伊马替尼、达沙替尼和尼洛替尼，在BCR-ABL1融合（PMID:11870241）患者中具有高水平的临床活性。
var_description: The BCR-ABL1 fusion protein (also known as the Philadelphia chromosome) juxtaposes part of the serine/threonine kinase BCR with the SH2/3, tyrosine kinase, DNA- and actin-binding domains of ABL1 (PMID: 3460176, 2825022). This fusion is commonly found in chronic myelogenous leukemia and acute lymphocytic leukemia. This fusion is well-studied and results in constitutive downstream JAK/STAT and PI3K signaling, resulting in growth-factor independence, inhibited apoptosis, altered cell motility and transformation (PMID: 11345193). Small molecule inhibitors of ABL1, including FDA-approved imatinib, dasatinib, and nilotinib, have had high levels of clinical activity in patients with the BCR-ABL1 fusion (PMID: 11870241).

var_description_zh: 在BCR-ABL融合的背景下观察到ABL1 Y253F突变。在使用伊马替尼（PMID:16880519）的慢性粒细胞白血病患者中发现了这种突变。BCR-ABL Y253F在小鼠骨髓中的表达证明其是活化的，如通过与单独的BCR-ABL相比增加的增殖和降低的小鼠存活率所测量的（PMID:16880519）。用表达ABL1 Y253F的BA/F3细胞进行的体外研究证明了对伊马替尼和尼洛替尼的抗性，如通过治疗后持续的细胞活力所测量的，以及对达沙替尼的敏感性，如通过治疗后降低的细胞活力所测量的（PMID:17496200）。
var_description: The ABL1 Y253F mutation is observed in the context of the BCR-ABL fusion. This mutation in found in patients with chronic myeloid leukemia who progress on imatinib (PMID: 16880519). Expression of BCR-ABL Y253F in murine bone marrow demonstrated that it is activating, as measured by increased proliferation and decreased mouse survival compared to BCR-ABL alone (PMID: 16880519). In vitro studies with Ba/F3 cells expressing ABL1 Y253F demonstrate resistance to imatinib and nilotinib, as measured by sustained cellular viability following treatment, and sensitivity to dasatinib, as measured by reduced cellular viability following treatment (PMID: 17496200).

var_description_zh: ABL1 F359I突变位于蛋白质的激酶结构域中，主要在BCR-ABL1重排中（PMID:18436994，23549879）。在ABL1的ATP结合环中发现ABL1 F359残基，靠近酶的催化中心，并且预测ABL1 F359I变体破坏伊马替尼结合的失活状态（PMID:18828913，23549879）。BA/F3细胞的体外耐药性研究表明，在获得伊马替尼和尼洛替尼耐药性的细胞系中获得了ABL1 F359I突变（PMID:23549879）。在对伊马替尼耐药的慢性粒细胞白血病患者中发现了这种耐药变异，在某些情况下对尼洛替尼耐药，但对达沙替尼治疗仍然敏感（PMID:18436994，22094354）。
var_description: The ABL1 F359I mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein, predominantly in the BCR-ABL1 rearrangement (PMID: 18436994, 23549879). The ABL1 F359 residue is found in the ATP binding loop of ABL1, near the catalytic center of the enzyme, and the ABL1 F359I variant is predicted to disrupt the imatinib-bound inactive state (PMID: 18828913, 23549879). In vitro drug resistance studies in Ba/F3 cells demonstrated the acquisition of the ABL1 F359I mutation in cell lines that gained resistance to imatinib and nilotinib (PMID: 23549879). This resistance variant was identified in patients with chronic myeloid leukemia that demonstrated resistance to imatinib, and in some cases nilotinib, but remained sensitive to dasatinib therapy (PMID: 18436994, 22094354).

var_description_zh: ABL1 F317C突变位于蛋白质的激酶结构域中，主要在BCR-ABL1重排中（PMID:23549879）。ABL1 F317残基是达沙替尼的接触点，预计F317C变体会破坏药物的结合能力（PMID:15705718，21220945，23549879）。BA/F3细胞的体外耐药性研究表明，在获得达沙替尼耐药性的细胞系中获得了ABL1 F317C突变（PMID:23549879）。这种耐药变异是在对达沙替尼治疗（PMID:21220945，23549879）获得耐药的BCR-ABL融合的慢性粒细胞白血病患者中发现的。
var_description: The ABL1 F317C mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein, predominantly in the BCR-ABL1 rearrangement (PMID: 23549879). The ABL1 F317 residue is a contact point for dasatinib and the F317C variant is predicted to disrupt the binding ability of the drug (PMID: 15705718, 21220945, 23549879). In vitro drug resistance studies in Ba/F3 cells demonstrated the acquisition of ABL1 F317C mutations in cell lines that gained resistance to dasatinib (PMID: 23549879). This resistance variant was identified in chronic myeloid leukemia patients with a BCR-ABL fusion who acquired resistance to dasatinib therapy (PMID: 21220945, 23549879).

var_description_zh: ABL1 T315A突变位于蛋白质的激酶结构域中，主要在BCR-ABL1重排中（PMID:23549879，15505216）。ABL1 T315残基位于ABL1的ATP结合区，并被预测破坏BCR-ABL1的无活性的达沙替尼结合状态（PMID:23549879）。表达T315A变体的小鼠模型发生与野生型BCR-ABL1表达相似的骨髓增殖性疾病，其对伊马替尼治疗敏感（PMID:15505216）。体外研究表明，表达ABL1 T315A的细胞保持对尼洛替尼的敏感性，如细胞增殖减少所证明的（PMID:15505216）。与更普遍的ABL1 T315I突变相似，ABL1 T315A被预测为慢性粒细胞白血病患者中的达沙替尼耐药突变（PMID:26308885）。
var_description: The ABL1 T315A mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein, predominantly in the BCR-ABL1 rearrangement (PMID: 23549879, 15505216). The ABL1 T315 residue is located in the ATP-binding region of ABL1 and is predicted to disrupt the inactive dasatinib-bound state of BCR-ABL1 (PMID: 23549879). Murine models engineered to express the T315A variant develop a myeloproliferative disease similar to that with wildtype BCR-ABL1 expression, which is sensitive to imatinib treatment (PMID: 15505216). In vitro studies demonstrate the ABL1 T315A expressing cells retain sensitivity to nilotinib, as evidenced by decreased cellular proliferation (PMID: 15505216). Similar to the more prevalent ABL1 T315I mutation, ABL1 T315A is predicted to be a dasatinib resistance mutation in chronic myeloid leukemia patients (PMID: 26308885).

var_description: The ABL1 A337V mutation is observed in the context of the BCR-ABL fusion. In vitro studies with Ba/F3 cells expressing ABL1 A337V demonstrate that the mutation is activating as measured by increased transformation and kinase activity compared to wildtype (PMID: 27890928). Preclinical studies of this mutation in the context of BCR-ABL demonstrate resistance to asciminib as measured by sustained cellular viability following treatment (PMID: 28819281).

var_description: The ABL1 F317V mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein, predominantly in the BCR-ABL1 rearrangement (PMID: 15705718, 23549879). ABL1 F317 resistance variants have been identified in chronic myeloid leukemia patients with a BCR-ABL fusion who acquired resistance to dasatinib therapy (PMID: 21220945, 23549879).

var_description_zh: ABL1 F311I突变位于蛋白质的激酶结构域中。该突变已在慢性粒细胞白血病中被鉴定（PMID:19925053）。尽管该突变本身没有功能特征，但在伊马替尼治疗后的BCR-ABL阳性急性淋巴细胞白血病患者中，该突变被鉴定为获得性耐药突变（PMID:33460055）。用表达ABL1 F311I的BCR-ABL阳性Ba/F3细胞进行的体外研究证明了对普纳替尼治疗的敏感性（通过降低细胞增殖来测量）和对阿西替尼治疗的抗性（通过持续细胞增殖来测量）（PMID:26582647）。
var_description: The ABL1 F311I mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein. This mutation has been identified in chronic myeloid leukemia (PMID: 19925053). Although not functionally characterized per se, this mutation was identified as an acquired resistance mutation in a patient with BCR-ABL-positive acute lymphoblastic leukemia following treatment with imatinib (PMID: 33460055). In vitro studies with BCR-ABL-positive Ba/F3 cells expressing ABL1 F311I demonstrated sensitivity to treatment with ponatinib, as measured by reduced cellular proliferation, and resistance to treatment with axitinib, as measured by sustained cellular proliferation (PMID: 26582647).

var_description: The ABL1 Q252H mutation is observed in the context of the BCR-ABL fusion. ATP site-dependent competition binding assays of ABL1 Q252H demonstrate resistance to imatinib as measured by increased IC50 values (PMID: 16046538).

var_description_zh: ABL1 F317I突变位于蛋白质的激酶结构域中，主要在BCR-ABL1重排中（PMID:17339191）。ABL1 F317残基是达沙替尼的接触点，预计F317I变体会破坏药物的结合能力（PMID:15705718）。体外研究表明，表达ABL1 F317I突变的造血细胞系对达沙替尼具有耐药性，这在饱和诱变研究（PMID:15705718）中得到证实。这种耐药变异是在两名BCR-ABL融合的慢性粒细胞白血病患者中发现的，他们对达沙替尼治疗产生了耐药性（PMID:17339191，24652384）。
var_description: The ABL1 F317I mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein, predominantly in the BCR-ABL1 rearrangement (PMID: 17339191). The ABL1 F317 residue is a contact point for dasatinib and the F317I variant is predicted to disrupt the binding ability of the drug (PMID: 15705718). In vitro studies demonstrate that hematopoietic cell lines expressing the ABL1 F317I mutation are resistant to dasatinib, as evidenced in saturation mutagenesis studies (PMID: 15705718). This resistance variant was identified in two chronic myeloid leukemia patients with a BCR-ABL fusions who acquired resistance to dasatinib therapy (PMID: 17339191, 24652384).

var_description_zh: ABL1 D276G突变位于蛋白质的激酶结构域中。与野生型ABL1和BCR-ABL（pMID:15510211）相比，该变体在小鼠BA/F3和32D细胞中的表达证明其是活化的，如通过增加的激酶活化和因子非依赖性生长所测量的。体外研究表明，与BCR-ABL相比，该变体对伊马替尼的敏感性降低，这是通过给药后的生长抑制来衡量的（PMID:15510211）。
var_description: The ABL1 D276G mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein. Expression of this variant in murine Ba/F3 and 32D cells demonstrated that it is activating, as measured by increased kinase activation and factor-independent growth compared to wildtype ABL1 and BCR-ABL (PMID: 15510211). In vitro studies suggest that this variant has decreased sensitivity to imatinib compared to BCR-ABL, as measured by growth inhibition upon drug administration (PMID: 15510211).

var_description_zh: 在BCR-ABL融合中观察到ABL1 p465S突变。用表达ABL1 p465S的BA/F3细胞进行的体外研究表明，通过与野生型相比增加的转化和激酶活性（PMID:27890928）来测量，该突变是激活的。在BCR-ABL的背景下，该突变的临床前研究表明，通过治疗后的持续细胞活力（PMID:28329763）来测量对阿西替尼的耐药性。
var_description: The ABL1 P465S mutation is observed in the context of the BCR-ABL fusion. In vitro studies with Ba/F3 cells expressing ABL1 P465S demonstrate that the mutation is activating as measured by increased transformation and kinase activity compared to wildtype (PMID: 27890928). Preclinical studies of this mutation in the context of BCR-ABL demonstrate resistance to asciminib as measured by sustained cellular viability following treatment (PMID: 28329763).

In vitro studies with Ba/F3 cells expressing ABL1 L248R demonstrate resistance to imatinib, bosutinib, dasatinib, nilotinib and ponatinib, as measured by high IC50 values compared to non-mutant BCR-ABL, and sensitivity to DCC-2036, as measured by low IC50 values compared to non-mutant BCR-ABL (PMID: 23044928).

var_description_zh: ABL1 R332W（也称为R351W）突变位于蛋白质的激酶结构域中。用表达ABL1 R332W的H1915细胞进行的体外研究表明，与野生型（PMID:26758680）相比，通过增加的激酶活性和细胞周期进程测量，该突变被激活。用表达该突变的H1915细胞进行的临床前研究证明了对伊马替尼治疗的敏感性，如通过集落生长形成减少所测量的（PMID:26758680）。

In vitro studies with H1915 cells expressing ABL1 R332W demonstrate that the mutation is activating as measured by increased kinase activity and cell cycle progression compared to wildtype (PMID: 26758680). Preclinical studies with H1915 cells expressing this mutation demonstrated sensitivity to treatment with imatinib as measured by reduced colony growth formation (PMID: 26758680).

var_description_zh: 在BCR-ABL融合的背景下观察到ABL1 K247R突变。该突变被鉴定为伊马替尼（PMID:16434384）治疗后BCR-ABL阳性慢性粒细胞白血病患者的获得性耐药突变。用表达ABL1 K247R的BA/F3细胞进行的体外研究表明，该突变可能是一种单核苷酸多态性，并且通过细胞增殖和伊马替尼和达沙替尼的敏感性与未突变的BCR-ABL（PMID:16151465）相比，该突变是中性的。
var_description: The ABL1 K247R mutation is observed in the context of the BCR-ABL fusion. This mutation was identified as an acquired resistance mutation in patients with BCR-ABL-positive chronic myeloid leukemia following treatment with imatinib (PMID: 16434384). In vitro studies with Ba/F3 cells expressing ABL1 K247R demonstrate that the mutation is likely a single nucleotide polymorphism and neutral as measured by cellular proliferation and imatinib and dasatinib sensitivity comparable to non-mutated BCR-ABL (PMID: 16151465).

var_description_zh: 在BCR-ABL融合的背景下观察到ABL1 E281K突变。虽然这种变异尚未得到功能验证，但它与BCR-ABL阳性急性淋巴细胞白血病患者对达沙替尼的耐药性有关（PMID:21193419）。
var_description: The ABL1 E281K mutation is observed in the context of the BCR-ABL fusion. While this variant has not been functionally validated, it is associated with resistance to dasatinib in a patient with BCR-ABL positive acute lymphoblastic leukemia (PMID: 21193419).

var_description_zh: 在BCR-ABL融合中观察到ABL1 S438C突变。尽管该突变本身没有功能特征，但在伊马替尼治疗后的BCR-ABL阳性慢性髓性白血病患者中，该突变被鉴定为获得性耐药突变（PMID:23676790，17715389）。在一项临床试验中，两名携带该突变的BCR-ABL阳性慢性粒细胞白血病患者在接受尼洛替尼（PMID:17715389）治疗后表现出完全的血液学反应。
var_description: The ABL1 S438C mutation is observed in the context of the BCR-ABL fusion. Although not functionally characterized per se, this mutation was identified as an acquired resistance mutation in patients with BCR-ABL-positive chronic myeloid leukemia following treatment with imatinib (PMID: 23676790, 17715389). In a clinical trial, two patients with BCR-ABL-positive chronic myeloid leukemia harboring this mutation demonstrated a complete hematological response after treatment with nilotinib (PMID: 17715389).

var_description_zh: 在BCR-ABL融合中观察到ABL1 T315I突变。该突变已在对伊马替尼耐药的BCR-ABL阳性慢性粒细胞白血病患者中发现（PMID:11423618，18794843）。BCR-ABL T315I在293T细胞中的表达表明，该突变对伊马替尼具有耐药性，这是通过给药后持续的细胞信号传导来测量的，并且被认为是一种“看门人”突变，类似于在厄洛替尼耐药性中观察到的EGFR T790M突变（PMID:11423618，18794843）。
var_description: The ABL1 T315I mutation is observed in the context of the BCR-ABL fusion. This mutation has been found in patients with BCR-ABL-positive chronic myeloid leukemia who are resistant to imatinib (PMID: 11423618, 18794843). Expression of BCR-ABL T315I in 293T cells demonstrated that this mutation is resistant to imatinib, as measured by sustained cell signaling upon drug administration, and is thought to be a "gatekeeper" mutation similar to the EGFR T790M mutation seen in resistance to erlotinib (PMID: 11423618, 18794843).

var_description_zh: 在BCR-ABL融合的背景下观察到ABL1 S417F突变。尽管该突变本身没有功能特征，但在伊马替尼治疗后的BCR-ABL阳性慢性髓性白血病患者中，该突变被鉴定为获得性耐药突变（PMID:32821940，21890264，185 19952）。
var_description: The ABL1 S417F mutation is observed in the context of the BCR-ABL fusion. Although not functionally characterized per se, this mutation was identified as an acquired resistance mutation in patients with BCR-ABL-positive chronic myeloid leukemia following treatment with imatinib (PMID: 32821940, 21890264, 18519952).

var_description_zh: 在BCR-ABL融合中观察到ABL1 M244V突变。虽然这种变异尚未得到功能验证，但它与BCR-ABL阳性慢性粒细胞白血病患者对伊马替尼的耐药性有关（PMID:21562040）。用表达ABL1 M244V的BA/F3细胞进行的体外研究证明了对阿西替尼的抗性，如通过持续的细胞活力所测量的（摘要：Leyte-Vidal等人骨髓增殖素综合征与慢性粒细胞白血病：基础与转化，血液2022卷。140补编。1.https：//ashpublications.org/blood/article/140/Supplement%201/9606/490327/Select-P-Loop-Mutants-in-BCR-ABL1-Confer-Moderate）。
var_description: The ABL1 M244V mutation is observed in the context of the BCR-ABL fusion. While this variant has not been functionally validated, it was associated with resistance to imatinib in patients with BCR-ABL positive chronic myeloid leukemia (PMID: 21562040). In vitro studies with Ba/F3 cells expressing ABL1 M244V demonstrate resistance to asciminib as measured by sustained cellular viability (Abstract: Leyte-Vidal et al. Myeloprolif. Syndromes & CML: Basic & Translational, Blood 2022 Vol. 140, Suppl. 1. https://ashpublications.org/blood/article/140/Supplement%201/9606/490327/Select-P-Loop-Mutants-in-BCR-ABL1-Confer-Moderate).

var_description_zh: 在BCR-ABL融合的背景下观察到ABL1 A380T突变。尽管该突变本身没有功能特征，但在接受伊马替尼（PMID:29434953）治疗的BCR-ABL阳性慢性粒细胞白血病患者中，该突变被鉴定为获得性耐药突变。在BCR-ABL融合的背景下，突变的临床前研究表明，通过治疗后的持续细胞活力（PMID:12393636）来衡量对伊马替尼的耐药性。
var_description: The ABL1 A380T mutation is observed in the context of the BCR-ABL fusion. Although not functionally characterized per se, this mutation was identified as an acquired resistance mutation in patients with BCR-ABL-positive chronic myeloid leukemia following treatment with imatinib (PMID: 29434953). Preclinical studies of the mutation in the context of BCR-ABL fusion demonstrate resistance to imatinib as measured by sustained cellular viability folowing treatment (PMID: 12393636).

var_description_zh: 在BCR-ABL融合的背景下观察到ABL1 L273M突变。尽管该突变本身没有功能特征，但在伊马替尼治疗后的BCR-ABL阳性慢性髓性白血病患者中，该突变被鉴定为获得性耐药突变（PMID:34292760，20595523，19837125）。计算机分析表明该突变对伊马替尼和博舒替尼耐药（PMID:28475010）。
var_description: The ABL1 L273M mutation is observed in the context of the BCR-ABL fusion. Although not functionally characterized per se, this mutation was identified as an acquired resistance mutation in patients with BCR-ABL-positive chronic myeloid leukemia following treatment with imatinib (PMID: 34292760, 20595523, 19837125). In silico analysis suggests that the mutation is resistant to imatinib and bosutinib (PMID: 28475010).

var_description_zh: 在BCR-ABL融合的情况下观察到ABL1 V468F突变。用表达ABL1 V468F的BA/F3细胞进行的体外研究表明，通过与野生型相比增加的转化和激酶活性（PMID:27890928）来测量，该突变是激活的。在BCR-ABL的背景下，该突变的临床前研究表明，通过治疗后的持续细胞活力（PMID:27890928，28329763）来测量对阿西替尼的耐药性。
var_description: The ABL1 V468F mutation is observed in the context of the BCR-ABL fusion. In vitro studies with Ba/F3 cells expressing ABL1 V468F demonstrate that the mutation is activating as measured by increased transformation and kinase activity compared to wildtype (PMID: 27890928). Preclinical studies of this mutation in the context of BCR-ABL demonstrate resistance to asciminib as measured by sustained cellular viability following treatment (PMID: 27890928, 28329763).

var_description_zh: NUP214-ABL1融合是由于染色体9q上的ABL1基因易位到NUP214基因，NUP214断裂点不同于外显子34-35，而ABL1断裂点出现在外显子1（PMID:15361874）。在T-ALL中发现了这种融合（PMID:15361874）。该融合蛋白在细胞系中的表达表明，通过融合蛋白和下游靶标CRKL的组成型磷酸化来测量，该融合蛋白和下游靶标CRKL在用伊马替尼处理后可被抑制（PMID:15361874）。
var_description: The NUP214-ABL1 fusion results from the translocation of the ABL1 gene to the NUP214 gene on chromosome 9q, with the NUP214 breakpoint varying from exon 34-35 and the ABL1 breakpoint occurring in exon 1 (PMID: 15361874). This fusion has been found in T-ALL (PMID:15361874). Expression of this fusion in cell lines demonstrated that it is activating as measured by constitutive phosphorylation of the fusion and downstream target CRKL that can be inhibited upon treatment with imatinib (PMID:15361874).

var_description_zh: 在BCR-ABL融合中观察到ABL1 F359V突变。虽然该变异体尚未得到功能验证，但它与BCR-ABL阳性慢性粒细胞白血病患者对尼洛替尼的耐药性相关（PMID:21562040）。
var_description: The ABL1 F359V mutation is observed in the context of the BCR-ABL fusion. While this variant has not been functionally validated, it was associated with resistance to nilotinib in patients with BCR-ABL positive chronic myeloid leukemia (PMID: 21562040).

var_description_zh: 在BCR-ABL融合的情况下观察到ABL1 L384M突变。虽然这种变异尚未得到功能验证，但它与BCR-ABL阳性慢性粒细胞白血病患者对伊马替尼的耐药性有关（PMID:21562040）。用表达ABL1 L384M的BA/F3细胞进行的体外研究证明了对普纳替尼的敏感性（PMID:28983061）。
var_description: The ABL1 L384M mutation is observed in the context of the BCR-ABL fusion. While this variant has not been functionally validated, it was associated with resistance to imatinib in patients with BCR-ABL positive chronic myeloid leukemia (PMID: 21562040). In vitro studies with Ba/F3 cells expressing ABL1 L384M demonstrate sensitivity to ponatinib (PMID: 28983061).

var_description_zh: 在BCR-ABL融合中观察到ABL1 Y253H突变。虽然与单独的BCR-ABL相比，BCR-ABL Y253H没有生长优势，但它与BCR-Abl阳性慢性粒细胞白血病患者对伊马替尼的耐药性有关（PMID:16482207）。
var_description: The ABL1 Y253H mutation is observed in the context of the BCR-ABL fusion. While BCR-ABL Y253H does not have a growth advantage compared to BCR-ABL alone, it is associated with resistance to imatinib in patients with BCR-ABL positive chronic myeloid leukemia (PMID: 16482207).

var_description_zh: 在BCR-ABL融合的背景下观察到ABL1 E279K突变。虽然该变异体尚未得到功能验证，但它与BCR-ABL阳性慢性粒细胞白血病患者对尼洛替尼的耐药性有关（PMID:21562040）。ABL1 E279K的体外抗性筛选证明了对伊马替尼、PD166326和AP23464的抗性，如通过治疗后的持续细胞活力所测量的（PMID:16754879）。
var_description: The ABL1 E279K mutation is observed in the context of the BCR-ABL fusion. While this variant has not been functionally validated, it is associated with resistance to nilotinib in patients with BCR-ABL positive chronic myeloid leukemia (PMID: 21562040). In vitro resistance screens of ABL1 E279K demonstrate resistance to imatinib, PD166326 and AP23464 as measured by sustained cellular viability following treatment (PMID: 16754879).

var_description_zh: 在BCR-ABL融合中观察到ABL1 G463D突变。尽管该突变本身没有功能特征，但在阿西替尼治疗后的BCR-ABL阳性慢性粒细胞白血病患者中，该突变被鉴定为获得性耐药突变（PMID:31826340，36949155）。
var_description: The ABL1 G463D mutation is observed in the context of the BCR-ABL fusion. Although not functionally characterized per se, this mutation was identified as an acquired resistance mutation in patients with BCR-ABL-positive chronic myeloid leukemia following treatment with asciminib (PMID: 31826340, 36949155).

var_description_zh: Akt1 E191A突变位于蛋白质的Pleckstrin同源结构域和激酶结构域之间。该突变在小鼠B细胞系中的表达表明，与野生型相比，通过增加的蛋白活化和生长因子非依赖性增殖来测量，该突变是中度活化的（PMID:23134728）。
var_description: The AKT1 E191A mutation is located in between the pleckstrin homology domain and the kinase domain of the protein. Expression of this mutation in a murine B cell line demonstrated that it is moderately activating as measured by increased protein activation and growth factor-independent proliferation compared to wildtype (PMID: 23134728).

var_description_zh: Akt1 Q59E突变位于蛋白的Pleckstrin同源结构域和激酶结构域之间（PMID:23134728）。该突变在小鼠B细胞系中的表达证明其是中性的，这是通过与野生型相比蛋白活化或生长因子非依赖性增殖没有变化来测量的（PMID:23134728）。
var_description: The AKT1 Q59E mutation is located in between the pleckstrin homology domain and the kinase domain of the protein (PMID: 23134728). Expression of this mutation in a murine B cell line demonstrated that it is neutral as measured by no change in protein activation or growth factor-independent proliferation compared to wildtype (PMID: 23134728).

var_description_zh: Akt1 L52R突变位于该蛋白的Pleckstrin同源结构域。该突变已在乳腺癌中发现（PMID:28572459）。与野生型相比，该突变在乳腺癌、胚胎肾和鼠成纤维细胞系中的表达证明其是活化的，如通过在异种移植模型中增加的蛋白和途径活化、锚定非依赖性生长和肿瘤生长所测量的（PMID:23134728，27147599）。L52残基的结构分析表明，该残基的任何突变都将导致蛋白质的组成型激活（PMID:20886116，23134728）。
var_description: The AKT1 L52R mutation is located in the pleckstrin homology domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in breast cancer (PMID: 28572459). Expression of this mutation in breast cancer, embryonic kidney and murine fibroblast cell lines demonstrated that it is activating as measured by increased protein and pathway activation, anchorage-independent growth and tumor growth in a xenograft model compared to wildtype (PMID: 23134728, 27147599). Structural analysis of the L52 residue suggests that any mutation at this residue will lead to constitutive activation of the protein (PMID: 20886116, 23134728).

var_description_zh: Akt1 R121W突变位于蛋白的Pleckstrin同源结构域和激酶结构域之间。该突变在小鼠B细胞和乳腺上皮细胞系中的表达表明，通过在缺乏生长因子的情况下不能增殖来测量，它可能是中性的（PMID:29533785）。
var_description: The AKT1 R121W mutation is located in between the pleckstrin homology domain and the kinase domain of the protein. Expression of this mutation in murine B-cell and breast epithelial cell lines demonstrated that it is likely neutral as measured by the failure to proliferate in the absence of growth factors (PMID: 29533785).

var_description_zh: Akt1 R23A突变位于蛋白的Pleckstrin同源结构域和激酶结构域之间。该突变在小鼠B细胞系中的表达表明，与野生型相比，通过适度增加的生长因子非依赖性增殖来测量，该突变可能是活化的，尽管蛋白活化没有变化（PMID:23134728）。
var_description: The AKT1 R23A mutation is located in between the pleckstrin homology domain and the kinase domain of the protein. Expression of this mutation in a murine B cell line demonstrated that it is likely activating as measured by moderately increased growth factor-independent proliferation compared to wildtype, although there was no change in protein activation (PMID: 23134728).

var_description_zh: AKT1 Q79E突变位于蛋白的Pleckstrin同源结构域和激酶结构域之间。该突变在小鼠B细胞系中的表达表明，与野生型相比，通过适度增加的生长因子非依赖性增殖来测量，该突变是激活的（PMID:23134728）。
var_description: The AKT1 Q79E mutation is located in between the pleckstrin homology domain and the kinase domain of the protein. Expression of this mutation in a murine B cell line demonstrated that it is activating as measured by moderately increased growth factor-independent proliferation compared to wildtype (PMID: 23134728).

var_description_zh: Akt1扩增导致该蛋白的过表达。这种改变虽然罕见，但已在包括乳腺癌和肺癌在内的各种癌症中发现（PMID:17616691，12631397，3037531，14655756，24896186）。在乳腺癌中，免疫组织化学分析显示在24%的携带Akt1扩增的肿瘤中Akt1染色升高（PMID:12631397）。Akt1在小鼠成纤维细胞系中的过表达表明其可能是中性的，如通过细胞转化的无变化所测量的；然而，组成型激活的Akt1的过表达表明其被激活，如通过在异种移植模型中增加的集落形成和肿瘤形成所测量的（PMID:11485901）。
var_description: AKT1 amplification results in overexpression of the protein. This alteration, though rare, has been found in various cancers including breast and lung cancers, among others (PMID: 17616691, 12631397, 3037531, 14655756, 24896186). In breast cancers, immunohistochemical analysis demonstrated elevated AKT1 staining in 24% of the tumors harboring AKT1 amplification (PMID: 12631397). Overexpression of AKT1 in a murine fibroblast cell line demonstrated that it was likely neutral as measured by no change in cellular transformation; however, overexpression of constitutively activated AKT1 demonstrated that it was activating as measured by increased colony formation and tumor formation in a xenograft model (PMID:11485901).

var_description_zh: Akt1 D323H突变位于蛋白质的激酶结构域中。该突变已在乳腺癌中发现（PMID:23134728）。该突变在乳腺和鼠成纤维细胞系中的表达证明其是活化的，如通过与野生型相比增加的激酶活性、途径活化、细胞增殖、集落形成和体内肿瘤形成所示（PMID:23134728，20886116）。
var_description: The AKT1 D323H mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in breast cancer (PMID: 23134728). Expression of this mutation in breast and murine fibroblast cell lines demonstrated that it is activating, as shown by increased kinase activity, pathway activation, cell proliferation, colony formation and in vivo tumor formation compared to wildtype (PMID: 23134728, 20886116).

var_description_zh: Akt1 N53A突变位于蛋白的Pleckstrin同源结构域和激酶结构域之间。该突变在小鼠B细胞系中的表达表明，通过与野生型相比适度增加的生长因子非依赖性增殖来测量，该突变是活化的（PMID:23134728）。
var_description: The AKT1 N53A mutation is located in between the pleckstrin homology domain and the kinase domain of the protein. Expression of this mutation in a murine B cell line demonstrated that it is activating as measured by moderately increased growth factor-independent proliferation compared to wildtype (PMID: 23134728).

var_description_zh: Akt1 F55Y突变位于蛋白质的Pleckstrin同源（pH）结构域中。该突变已在乳腺癌中发现（PMID:28481359）。该突变在小鼠B细胞系中的表达表明，与野生型相比，通过增加的蛋白活化和适度增加的生长因子非依赖性增殖来测量，该突变是活化的（PMID:23134728）。
var_description: The AKT1 F55Y mutation is located in the pleckstrin homology (PH) domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in breast cancer (PMID: 28481359). Expression of this mutation in a murine B-cell line demonstrated that it is activating as measured by increased protein activation and moderately increased growth factor-independent proliferation compared to wildtype (PMID: 23134728).

var_description_zh: Akt1 T 65_I75dup突变位于该蛋白的Pleckstrin同源（pH）结构域。该突变已在乳腺癌中被鉴定，并且是统计学上显著的热点（PMID:28481359）。用表达Akt1 T 65_I75dup的MCF10A细胞进行的体外研究表明，与野生型（PMID:35440569）相比，通过蛋白质的过度磷酸化和PI-3K途径的生长因子非依赖性激活来测量，该突变是激活的。
var_description: The AKT1 T65_I75dup mutation is located in the pleckstrin homology (PH) domain of the protein. This mutation has been identified in breast cancer and is a statistically significant hotspot (PMID: 28481359). In vitro studies with MCF10a cells expressing AKT1 T65_I75dup demonstrate that the mutation is activating as measured by hyperphosphorylation of the protein and growth factor-independent activation of the PI-3K pathway compared to wildtype (PMID: 35440569).

var_description_zh: Akt1 D323Y突变位于蛋白质的激酶结构域中。该突变已在前列腺癌中发现（PMID:26544944）。该突变在肺癌细胞系中的表达表明，通过在细胞增殖测定（PMID:27478040）中测定挽救厄洛替尼敏感性的能力，其可能被激活。
var_description: The AKT1 D323Y mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in prostate cancer (PMID: 26544944). Expression of this mutation in a lung cancer cell line demonstrated that it is likely activating as measured by the ability to rescue erlotinib sensitivity in a cell proliferation assay (PMID: 27478040).

var_description_zh: Akt1 L362R突变位于蛋白质的Pleckstrin同源结构域和激酶结构域之间（PMID:23134728）。该突变在小鼠B细胞系中的表达表明，其可能是中性的，这是通过与野生型相比蛋白活化或生长因子非依赖性增殖没有变化来测量的（PMID:23134728）。
var_description: The AKT1 L362R mutation is located in between the pleckstrin homology domain and the kinase domain of the protein (PMID: 23134728). Expression of this mutation in a murine B cell line demonstrated that it is likely neutral as measured by no change in protein activation or growth factor-independent proliferation compared to wildtype (PMID: 23134728).

var_description_zh: Akt1 E40K突变位于该蛋白的Pleckstrin同源结构域。该突变已在肠癌和卵巢癌中发现（PMID:28481359）。该突变在鼠成纤维细胞和鸡胚成纤维细胞中的表达以及结构建模和生化分析表明，与野生型相比，通过增加的蛋白活性、途径活化、集落形成和体内肿瘤形成来测量，该突变是活化的（PMID:9690513，9843996）。
var_description: The AKT1 E40K mutation is located in the pleckstrin homology domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in intestinal and ovarian cancer (PMID: 28481359). Expression of this mutation in murine fibroblast cells and chicken embryo fibroblast cells as well as structural modeling and biochemical assays demonstrated that it is activating as measured by increased protein activity, pathway activation, colony formation, and in vivo tumor formation compared to wildtype (PMID:9690513, 9843996).

var_description_zh: Akt1 R370C突变位于蛋白质的激酶结构域中。在结直肠癌中发现了这种突变。该突变在胚胎肾细胞中的表达表明，通过在三只植入的小鼠中的一只中的异种移植肿瘤形成（PMID:27147599）来测量，该突变可能被激活。

var_description_zh: Akt1 E17K突变位于蛋白的Pleckstrin同源结构域（PMID:17611497，20440266）。在组织过度生长状态的Proteus综合征和乳腺癌中发现了这种突变（PMID:21793738，28489509）。与野生型相比，该突变在乳腺癌细胞、鼠成纤维细胞、B细胞和白血病小鼠模型中的表达证明其是活化的，如通过体内增加的途径活化、生长因子非依赖性细胞增殖、集落形成和肿瘤形成所测量的（PMID:17611497，18256540，9843996，23134728，23741320）。体外研究表明，通过细胞增殖（PMID:17611497）测定，当在胚胎肾细胞系中表达时，该突变对ATP竞争性Akt抑制剂敏感。52名携带该突变的实体瘤患者表现出对Akt抑制剂AZD5363（PMID:28489509）的临床反应。在AACR Genie Consortium的一项研究中，比较了E17K突变乳腺癌患者与AKT1野生型患者的结果，总生存率没有显著差异，但携带E17K突变的患者接受mTOR抑制剂治疗的时间更长（PMID:31924700）。
var_description: The AKT1 E17K mutation is located in the pleckstrin homology domain of the protein (PMID: 17611497, 20440266). This mutation has been found in the tissue overgrowth condition Proteus syndrome and in breast cancer (PMID: 21793738, 28489509). Expression of this mutation in breast cancer cells, murine fibroblasts, B cells, and in a mouse model of leukemia demonstrated that it is activating as measured by increased pathway activation, growth factor-independent cell proliferation, colony formation and tumor formation in vivo compared to wildtype (PMID: 17611497, 18256540, 9843996, 23134728, 23741320). In vitro studies have demonstrated that this mutation is sensitive to ATP-competitive AKT inhibitors when expressed in an embryonic kidney cell line as measured by cell proliferation (PMID: 17611497). Fifty-two patients with solid tumors harboring this mutation demonstrated a clinical response to the AKT inhibitor AZD5363 (PMID: 28489509). In a study by the AACR GENIE consortium comparing outcomes of patients with E17K-mutant breast cancer to those who were AKT1-wildtype, there was no significant difference in overall survival, but patients harboring E17K alterations had longer duration on mTOR inhibitor therapy (PMID: 31924700).

var_description_zh: AKT1 Q79K突变位于该蛋白的Pleckstrin同源结构域。在黑色素瘤、乳腺癌和子宫内膜癌中发现了这种突变。该突变在乳腺癌细胞系和鼠成纤维细胞系中的表达证明其是活化的，如通过与野生型相比增加的途径活化、细胞增殖和集落形成所测量的（PMID:23134728）。表达AKT1 Q79K突变的黑色素瘤细胞的临床研究和体外研究表明，该突变是BRAF突变的黑色素瘤中获得性维莫非尼耐药性的一种机制，这是通过药物治疗后持续的细胞活力来测量的（PMID:24265152，24265155）。
var_description: The AKT1 Q79K mutation is located in the pleckstrin homology domain of the protein. This mutation is found in melanoma, breast and endometrial cancer. Expression of this mutation in a breast cancer cell line and murine fibroblast cell line demonstrated that it is activating as measured by increased pathway activation, cell proliferation and colony formation compared to wildtype (PMID: 23134728). Clinical studies and in vitro studies of melanoma cells expressing the AKT1 Q79K mutation suggest that this mutation is a mechanism of acquired vemurafenib resistance in BRAF-mutated melanoma as measured by sustained cell viability upon drug treatment (PMID: 24265152, 24265155).

var_description_zh: AKT1 K189N突变位于蛋白的Pleckstrin同源结构域和激酶结构域之间。在非小细胞肺癌中发现了这种突变（PMID:23134728）。这种突变的功能数据相互矛盾。该突变在小鼠B细胞系中的表达表明，与野生型相比，该突变在途径激活或生长因子非依赖性增殖方面没有变化，因此是中性的（PMID:23134728）。然而，该突变在乳腺上皮细胞系中的表达表明，与野生型相比，通过增加的途径活化和集落形成（PMID:23134728）来测量，该突变是活化的。

var_description_zh: Akt1 W80A突变位于该蛋白的Pleckstrin同源结构域。该突变已在乳腺癌中发现（PMID:28572459）。该突变在脂肪细胞中的表达表明，与野生型相比，通过增加的蛋白活化来测量，该突变是活化的（PMID:25856301）。体外研究已经证明，该突变在乳腺癌细胞和脂肪细胞中对Akt抑制剂MK2206具有抗性，如通过药物治疗后的持续蛋白活化所测量的（PMID:25856301，25551293）。W80残基的结构分析表明它是变构Akt抑制剂结合的关键残基（PMID:18669636）。
var_description: The AKT1 W80A mutation is located in the pleckstrin homology domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in breast cancer (PMID: 28572459). Structural analysis of the W80 residue suggests that it is a critical residue for allosteric AKT inhibitor binding (PMID: 18669636).

var_description: The AKT1 R328A mutation is located in between the pleckstrin homology domain and the kinase domain of the protein (PMID: 23134728). Expression of this mutation in a murine B cell line demonstrated that it is activating as measured by moderately increased growth factor-independent proliferation compared to wildtype (PMID: 23134728).

var_description_zh: ALK G1201E突变位于该蛋白的细胞内酪氨酸激酶结构域（PMID:21383740）。在甲状腺癌中发现了这种突变（PMID:21596819）。这种突变的功能数据相互矛盾。该突变在大鼠肾上腺细胞中的表达表明其可能是中性的，因为与野生型相比，蛋白质和途径激活以及轴突生长没有变化（PMID:28030793）。然而，该突变在鼠成纤维细胞中的表达证明其是活化的，如通过增加的途径活化、细胞增殖、细胞侵袭和集落形成所测量的（PMID:28030793）。
var_description: The ALK G1201E mutation is located in the intracellular tyrosine kinase domain of the protein (PMID: 21383740). This mutation has been found in thyroid cancer (PMID: 21596819). There is conflicting functional data for this mutation. Expression of this mutation in rat adrenal cells demonstrated that it is likely neutral as measured by no change in protein and pathway activation and neurite outgrowth compared to wildtype (PMID: 28030793). However, expression of this mutation in murine fibroblast cells demonstrated that it is activating as measured by increased pathway activation, cell proliferation, cell invasion, and colony formation (PMID: 28030793).

var_description_zh: ALK Y1278S突变位于该蛋白的酪氨酸激酶结构域。该突变已在神经母细胞瘤中发现（PMID:23598171，25071110）。该突变在体外和鼠成纤维细胞、大鼠肾上腺和神经母细胞瘤细胞系中的表达表明，与野生型相比，通过增加的蛋白活性、细胞活力、细胞增殖和病灶形成（PMID:25517749，27049722），该突变被激活。体外研究表明，当在体外和大鼠肾上腺和鼠成纤维细胞中表达时，该突变对ALK抑制剂克唑替尼具有抗性，这通过药物治疗后的持续蛋白活性和细胞增殖来测量（PMID:25517749，27049722）。两名携带该突变的神经母细胞瘤患者服用克唑替尼后疾病进展，但其中一名患者随后对氯拉替尼有部分反应（PMID:23598171）（摘要：Vasseur等人，JCO Po，2019 https：//ascopubs.org/doi/full/10.1200/PO.18.00396）。
var_description: The ALK Y1278S mutation is located in the tyrosine kinase domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in neuroblastoma (PMID: 23598171, 25071110). Expression of this mutation in vitro and in murine fibroblast, rat adrenal and neuroblastoma cell lines demonstrated it is activating as measured by increased protein activity, cell viability, cell proliferation, and foci formation compared to wildtype (PMID: 25517749, 27049722). In vitro studies demonstrate that this mutation is resistant to the ALK inhibitor crizotinib when expressed in vitro and in rat adrenal and murine fibroblast cells as measured by sustained protein activity and cell proliferation upon drug treatment (PMID: 25517749, 27049722). Two patients with neuroblastoma harboring this mutation had progressive disease on crizotinib but one of these patients subsequently had a partial response to lorlatinib (PMID: 23598171)(Abstract: Vasseur et al. JCO PO, 2019. https://ascopubs.org/doi/full/10.1200/PO.18.00396).

var_description_zh: Lamtor1-Akt1融合涉及Lamtor1的N-末端与Akt1的C-末端融合，含有Akt1连接区、激酶结构域和疏水区，但缺少调节Pleckstrin同源结构域。这种突变已在血红素恶性肿瘤中发现。该突变在患者来源的细胞系和异种移植模型中的表达表明，通过组成型激活的激酶活性和定位于细胞质（PMID:30877085）来测量，该突变是激活的。体内小鼠研究表明，该突变对AKT抑制剂如MK2206具有抗性，如通过药物治疗后持续的肿瘤负荷所测量的，但对AKT抑制剂Ipatasertib和mTORC1抑制剂坦罗莫司的组合敏感，如通过药物治疗后减少的肿瘤负荷所测量的。一名携带该突变的组织病理学上不确定的上皮样肿瘤患者表现出最初的快速反应，但随后发展为Ipatasertib（PMID:30877085）。
var_description: The LAMTOR1-AKT1 fusion involves the N-terminus of LAMTOR1 fused to the C-terminus of AKT1, containing the AKT1 linker region, kinase domain and hydrophobic region but lacking the regulatory pleckstrin homology domain. This mutation has been found in heme malignancies. Expression of this mutation in patient-derived cell line and xenograft models demonstrated it is activating as measured by constitutively activated kinase activity and localization to the cytoplasm (PMID: 30877085). In vivo mouse studies have demonstrated that this mutation is resistant to AKT inhibitors such as MK2206, as measured by sustained tumor burden upon drug treatment, but is sensitive to the combination of the AKT inhibitor ipatasertib and the mTORC1 inhibitor temsirolimus, as measured by reduced tumor burden upon drug treatment. One patient with a histopathologically indeterminate epithelioid neoplasm harboring this mutation demonstrated an initial rapid response but subsequent progression to ipatasertib (PMID: 30877085).

var_description_zh: CAD-ALK融合涉及CAD的N末端与ALK的C末端结合，包括ALK酪氨酸激酶结构域。虽然该融合蛋白尚未进行功能表征，但一名携带该突变的结肠癌患者对ALK抑制剂恩曲替尼（PMID:26633560）有客观反应。恩曲替尼治疗（PMID:28368455）后，在CAD-ALK患者的血浆循环肿瘤DNA中检测到几种继发性ALK突变，即F1174C、F1174L、F1245V和G1128A。
var_description: The CAD-ALK fusion involves the N-terminus of CAD combined with the C-terminus of ALK, including the ALK tyrosine kinase domain. While this fusion protein has not yet been functionally characterized, one patient with colon cancer harboring this mutation had an objective response to the ALK inhibitor entrectinib (PMID: 26633560). Several secondary ALK mutations, F1174C, F1174L, F1245V and G1128A, were detected in the plasma circulating tumor DNA of the CAD-ALK patient following entrectinib treatment (PMID: 28368455).

var_description_zh: ALK T1151dup突变位于该蛋白的酪氨酸激酶结构域。在肺癌中发现了这种突变（PMID:22277784）。体外研究表明，当在肺癌和鼠B细胞系中的EML4-ALK融合中表达时，该突变赋予对克唑替尼、阿来替尼和色瑞替尼的抗性，并且对氯拉替尼轻度敏感，如通过通路活化分析和药物治疗后的细胞增殖所测量的（PMID:22277784，24675041，26144315）。
var_description: The ALK T1151dup mutation is located in the tyrosine kinase domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in lung cancer (PMID: 22277784). In vitro studies demonstrate that this mutation confers resistance to crizotinib, alectinib and ceritinib and is mildly sensitive to lorlatinib when expressed in the context of an EML4-ALK fusion in lung cancer and murine B-cell lines as measured by pathway activation analysis and cell proliferation upon drug treatment (PMID: 22277784, 24675041, 26144315).

var_description_zh: ALK V597A突变位于该蛋白未鉴定的MAM结构域。在肺癌中发现了这种突变。该突变在非小细胞肺癌细胞系中的表达证明其是活化的，如通过与野生型相比在小鼠异种移植物中增加的蛋白和途径活化以及增加的肿瘤形成所测量的（PMID:21847362）。
var_description: The ALK V597A mutation is located in the uncharacterized MAM domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in lung cancer. Expression of this mutation in a non-small cell lung cancer cell line demonstrated that it is activating as measured by increased protein and pathway activation and increased tumor formation in mouse xenografts compared to wildtype (PMID: 21847362).

var_description_zh: ALK A1099T突变位于蛋白的酪氨酸激酶结构域。该突变已在神经母细胞瘤中发现（PMID:23104988）。该突变在神经母细胞瘤和大鼠肾上腺细胞中的表达表明其可能是中性的，因为与野生型相比，蛋白质或途径激活没有变化（PMID:23104988）。体外研究表明，当在大鼠肾上腺细胞中表达时，该突变对ALK抑制剂克唑替尼（克唑替尼）敏感，这通过药物治疗后轴突生长减少来测量（PMID:23104988）。
var_description: The ALK A1099T mutation is located in the tyrosine kinase domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in neuroblastoma (PMID: 23104988). Expression of this mutation in neuroblastoma and rat adrenal cells demonstrated it is likely neutral as measured by no change in protein or pathway activation compared to wildtype (PMID: 23104988). In vitro studies demonstrate that this mutation is sensitive to the ALK inhibitor crizotinib when expressed in rat adrenal cells as measured by decreased neurite outgrowth upon drug treatment (PMID: 23104988).

var_description_zh: ALK F1174L突变位于蛋白的酪氨酸激酶结构域。该突变已在神经母细胞瘤和肺癌中发现（PMID:18923525，21030459，28434515，27432227）。该突变被鉴定为携带用ALK抑制剂恩曲替尼（PMID:28368455）治疗的CAD-ALK融合的结直肠癌患者的血浆循环肿瘤DNA中出现的继发性突变。该突变在鼠成纤维细胞和B细胞系中的体外表达，以及在神经母细胞瘤细胞系中的内源性表达表明，与野生型相比，其在异种移植模型中通过增加的蛋白活化、集落形成、细胞活力和增殖、侵袭力和肿瘤形成而被激活（PMID:25517749，18724359，18923524，18923525，207 19933，21242967，23104988，22072639，18923523，21596819）。体外和体内研究表明，当在神经母细胞瘤、鼠细胞和大鼠肾上腺细胞中表达时，该突变对ALK抑制剂克唑替尼具有抗性，但对氯拉替尼和布里加替尼敏感，这通过药物治疗后的细胞增殖和通路激活来测量（PMID:26554404，27049722，23104988，22072639）。体外研究还表明，该突变对克唑替尼（克唑替尼）、色瑞替尼和阿来替尼具有耐药性，但在ALK融合中表达时对氯拉替尼（劳拉替尼）敏感，这是通过药物治疗后的通路激活和细胞增殖来衡量的（PMID:26144315，27009859，21030459，22072639，21948233）。在7名携带该突变的肿瘤患者中，5名患者在服用克唑替尼后出现进展，2名患者在服用色瑞替尼后出现进展（PMID:18923525，21030459，28434515，27432227）。
var_description: The ALK F1174L mutation is located in the tyrosine kinase domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in neuroblastoma and lung cancer (PMID: 18923525, 21030459, 28434515, 27432227). This mutation was identified as an emerged secondary mutation in the plasma circulating tumor DNA of a colorectal cancer patient harboring the CAD-ALK fusion treated with ALK inhibitor entrectinib (PMID: 28368455). Expression of this mutation in vitro, in murine fibroblast and B-cell cell lines, and endogenous expression in a neuroblastoma cell line demonstrated that it is activating as measured by increased protein activation, colony formation, cell viability and proliferation, invasiveness and tumor formation in a xenograft model compared to wildtype (PMID: 25517749, 18724359, 18923524, 18923525, 20719933, 21242967, 23104988, 22072639, 18923523, 21596819). In vitro and in vivo studies demonstrate that this mutation is resistant to the ALK inhibitor crizotinib but sensitive to lorlatinib and brigatinib when expressed in neuroblastoma, murine cells and rat adrenal cells as measured by cell proliferation and pathway activation upon drug treatment (PMID: 26554404, 27049722, 23104988, 22072639). In vitro studies also demonstrate that this mutation is resistant to crizotinib, ceritinib and alectinib but sensitive to lorlatinib when expressed in the context of ALK fusions as measured by pathway activation and cell proliferation upon drug treatment (PMID: 26144315, 27009859, 21030459, 22072639, 21948233). In seven patients with tumors harboring this mutation, five patients progressed on crizotinib and two patients progressed on ceritinib (PMID: 18923525, 21030459, 28434515, 27432227).

var_description_zh: ALK R291C突变位于蛋白的MAM结构域1。该突变已在结直肠癌中鉴定（PMID:24755471，26336987）。一名携带ALK R291C和EML4-ALK融合基因的非小细胞肺癌患者接受了克唑替尼治疗，并显示出12个月的无进展生存期（PMID:36502690），尽管该患者本身没有功能特征。
var_description: The ALK R291C mutation is located in the MAM domain 1 of the protein. This mutation has been identified in colorectal cancer (PMID: 24755471, 26336987). Although not functionally characterized per se, a patient with non-small cell lung cancer harboring ALK R291C and EML4-ALK fusion was treated with crizotinib and demonstrated progression-free survival for 12 months (PMID: 36502690).

var_description_zh: ALK R1231Q突变位于该蛋白的细胞内酪氨酸激酶结构域。该突变已在神经母细胞瘤中发现（PMID:20719933）。该突变在鼠成纤维细胞中的表达证明它是中性的，如通过与野生型相比集落形成没有变化所测量的（PMID:23104988）。
var_description: The ALK R1231Q mutation is located in the intracellular tyrosine kinase domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in neuroblastoma (PMID: 20719933). Expression of this mutation in murine fibroblast cells demonstrated that it is neutral as measured by no change in colony formation compared to wildtype (PMID: 23104988).

var_description_zh: ALK I1183T突变位于该蛋白的细胞内酪氨酸激酶结构域（PMID:21383740）。该突变已在神经母细胞瘤中发现（PMID:26503946）。该突变在鼠成纤维细胞中的表达表明其可能是中性的，如通过与野生型相比集落形成无变化所测量的（pMID:25517749）。
var_description: The ALK I1183T mutation is located in the intracellular tyrosine kinase domain of the protein (PMID: 21383740). This mutation has been found in neuroblastoma (PMID: 26503946). Expression of this mutation in murine fibroblast cells demonstrated that it is likely neutral as measured by no change in colony formation compared to wildtype (PMID: 25517749).

var_description_zh: ALK T1087I突变位于蛋白的跨膜结构域（PMID:21383740）。该突变在鼠成纤维细胞中的表达证明其可能是中性的，这是通过与野生型相比蛋白活化或细胞增殖没有变化来测量的（PMID:23104988）。
var_description: The ALK T1087I mutation is located in the transmembrane domain of the protein (PMID: 21383740).  Expression of this mutation in murine fibroblast cells demonstrated that it is likely neutral as measured by no change in protein activation or cell proliferation compared to wildtype (PMID: 23104988).

var_description_zh: ALK K1062M突变位于蛋白的近膜区（PMID:21383740）。该突变已在神经母细胞瘤中发现（PMID:18923524）。该突变在成纤维细胞中的表达表明，与野生型相比，通过增加的蛋白质和途径激活、细胞侵袭和集落形成来测量，该突变是激活的（PMID:18923524，21596819）。
var_description: The ALK K1062M mutation is located in the juxtamembrane domain of the protein (PMID: 21383740). This mutation has been found in neuroblastoma (PMID: 18923524). Expression of this mutation in fibroblast cells demonstrated that it is activating as measured by increased protein and pathway activation, cell invasion, and colony formation compared to wildtype (PMID: 18923524, 21596819).

var_description_zh: ALK H694R突变位于该蛋白的未鉴定结构域中。在肺癌中发现了这种突变。该突变在非小细胞肺癌细胞系中的表达证明其是活化的，如通过与野生型相比在小鼠异种移植物中增加的蛋白和途径活化以及增加的肿瘤形成所测量的（PMID:21847362）。
var_description: The ALK H694R mutation is located in an uncharacterized domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in lung cancer. Expression of this mutation in a non-small cell lung cancer cell line demonstrated that it is activating as measured by increased protein and pathway activation and increased tumor formation in mouse xenografts compared to wildtype (PMID: 21847362).

var_description_zh: ALK G1128A突变位于该蛋白的酪氨酸激酶结构域。该突变已在神经母细胞瘤和肺癌中发现（PMID:21632861，30089600）。该突变被鉴定为携带用ALK抑制剂恩曲替尼（PMID:28368455）治疗的CAD-ALK融合的结直肠癌患者的血浆循环肿瘤DNA中出现的继发性突变。该突变在体外以及在大鼠肾上腺和鼠成纤维细胞中的表达表明，与野生型相比，通过增加的蛋白活化、细胞活力和集落形成来测量，该突变是活化的（PMID:25517749，27049722）。体外研究表明，当在小鼠成纤维细胞和大鼠肾上腺细胞中表达时，该突变对ALK抑制剂克唑替尼（克唑替尼）具有抗性，但对布里加替尼（布加替尼）敏感，这是通过药物治疗后的细胞活力来测量的（PMID:25517749）。
var_description: The ALK G1128A mutation is located in the tyrosine kinase domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in neuroblastoma and lung cancer (PMID: 21632861, 30089600). This mutation was identified as an emerged secondary mutation in the plasma circulating tumor DNA of a colorectal cancer patient harboring the CAD-ALK fusion treated with ALK inhibitor entrectinib (PMID: 28368455). Expression of this mutation in vitro and in rat adrenal and murine fibroblast cells demonstrated that it is activating as measured by increased protein activation, cell viability, and colony formation compared to wildtype (PMID: 25517749, 27049722). In vitro studies demonstrate that this mutation is resistant to the ALK inhibitor crizotinib but sensitive to brigatinib when expressed in murine fibroblasts and rat adrenal cells as measured by cell viability upon drug treatment (PMID: 25517749).

var_description_zh: EML4-ALK融合涉及EML4的N末端与ALK的C末端结合，包括ALK酪氨酸激酶结构域。在非小细胞肺癌中发现了这种突变（PMID:22277784）。EML-ALK融合蛋白在非小细胞肺癌和造血细胞中的表达表明，通过增加的蛋白和途径激活（PMID:21030459，21613408，21613408，21791641，21948233，22235099，22277784，24675041，25228534）来测量其激活。在细胞系和异种移植模型中，这种改变已被广泛证明对ALK抑制剂克唑替尼敏感（PMID:24675041，21030459）。在一份病例报告中，一名携带EML4-ALK和ALK V1180L的非小细胞肺癌患者最初接受阿列替尼治疗并表现出耐药性，诱导非小细胞肺癌向小细胞肺癌转化，随后接受氯拉替尼治疗并表现出部分缓解（PMID:37907052）。
var_description: The EML4-ALK fusion involves the N-terminus of EML4 combined with the C-terminus of ALK, including the ALK tyrosine kinase domain. This mutation has been found in non-small cell lung cancer (PMID: 22277784). Expression of the EML-ALK fusion in non-small cell lung cancer and hematopoietic cells demonstrated that it is activating as measured by increased protein and pathway activation (PMID:21030459, 21613408, 21613408, 21791641, 21948233, 22235099, 22277784, 24675041, 25228534).  In cell line and xenograft models, this alteration has been widely shown to be sensitive to the ALK inhibitor crizotinib (PMID: 24675041, 21030459). In a case report, a patient with non-small cell lung cancer harboring EML4-ALK and ALK V1180L was initially treated with alectinib and demonstrated resistance, inducing non-small cell lung cancer to small cell lung cancer transformation, and was then subsequently treated with lorlatinib and demonstrated partial response (PMID: 37907052).

var_description_zh: ALK R1464*突变位于蛋白质的酪氨酸激酶结构域中。该突变在鼠成纤维细胞中的表达证明其可能是中性的，这是通过与野生型相比蛋白活化或细胞增殖没有变化来测量的（PMID:23104988）。
var_description: The ALK R1464* mutation is located in the tyrosine kinase domain of the protein. Expression of this mutation in murine fibroblast cells demonstrated that it is likely neutral as measured by no change in protein activation or cell proliferation compared to wildtype (PMID: 23104988).

var_description_zh: ALK D1203N突变位于蛋白的酪氨酸激酶结构域。已在非小细胞肺癌中发现该突变（PMID:21948233，25749034，25421750）。体外研究表明，当在小鼠B细胞中的EML4-ALK融合中表达时，该突变对克唑替尼具有耐药性，这是通过药物治疗后的持续增殖来测量的（PMID:21948233）。
var_description: The ALK D1203N mutation is located in the tyrosine kinase domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in non-small cell lung cancer (PMID: 21948233, 25749034, 25421750). In vitro studies demonstrate this mutation is resistant to crizotinib when expressed in the context of an EML4-ALK fusion in murine B-cells as measured by sustained proliferation upon drug treatment (PMID: 21948233).

var_description_zh: ALK L1204F突变位于蛋白质的激酶结构域中。用表达ALK L1204F的NIH3T3细胞进行的体外研究表明，通过与野生型（PMID:33674381）相当的转化和激酶活性测量，突变可能是中性的。
var_description: The ALK L1204F mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein. In vitro studies with NIH3T3 cells expressing ALK L1204F demonstrate that the mutation is likely neutral as measured by transformation and kinase activity comparable to wildtype (PMID: 33674381).

var_description_zh: ALK G1269S突变位于该蛋白的细胞内酪氨酸激酶结构域（PMID:21383740）。在肺癌中发现了这种突变（PMID:23344087）。体外和体内研究表明，当在肺癌和鼠B细胞系中的EML4-ALK融合中表达时，该突变对克唑替尼具有抗性，但对色瑞替尼敏感，如通过药物治疗后的蛋白活化、细胞增殖和肿瘤生长所测量的（PMID:24675041，22034911，21948233）。
var_description: The ALK G1269S mutation is located in the intracellular tyrosine kinase domain of the protein (PMID: 21383740). This mutation has been found in lung cancer (PMID:  23344087). In vitro and in vivo studies demonstrate that this mutation is resistant to crizotinib but sensitive to ceritinib when expressed in the context of an EML4-ALK fusion in lung cancer and murine B-cell lines as measured by protein activation, cell proliferation and tumor growth upon drug treatment (PMID: 24675041, 22034911, 21948233).

var_description_zh: ALK I1171S突变位于蛋白的酪氨酸激酶结构域。该突变已在肺癌和神经母细胞瘤中发现（PMID:26464158，27009859）。虽然这种突变仅在ALK融合的情况下被表征，但体外研究表明，它对ALK抑制剂克唑替尼和阿列替尼具有耐药性，但当在淋巴瘤细胞系中表达时，通过药物治疗后的增殖来衡量，它对布里加替尼敏感（PMID:27009859）。一名ALK融合阳性肺癌患者在阿列替尼治疗后出现ALK I1171S突变（PMID:26464158）。
var_description: The ALK I1171S mutation is located in the tyrosine kinase domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in lung cancer and neuroblastoma (PMID: 26464158, 27009859). While this mutation has only been characterized in the context of an ALK fusion, in vitro studies have shown it confers resistance to the ALK inhibitors crizotinib  and alectinib but is sensitive to brigatinib when expressed in lymphoma cell lines as measured by proliferation upon drug treatment (PMID: 27009859). One patient with ALK-fusion positive lung cancer developed an ALK I1171S mutation upon progression on alectinib (PMID: 26464158).

var_description_zh: ALK G1202R突变位于该蛋白的酪氨酸激酶结构域。该突变已在肺癌中发现（PMID:22277784，24736079，24675041，29376144，27130468，27432227）。体外和体内研究表明，该突变对ALK抑制剂克唑替尼（克唑替尼）、色瑞替尼、阿来替尼和布加替尼具有抗性，但对氯拉替尼（劳拉替尼）敏感，当在肺癌和鼠B细胞系中的EML4-ALK融合中表达时，通过药物治疗后的持续蛋白活化、细胞活力和肿瘤生长进行测量（PMID:29650534，26698910，22277784，24675041，26144315）。此外，共表达另一种耐药突变L1196M和G1202R突变的EML4-ALK阳性细胞对克唑替尼、阿列替尼、色瑞替尼、布加替尼和劳拉替尼高度耐药，这是通过药物治疗后的持续蛋白活化和细胞活力来测量的（PMID:29650534）。
var_description: The ALK G1202R mutation is located in the tyrosine kinase domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in lung cancer (PMID: 22277784, 24736079, 24675041, 29376144, 27130468, 27432227). In vitro and in vivo studies demonstrate that this mutation is resistant to the ALK inhibitors crizotinib, ceritinib, alectinib and brigatinib but is sensitive to lorlatinib when expressed in the context of an EML4-ALK fusion in lung cancer and murine B-cell lines as measured by sustained protein activation, cell viability and tumor growth upon drug treatment (PMID: 29650534, 26698910, 22277784, 24675041, 26144315). Additionally, EML4-ALK-positive cells co-expressing another resistance mutation, L1196M, with the G1202R mutation are highly resistant to crizotinib, alectinib, ceritinib, brigatinib and lorlatinib as measured by sustained protein activation and cell viability upon drug treatment (PMID: 29650534).

var_description_zh: ALK A1234T突变位于该蛋白的酪氨酸激酶结构域。该突变已在神经母细胞瘤和肺癌中发现（PMID:18923525，18428421）。该突变在神经母细胞瘤和大鼠肾上腺细胞中的表达表明其可能是中性的，因为与野生型相比，蛋白质或途径激活没有变化（PMID:23104988）。体外研究表明，当在大鼠肾上腺细胞中表达时，该突变对ALK抑制剂克唑替尼（克唑替尼）敏感，这通过药物治疗后轴突生长减少来测量（PMID:23104988）。
var_description: The ALK A1234T mutation is located in the tyrosine kinase domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in neuroblastoma and lung cancer (PMID: 18923525, 18428421). Expression of this mutation in neuroblastoma and rat adrenal cells demonstrated it is likely neutral as measured by no change in protein or pathway activation compared to wildtype (PMID: 23104988). In vitro studies demonstrate that this mutation is sensitive to the ALK inhibitor crizotinib when expressed in rat adrenal cells as measured by decreased neurite outgrowth upon drug treatment (PMID: 23104988).

var_description_zh: ALK T1151K突变位于蛋白的酪氨酸激酶结构域。体外研究表明，当在肺癌细胞系中的EML4-ALK融合中表达时，该突变对克唑替尼具有抗性，这是通过药物治疗后的持续细胞活力来测量的（PMID:22034911）。一名具有EML4-ALK融合的肺癌患者在使用克唑替尼和色瑞替尼（PMID:28676215）进展后获得了该突变。
var_description: The ALK T1151K mutation is located in the tyrosine kinase domain of the protein. In vitro studies demonstrate that this mutation is resistant to crizotinib when expressed in the context of an EML4-ALK fusion in lung cancer cell lines as measured by sustained cell viability upon drug treatment (PMID: 22034911). One patient with lung cancer with the EML4-ALK fusion acquired this mutation after progression on crizotinib and ceritinib (PMID: 28676215).

var_description_zh: KIF5B-ALK融合涉及KIF5B的N末端与ALK的C末端结合，包括ALK酪氨酸激酶结构域。该融合蛋白在鼠成纤维细胞中的表达表明，与载体对照（pMID:21613408，26144315）相比，通过增加的蛋白和途径活化以及增加的增殖来测量，该融合蛋白是活化的。体外研究表明，当在人胚胎肾细胞中表达时，该突变对ALK抑制剂克唑替尼敏感，如通过药物治疗后增殖减少所测量的（PMID:21613408）。
var_description: The KIF5B-ALK fusion involves the N-terminus of KIF5B combined with the C-terminus of ALK, including the ALK tyrosine kinase domain. Expression of this fusion in murine fibroblast cells demonstrated that it is activating as measured by increased protein and pathway activation and increased proliferation compared to vector control (PMID: 21613408, 26144315). In vitro studies demonstrate that this mutation is sensitive to the ALK inhibitor crizotinib when expressed in human embryonic kidney cells as measured by decreased proliferation upon drug treatment (PMID: 21613408).

var_description_zh: ATIC-ALK融合涉及与ALK的C末端融合的ATIC的N末端，包括ALK酪氨酸激酶结构域。这种融合已在间变性大细胞淋巴瘤中得到鉴定（PMID:10702393，10706082）。虽然这种融合尚未在功能上得到表征，但一名携带ATIC-ALK的婴儿型半球胶质瘤患者接受了氯拉替尼治疗，并显示出接近完全缓解（PMID:36910660）。在另一份病例报告中，一名同时携带ATIC-ALK和CCNY-ALK的非小细胞肺癌患者接受了克唑替尼治疗，并显示出部分缓解（PMID:33489809）。
var_description: The ATIC-ALK fusion involves the N-terminus of ATIC fused to the C-terminus of ALK, including the ALK tyrosine kinase domain. This fusion has been identified in anaplastic large cell lymphoma (PMID: 10702393, 10706082). While this fusion has not yet been functionally characterized, a patient with infant-type hemispheric glioma harboring ATIC-ALK was treated with lorlatinib and demonstrated a near complete response (PMID: 36910660). In another case report, a patient with non-small cell lung cancer harboring both ATIC-ALK and CCNY-ALK was treated with crizotinib and demonstrated partial response (PMID: 33489809).

var_description_zh: ALK扩增导致该蛋白的过表达。该突变已在各种类型的癌症中发现（PMID:22614325，21474455）。ALK在神经母细胞瘤细胞系中的过表达证明其被激活，如通过增加的细胞增殖、集落形成和细胞侵袭力（PMID:24356251）所测量的。
var_description: ALK amplification results in overexpression of the protein. This mutation has been found in various types of cancers (PMID: 22614325, 21474455). Overexpression of ALK in neuroblastoma cell lines demonstrated that it is activating as measured by increased cell proliferation, colony formation, and cell invasiveness (PMID: 24356251).

var_description_zh: ALK-DYSF融合涉及与ALK的C末端融合的DYSF的N末端，包括ALK酪氨酸激酶结构域。虽然这种融合尚未进行功能表征，但一名同时携带ALK-DYSF和ALK-ITGAV的肺腺癌患者接受了克唑替尼治疗，并表现出部分缓解，无进展生存期为23个月（PMID:31894386，29472060）。
var_description: The ALK-DYSF fusion involves the N-terminus of DYSF fused to the C-terminus of ALK, including the ALK tyrosine kinase domain. While this fusion has not yet been functionally characterized, a patient with lung adenocarcinoma harboring both ALK-DYSF and ALK-ITGAV was treated with crizotinib and demonstrated partial response with a progression-free survival of 23 months (PMID: 31894386, 29472060).

var_description_zh: ALK-ITGAV融合涉及ITGAV的N末端与ALK的C末端融合，包括ALK酪氨酸激酶结构域。虽然这种融合尚未进行功能表征，但一名同时携带ALK-ITGAV和ALK-DYSF的肺腺癌患者接受了克唑替尼治疗，并表现出部分缓解，无进展生存期为23个月（PMID:31894386，29472060）。
var_description: The ALK-ITGAV fusions involves the N-terminus of ITGAV fused to the C-terminus of ALK, including the ALK tyrosine kinase domain. While this fusion has not yet been functionally characterized, a patient with lung adenocarcinoma harboring both ALK-ITGAV and ALK-DYSF was treated with crizotinib and demonstrated partial response with a progression-free survival of 23 months (PMID: 31894386, 29472060).

var_description_zh: ALK M1166R突变位于该蛋白的细胞内酪氨酸激酶结构域（PMID:21383740）。该突变已在神经母细胞瘤中发现（PMID:18724359，25517749）。该突变在体外和鼠成纤维细胞中的表达表明，与野生型相比，通过增加的蛋白活化和适度增加的集落形成来测量，该突变是活化的（PMID:23104988，25517749）。体外研究表明，当在鼠成纤维细胞中表达时，该突变对ALK抑制剂克唑替尼敏感，如通过药物治疗后细胞增殖减少所测量的（PMID:25517749）。
var_description: The ALK M1166R mutation is located in the intracellular tyrosine kinase domain of the protein (PMID: 21383740). This mutation has been found in neuroblastoma (PMID: 18724359, 25517749). Expression of this mutation in vitro and in murine fibroblast demonstrated that it is activating as measured by increased protein activation and modestly increased colony formation compared to wildtype (PMID: 23104988, 25517749). In vitro studies demonstrate that this mutation is sensitive to the ALK inhibitor crizotinib when expressed in murine fibroblasts as measured by decreased cell proliferation upon drug treatment (PMID: 25517749).

var_description_zh: ALK E1197K突变位于蛋白质的激酶结构域中。该突变已在黑色素瘤中鉴定（PMID:22842228）。计算机分析表明，该突变具有激活和高度破坏性（PMID:24755198）。
var_description: The ALK E1197K mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein. This mutation has been identified in melanoma (PMID: 22842228). In silico analysis suggests that the mutation is activating and highly damaging (PMID: 24755198).

var_description_zh: ALK G881D突变位于该蛋白的细胞外富含甘氨酸的区域。在肺癌中发现了这种突变。该突变在非小细胞肺癌细胞系中的表达证明其是活化的，如通过与野生型相比在小鼠异种移植物中增加的蛋白和途径活化以及增加的肿瘤形成所测量的（PMID:21847362）。
var_description: The ALK G881D mutation is located in the extracellular glycine-rich domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in lung cancer. Expression of this mutation in a non-small cell lung cancer cell line demonstrated that it is activating as measured by increased protein and pathway activation and increased tumor formation in mouse xenografts compared to wildtype (PMID: 21847362).

var_description_zh: ALK F1174I突变位于该蛋白的细胞内酪氨酸激酶结构域（PMID:21383740）。该突变已在神经母细胞瘤中发现（PMID:18990089，18724359，25517749）。该突变在大鼠肾上腺小鼠B细胞和成纤维细胞系中的表达表明，与野生型相比，通过增加的蛋白和途径活化、细胞增殖和集落形成来测量，该突变是活化的（PMID:23104988）。体外研究表明，当在鼠B细胞系中单独表达或在NPM-ALK融合中表达时，该突变对ALK抑制剂克唑替尼（克唑替尼）、色瑞替尼、阿来替尼和劳拉替尼敏感，这通过药物治疗后细胞增殖减少来测量（PMID:23104988，25749034）。
var_description: The ALK F1174I mutation is located in the intracellular tyrosine kinase domain of the protein (PMID: 21383740). This mutation has been found in neuroblastoma (PMID: 18990089, 18724359, 25517749). Expression of this mutation in rat adrenal murine B-cell and fibroblast cell lines demonstrated that it is activating as measured by increased protein and pathway activation, cell proliferation, and colony formation compared to wildtype (PMID: 23104988). In vitro studies demonstrate that this mutation is sensitive to the ALK inhibitors crizotinib, ceritinib, alectinib and lorlatinib when expressed alone or in the context of an NPM-ALK fusion in a murine B-cell line as measured by decreased cell proliferation upon drug treatment (PMID: 23104988, 25749034).

var_description_zh: ALK E1384K突变位于蛋白质的激酶结构域中。在肺癌中发现了这种突变。该突变在非小细胞肺癌细胞系中的表达证明其是活化的，如通过与野生型相比在小鼠异种移植物中增加的蛋白和途径活化以及增加的肿瘤形成所测量的（PMID:21847362）。
var_description: The ALK E1384K mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in lung cancer. Expression of this mutation in a non-small cell lung cancer cell line demonstrated that it is activating as measured by increased protein and pathway activation and increased tumor formation in mouse xenografts compared to wildtype (PMID: 21847362).

var_description_zh: NPM1-ALK融合蛋白涉及NPM1的N末端与ALK的C末端结合，包括ALK酪氨酸激酶结构域。该突变已在淋巴瘤中发现（PMID:25421750）。NPM1-ALK融合蛋白在小鼠B细胞和转基因小鼠模型中的表达表明，与野生型相比，其蛋白和途径激活增加，并且在小鼠模型中发生T细胞淋巴瘤和浆细胞肿瘤（PMID:26133723，25421750，12424201）。
var_description: The NPM1-ALK fusion protein involves the N-terminus of NPM1 combined with the C-terminus of ALK, including the ALK tyrosine kinase domain. This mutation has been found in lymphoma (PMID: 25421750). Expression of the NPM1-ALK fusion in murine B-cells and in transgenic mouse models demonstrated that it is activating as measured by increase protein and pathway activation compared to wildtype and the development of T-cell lymphomas and plasma cell tumors in mouse models (PMID: 26133723, 25421750, 12424201).

var_description_zh: ALK I1171N突变位于该蛋白的细胞内酪氨酸激酶结构域（PMID:21383740）。该突变已在肺癌中发现（PMID:27432227，29376144，25393798）。该突变在体外以及在大鼠肾上腺和鼠成纤维细胞系中的表达表明，与野生型相比，通过增加的蛋白活化、细胞活力和集落形成来测量，该突变是活化的（PMID:25517749，27049722）。体外研究表明，该突变对ALK抑制剂克唑替尼具有耐药性，但在体外和大鼠肾上腺细胞中表达时，通过蛋白活化分析和药物治疗后的细胞活力测定，该突变对布加替尼敏感（PMID:25517749，27049722）。体外研究还表明，该突变对克唑替尼、色瑞替尼、阿来替尼具有耐药性，但当在小鼠B细胞系中的ALK融合中表达时，可能对布加替尼和劳拉替尼敏感，如通过蛋白活化分析和药物治疗后的细胞活力所测量的（PMID:25749034，27432227，23239810）。在一份病例报告中，一名ALK阳性大B细胞淋巴瘤患者在接受阿列替尼治疗后获得ALK I1171N，随后对氯拉替尼完全缓解（PMID:36809056）。
var_description: The ALK I1171N mutation is located in the intracellular tyrosine kinase domain of the protein (PMID: 21383740). This mutation has been found in lung cancer (PMID: 27432227, 29376144, 25393798). Expression of this mutation in vitro and in rat adrenal and murine fibroblast cell lines demonstrated that it is activating as measured by increased protein activation, cell viability, and colony formation compared to wildtype (PMID: 25517749, 27049722). In vitro studies demonstrate that this mutation is resistant to the ALK inhibitor crizotinib but is sensitive to brigatinib when expressed in vitro and in rat adrenal cells as measured by protein activation analysis and cell viability upon drug treatment (PMID: 25517749, 27049722). In vitro studies also demonstrate that this mutation is resistant to crizotinib, ceritinib, alectinib but may be sensitive to brigatinib and lorlatinib when expressed in the context of ALK fusions in a murine B-cell line as measured by protein activation analysis and cell viability upon drug treatment (PMID: 25749034, 27432227, 23239810). In a case report, a patient with ALK-positive large B-cell lymphoma acquired ALK I1171N following treatment with alectinib and subsequently achieved complete response to lorlatinib (PMID: 36809056).

var_description_zh: ALK D1091N突变位于该蛋白的跨膜区。该突变已在神经母细胞瘤中发现（PMID:18923525，18724359）。该突变在神经母细胞瘤、大鼠肾上腺和鼠成纤维细胞和B细胞细胞系中的表达证明其是中性的，如通过与野生型相比在蛋白质或途径活化、细胞增殖或集落形成方面没有变化所测量的（PMID:23104988）。体外研究表明，当在神经母细胞瘤细胞中表达时，该突变对ALK抑制剂阿列替尼（阿来替尼）敏感，如通过药物治疗后降低的通路激活所测量的（PMID:28455243）。
var_description: The ALK D1091N mutation is located in the transmembrane domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in neuroblastoma (PMID: 18923525,18724359).  Expression of this mutation in neuroblastoma, rat adrenal and murine fibrobast and B-cell cell lines demonstrated that it is neutral as measured by no change in protein or pathway activation, cell proliferation or colony formation compared to wildtype (PMID: 23104988). In vitro studies demonstrate that this mutation is sensitive to the ALK inhibitor alectinib when expressed in neuroblastoma cells as measured by decreased pathway activation upon drug treatment (PMID: 28455243).

var_description_zh: ALK L1196Q突变位于该蛋白的ALKαC-螺旋和催化环结构域之间。体外研究表明，该突变对ALK抑制剂克唑替尼（克唑替尼）具有耐药性，但在NPM-ALK融合淋巴瘤和鼠B细胞系中表达时，对布加替尼敏感，这是通过药物治疗后的细胞活力来测量的（PMID:23239810）。
var_description: The ALK L1196Q mutation is located between the ALK αC-helix and catalytic loop domains of the protein. In vitro studies demonstrate that this mutation is resistant to the ALK inhibitor crizotinib but sensitive to brigatinib when expressed in the context of an NPM-ALK fusion in lymphoma and murine B-cell cell lines as measured by cell viability upon drug treatment (PMID: 23239810).

var_description_zh: ALK L1122V突变位于该蛋白的细胞内酪氨酸激酶结构域（PMID:21383740）。该突变已在淋巴瘤中发现（PMID:28572459）。体外研究表明，当在鼠B细胞中的NPM-ALK融合中表达时，该突变对ALK抑制剂克唑替尼（克唑替尼）、色瑞替尼、阿来替尼和布加替尼具有耐药性，这通过药物治疗后的持续增殖来测量（PMID:25421750）。
var_description: The ALK L1122V mutation is located in the intracellular tyrosine kinase domain of the protein (PMID: 21383740). This mutation has been found in lymphoma (PMID: 28572459). In vitro studies demonstrate that this mutation is resistant to the ALK inhibitors crizotinib, ceritinib, alectinib, and brigatinib when expressed in the context of an NPM-ALK fusion in murine B-cells as measured by sustained proliferation upon drug treatment (PMID: 25421750).

var_description_zh: ALK G1123S突变位于该蛋白的酪氨酸激酶结构域。在肺癌中发现了这种突变（PMID:26134233）。一名携带该突变的ALK融合阳性肺腺癌患者在最初对克唑替尼和色瑞替尼有部分反应后进展，但对阿列替尼有反应（PMID:26134233）。
var_description: The ALK G1123S mutation is located in the tyrosine kinase domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in lung cancer (PMID: 26134233). One patient with ALK-fusion positive lung adenocarcinoma harboring this mutation progressed after initial partial responses to crizotinib and ceritinib but responded to alectinib (PMID: 26134233).

var_description_zh: ALK C1156F突变位于蛋白的酪氨酸激酶结构域。该突变已在淋巴瘤中发现（PMID:28572459）。体外研究表明，该突变对ALK抑制剂色瑞替尼、阿来替尼、布加替尼和劳拉替尼具有耐药性，但对克唑替尼敏感，而C1156F和D1203N组合突变在鼠B细胞中的NPM-ALK融合中表达时对克唑替尼具有耐药性，这是通过药物治疗后的蛋白活化和活力来测量的（PMID:25749034，30322862）。
var_description: The ALK C1156F mutation is located in the tyrosine kinase domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in lymphoma (PMID: 28572459). In vitro studies demonstrate that this mutation is resistant to the ALK inhibitors ceritinib, alectinib, brigatinib and lorlatinib but sensitive to crizotinib, while the combination C1156F and D1203N mutation is resistant to crizotinib when expressed in the context of an NPM-ALK fusion in murine B-cells as measured by protein activation and viability upon drug treatment (PMID: 25749034, 30322862).

var_description_zh: ALK I1250T突变位于该蛋白的细胞内酪氨酸激酶结构域（PMID:21383740）。该突变已在神经母细胞瘤中发现（PMID:21804922）。该突变在体外以及在大鼠肾上腺细胞和鼠成纤维细胞中的表达证明其是中性的，如通过与野生型相比蛋白活化和集落形成没有变化所测量的（pMID:25517749，21804922）。
var_description: The ALK I1250T mutation is located in the intracellular tyrosine kinase domain of the protein (PMID: 21383740). This mutation has been found in neuroblastoma (PMID: 21804922). Expression of this mutation in vitro and in rat adrenal cells and murine fibroblasts demonstrated that it is neutral as measured by no change in protein activation and colony formation compared to wildtype (PMID: 25517749, 21804922).

var_description_zh: ALK L1198P突变位于该蛋白的细胞内酪氨酸激酶结构域（PMID:21383740）。该突变已在神经母细胞瘤中发现（PMID:28572459）。体外研究表明，当在小鼠B细胞中的EML4-ALK融合中表达时，该突变对ALK抑制剂克唑替尼具有抗性，如通过药物治疗后的持续生存力所测量的（PMID:21948233）。
var_description: The ALK L1198P mutation is located in the intracellular tyrosine kinase domain of the protein (PMID: 21383740). This mutation has been found in neuroblastoma (PMID: 28572459). In vitro studies demonstrate that this mutation is resistant to the ALK inhibitor crizotinib when expressed in the context of an EML4-ALK fusion in murine B-cells as measured by sustained viability upon drug treatment (PMID: 21948233).

var_description_zh: ALK F1174S突变位于蛋白的酪氨酸激酶结构域。该突变已在神经母细胞瘤中发现（PMID:21059859，25517749，23084186）。该突变在神经母细胞瘤和鼠成纤维细胞系中的表达表明，与野生型相比，通过增加的蛋白和途径活化以及细胞活力来测量，该突变是活化的（PMID:23104988，21059859）。体外研究表明，当在大鼠肾上腺细胞系中表达时，该突变对ALK抑制剂克唑替尼（克唑替尼）具有抗性，这是通过药物治疗后的持续细胞活力来测量的（PMID:23104988）。体外研究还表明，当在小鼠B细胞中的EML4-ALK融合蛋白中表达时，该突变对克唑替尼和阿列替尼具有耐药性，而对色瑞替尼、布加替尼和劳拉替尼敏感，这是通过药物治疗后的蛋白活化来测量的（PMID:27432227）。
var_description: The ALK F1174S mutation is located in the tyrosine kinase domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in neuroblastoma (PMID: 21059859, 25517749, 23084186). Expression of this mutation in neuroblastoma and murine fibroblast cell lines demonstrated that it is activating as measured by increased protein and pathway activation and cell viability compared to wildtype (PMID: 23104988, 21059859). In vitro studies demonstrate that this mutation is resistant to the ALK inhibitor crizotinib when expressed in a rat adrenal cell line as measured by sustained cell viability upon drug treatment (PMID: 23104988). In vitro studies have also demonstrated that this mutation is resistant to crizotinib and alectinib and sensitive to ceritinib, brigatinib and lorlatinib when expressed in the context of an EML4-ALK fusion in murine B-cells as measured by protein activation upon drug treatment (PMID: 27432227).

var_description_zh: ALK D1349H突变位于该蛋白的酪氨酸激酶结构域。ALK D1349H突变在成纤维细胞中的表达表明其可能是中性的，如通过转化和蛋白磷酸化所测量的，与野生型相当（PMID:25517749）。
var_description: The ALK D1349H mutation is located in the tyrosine kinase domain of the protein. Expression of the ALK D1349H mutation in fibroblast cells demonstrated it is likely neutral as measured by transformation and protein phosphorylation comparable to wildtype (PMID: 25517749).

var_description_zh: ALK P1139S突变位于该蛋白的细胞内酪氨酸激酶结构域。体外研究表明，该突变对ALK抑制剂克唑替尼（克唑替尼）、布里加替尼（布加替尼）、阿列替尼（阿来替尼）敏感，但当在鼠B细胞中的NPM-ALK融合中表达时，通过药物治疗后的蛋白活化和细胞活力（PMID:25421750）测定，该突变对色瑞替尼具有耐药性。
var_description: The ALK P1139S mutation is located in the intracellular tyrosine kinase domain of the protein. In vitro studies demonstrate that this mutation is sensitive to the ALK inhibitors crizotinib, brigatinib, alectinib but is resistant to ceritinib when expressed in the context of an NPM-ALK fusion in murine B-cells as measured by protein activation and cell viability upon drug treatment (PMID: 25421750).

var_description_zh: ALK L1196M突变位于该蛋白的细胞内酪氨酸激酶结构域（PMID:21383740）。该突变已在肺癌中发现（PMID:28434515，23344087，23434628）。该突变在体外和小鼠B细胞和大鼠肾上腺细胞系中的表达表明，与野生型相比，通过适度增加的蛋白活化、集落形成和细胞增殖来测量，该突变是活化的（PMID:25517749，22235099）。体外和体内研究证明，如通过蛋白活化分析、细胞生存力和药物治疗后的肿瘤生长所测量的，当在鼠B细胞、胚胎肾、肺癌和淋巴瘤细胞系中的ALK融合中表达时，该突变对ALK抑制剂克唑替尼、布加替尼和阿来替尼具有抗性，但对色瑞替尼和劳拉替尼敏感（PMID:29650534，22277784，24675041，25517749，26144315，22235099，25421750，21613408，23344087 ) .然而，共表达L1196M突变和G1202R突变的EML4-ALK阳性细胞对克唑替尼、阿列替尼、色瑞替尼、brigatnib和劳拉替尼高度耐药，如通过药物治疗后的持续蛋白活化和细胞活力所测量的（PMID:29650534）。
var_description: The ALK L1196M mutation is located in the intracellular tyrosine kinase domain of the protein (PMID: 21383740). This mutation has been found in lung cancer (PMID: 28434515, 23344087, 23434628). Expression of this mutation in vitro and in murine B-cell and rat adrenal cell lines demonstrated that it is activating as measured by moderately increased protein activation, colony formation and cell proliferation compared to wildtype (PMID: 25517749, 22235099). In vitro and in vivo studies demonstrate that this mutation is resistant to the ALK inhibitors crizotinib, brigatinib, and alectinib but sensitive to ceritinib and lorlatinib when expressed in the context of an ALK fusion in murine B-cell, embryonic kidney, lung cancer and lymphoma cell lines as measured by protein activation analysis, cell viability and tumor growth upon drug treatment (PMID: 29650534, 22277784, 24675041, 25517749, 26144315, 22235099, 25421750, 21613408, 22034911, 23344087). However, EML4-ALK-positive cells coexpressing the L1196M mutation with the G1202R mutation are highly resistant to crizotinib, alectinib, ceritinib, brigatnib and lorlatinib as measured by sustained protein activation and cell viability upon drug treatment (PMID: 29650534).

var_description_zh: STRN-ALK融合蛋白将STRN的N-末端（包括STRN纹状体蛋白结构域的一部分）与ALK的C-末端（包括ALK酪氨酸激酶结构域）结合。在患有恶性间皮瘤和结肠直肠癌的患者中发现了该突变（PMID:24613930）（摘要：Rüschoff等人JCO Po，2019 https：//ascopubs.org/doi/full/10.1200/PO.19.00048）。虽然这种融合还没有被功能表征，但其他ALK融合已经被表征并显示为激活，这表明这种融合也可能是激活的（PMID:17625570，8122112）。一名患有恶性腹膜间皮瘤（MPM）且表达STRN-ALK融合蛋白的儿童患者对ALK抑制剂色瑞替尼有显著反应，一名患有这种改变的结肠癌患者对ALK抑制剂色瑞替尼有临床反应，在治疗开始后三个月病情持续减轻（PMID:24613930）（摘要：Rüschoff等人，JCO Po，2019 https：//ascopubs.org/doi/full/10.1200/PO.19.00048）。一名表达STRN-ALK融合蛋白的MPM成年患者对ALK抑制剂克唑替尼表现出部分应答，随后在发生已知ALK耐药突变ALK L1196M（PMID:34568722）后接受下一代ALK抑制剂布加替尼治疗。
var_description: The STRN-ALK fusion protein combines the N-terminus of STRN, including a portion of the STRN striatin domain, with the C-terminus of ALK, including the ALK tyrosine kinase domain. This mutation is found in patients with malignant mesothelioma and colorectal cancer (PMID: 24613930)(Abstract: Rüschoff et al. JCO PO, 2019. https://ascopubs.org/doi/full/10.1200/PO.19.00048). While this fusion has not been functionally characterized, other ALK fusions have been characterized and shown to be activating, suggesting that this fusion is also likely activating (PMID: 17625570, 8122112). One pediatric patient with malignant peritoneal mesothelioma (MPM) expressing the STRN-ALK fusion protein had a dramatic response to the ALK inhibitor ceritinib, and one patient with colon cancer harboring this alteration had a clinical response to the ALK inhibitor ceritinib with continued disease reduction at three months after treatment initiation (PMID: 24613930)(Abstract: Rüschoff et al. JCO PO, 2019. https://ascopubs.org/doi/full/10.1200/PO.19.00048). An adult patient with MPM expressing the STRN-ALK fusion protein exhibited a partial response to the ALK inhibitor crizotinib and was subsequently treated with next-generation ALK inhibitor brigatinib after developing a known ALK resistance mutation, ALK L1196M (PMID: 34568722).

var_description_zh: ALK S1206R突变位于该蛋白的细胞内酪氨酸激酶结构域。体外和体内研究表明，当在小鼠B细胞中的EML4-ALK融合蛋白中表达时，该突变对克唑替尼具有耐药性，这通过药物治疗后的持续增殖和肿瘤生长来衡量（PMID:22034911）。
var_description: The ALK S1206R mutation is located in the intracellular tyrosine kinase domain of the protein. In vitro and in vivo studies demonstrate that this mutation is resistant to crizotinib when expressed in the context of an EML4-ALK fusion in murine B-cells as measured by sustained proliferation and tumor growth upon drug treatment (PMID: 22034911).

var_description_zh: ALK G1128S突变位于该蛋白的激酶结构域。该突变已在淋巴瘤中发现（PMID:28572459）。体外研究表明，该突变对克唑替尼（克唑替尼）、阿列替尼（阿来替尼）、布里加替尼（布加替尼）和氯拉替尼（劳拉替尼）敏感，当在鼠B细胞中的NPM-ALK融合中表达时，通过药物治疗后的增殖减少来测量（PMID:25749034）。
var_description: The ALK G1128S mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in lymphoma (PMID: 28572459). In vitro studies demonstrate that this mutation sensitive to crizotinib, alectinib, brigatinib and lorlatinib when expressed in the context of an NPM-ALK fusion in murine B-cells as measured by decreased proliferation upon drug treatment (PMID: 25749034).

var_description_zh: ALK G1123D突变位于该蛋白的激酶结构域。体外研究表明，当在神经母细胞瘤细胞中与ALK F1174L突变共表达时，该突变对克唑替尼敏感，如通过药物治疗后集落形成减少所测量的（PMID:21948233）。
var_description: The ALK G1123D mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein. In vitro studies demonstrate that this mutation is sensitive to crizotinib when co-expressed with the ALK F1174L mutation in neuroblastoma cells as measured by decreased colony formation upon drug treatment (PMID: 21948233).

var_description_zh: ALK E1210K突变位于该蛋白的细胞内酪氨酸激酶结构域（PMID:21383740）。在肺癌和淋巴瘤中发现了这种突变（PMID:28572459）。体外研究表明，当在小鼠B细胞中的EML4-ALK融合中表达时，该突变对克唑替尼具有耐药性，这是通过药物治疗后的持续细胞增殖来测量的（PMID:22034911）。
var_description: The ALK E1210K mutation is located in the intracellular tyrosine kinase domain of the protein (PMID: 21383740). This mutation has been found in lung cancer and lymphoma (PMID: 28572459). In vitro studies demonstrate this mutation is resistant to crizotinib when expressed in the context of an EML4-ALK fusion in murine B-cells as measured by sustained cell proliferation upon drug treatment (PMID: 22034911).

var_description_zh: ALK F1174V突变位于该蛋白的细胞内酪氨酸激酶结构域（PMID:21383740）。该突变已在淋巴瘤、神经母细胞瘤和肺癌中发现（PMID:28572459）。该突变在神经母细胞瘤细胞系中的内源性表达表明，与野生型相比，通过增加的途径激活来测量其激活（PMID:18923523）。体外研究表明，当在神经母细胞瘤细胞系中内源性表达时，该突变对第一代ALK抑制剂克唑替尼（克唑替尼）具有耐药性，但对第二代ALK抑制剂布里加替尼（布加替尼）、氯拉替尼（劳拉替尼）和阿列替尼（阿来替尼）敏感，这是通过药物治疗后通路激活和细胞活力降低来测量的（PMID:27049722，31334113，27483357）。
var_description: The ALK F1174V mutation is located in the intracellular tyrosine kinase domain of the protein (PMID: 21383740). This mutation has been found in lymphoma, neuroblastoma, and lung cancer (PMID: 28572459). Endogenous expression of this mutation in a neuroblastoma cell line demonstrated that it is activating as measured by increased pathway activation compared to wildtype (PMID:18923523). In vitro studies demonstrate that this mutation is resistant to the first-generation ALK inhibitor crizotinib but sensitive to the second-generation ALK inhibitors brigatinib, lorlatinib and alectinib when endogenously expressed in a neuroblastoma cell line as measured by decreased pathway activation and cell viability upon drug treatment (PMID: 27049722, 31334113, 27483357).

var_description_zh: ALK C1156Y突变位于该蛋白的酪氨酸激酶结构域。该突变已在非小细胞肺癌中发现（PMID:23434628，20979473，22235099，24675041，26698910，26144315，27045755，27432227）。虽然该突变仅在ALK融合的背景下进行了研究，但该突变在EML4-ALK阳性小鼠B细胞和胚胎肾细胞系中的表达表明，与单独的EML4-ALK相比，该突变是活化的，如通过增加的蛋白活化和生长因子非依赖性增殖所测量的（PMID:22235099，21613408）。体外和体内研究表明，当在鼠B细胞系中的EML4-ALK融合中表达时，该突变的表达赋予对ALK抑制剂色瑞替尼和克唑替尼的抗性，但不赋予对阿来替尼和劳拉替尼的抗性，如通过药物治疗后的持续细胞增殖所测量的（PMID:24675041，26144315，22235099）。
var_description: The ALK C1156Y mutation is located in the tyrosine kinase domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in non-small cell lung cancer (PMID: 23434628, 20979473, 22235099, 24675041, 26698910, 26144315, 27045755, 27432227). While this mutation has only been studied in the context of an ALK fusion, expression of this mutation in an EML4-ALK-positive murine B-cell and embryonic kidney cell line demonstrates that it is activating as measured by increased protein activation and growth factor-independent proliferation compared to EML4-ALK alone (PMID: 22235099, 21613408). In vitro and in vivo studies demonstrate that expression of this mutation confers resistance to the ALK inhibitors ceritinib and crizotinib, but not alectinib and lorlatinib, when expressed in the context of an EML4-ALK fusion in a murine B-cell line as measured by sustained cell proliferation upon drug treatment (PMID: 24675041, 26144315, 22235099).

var_description_zh: ALK R1060H突变位于该蛋白的细胞内酪氨酸激酶结构域。该突变已在神经母细胞瘤中发现（PMID:25517749）。该突变在鼠成纤维细胞中的表达证明其可能是中性的，如通过与野生型相比集落形成无变化所测量的（PMID:23104988）。
var_description: The ALK R1060H mutation is located in the intracellular tyrosine kinase domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in neuroblastoma (PMID: 25517749). Expression of this mutation in murine fibroblast cells demonstrated that it is likely neutral as measured by no change in colony formation compared to wildtype (PMID: 23104988).
