var_description_zh: ALK G1269A突变位于该蛋白的细胞内酪氨酸激酶结构域（PMID:21383740）。该突变已在肺癌中发现（PMID:28434515，27045755，23344087）。该突变在大鼠肾上腺细胞系中的表达表明，通过与野生型相比增加的蛋白活化和细胞活力（PMID:27049722）来测量，该突变是活化的。该突变在EML4-ALK阳性小鼠B细胞系中的表达表明，与单独的EML4-ALK相比，通过增加的生长因子非依赖性增殖来测量其活化（PMID:22235099）。体外和体内研究表明，当在肺癌、淋巴瘤和大鼠肾上腺细胞系中表达时，该突变对克唑替尼耐药，但对色瑞替尼、布加替尼和阿来替尼敏感，如通过蛋白活化分析、细胞增殖和药物治疗后的肿瘤生长所测量的（PMID:27049722）。体外研究还表明，当在淋巴瘤、肺癌和鼠B细胞和成纤维细胞系中的ALK融合中表达时，该突变对Akt抑制剂克唑替尼具有抗性，但对色瑞替尼、劳拉替尼和afectinib敏感，如通过蛋白质和通路活化分析以及药物治疗后的细胞活力所测量的（PMID:24675041，26144315，22235099，27009859，23344087）。
var_description: The ALK G1269A mutation is located in the intracellular tyrosine kinase domain of the protein (PMID: 21383740). This mutation has been found in lung cancer (PMID: 28434515, 27045755, 23344087). Expression of this mutation in a rat adrenal cell line demonstrated that it is activating as measured by increased protein activation and cell viability as compared to wildtype (PMID: 27049722). Expression of this mutation in an EML4-ALK-positive murine B-cell line demonstrated that it is activating as measured by increased growth factor-independent proliferation compared to EML4-ALK alone (PMID: 22235099). In vitro and in vivo studies demonstrate that this mutation is resistant to crizotinib but sensitive to ceritinib, brigatinib and alectinib when expressed in lung cancer, lymphoma and rat adrenal cell lines as measured by protein activation analysis, cell proliferation, and tumor growth upon drug treatment (PMID: 27049722). In vitro studies also demonstrate that this mutation is resistant to the AKT inhibitors crizotinib but sensitive to ceritinib, lorlatinib and afectinib when expressed in the context of ALK fusions in lymphoma, lung cancer and murine B-cell and fibroblast cell lines as measured by protein and pathway activation analysis and cell viability upon drug treatment (PMID: 24675041, 26144315, 22235099, 27009859, 23344087).

var_description_zh: ALK M1328I突变位于该蛋白的细胞内酪氨酸激酶结构域（PMID:21383740）。在淋巴瘤中发现了这种突变（PMID:24491302）。虽然该突变仅在ALK融合的背景下进行了研究，但该突变在NPM-ALK融合阳性鼠B细胞中的表达表明，与单独的NPM-ALK相比，该突变通过增加增殖而被激活（PMID:24491302）。一名ALK融合阳性淋巴瘤患者在使用ALK抑制剂克唑替尼（PMID:24491302）治疗期间获得了该突变和ALK I1171N突变。
var_description: The ALK M1328I mutation is located in the intracellular tyrosine kinase domain of the protein (PMID: 21383740). This mutation has been found in lymphoma (PMID: 24491302). While this mutation has only been studied in the context of ALK fusions, expression of this mutation in NPM-ALK fusion-positive murine B-cells demonstrated that it is activating as measured by increased proliferation compared to NPM-ALK alone (PMID: 24491302). One patient with ALK fusion-positive lymphoma acquired this mutation along with an ALK I1171N mutation while progressing on the ALK inhibitor crizotinib (PMID: 24491302).

var_description_zh: ALK I1171T突变位于蛋白的酪氨酸激酶结构域。该突变已在肺癌中发现（PMID:24675041，25228534，25736571）。体外和体内研究表明，该突变对克唑替尼（克唑替尼）、阿列替尼（阿来替尼）、布里加替尼（布加替尼）和氯拉替尼（劳拉替尼）具有耐药性，但对色瑞替尼敏感，当在肺癌和鼠B细胞系的ALK融合中表达时，通过药物治疗后的细胞活力和肿瘤生长进行测量（PMID:30322862，24675041，25749034，25228534，22034911）。
var_description: The ALK I1171T mutation is located in the tyrosine kinase domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in lung cancer (PMID: 24675041, 25228534, 25736571). In vitro and in vivo studies demonstrate that this mutation is resistant to crizotinib, alectinib, brigatinib and lorlatinib but sensitive to ceritinib when expressed in the context of ALK fusions in lung cancer and murine B-cell lines as measured by cell viability and tumor growth upon drug treatment (PMID: 30322862, 24675041, 25749034, 25228534, 22034911).

var_description_zh: ALK R401Q突变位于该蛋白的MAM结构域1。该突变已在基底细胞癌中鉴定（PMID:26950094）。用BA/F3细胞和表达ALK R401Q的MCF10A细胞进行的体外研究表明，如通过与野生型（PMID:29533785）相当的细胞增殖和生存力所测量的，突变可能是中性的。
var_description: The ALK R401Q mutation is located in the MAM domain 1 of the protein. This mutation has been identified in basal cell carcinoma (PMID: 26950094). In vitro studies with Ba/F3 cells and MCF10A cells expressing ALK R401Q demonstrate that the mutation is likely neutral as measured by cell proliferation and viability comparable to wildtype (PMID: 29533785).

var_description_zh: ALK的融合是常见的，并且产生于染色体易位，其通常将启动子和伴侣基因的N-末端部分与ALK的C-末端部分（包括激酶结构域）融合。ALK融合在肺癌中最为常见（PMID:22235099）。已经报道了多种ALK融合体，其中融合伴侣的启动子驱动ALK基因的表达，并对其进行了生物学表征，包括EML4-ALK（pMID:17625570）和NPM-ALK（pMID:8122112），它们是活化的和致癌的。ALK融合体通常对小分子ALK抑制剂敏感，尽管常常通过融合蛋白的错义突变产生抗性（PMID:24675041）。
var_description: Fusions of ALK are common and arise from chromosomal translocations that generally fuse the promotor and N-terminal portion of a partner gene with the C-terminal portion of ALK, including the kinase domain. ALK fusions are most common in lung cancer (PMID: 22235099). Various ALK fusions in which the promoter of the fusion partner drives expression of the ALK gene have been reported and biologically characterized, including EML4-ALK, (PMID: 17625570) and NPM-ALK (PMID: 8122112), which are activating and oncogenic. ALK fusions are generally sensitive to small molecule ALK inhibitors, though resistance is often accrued through missense mutations of the fusion protein (PMID:24675041).

var_description_zh: ALK S1206Y突变位于该蛋白的细胞内酪氨酸激酶结构域（PMID:21383740）。在肺癌中发现了这种突变（PMID:22277784，24675041）。体外研究表明，当在小鼠B细胞系中的EML4-ALK融合中表达时，该突变对克唑替尼具有耐药性，但对色瑞替尼、劳拉替尼和阿来替尼敏感，这是通过药物治疗后的蛋白活化和细胞活力来测量的（PMID:22277784，24675041，26144315）。
var_description: The ALK S1206Y mutation is located in the intracellular tyrosine kinase domain of the protein (PMID: 21383740). This mutation has been found in lung cancer (PMID: 22277784, 24675041). In vitro studies demonstrate that this mutation is resistant crizotinib but sensitive to ceritinib, lorlatinib, and alectinib when expressed in the context of an EML4-ALK fusion in a murine B-cell line as measured by protein activation and cell viability upon drug treatment (PMID: 22277784, 24675041, 26144315).

var_description_zh: ALK-GCC2融合涉及与ALK的C末端融合的GCC2的N末端，包括ALK酪氨酸激酶结构域。该突变已在非小细胞肺癌中鉴定（PMID:35116968）。用表达ALK-GCC2的BA/F3细胞进行的体外研究表明，与野生型相比，通过增加的IL-3非依赖性生长和下游信号的过度激活来测量，融合是活化的（PMID:29290262）。在一份病例报告中，一名携带ALK-GCC2的晚期肺腺癌患者接受了克唑替尼治疗，并显示出18个月的无进展生存期（PMID:29290262）。在第二个病例报告中，一名携带ALK-GCC2的非小细胞肺癌患者接受了克唑替尼治疗，无进展生存期为21个月（PMID:35116968）。每个病例中的两名患者均报告在疾病进展后获得了对克唑替尼的耐药性，并且对随后的第二代或第三代酪氨酸激酶抑制剂治疗仅有部分反应，无进展生存期缩短（PMID:29290262，35116968）。
var_description: The ALK-GCC2 fusion involves the N-terminus of GCC2 fused to the C-terminus of ALK, including the ALK tyrosine kinase domain. This mutation has been identified in non-small cell lung cancer (PMID: 35116968). In vitro studies with Ba/F3 cells expressing ALK-GCC2 demonstrate that the fusion is activating as measured by increased IL-3-independent growth and hyperactivation of downstream signaling compared to wildtype (PMID: 29290262). In a case report, a patient with advanced lung adenocarcinoma harboring ALK-GCC2 was treated with crizotinib and demonstrated a progression-free survival for 18 months (PMID: 29290262). In a second case report, a patient with non-small cell lung cancer harboring ALK-GCC2 was treated with crizotinib and demonstrated a progression-free survival of 21 months (PMID: 35116968). Both patients in each case report acquired resistance to crizotinib after progressing and demonstrated only partial response to subsequent second or third generation tyrosine kinase inhibitors treatments with shortened progression-free survival (PMID: 29290262, 35116968).

var_description_zh: ALK T1151M突变位于该蛋白的细胞内酪氨酸激酶结构域（PMID:21383740）。该突变在神经母细胞瘤中发现（PMID:18923525，23104988）。这种突变的功能数据相互矛盾。该突变在体外的表达表明，与野生型相比，通过适度增加的组成型蛋白激活来测量，该突变是激活的（PMID:25517749）。然而，该突变在大鼠肾上腺和鼠成纤维细胞和B-细胞系中的表达证明其是中性的，如通过与野生型相比在途径激活、细胞活力、细胞增殖和集落形成方面没有变化所测量的（PMID:25517749，18923525，23104988）。体外研究表明，当在NPM-ALK融合中表达时，该突变对ALK抑制剂克唑替尼、色瑞替尼、阿来替尼和布加替尼具有耐药性，并且当在淋巴瘤细胞中EML4-ALK融合中表达时，该突变对克唑替尼和色瑞替尼具有耐药性，但对阿来替尼和布加替尼稍微敏感，这是通过药物治疗后的细胞活力来测量的（PMID:27009859）。
var_description: The ALK T1151M mutation is located in the intracellular tyrosine kinase domain of the protein (PMID: 21383740). This mutation is found in neuroblastoma (PMID: 18923525, 23104988). There is conflicting functional data for this mutation. Expression of this mutation in vitro demonstrated that it is activating as measured by modestly increased constitutive protein activation compared to wildtype (PMID: 25517749). However, expression of this mutation in rat adrenal and murine fibroblast and B- cell lines demonstrated that it is neutral as measured by no change in pathway activation, cell viability, cell proliferation, and colony formation compared to wildtype (PMID: 25517749, 18923525, 23104988). In vitro studies demonstrate that this mutation is resistant to the ALK inhibitors crizotinib, ceritinib, alectinib and brigatinib when expressed in the context of an NPM-ALK fusion and resistant to crizotinib and ceritinib but slightly sensitive to alectinib and brigatinib when expressed in the context of an EML4-ALK fusion in lymphoma cells as measured by cell viability upon drug treatment (PMID: 27009859).

var_description_zh: ALK Q1064R突变位于蛋白的近膜区（PMID:21383740）。虽然该突变仅在ALK融合的背景下进行了研究，但该突变在NPM-ALK融合阳性鼠B细胞中的表达表明，与单独的NPM-ALK相比，该突变通过增加增殖而激活（PMID:24491302）。一名ALK融合阳性淋巴瘤患者在使用ALK抑制剂克唑替尼（PMID:24491302）时获得了这种突变。
var_description: The ALK Q1064R mutation is located in the juxtamembrane domain of the protein (PMID: 21383740). While this mutation has only been studied in the context of ALK fusions, expression of this mutation in NPM-ALK fusion-positive murine B-cells demonstrated that it activating as measured by increased proliferation compared to NPM-ALK alone (PMID: 24491302). One patient with ALK fusion-positive lymphoma acquired this mutation while progressing on the ALK inhibitor crizotinib (PMID: 24491302).

var_description_zh: RanBP2-ALK融合涉及RanBP2的N末端与ALK的C末端融合，包括ALK酪氨酸激酶结构域。在炎症性肌纤维母细胞瘤中发现了这种突变。该突变在小鼠B细胞中的表达表明，通过生长因子非依赖性增殖测量，该突变是激活的。体外研究表明，当在小鼠B细胞中表达时，该突变对ALK抑制剂克唑替尼（克唑替尼）敏感，这是通过药物治疗后细胞活力降低来测量的（PMID:21030459）。
var_description: The RANBP2-ALK fusion involves the N-terminus of RANBP2 fused to the C-terminus of ALK, including the ALK tyrosine kinase domain. This mutation has been found in inflammatory myofibroblastic tumors. Expression of this mutation in murine B-cells demonstrated that it is activating as measured by growth-factor independent proliferation. In vitro studies demonstrate that this mutation is sensitive to the ALK inhibitor crizotinib when expressed in murine B-cells as measured by decreased cell viability upon drug treatment (PMID: 21030459).

var_description_zh: ALK R401L突变位于蛋白的MAM结构域1。用表达ALK R401L的FaDu细胞进行的体外研究表明，与野生型（相比，该突变被激活，表现为细胞增殖、克隆形成存活和细胞侵袭的增加。摘要#2422，AACR 2021.https：//aacrjournals.org/cancerres/article/81/13_Supplement/2422/668318/Abstract-2422-Genetic-aberrations-of-Anaplastic）。
var_description: The ALK R401L mutation is located in the MAM domain 1 of the protein. In vitro studies with FaDu cells expressing ALK R401L demonstrate that the mutation is activating as measured by increased cellular proliferation, clonogenic survival and cellular invasion compared to wildtype (Abstract: Wang et al. Abstract # 2422, AACR 2021. https://aacrjournals.org/cancerres/article/81/13_Supplement/2422/668318/Abstract-2422-Genetic-aberrations-of-Anaplastic).

var_description_zh: ALK D1270G突变位于该蛋白的酪氨酸激酶结构域。该突变已在神经母细胞瘤中发现（PMID:25517749）。该突变在体外和鼠成纤维细胞中的表达证明其可能是中性的，这是通过与野生型相比蛋白活化或集落形成没有变化来测量的（PMID:25517749）。
var_description: The ALK D1270G mutation is located in the tyrosine kinase domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in neuroblastoma (PMID: 25517749). Expression of this mutation in vitro and in murine fibroblast cells demonstrated it is likely neutral as measured by no change in protein activation or colony formation compared to wildtype (PMID: 25517749).

var_description_zh: ALK R1192P突变位于该蛋白的细胞内酪氨酸激酶结构域（PMID:21383740）。该突变已在淋巴瘤中发现（PMID:28572459）。该突变在体外以及在大鼠肾上腺和鼠成纤维细胞和B细胞中的表达表明，与野生型相比，通过增加的蛋白活性、细胞活力和集落形成（PMID:25517749，27049722），该突变被激活。体外研究表明，该突变对克唑替尼、色瑞替尼和阿来替尼具有耐药性，但在体外和大鼠肾上腺细胞中表达时，以及在淋巴瘤细胞中的NPM-ALK融合中，通过药物治疗后的蛋白活性和细胞增殖测定，该突变对布加替尼敏感（PMID:27049722，27009859）。
var_description: The ALK R1192P mutation is located in the intracellular tyrosine kinase domain of the protein (PMID: 21383740). This mutation has been found in lymphoma (PMID: 28572459). Expression of this mutation in vitro and in rat adrenal and murine fibroblast and B-cells demonstrated that it is activating as measured by increased protein activity, cell viability, and colony formation compared to wildtype (PMID: 25517749, 27049722). In vitro studies demonstrate that this mutation is resistant to crizotinib, ceritinib, and alectinib but is sensitive to brigatinib when expressed in vitro and in rat adrenal cells and in the context of an NPM-ALK fusion in lymphoma cells as measured by protein activity and cell proliferation upon drug treatment (PMID: 27049722, 27009859).

var_description_zh: ALK N1178H突变位于该蛋白的细胞内酪氨酸激酶结构域（PMID:21383740）。该突变已在淋巴瘤中发现（PMID:28572459）。体外研究表明，当在鼠B细胞中的NPM-ALK融合中表达时，该突变对ALK抑制剂布加替尼具有中度耐药性，并对克唑替尼、色瑞替尼、阿来替尼和劳拉替尼敏感，这通过药物治疗后的蛋白活化和细胞活力来测量（PMID:25749034，30322862）。
var_description: The ALK N1178H mutation is located in the intracellular tyrosine kinase domain of the protein (PMID: 21383740). This mutation has been found in lymphoma (PMID: 28572459 ). In vitro studies demonstrate that this mutation is modestly resistant to the ALK inhibitor brigatinib and sensitive to crizotinib, ceritinib, alectinib and lorlatinib when expressed in the context of an NPM-ALK fusion in murine B-cells as measured by protein activation and cell viability upon drug treatment (PMID: 25749034, 30322862).

var_description_zh: ALK R1275Q突变位于该蛋白的细胞内酪氨酸激酶结构域。该突变在家族性神经母细胞瘤中被发现为种系突变（PMID:18923523）。该突变在大鼠肾上腺、鼠成纤维细胞、鼠B细胞和神经母细胞瘤细胞中的体外表达以及在小鼠体内模型中的表达表明，与野生型相比，通过增加的蛋白活化、细胞活力、集落形成、细胞侵袭和肿瘤形成来测量其活化（pMID:25517749，27049722，26829053，18923523，18923525）。体外和体内研究表明，当在体外和神经母细胞瘤细胞中表达时，该突变对ALK抑制剂克唑替尼和氯拉替尼敏感，如通过药物治疗后降低的蛋白活化、细胞活力和肿瘤生长所测量的（PMID:26554404，25517749，27049722，26829053，18923523，22072639）。
var_description: The ALK R1275Q mutation is located in the intracellular tyrosine kinase domain of this protein. This mutation has been found as a germline mutation in familial neuroblastoma (PMID: 18923523). Expression of this mutation in vitro, in rat adrenal, murine fibroblast, murine B-cell and neuroblastoma cells and in an in vivo mouse model demonstrated that it is activating as measured by increased protein activation, cell viability, colony formation, cell invasion, and tumor formation compared to wildtype (PMID: 25517749, 27049722, 26829053, 18923523, 18923525). In vitro and in vivo studies demonstrate that this mutation is sensitive to the ALK inhibitors crizotinib and lorlatinib when expressed in vitro and in neuroblastoma cells as measured by decreased protein activation, cell viability and tumor growth upon drug treatment (PMID: 26554404, 25517749, 27049722, 26829053, 18923523, 22072639).

var_description_zh: ALK I1170N突变位于该蛋白的酪氨酸激酶结构域。该突变在成纤维细胞中的表达表明其可能被激活，如通过与野生型相比增加的病灶形成所测量的（PMID:25517749）。
var_description: The ALK I1170N mutation is located in the tyrosine kinase domain of the protein. Expression of this mutation in fibroblast cells demonstrated it is likely activating as measured by increased foci formation compared to wildtype (PMID:25517749).

var_description_zh: ALK L1152P突变位于该蛋白的细胞内酪氨酸激酶结构域（PMID:21383740）。在肺癌中发现了这种突变（PMID:21791641）。体外研究表明，当在体外表达时，该突变对ALK抑制剂克唑替尼（克唑替尼）和西瑞替尼（色瑞替尼）具有抗性，并且在小鼠B细胞中的EML4-ALK融合中，通过药物治疗后的持续蛋白活性和增殖进行测量（PMID:24675041，30006516）。
var_description: The ALK L1152P mutation is located in the intracellular tyrosine kinase domain of the protein (PMID: 21383740). This mutation has been found in lung cancer (PMID: 21791641). In vitro studies demonstrate that this mutation is resistant to the ALK inhibitors crizotinib and ceritinib when expressed in vitro and in the context of an EML4-ALK fusion in murine B-cells as measured by sustained protein activity and proliferation upon drug treatment (PMID: 24675041, 30006516).

var_description_zh: ALK A1200V突变位于该蛋白的细胞内酪氨酸激酶结构域（PMID:21383740）。该突变已在神经母细胞瘤和肺癌中发现（PMID:25517749，22941188，26168399）。该突变在体外和鼠成纤维细胞中的表达证明其可能是中性的，这是通过与野生型相比蛋白质活性或集落形成没有变化来测量的（pMID:25517749）。
var_description: The ALK A1200V mutation is located in the intracellular tyrosine kinase domain of the protein (PMID: 21383740). This mutation has been found in neuroblastoma and lung cancer (PMID: 25517749, 22941188, 26168399). Expression of this mutation in vitro and in murine fibroblasts demonstrated that it is likely neutral as measured by no change in protein activity or colony formation compared to wildtype (PMID: 25517749).

var_description_zh: ALK F1245V突变位于该蛋白的细胞内酪氨酸激酶结构域（PMID:21383740）。该突变已在神经母细胞瘤中发现（PMID:25517749）。该突变被鉴定为携带用ALK抑制剂恩曲替尼（PMID:28368455）治疗的CAD-ALK融合的结肠直肠癌患者的血浆循环肿瘤DNA中出现的继发性突变。该突变在体外和鼠成纤维细胞中的表达表明，与野生型相比，通过增加的蛋白活化和集落形成（PMID:25517749）来测量，该突变是活化的。体外研究表明，当在鼠成纤维细胞中表达时，该突变对克唑替尼敏感，这是通过药物治疗后生存力降低来衡量的（PMID:25517749）。
var_description: The ALK F1245V mutation is located in the intracellular tyrosine kinase domain of the protein (PMID: 21383740). This mutation has been found in neuroblastoma (PMID: 25517749). This mutation was identified as an emerged secondary mutation in the plasma circulating tumor DNA of a colorectal cancer patient harboring the CAD-ALK fusion treated with ALK inhibitor entrectinib (PMID: 28368455). Expression of this mutation in vitro and in murine fibroblast cells demonstrated that it is activating as measured by increased protein activation and colony formation compared to wildtype (PMID: 25517749). In vitro studies demonstrate that this mutation is sensitive to crizotinib when expressed in murine fibroblasts as measured by decreased viability upon drug treatment (PMID: 25517749).

var_description_zh: ALK I1170S突变位于蛋白的酪氨酸激酶结构域。该突变在成纤维细胞中的表达表明，与野生型蛋白（PMID:25517749）相比，通过增加的焦点形成来测量，该突变可能是激活的。
var_description: The ALK I1170S mutation is located in the tyrosine kinase domain of the protein. Expression of this mutation in fibroblast cells demonstrated it is likely activating as measured by increased foci formation compared to wildtype protein (PMID:25517749).

var_description_zh: ALK T1343I突变位于蛋白的酪氨酸激酶结构域。该突变已在神经母细胞瘤中发现（PMID:25517749）。该突变在体外和鼠成纤维细胞中的表达证明它是中性的，这是通过与野生型相比蛋白活化或集落形成没有变化来测量的（PMID:25517749）。
var_description: The ALK T1343I mutation is located in the tyrosine kinase domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in neuroblastoma (PMID: 25517749). Expression of this mutation in vitro and in murine fibroblast cells demonstrated that it is neutral as measured by no change in protein activation or colony formation compared to wildtype (PMID: 25517749).

var_description_zh: ALK R1275L突变位于该蛋白的酪氨酸激酶结构域。该突变已在神经母细胞瘤中发现（PMID:23598171）。虽然该突变尚未进行功能鉴定，但一名携带该突变的神经母细胞瘤患者对ALK抑制剂克唑替尼（PMID:23598171）的反应稳定。
var_description: The ALK R1275L mutation is located in the tyrosine kinase domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in neuroblastoma (PMID: 23598171). While this mutation has not yet been functionally characterized, one patient with neuroblastoma harboring this mutation demonstrated stable disease in response to the ALK inhibitor crizotinib (PMID: 23598171).

var_description_zh: ALK L1198F突变位于该蛋白的细胞内酪氨酸激酶结构域（PMID:21383740）。在淋巴瘤和肺癌中发现了这种突变（PMID:28572459）。该突变在鼠成纤维细胞中的表达表明，通过增加的蛋白活化、细胞侵袭和集落形成（PMID:21596819）来测量，该突变是活化的。体外研究表明，该突变对ALK抑制剂布加替尼、阿来替尼和色瑞替尼具有耐药性，但在鼠B细胞中的NPM-ALK融合中表达时对克唑替尼敏感，这是通过药物治疗后的细胞增殖来测量的（PMID:25421750）。体外研究还表明，当在NPM-ALK阳性淋巴瘤细胞系中与ALK C1156F突变共表达时，该突变对ALK抑制剂氯拉替尼具有抗性，这通过药物治疗后的持续蛋白活化和细胞增殖来测量（PMID:30322862）。一名携带ALK C1156Y突变的转移性ALK重排肺癌患者在接受氯拉替尼治疗后出现ALK L1198F突变（PMID:26698910）。ALK L1198F在患者肿瘤中的表达赋予了对氯拉替尼的耐药性，同时也使肿瘤对先前耐药的克唑替尼治疗敏感，解决了患者的癌症相关症状（PMID:26698910）。
var_description: The ALK L1198F mutation is located in the intracellular tyrosine kinase domain of the protein (PMID: 21383740). This mutation has been found in lymphoma and lung cancer (PMID: 28572459). Expression of this mutation in murine fibroblasts demonstrated that it is activating as measured by increased protein activation, cell invasion, and colony formation (PMID: 21596819). In vitro studies demonstrate that this mutation is resistant to the ALK inhibitors brigatinib, alectinib, and ceritinib but sensitive to crizotinib when expressed in the context of an NPM-ALK fusion in murine B-cells as measured by cell proliferation upon drug treatment (PMID: 25421750). In vitro studies also demonstrate that this mutation is resistant to the ALK inhibitor lorlatinib when coexpressed with an ALK C1156F mutation in an NPM-ALK-positive lymphoma line as measured by sustained protein activation and cell proliferation upon drug treatment (PMID: 30322862). A patient with metastatic ALK-rearranged lung cancer harboring an ALK C1156Y mutation acquired an ALK L1198F mutation upon progression after treatment with lorlatinib (PMID: 26698910). The expression of ALK L1198F in the patient's tumor conferred resistance to lorlatinib while also sensitizing the tumor to the previously resistant crizotinib treatment, resolving the patient's cancer-related symptoms (PMID: 26698910).

var_description_zh: ALK S1206C突变位于该蛋白的细胞内激酶结构域（PMID:21383740）。在淋巴瘤和肺癌中发现了这种突变（PMID:28572459）。体外研究表明，当在鼠B细胞中的NPM-ALK融合中表达时，该突变对克唑替尼、色瑞替尼、阿来替尼和布加替尼具有耐药性，如通过药物治疗后的持续增殖所测量的（PMID:25421750）。
var_description: The ALK S1206C mutation is located in the intracellular kinase domain of the protein (PMID: 21383740). This mutation has been found in lymphoma and lung cancer (PMID: 28572459). In vitro studies demonstrate that this mutation is resistant to crizotinib, ceritinib, alectinib and brigatinib when expressed in the context of an NPM-ALK fusion in murine B-cells as measured by sustained proliferation upon drug treatment (PMID: 25421750).

var_description_zh: ALK L1152R突变位于该蛋白的细胞内酪氨酸激酶结构域。在肺癌中发现了这种突变（PMID:21791641）。虽然该突变仅在ALK融合的背景下进行了研究，但该突变在EML4-ALK阳性小鼠B细胞系中的表达表明，与单独的EML4-ALK相比，该突变是中性的，没有改变通路激活或细胞增殖（PMID:21791641）。体外研究表明，当在小鼠B细胞或成纤维细胞系中的EML4-ALK融合中表达时，该突变对克唑替尼具有抗性，但对氯拉替尼敏感，这是通过蛋白质和通路活化分析以及药物治疗后的细胞增殖来测量的（PMID:26144315，21791641）。
var_description: The ALK L1152R mutation is located in the intracellular tyrosine kinase domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in lung cancer (PMID: 21791641). While this mutation has only been studied in the context of an ALK fusion, expression of this mutation in an EML4-ALK positive murine B-cell line demonstrated that it is neutral as measured by no change to pathway activation or cell proliferation compared to EML4-ALK alone (PMID: 21791641). In vitro studies demonstrate that this mutation is resistant to crizotinib but sensitive to lorlatinib when expressed in the context of an EML4-ALK fusion in murine B-cell or fibroblast cell lines as measured by protein and pathway activation analysis and cell proliferation upon drug treatment (PMID: 26144315, 21791641).

var_description_zh: ALK G1286R突变位于该蛋白的酪氨酸激酶结构域。该突变已在黑色素瘤中发现（PMID:25589618）。该突变在体外和鼠成纤维细胞中的表达证明其可能是中性的，因为与野生型相比，蛋白活化和集落形成没有变化（PMID:25517749）。
var_description: The ALK G1286R mutation is located in the tyrosine kinase domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in melanoma (PMID: 25589618). Expression of this mutation in vitro and in murine fibroblast cells demonstrated that it is likely neutral as measured by no change in protein activation and colony formation compared to wildtype (PMID: 25517749).

var_description_zh: ALK E1242K突变位于该蛋白的激酶结构域。该突变已在黑色素瘤中鉴定（PMID:32321774，22842228）。用表达ALK E1242K的NIH3T3细胞进行的体外研究表明，突变可能是中性的，如转化和激酶活性与野生型相当（PMID:33674381）。
var_description: The ALK E1242K mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein. This mutation has been identified in melanoma (PMID: 32321774, 22842228). In vitro studies with NIH3T3 cells expressing ALK E1242K demonstrate that the mutation is likely neutral as measured by transformation and kinase activity being comparable to wildtype (PMID: 33674381).

var_description_zh: AMER1的截短突变在结直肠癌中很常见，并且与间充质表型相关（PMID:26071483）。细胞中Amer1蛋白的丢失导致APC蛋白水平降低和APC在质膜上的定位降低（PMID:26071483）。
var_description: Truncating mutations of AMER1 are common in colorectal cancer and are associated with a mesenchymal phenotype (PMID: 26071483). Loss of AMER1 protein in cells results in decreased APC protein levels and decreased localization of APC to the plasma membrane (PMID: 26071483).

var_description_zh: ALK T1151R突变位于蛋白的酪氨酸激酶结构域。虽然该突变尚未进行功能鉴定，但一名携带该突变的神经母细胞瘤患者对克唑替尼产生了耐药性（PMID:25071110）。在一份病例报告中，一名肺腺癌患者在接受色瑞替尼治疗后获得ALK T1151R，随后在接受布加替尼（PMID:31027750）治疗后表现出显著的反应和肿瘤缩小。
var_description: The ALK T1151R mutation is located in the tyrosine kinase domain of the protein. While this mutation has not been functionally characterized, one patient with neuroblastoma harboring this mutation developed resistance to crizotinib (PMID: 25071110). In a case report, a patient with lung adenocarcinoma acquired ALK T1151R following treatment with ceritinib and then demonstrated significant response and tumor reduction after subsequent treatment with brigatinib (PMID: 31027750).

var_description_zh: 在家族性腺瘤性息肉病患者中检测到APC缺失（PMID:15643602，25317407）。这些改变主要包括整个APC基因座，导致单倍体不充分（PMID:11867715）。基于APC作为肿瘤抑制因子的功能，APC通过缺失突变的缺失可能导致异常的Wnt通路激活，并与增生和最终的肿瘤进展相关（PMID:8259511）。
var_description: APC deletions have been detected in patients with familial adenomatous polyposis (PMID: 15643602, 25317407). These alterations predominantly encompass the entire APC locus leading to haploinsuffuciciency (PMID: 11867715). Based on the function of APC as a tumor suppressor, loss of APC through deletion mutations is likely to result in aberrant WNT-pathway activation and is associated with hyperplasia and eventual tumor progression (PMID: 8259511).

var_description_zh: ALK S1206F突变位于该蛋白的激酶结构域。虽然该突变尚未进行功能表征，但一名在EML4-ALK重排背景下携带该突变的非小细胞肺癌患者表现出对克唑替尼的耐药性（PMID:27565908，27780853）。
var_description: The ALK S1206F mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein. While this mutation has not been functionally characterized, one patient with non-small cell lung cancer harboring this mutation in the context of an EML4-ALK rearrangement exhibited resistance to crizotinib (PMID: 27565908, 27780853).

var_description_zh: APC I1307K突变位于APC蛋白的β-连环蛋白结合域附近。该突变在家族性腺瘤性息肉病（FAP）（一种癌症易感综合征）和散发性结直肠癌中被发现为种系突变。虽然该突变尚未进行功能表征，但结构建模显示该突变可能失活，因为I1307K突变预计会影响β-连环蛋白结合（PMID:9724771）。
var_description: The APC I1307K mutation is located near a β-catenin binding domain in the APC protein. This mutation has been found as a germline mutation in familial adenomatous polyposis (FAP), a cancer predisposition syndrome, and sporadic colorectal cancer. While this mutation has not been functionally characterized, structural modeling shows that this mutation is likely inactivating because the I1307K mutation is predicted to impact β-catenin binding (PMID: 9724771).

var_description_zh: ALK V1180L突变位于蛋白的酪氨酸激酶结构域。该突变已在肺癌中发现（PMID:25228534）。虽然该突变仅在AML融合的情况下进行了研究，但该突变在EML4-ALK融合阳性的非小细胞肺癌和造血细胞中的表达表明，与单独的EML4-ALK相比，该突变通过增加的蛋白和途径活化增殖而被激活（PMID:25228534）。体外和体内研究表明，当在EML4-ALK融合蛋白中表达时，该突变对阿列替尼具有抗性，这是通过持续的蛋白活化和细胞活力（PMID:25228534）来测量的。在一份病例报告中，一名携带ALK V1180L和EML4-ALK的非小细胞肺癌患者最初接受阿列替尼治疗并表现出耐药性，诱导非小细胞肺癌向小细胞肺癌转化，随后接受氯拉替尼治疗并表现出部分缓解（PMID:37907052）。
var_description: The ALK V1180L mutation is located in the tyrosine kinase domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in lung cancer (PMID:  25228534). While this mutation has only been studied in the context of AML fusions, expression of this mutation in EML4-ALK fusion-positive non-small cell lung cancer and hematopoietic cells demonstrated that it is activating as measured by increased protein and pathway activation proliferation compared to EML4-ALK alone (PMID: 25228534). In vitro and in vivo studies demonstrate that this mutation is resistant to alectinib when expressed in the context of an EML4-ALK fusion as measured by sustained protein activation and cell viability (PMID: 25228534). In a case report, a patient with non-small cell lung cancer harboring ALK V1180L and EML4-ALK was initially treated with alectinib and demonstrated resistance, inducing non-small cell lung cancer to small cell lung cancer transformation, and was then subsequently treated with lorlatinib and demonstrated partial response (PMID: 37907052).

var_description_zh: 截短的APC突变导致全长APC蛋白的缺失，从而导致APC功能受损或异常。APC失调与致癌转录因子β-连环蛋白（β-catenin）的积累有关，进而导致靶基因表达异常和肿瘤发生（PMID:11062151）。APC截短突变通常是发生在单个等位基因（种系或体细胞）上的早期事件；然而，肿瘤通常在第二个等位基因上获得第二次命中，减少细胞中功能性APC的总量（PMID:11257105）。此外，已显示APC的截短突变的表达以显性方式导致染色体不稳定，假定在额外致癌改变的积累中起重要作用（PMID:15561772）。
var_description: Truncating APC mutations result in loss of full-length APC protein leading to impaired or abnormal APC function. APC deregulation is associated with accumulation of β-catenin, an oncogenic transcription factor, which in turn leads to aberrant target gene expression and tumorigenesis (PMID: 11062151). APC truncating mutations are typically early events occurring on a single allele (germline or somatic); however, the tumor often acquires a second hit on the second allele, reducing the overall amount of functional APC in the cell (PMID: 11257105). Furthermore, expression of truncating mutations of APC has been shown to result in chromosomal instability in a dominant manner, postulated to play an important role in the accumulation of additional oncogenic alterations (PMID: 15561772).

var_description_zh: APC N1026S突变位于APC蛋白的β-连环蛋白结合域附近。该突变在家族性腺瘤性息肉病（FAP）（一种癌症易感综合征）和散发性结直肠癌中被发现为种系突变。体外研究表明，与野生型相比，该突变可能通过降低β-连环蛋白结合而失活（PMID:18166348）。
var_description: The APC N1026S mutation is located near a β-catenin binding domain in the APC protein. This mutation has been found as a germline mutation in familial adenomatous polyposis (FAP), a cancer predisposition syndrome, and sporadic colorectal cancer. In vitro studies have demonstrated that this mutation is likely inactivating as measured by decreased β-catenin binding compared to wildtype (PMID: 18166348).

var_description_zh: AR A159T突变位于蛋白的氨基末端结构域。该突变是在一个雄激素不敏感综合征患者的种系中发现的。这种突变的功能数据相互矛盾。使用两个单独的转录报告基因在猿猴细胞系中表达该突变证明，与野生型相比，该突变是失活的或中性的，分别通过AR转录活性的降低或无变化来测量（pMID:25500996）。
var_description: The AR A159T mutation is located in the amino-terminal domain of the protein. This mutation was found in the germline of an individual with androgen insensitivity syndrome. There is conflicting functional data for this mutation. Expression of this mutation in a simian cell line using two separate transcriptional reporters demonstrated that it is inactivating or neutral as measured by a decrease or no change in AR transcriptional activity, respectively, compared to wildtype (PMID: 25500996).

var_description_zh: APC R640G突变位于APC蛋白的犰狳重复区。该突变在家族性腺瘤性息肉病（FAP）（一种癌症易感综合征）中被发现为种系突变。体外研究表明，与野生型（PMID:19111562）相比，通过APC蛋白的缺陷剪接测量，该突变可能失活。
var_description: The APC R640G mutation is located in the Armadillo repeat region of the APC protein. This mutation has been found as a germline mutation in familial adenomatous polyposis (FAP), a cancer predisposition syndrome. In vitro studies have demonstrated that this mutation is likely inactivating as measured by defective splicing of the APC protein compared to wildtype (PMID: 19111562).

var_description_zh: AR G248V突变位于蛋白的氨基末端结构域。该突变是在一名轻度雄激素不敏感综合征患者的种系中发现的。这种突变的功能数据相互矛盾。使用两个单独的转录报告基因在猿猴细胞系中表达该突变证明，与野生型相比，该突变是失活的或中性的，分别通过AR转录活性的降低或无变化来测量（pMID:25500996）。
var_description: The AR G248V mutation is located in the amino-terminal domain of the protein. This mutation was found in the germline of an individual with minor androgen insensitivity syndrome. There is conflicting functional data for this mutation. Expression of this mutation in a simian cell line using two separate transcriptional reporters demonstrated that it is inactivating or neutral as measured by a decrease or no change in AR transcriptional activity, respectively, compared to wildtype (PMID: 25500996).

var_description_zh: ALK F1245C突变位于蛋白的酪氨酸激酶结构域。该突变已在神经母细胞瘤中发现（PMID:25517749，26554404，23598171）。该突变在体外以及在大鼠肾上腺和鼠成纤维细胞系中的表达证明其是活化的，如通过与野生型相比增加的组成型蛋白活化、细胞活力和集落形成所测量的（PMID:25517749，27049722）。体外和体内研究表明，该突变对ALK抑制剂克唑替尼具有抗性，但在体外表达时，以及在大鼠肾上腺、神经母细胞瘤和鼠成纤维细胞中表达时，对布加替尼和劳拉替尼敏感，如通过蛋白活化分析、细胞增殖和药物治疗后的肿瘤生长所测量的（PMID:26554404，25517749）。体外研究还表明，当在小鼠B细胞中的EML4-ALK融合中表达时，该突变对克唑替尼具有耐药性，这是通过药物治疗后的持续细胞增殖来测量的（PMID:22034911）。
var_description: The ALK F1245C mutation is located in the tyrosine kinase domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in neuroblastoma (PMID: 25517749, 26554404, 23598171). Expression of this mutation in vitro and in rat adrenal and murine fibroblast cell lines demonstrates that it is activating as measured by increased constitutive protein activation, cell viability, and colony formation compared to wildtype (PMID: 25517749, 27049722). In vitro and in vivo studies demonstrate that this mutation is resistant to the ALK inhibitor crizotinib but sensitive to brigatinib and lorlatinib when expressed in vitro, and in rat adrenal, neuroblastoma and murine fibroblast cells as measured by protein activation analysis, cell proliferation and tumor growth upon drug treatment (PMID: 26554404, 25517749). In vitro studies also demonstrate that this mutation is resistant to crizotinib when expressed in the context of an EML4-ALK fusion in murine B-cells as measured by sustained cell proliferation upon drug treatment (PMID: 22034911).

var_description_zh: AR L272F突变位于蛋白的氨基末端结构域。该突变是在轻度或部分雄激素不敏感综合征个体的种系中发现的。该突变在猿猴细胞系中的表达表明其可能是中性的，因为与野生型相比，AR转录活性没有变化（PMID:25500996）。
var_description: The AR L272F mutation is located in the amino-terminal domain of the protein. This mutation was found in the germline of individuals with minor or partial androgen insensitivity syndrome. Expression of this mutation in a simian cell line demonstrated that it is likely neutral as measured by no change in AR transcriptional activity compared to wildtype (PMID: 25500996).

var_description_zh: AR H875Y突变位于蛋白的配体结合域。这种突变是在前列腺癌中发现的。该突变在猿猴细胞系中的表达表明，它激活并促进了对抗雄激素尼鲁米特和羟基氟他胺的抗性，这是通过药物治疗后增加的AR转录活性来测量的。该突变在猿猴和人前列腺癌细胞系中的表达也证明，用雄激素5A-二氢睾酮处理增加了转录活性，但没有达到野生型AR的水平，与野生型AR相比，用脱氢表雄酮、雌二醇和孕酮处理增加了转录活性，并且用抗雄激素比卡鲁胺处理对突变体的转录活性没有影响（PMID:9815822，9092797）。
var_description: The AR H875Y mutation is located in the ligand-binding domain of the protein. This mutation is found in prostate cancer. Expression of this mutation in simian cell lines demonstrated that it is activating and promotes resistance to the antiandrogens nilutamide and hydroxyflutamide as measured by increased AR transcriptional activity upon drug treatment. Expression of this mutation in simian and human prostate cancer cell lines also demonstrated that treatment with the androgen 5a-dihydrotestosterone increased transcriptional activity but not to levels seen by wildtype AR, treatment with dehydroepiandrosterone, estradiol and progesterone increased transcriptional activity compared to wildtype AR and treatment with the antiandrogen bicalutamide had no effect on transcriptional activity of the mutant (PMID: 9815822, 9092797).

var_description_zh: AR F876L突变位于蛋白的配体结合域。在用抗雄激素ARN-509治疗的进行性去势抵抗性前列腺癌中发现了这种突变。该突变在前列腺癌细胞系和异种移植模型中的表达表明，与野生型相比，在抗雄激素ARN-509和恩扎鲁胺的存在下，持续的AR转录活性和细胞增殖和肿瘤生长表明，该突变是活化的，并可促进抗雄激素抵抗（PMID:23779130）。
var_description: The AR F876L mutation is located in the ligand-binding domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in progressive castration-resistant prostate cancer that has been treated with the antiandrogen, ARN-509. Expression of this mutation in prostate cancer cell lines and xenograft models demonstrated that it is activating and can promote antiandrogen resistance, as shown by sustained AR transcriptional activity and cell proliferation and tumor growth in the presence of the antiandrogens, ARN-509 and enzalutamide, compared to wildtype (PMID: 23779130).

var_description_zh: AR L57del突变位于蛋白的氨基末端结构域。该突变是在轻度或部分雄激素不敏感综合征个体的种系中发现的。该突变在猿猴细胞系中的表达表明其可能是中性的，因为与野生型相比，AR转录活性没有变化（PMID:25500996）。
var_description: The AR L57del mutation is located in the amino-terminal domain of the protein. This mutation was found in the germline of individuals with minor or partial androgen insensitivity syndrome. Expression of this mutation in a simian cell line demonstrated that it is likely neutral as measured by no change in AR transcriptional activity compared to wildtype (PMID: 25500996).

var_description_zh: AR G216R突变位于蛋白的氨基末端结构域。该突变是在部分或轻微雄激素不敏感综合征患者的种系中发现的，这些患者具有该综合征的各种相关表现。该突变在猿猴细胞系中的表达表明其可能是中性的，因为与野生型相比，AR转录活性没有变化（PMID:25500996）。
var_description: The AR G216R mutation is located in the amino-terminal domain of the protein. This mutation was found in the germline of individuals with partial or minor androgen insensitivity syndrome with various related manifestations of the syndrome. Expression of this mutation in a simian cell line demonstrated that it is likely neutral as measured by no change in AR transcriptional activity compared to wildtype (PMID: 25500996).

var_description_zh: AR V716M突变（也称为AR V715M）位于蛋白质的配体结合域。该突变已在前列腺癌中鉴定（PMID:37563129）。用表达AR V716M的COS7细胞进行的体外研究表明，与野生型（PMID:8145761）相比，通过在孕酮存在下增加的转录活性来测量，该突变被激活。前列腺癌患者接受氟他胺治疗，在治疗患者的三个转移灶中发现AR V716M（PMID:19366804）。
var_description: The AR V716M mutation (also referred to as AR V715M) is located in the ligand-binding domain of the protein. This mutation has been identified in prostate cancer (PMID: 37563129). In vitro studies with COS7 cells expressing AR V716M demonstrate that the mutation is activating as measured by increased transcriptional activity in the presence of progesterone compared to wildtype (PMID: 8145761). A patient with prostate cancer was treated with flutamide and AR V716M was identified in three metastases from the treated patient (PMID: 19366804).

var_description_zh: AR W742L突变（也称为W741L）位于该蛋白的激活功能-2结构域。这种突变是在前列腺癌中发现的。该突变在前列腺癌细胞中的表达表明其促进对比卡鲁胺的抗性，如通过药物治疗后持续的AR转录活性所测量的，但对另一种抗雄激素药物羟基氟他胺仍然敏感，如通过药物治疗后降低的AR转录活性所显示的（PMID:12517791）。
var_description: The AR W742L mutation (also called W741L) is located in the activation function-2 domain of the protein. This mutation is found in prostate cancer. Expression of this mutation in prostate cancer cells demonstrated that it promotes resistance to bicalutamide, as measured by sustained AR transcriptional activity upon drug treatment, but remains sensitive to another anti-androgen, hydroxyflutamide, as shown by decreased AR transcriptional activity upon drug treatment (PMID: 12517791).

var_description_zh: AR扩增导致该蛋白的过表达。该突变已在去势抵抗性前列腺癌中发现，并构成对激素治疗的抗性机制（PMID:7795646，12888829）。与具有正常AR表达的细胞相比，AR在前列腺癌细胞系和异种移植模型中的过表达证明其被激活，如通过在缺乏雄激素的培养基中的增殖增加和在抗雄激素比卡鲁胺存在下的增殖增加所测量的（PMID:7511045，10496349，11306464，14702632）。
var_description: AR amplification results in overexpression of the protein. This mutation has been found in castration-resistant prostate cancer and constitutes a mechanism of resistance to hormonal therapy (PMID: 7795646, 12888829). Overexpression of AR in prostate cancer cell lines and xenograft models demonstrates that it is activating as measured by increased proliferation in androgen-deprived media and increased proliferation in the presence of the anti-androgen, bicalutamide, compared to cells with normal AR expression (PMID: 7511045, 10496349, 11306464, 14702632).

var_description_zh: ALK F1174C突变位于该蛋白的细胞内酪氨酸激酶结构域（PMID:21383740）。该突变已在神经母细胞瘤和肺癌中发现（PMID:21632861，21940108，25517749，28572459，24675041）。该突变被鉴定为携带用ALK抑制剂恩曲替尼（PMID:28368455）治疗的CAD-ALK融合的结直肠癌患者的血浆循环肿瘤DNA中出现的继发性突变。虽然该突变仅在ALK融合的背景下进行了研究，但该突变在EML4-ALK融合阳性小鼠B细胞系中的表达表明，与单独的EML4-ALK相比，该突变通过增加的途径激活而被激活（PMID:22034911）。体外研究表明，该突变对ALK抑制剂克唑替尼和色瑞替尼具有耐药性，但在小鼠B细胞中EML4-ALK融合表达时对阿来替尼、布加替尼和劳拉替尼敏感，这是通过在药物存在下的持续细胞增殖来测量的（PMID:24675041，27432227）。
var_description: The ALK F1174C mutation is located in the intracellular tyrosine kinase domain of the protein (PMID: 21383740). This mutation has been found in neuroblastoma and lung cancer (PMID: 21632861, 21940108, 25517749, 28572459, 24675041). This mutation was identified as an emerged secondary mutation in the plasma circulating tumor DNA of a colorectal cancer patient harboring the CAD-ALK fusion treated with ALK inhibitor entrectinib (PMID: 28368455). While this mutation has only been studied in the context of an ALK fusion, expression of this mutation in an EML4-ALK fusion-positive murine B-cell line demonstrated that it is activating as measured by increased pathway activation compared to EML4-ALK alone (PMID: 22034911).  In vitro studies demonstrated that this mutation is resistant to the ALK inhibitors crizotinib and ceritinib but sensitive to alectinib, brigatinib and lorlatinib when expressed in the context of an EML4-ALK fusion in murine B cells as measured by sustained cell proliferation in the presence of the drug (PMID: 24675041, 27432227).

var_description_zh: ARV567ES变体保留了蛋白的氨基末端反式激活和DNA结合结构域，但缺少羧基末端配体结合结构域。在去势抵抗性转移性前列腺癌中发现该变体（PMID:21552559）。该变体在前列腺癌细胞系、异种移植模型和转基因小鼠模型中的表达证明，如通过核定位所测量的，其是活化的，与野生型相比，雄激素非依赖性细胞增殖和肿瘤生长增加，并且诱导前列腺癌的致癌作用（PMID:20644256，24027426）。
var_description: The ARv567es variant retains the amino-terminal transactivation and DNA binding domains of the protein but lacks the carboxy-terminal ligand binding domain. This variant is found in castration-resistant metastatic prostate cancer (PMID: 21552559). Expression of this variant in prostate cancer cell lines, xenograft models and a transgenic mouse model demonstrated that it is activating as measured by nuclear localization, increased androgen-independent cell proliferation and tumor growth compared to wildtype and the induction of prostate cancer carcinogenesis (PMID: 20644256, 24027426).

var_description_zh: AR增强子的扩增导致位于AR基因上游650kb的该调控元件的拷贝数增加。在去势抵抗性前列腺癌中发现了这种改变（PMID:29909987，33620092，29909985，32903952）。与具有正常AR增强子表达的细胞相比，在低雄激素剂量下，前列腺癌细胞系中AR增强子区的扩增被激活，如增殖增加所示（PMID:29909987）。用去势抵抗性转移性前列腺癌的患者来源的异种移植物进行的体外和体内实验已经证明，这种改变可以赋予对恩扎鲁胺和阿帕鲁胺（直接AR拮抗剂）的抗性，如通过与野生型相比对药物的敏感性降低所测量的（PMID:29909987，33620092）。4例携带AR增强子扩增的转移性去势抵抗性前列腺癌患者在接受恩扎鲁胺治疗后疾病进展（PMID:29909985，32903952）。
var_description: Amplification of the AR enhancer results in a copy number increase of this regulatory element located 650 kb upstream of the AR gene. This alteration has been found in castration-resistant prostate cancer (PMID: 29909987, 33620092, 29909985, 32903952). Amplification of the AR enhancer region in prostate cancer cell lines is activating as demonstrated by increased proliferation at low androgen doses compared to cells with normal AR enhancer expression (PMID: 29909987). In vitro and in vivo experiments with patient-derived xenografts of castration-resistant metastatic prostate cancer have demonstrated that this alteration may confer resistance to enzalutamide and apalutamide, direct AR antagonists, as measured by decreased sensitivity to the drug compared to wildtype (PMID: 29909987, 33620092). Four patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer harboring AR enhancer amplification had progressive disease upon treatment with enzalutamide (PMID: 29909985, 32903952).

var_description_zh: AR T878A突变位于蛋白的配体结合域。该突变在对雄激素合成抑制剂醋酸阿比特龙或抗雄激素药物羟基氟他胺耐药的前列腺癌中发现（PMID:25320358，10363963，38781544）。该突变在前列腺癌细胞系中的表达表明，与野生型相比，该突变是激活的，如通过响应于许多类固醇激素（包括孕酮、雌激素、肾上腺雄激素脱氢表雄酮）而增加的AR转录活性以及响应于抗雄激素尼鲁米特和羟基氟他胺而增加的AR转录活性所测量的（PMID:2260966，9815822，9092797）。
var_description: The AR T878A mutation is located in the ligand-binding domain of the protein. This mutation was found in prostate cancer resistant to the androgen synthesis inhibitor abiraterone acetate or the antiandrogen hydroxyflutamide (PMID: 25320358, 10363963, 38781544). Expression of this mutation in prostate cancer cell lines demonstrated that it is activating as measured by increased AR transcriptional activity in response to numerous steroid hormones, including progesterone, estrogen, adrenal androgen dehydroepiandrosterone as well as increased AR transcriptional activity in response to the antiandrogens, nilutamide and hydroxyflutamide, compared to wildtype (PMID: 2260966, 9815822, 9092797).

var_description_zh: AR N235K突变位于蛋白的氨基末端结构域。这种突变是在一个患有轻度雄激素不敏感综合征的个体的种系中发现的。该突变在猿猴细胞系中的表达表明，与野生型相比，通过降低的AR转录活性（PMID:25500996，11422119）来测量，该突变可能是失活的。
var_description: The AR N235K mutation is located in the amino-terminal domain of the protein. This mutation was found in the germline of an individual with minor androgen insensitivity syndrome. Expression of this mutation in a simian cell line demonstrated that it is likely inactivating as measured by decreased AR transcriptional activity compared to wildtype (PMID: 25500996, 11422119).

var_description_zh: AR W742C突变（也称为W741C）位于该蛋白的激活功能-2结构域。这种突变是在前列腺癌中发现的。该突变在前列腺癌细胞中的表达表明，它促进了对比卡鲁胺的抗性，如通过药物治疗后异种移植模型中持续的AR转录活性和肿瘤生长所测量的，但对另一种抗雄激素药物羟基氟他胺仍然敏感，如通过药物治疗后降低的AR转录活性所显示的（PMID:12517791）。
var_description: The AR W742C mutation (also called W741C) is located in the activation function-2 domain of the protein. This mutation is found in prostate cancer. Expression of this mutation in prostate cancer cells demonstrated that it promotes resistance to bicalutamide, as measured by sustained AR transcriptional activity and tumor growth in xenograft models upon drug treatment, but remains sensitive to another anti-androgen, hydroxyflutamide, as shown by decreased AR transcriptional activity upon drug treatment (PMID: 12517791).

var_description_zh: AR Q 58_Q59insL突变位于该蛋白的氨基末端结构域。这种突变是在一个患有轻度雄激素不敏感综合征的个体的种系中发现的。该突变在猿猴细胞系中的表达表明，通过与野生型相比降低的AR转录活性（PMID:25500996）来测量，其可能是失活的。
var_description: The AR Q58_Q59insL mutation is located in the amino-terminal domain of the protein. This mutation was found in the germline of an individual with minor androgen insensitivity syndrome. Expression of this mutation in a simian cell line demonstrated that it is likely inactivating as measured by decreased AR transcriptional activity compared to wildtype (PMID: 25500996).

var_description_zh: AR L702H突变位于蛋白的配体结合域。该突变已在对醋酸阿比特龙或恩扎鲁胺耐药的转移性去势抵抗性前列腺癌中被鉴定（PMID:38781544）。首次发现AR L702H突变与AR T878A突变共表达。该突变在猿猴和人类细胞系中的表达表明，与野生型相比，其对糖皮质激素皮质醇的转录活性和细胞增殖反应增加。与单独表达L702H相比，该突变与AR T878A突变的表达表现出对皮质醇更高的响应性，如通过增加的转录活性所测量的，并且还表现出对抗雄激素比卡鲁胺的敏感性，如通过降低的转录活性和在药物治疗后降低的细胞增殖所测量的（PMID:10835690，11956172）。
var_description: The AR L702H mutation is located in the ligand-binding domain of the protein. This mutation has been identified in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer that was resistant to abiraterone acetate or enzalutamide (PMID: 38781544). The AR L702H mutation was first found to be co-expressed with the AR T878A mutation. Expression of this mutation in simian and human cell lines demonstrated that it is activating as measured by increased transcriptional activity and cell proliferation in response to the glucocorticoid cortisol compared to wildtype. Expression of this mutation along with the AR T878A mutation demonstrated even higher responsiveness to cortisol as measured by increased transcriptional activity compared to expression of L702H alone and also shows sensitivity to the anti-androgen bicalutamide as measured by decreased transcriptional activity and decreased cell proliferation upon drug treatment (PMID: 10835690, 11956172).

var_description_zh: AR L57Q突变发生在蛋白质的氨基末端结构域内。这种突变是在前列腺癌中发现的。L57Q突变在猿猴细胞系中的表达表明，与野生型相比，通过降低的AR转录活性（PMID:22403669）来测量，它是失活的。
var_description: The AR L57Q mutation occurs within the amino-terminal domain of the protein. This mutation is found in prostate cancer. Expression of the L57Q mutation in simian cell lines demonstrated that it is inactivating as measured by decreased AR transcriptional activity compared to wildtype (PMID: 22403669).

var_description_zh: AR P380R突变位于蛋白的氨基末端结构域。这种突变是在一个患有轻度雄激素不敏感综合征的个体的种系中发现的。这种突变的功能数据相互矛盾。使用两个单独的转录报告基因在猿猴细胞系中表达该突变证明，与野生型相比，该突变是失活的或中性的，分别通过AR转录活性的降低或无变化来测量（pMID:25500996）。
var_description: The AR P380R mutation is located in the amino-terminal domain of the protein. This mutation was found in the germline of an individual with minor androgen insensitivity syndrome. There is conflicting functional data for this mutation. Expression of this mutation in a simian cell line using two separate transcriptional reporters demonstrated that it is inactivating or neutral as measured by a decrease or no change in AR transcriptional activity, respectively, compared to wildtype (PMID: 25500996).

var_description_zh: AR F877L突变位于蛋白的配体结合域。该突变在对恩扎鲁胺耐药的前列腺癌和转移性去势抵抗性前列腺癌中发现（PMID:23779130，38781544）。该突变在前列腺癌细胞系和异种移植模型中的表达证明其激活并促进对抗雄激素、恩扎鲁胺和ARN-509的抗性，如通过药物治疗后持续的AR转录活性和持续的细胞增殖和肿瘤生长所测量的（PMID:23779130，23842682）。
var_description: The AR F877L mutation is located in the ligand-binding domain of the protein. This mutation is found in prostate cancer and metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer that was resistant to enzalutamide (PMID: 23779130, 38781544). Expression of this mutation in prostate cancer cell lines and xenograft models demonstrates that it is activating and promotes resistance to the anti-androgens, enzalutamide and ARN-509 as measured by sustained AR transcriptional activity and sustained cell proliferation and tumor growth upon drug treatment (PMID: 23779130, 23842682).

var_description_zh: AR-V7变体是雄激素受体的剪接变体，缺少外显子3至内含子3。AR-V7保留了蛋白的氨基末端反式激活和DNA结合域，但缺少羧基末端配体结合域。该变异体在正常前列腺和激素敏感性前列腺癌中发现，但在去势抵抗性前列腺癌中尤其过表达（PMID:21552559）。该变体在前列腺癌细胞系和异种移植模型中的表达表明，与野生型相比，其通过核定位、增加的AR转录激活和增加的雄激素非依赖性细胞增殖和肿瘤生长而被激活（PMID:19117982，19244107）。体外研究表明，与野生型相比，AR-V7在DNA上具有独特的结合位点（PMID:35354884）。
var_description: The AR-V7 variant is a splice variant of the androgen receptor that lacks exon 3 to intron 3. AR-V7 retains the amino-terminal transactivation and DNA binding domains of the protein but lacks the carboxy-terminal ligand-binding domain. This variant is found in normal prostate and hormone-sensitive prostate cancer, but is especially overexpressed in castration-resistant prostate cancer (PMID: 21552559). Expression of this variant in prostate cancer cell lines and xenograft models demonstrated that it is activating as measured by nuclear localization, increased AR transcriptional activation and increased androgen-independent cell proliferation and tumor growth compared to wildtype (PMID: 19117982, 19244107). In vitro studies have demonstrated that AR-V7 has unique binding sites on DNA compared to wildtype (PMID: 35354884).

var_description_zh: AR T878S突变位于蛋白的配体结合域。该突变已在对醋酸阿比特龙（PMID:38781544）耐药的转移性去势抵抗性前列腺癌中被鉴定。该突变在猿猴细胞系中的表达表明，它激活并促进对抗雄激素尼鲁米特和羟基氟他胺的抗性，如药物治疗后AR转录活性增加所示。该突变在猿猴细胞系中的表达还表明，用雄激素5A-二氢睾酮处理增加了转录活性，但没有达到野生型AR的水平，并且用抗雄激素比卡鲁胺处理对转录活性没有影响（PMID:9815822）。
var_description: The AR T878S mutation is located in the ligand-binding domain of the protein. This mutation has been identified in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer that was resistant to abiraterone acetate (PMID: 38781544). Expression of this mutation in simian cell lines demonstrated that it is activating and promotes resistance to the antiandrogens nilutamide and hydroxyflutamide as shown by increased AR transcriptional activity upon drug treatment. Expression of this mutation in simian cell lines also demonstrated that treatment with the androgen 5a-dihydrotestosterone increased transcriptional activity but not to levels seen by wildtype AR and treatment with the antiandrogen bicalutamide had no effect on transcriptional activity (PMID: 9815822).

var_description_zh: AR D891N突变位于蛋白的配体结合域。该突变已在前列腺癌中鉴定（PMID:10363963）。关于该突变的致癌功能存在相互矛盾的证据。用AR D891N进行的体外荧光素酶报告基因分析表明，与野生型相比，在雌二醇和孕酮存在的情况下，通过增加的转录活性来测量，突变是激活的（PMID:34208290）。然而，用AR D891N进行的其它体外荧光素酶报告基因测定表明，在R1881、孕烯醇酮、孕酮、泼尼松和地塞米松（PMID:37563129）的存在下，通过与野生型相当的转录活性测量，突变可能是中性的。
var_description: The AR D891N mutation is located in the ligand-binding domain of the protein. This mutation has been identified in prostate cancer (PMID: 10363963). There is conflicting evidence on the oncogenic function of this mutation. In vitro luciferase reporter assays with AR D891N demonstrate that the mutation is activating as measured by increased transcriptional activity in the presence of estradiol and progesterone compared to wildtype (PMID: 34208290). However, other in vitro luciferase reporter assays with AR D891N demonstrate that the mutation is likely neutral as measured by transcriptional activity comparable to wildtype in the presence of R1881, pregnenolone, progesterone, prednisone and dexamethasone (PMID: 37563129).

var_description_zh: AR Q120E突变位于蛋白的氨基末端结构域。该突变是在一名患有部分雄激素不敏感综合征（表现为阴蒂肥大）的个体的种系中发现的。该突变在猿猴细胞系中的表达表明其可能是中性的，因为与野生型相比，AR转录活性没有变化（PMID:25500996）。
var_description: The AR Q120E mutation is located in the amino-terminal domain of the protein. This mutation was found in the germline of an individual with partial androgen insensitivity syndrome manifested by clitoromegaly. Expression of this mutation in a simian cell line demonstrated that it is likely neutral as measured by no change in AR transcriptional activity compared to wildtype (PMID: 25500996).

var_description_zh: ARID1A截短突变可以产生几种形式的C末端截短蛋白。在胃癌、结肠癌、乳腺癌和胰腺癌中发现了这些突变（PMID:22009941）。这些突变在卵巢和子宫内膜癌细胞系中的内源性表达表明，与野生型的再表达相比，它们通过增加的细胞增殖而被激活，并且体内ARID1A的缺失结合PTEN-PIK3CA途径中的突变导致转基因小鼠模型中卵巢癌的发展（PMID:21900401，24899687，25625625）。
var_description: ARID1A truncating mutations can produce several forms of C-terminally truncated proteins. These mutations have been found in gastric, colon, breast, and pancreatic cancer (PMID: 22009941). Endogenous expression of these mutations in ovarian and endometrial cancer cell lines demonstrated that they are activating as measured by increased cell proliferation compared to the re-expression of wildtype, and in vivo loss of ARID1A in combination with a mutation in the PTEN-PIK3CA pathway resulted in the development of ovarian cancer in transgenic mouse models (PMID: 21900401, 24899687, 25625625).

var_description_zh: ASXL1 G646WFS*12突变位于蛋白的SRC1结合域。该突变已在原发性骨髓纤维化中发现（PMID:31076447）。在骨髓移植小鼠模型中，小鼠骨髓细胞中ASXL1截短突变的表达导致去分化和骨髓增生异常综合征（PMID:24216483，26095772）。该突变与原发性骨髓纤维化患者较差的生存率相关（PMID:31076447）。
var_description: The ASXL1 G646Wfs*12 mutation is located in the SRC1-binding domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in primary myelofibrosis (PMID: 31076447). Expression of ASXL1 truncation mutations in murine myeloid cells resulted in dedifferentiation and myelodysplastic syndrome in a bone marrow transplant mouse model (PMID: 24216483, 26095772). This mutation is associated with worse survival in patients with primary myelofibrosis (PMID: 31076447).

var_description_zh: ARID1A缺失导致该蛋白的丢失，并已在胃癌、乳腺癌和卵巢癌中发现（PMID:22249247，23208470，21412130）。这些改变经常与PTEN或PIK3CA突变同时发生。结肠和子宫内膜癌细胞系中ARID1A的缺失导致DNA损伤和对PARP抑制的敏感性增加，并且体内ARID1A的缺失结合PTEN-PIK3CA途径的突变导致转基因小鼠模型中卵巢癌的发展（PMID:31196855，24899687，25625625）。
var_description: ARID1A deletions result in loss of the protein and have been found in gastric, breast and ovarian cancer (PMID: 22249247, 23208470, 21412130). These alterations frequently co-occur with PTEN or PIK3CA mutations. Deletion of ARID1A in colon and endometrial cancer cell lines resulted in increased DNA damage and sensitivity to PARP inhibition, and in vivo loss of ARID1A in combination with a mutation in the PTEN-PIK3CA pathway resulted in the development of ovarian cancer in transgenic mouse models (PMID: 31196855, 24899687, 25625625).

var_description_zh: ASXL1缺失导致蛋白质的丢失。这些突变已在髓系疾病中发现（PMID:22897849）。与野生型相比，ASXL1敲低转基因小鼠模型的体内研究通过增加凋亡和有丝分裂导致骨髓增生异常综合征的发展（PMID:24255920，24218140）。
var_description: ASXL1 deletions result in the loss of the protein. These mutations have been found in myeloid disorders (PMID: 22897849). In vivo studies with an ASXL1 knockdown transgenic mouse model resulted in the development of a myelodysplastic syndrome through increased apoptosis and mitosis compared to wildtype (PMID: 24255920, 24218140).

var_description_zh: ATM D1682H突变位于蛋白质的已知功能域之外。该突变已在慢性淋巴细胞性白血病患者中发现（PMID:23585524）。与野生型（pMID：pMID:23585524）相比，携带该突变的原代CLL细胞证明其可能是失活的，这是通过照射后下游靶基因的激活减少来测量的。
var_description: The ATM D1682H mutation is located outside of a known functional domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in patients with chronic lymphocytic leukemia (PMID: 23585524). Primary CLL cells harboring this mutation demonstrated that it is likely inactivating as measured by decreased activation of downstream target genes after irradiation compared to wildtype (PMID: PMID: 23585524).

var_description_zh: ASXL1截短突变可产生几种形式的C末端截短蛋白，最常见的是导致PhD结构域的缺失（PMID:22897849）。这些突变已在白血病中发现（PMID:21455215，19388938）。在骨髓移植小鼠模型中，小鼠骨髓细胞中ASXL1截短突变的表达导致去分化和骨髓增生异常综合征（PMID:24216483，26095772）。
var_description: ASXL1 truncating mutations can produce several forms of C-terminally truncated proteins and most commonly result in loss of the PHD domain (PMID: 22897849). These mutations have been found in leukemia (PMID: 21455215, 19388938). Expression of ASXL1 truncating mutations in murine myeloid cells resulted in dedifferentiation and myelodysplastic syndrome in a bone marrow transplant mouse model (PMID: 24216483, 26095772).

var_description_zh: ATM截短突变可以产生几种形式的C末端截短的ATM蛋白。当在种系中发现时，这些突变导致共济失调-毛细血管扩张综合征，这增加了癌症易感性，包括20%至30%的淋巴癌、胃癌、乳腺癌、中枢神经系统、皮肤癌和其他癌症的终生风险（PMID:27413114）。ATM在小鼠模型和细胞系中的缺失证明它是致癌的，如通过降低的DNA修复效率和增加的细胞运动性所测量的（PMID:30553448，30348496）。
var_description: ATM truncating mutations can produce several forms of C-terminally truncated ATM proteins. When found in the germline, these mutations result in ataxia-telangiectasia syndrome, which increases cancer predisposition, including a 20% to 30% lifetime risk of lymphoid, gastric, breast, central nervous system, skin, and other cancers (PMID: 27413114). Deletion of ATM in mouse models and cell lines demonstrates that it is oncogenic as measured by decreased DNA repair efficiency and increased cellular motility (PMID: 30553448, 30348496).

var_description: The ATM S2855_V2856delinsRI mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in patients with Ataxia Telangiectasia (PMID: 19431188). Expression of this mutation in an ATM-null cell line has demonstrated that it is likely inactivating as measured by loss of kinase activity compared to wildtype (PMID: 19431188).

var_description_zh: ATM R 2547_S2549del突变位于该蛋白的脂肪调节区和激酶区之间。该突变已在共济失调-毛细血管扩张症中发现（PMID:12552559，22649200，11382771）。虽然该突变尚未进行功能表征，但在共济失调-毛细血管扩张症细胞和小鼠模型中跨越该范围的其他ATM插入/缺失突变的表达表明，与野生型相比，它们通过降低的激酶活性、破坏的DNA损伤反应和增加的肿瘤发展易感性而失活（PMID:19431188，11382771，12195425）。
var_description: The ATM R2547_S2549del mutation is located in between the FAT regulatory and kinase domains of the protein. This mutation has been found in ataxia-telangiectasia (PMID: 12552559, 22649200, 11382771). While this mutation has not been functionally characterized, expression of other ATM insertion/deletion mutations spanning this range in ataxia-telangiectasia cells and mouse models demonstrated that they are inactivating as measured by reduced kinase activity, disrupted DNA damage response and increased susceptibility to tumor development compared to wildtype (PMID: 19431188, 11382771, 12195425).

var_description_zh: ATM L589R突变（也称为ATM L590R）位于蛋白质的热重复结构域中。该突变已在共济失调-毛细血管扩张症中发现（PMID:12552559，15928302）。该突变在共济失调-毛细血管扩张症细胞中的表达表明，通过蛋白表达的缺失（PMID:10873394）来测量，该突变是失活的。
var_description: The ATM L589R mutation  (also cited as ATM L590R) is located in the HEAT repeat domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in ataxia-telangiectasia (PMID: 12552559, 15928302). Expression of this mutation in ataxia-telangiectasia cells demonstrated that it is inactivating as measured by loss of protein expression (PMID: 10873394).

var_description_zh: ATM S49C突变位于蛋白质的已知功能域之外。该突变已在慢性淋巴细胞性白血病（CLL）患者中发现（PMID:23585524）。与野生型（pMID：pMID:23585524）相比，携带该突变的原代CLL细胞证明其可能是中性的，如通过照射后下游靶基因的激活所测量的。

This mutation has been found in patients with chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL)(PMID: 23585524). Primary CLL cells harboring this mutation demonstrated it is likely neutral as measured by activation of downstream target genes after irradiation comparable to wildtype (PMID: PMID: 23585524).

var_description_zh: ATM N2875K突变位于该蛋白的激酶结构域。该突变已在前列腺癌中发现，并且是统计学上显著的热点（PMID:29247016）。该突变与AMT D2870A突变一起在人胚胎肾细胞和小鼠模型中的表达表明，这两种突变一起失活，如通过破坏的DNA损伤反应和与野生型相比增加的染色质不稳定性所测量的（PMID:9733515，22869596）。D2870A/N2875K突变在小鼠胚胎成纤维细胞中的表达也显示出对拓扑异构酶I抑制剂喜树碱的敏感性增加，如通过药物治疗后细胞增殖减少所测量的（PMID:27304073）。
var_description: The ATM N2875K mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in prostate cancer and is a statistically significant hotspot (PMID: 29247016). Expression of this mutation, along with the AMT D2870A mutation, in human embryonic kidney cells and mouse models demonstrated that together both mutations are inactivating as measured by disrupted DNA damage response and increased chromatin instability compared to wildtype (PMID: 9733515, 22869596) Expression of the D2870A/N2875K mutations in murine embryonic fibroblasts also showed increased sensitivity to the topoisomerase I inhibitor camptothecin as measured by decreased cell proliferation upon drug treatment (PMID: 27304073).

var_description_zh: ATM R3008C突变位于蛋白质的激酶结构域中。该突变已在慢性淋巴细胞白血病（CLL）、弥漫性大B细胞白血病和套细胞白血病（PMID:11756177）中发现。该突变在来自CLL患者的样品中以及在共济失调毛细血管扩张症淋巴母细胞样细胞系中的表达证明其是失活的，如与野生型相比对DNA损伤剂的蛋白质应答降低所示（PMID:23585524，12552566）。
var_description: The ATM R3008C mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL), diffuse large B-cell leukemia and mantle cell leukemia (PMID: 11756177). Expression of this mutation in samples from patients with CLL as well as in an ataxia telangiectasia lymphoblastoid cell line demonstrated that it was inactivating as shown by a reduction in protein response to DNA damaging agents compared to wildtype (PMID: 23585524, 12552566).

var_description_zh: ATM N2875T突变位于蛋白的MG2-结合催化环中。该突变已在肝细胞癌中鉴定（PMID:22634756）。计算机分析表明，该突变通过破坏催化环活性位点而失活（PMID:31740029）。
var_description: The ATM N2875T mutation is located in the Mg2-binding catalytic loop of the protein. This mutation has been identified in hepatocellular carcinoma (PMID: 22634756). In silico analysis suggests that the mutation is inactivating through disruption of the catalytic loop active site (PMID: 31740029).

var_description_zh: ATM T2031I突变位于蛋白质的脂肪结构域。该突变已在神经母细胞瘤患者中发现（PMID:29059438）。该突变在ATM缺陷型成纤维细胞中的表达表明，通过与野生型（PMID:29059438）相当的辐射后的稳定生存力测量，它可能是中性的。
var_description: The ATM T2031I mutation is located in the FAT domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in patients with neuroblastoma (PMID: 29059438). Expression of this mutation in ATM-deficient fibroblasts demonstrated that it is likely neutral as measured by stable viability after irradiation comparable to wildtype (PMID: 29059438).

var_description_zh: ATRX缺失导致蛋白表达缺失，发生在α地中海贫血精神发育迟滞（ATR-X）综合征和α地中海贫血骨髓增生异常综合征（ATMDS）患者中。与缺乏ATRX改变的患者相比，ATRX缺失的患者预后更好（PMID:23904111，27311324）。此外，一项研究显示ATRX缺失与p53突变显著相关（PMID:26741321）。基于功能缺失研究，预计ATRX缺失会导致染色体不稳定和端粒交替延长（ALT）（PMID:21719641，24148618）。
var_description: ATRX deletions lead to loss of protein expression and occur in patients with alpha thalassaemia mental retardation (ATR-X) syndrome and alpha thalassemia myelodysplastic syndrome (ATMDS). Patients with ATRX deletions are associated with better prognosis than those lacking ATRX alterations (PMID: 23904111, 27311324). Additionally, a single study revealed a significant association of ATRX loss and p53 mutations (PMID: 26741321). Based on loss of function studies, ATRX deletions are expected to result in chromosomal instability and alternate lengthening of telomeres (ALT) (PMID: 21719641, 24148618).

var_description_zh: Axin1的截短突变导致Axin1蛋白通常缺乏二聚化结构域和/或GSK3和β-连环蛋白结合结构域（PMID:25236910）。Axin1缺失的细胞系表现出增加的β-连环蛋白活性，并且Axin1的过表达是生长抑制的（PMID:10700176）。
var_description: Truncation mutations of AXIN1 result in AXIN1 proteins that typically lack the dimerization domain and/or GSK3 and β-catenin binding domain (PMID: 25236910). AXIN1 deleted cell lines exhibit increased β-catenin activity and overexpression of AXIN1 was growth suppressive (PMID: 10700176).

var_description_zh: Axin1的缺失导致β-连环蛋白的降解受损，从而导致Wnt信号通路激活受损。在髓母细胞瘤中发现了Axin1缺失（PMID:11585731）。用Axin1敲低的人肝细胞癌小鼠模型进行的体内研究表明，Axin1的缺失是失活的，这是通过与野生型相比，经典Wnt/β-连环蛋白靶基因的诱导减少来测量的（PMID:30737831）。
var_description: Loss of AXIN1 results in impaired degradation of beta-catenin and, thus, impaired WNT signaling pathway activation. AXIN1 deletions have been identified in medulloblastoma (PMID: 11585731). In vivo studies with an AXIN1 knockdown human hepatocellular carcinoma mouse model demonstrated that the loss of AXIN1 is inactivating as measured by reduced induction of canonical WNT/beta-Catenin target genes compared to wildtype (PMID: 30737831).

var_description_zh: ATRX中的截短突变发生在几个蛋白质结构域中，导致蛋白质表达减少，并与DNA甲基化有关。α地中海贫血精神发育迟滞（ATR-X）综合征和α地中海贫血骨髓增生异常综合征（ATMDS）中的截短ATRX变异体最常在高度保守的解旋酶结构域以及P-box和Q-box结构域、潜在的蛋白质相互作用结构域中检测到（PMID:8968741，14592816，18409179，17609377）。在一些情况下，截短的ATRX表型可以通过突变等位基因的外显子内跳跃表达下游起始位点来拯救，这与低形态效应一致（PMID:18409179，15591283）。基于功能缺失研究，预计ATRX缺失会导致染色体不稳定和端粒交替延长（ALT）（PMID:21719641，24148618）。
var_description: Truncating mutations in ATRX occur throughout several protein domains and leads to reduced protein expression and is associated with DNA methylation. Truncated ATRX variants in both alpha thalassaemia mental retardation (ATR-X) syndrome and alpha thalassemia myelodysplastic syndrome (ATMDS) are most commonly detected in the highly conserved helicase domain and also the P-box and Q-box domains, potential protein-interaction domains (PMID: 8968741, 14592816, 18409179, 17609377). In some cases, the truncated ATRX phenotype can be rescued by expression of a downstream start site through intraexonic skipping of the mutant allele, consistent with a hypomorphic effect (PMID: 18409179, 15591283). Based on loss of function studies, ATRX deletions are expected to result in chromosomal instability and alternate lengthening of telomeres (ALT) (PMID: 21719641, 24148618).

var_description_zh: BAP1 G178V突变位于蛋白质的催化泛素C-末端水解酶结构域。该突变已在肺癌和恶性胸膜间皮瘤中发现（PMID:24894717）。该突变在体外和肺癌细胞中的表达表明，与野生型相比，通过降低的去泛素化活性和降低的抑制细胞增殖的能力来测量，该突变是失活的（PMID:18757409）。
var_description: The BAP1 G178V mutation is located in the catalytic ubiquitin C-terminal hydrolase domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in lung cancer and malignant pleural mesothelioma (PMID: 24894717). Expression of this mutation in vitro and in lung cancer cells demonstrated that it is inactivating as measured by diminished deubiquitinating activity and the reduced ability to suppress cell proliferation compared to wildtype (PMID: 18757409).

var_description_zh: BAP1 F81V突变位于蛋白质的催化泛素C-末端水解酶结构域。该突变在体外和人细胞系中的表达表明，通过降低的蛋白质稳定性和去泛素酶活性的丧失（PMID:26680512）来测量，该突变是失活的。
var_description: The BAP1 F81V mutation is located in the catalytic ubiquitin C-terminal hydrolase domain of the protein. Expression of this mutation in vitro and in human cell lines demonstrated that it is inactivating as measured by decreased protein stability and loss of deubiquitinase activity (PMID: 26680512).

var_description_zh: BAP1截短突变产生几种形式的C末端截短的BAP1蛋白，其丢失了核定位信号（PMID:21874000）。这些突变已在肝细胞癌、头颈部鳞状细胞癌、肺癌、肾透明细胞癌、胸膜间皮瘤和葡萄膜黑色素瘤中发现。BAP1截短突变体在肺癌细胞中的表达证明其不能定位于细胞核，并且如通过抑制细胞周期的能力降低所测量的，BAP1在肺癌细胞系中的核缺失是致癌的（PMID:18757409）。
var_description: BAP1 truncating mutations produce several forms of C-terminally truncated BAP1 proteins with loss of the nuclear localization signal (PMID: 21874000). These mutations have been found in hepatocellular cancer, head and neck squamous cell cancer, lung cancer, renal clear cell cancer, pleural mesothelioma and uveal melanoma. Expression of a BAP1 truncation mutant in lung cancer cells demonstrated that it is unable to localize to the nucleus and nuclear loss of BAP1 in lung cancer cell lines was oncogenic as measured by the reduced ability to suppress the cell cycle (PMID: 18757409).

var_description_zh: BAP1 A95D突变位于蛋白质的催化泛素C-末端水解酶结构域。该突变已在肺癌和恶性胸膜间皮瘤中发现（PMID:24894717，26680512）。该突变在体外和肺癌细胞中的表达表明，与野生型相比，通过降低的蛋白质稳定性、降低的去泛素化活性和降低的抑制细胞增殖的能力来测量，该突变是失活的（PMID:18757409，26680512）。
var_description: The BAP1 A95D mutation is located in the catalytic ubiquitin C-terminal hydrolase domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in lung cancer and malignant pleural mesothelioma (PMID: 24894717, 26680512). Expression of this mutation in vitro and in lung cancer cells demonstrated that it is inactivating as measured by decreased protein stability, diminished deubiquitinating activity and the reduced ability to suppress cell proliferation compared to wildtype (PMID: 18757409, 26680512).

var_description_zh: BAP1 C91A突变位于催化泛素C-末端水解酶结构域。该突变在体外和肺癌细胞系中的表达表明，与野生型相比，通过降低的去泛素化活性和不能抑制细胞增殖来测量，该突变是失活的（PMID:18757409）。
var_description: The BAP1 C91A mutation is located in the catalytic ubiquitin C-terminal hydrolase domain. Expression of this mutation in vitro and in lung cancer cell lines demonstrated that it is inactivating as measured by diminished deubiquitinating activity and the inability to suppress cell proliferation compared to wildtype (PMID: 18757409).

var_description_zh: BAP1缺失导致蛋白的部分或完全丢失（PMID:26246155）。这些突变已经在葡萄膜黑色素瘤、肺癌和其他癌症中被发现。BAP1在肺癌和葡萄膜黑色素瘤细胞系中的缺失被证明是致癌的，如通过基因组的整体甲基化改变和抑制细胞周期的能力降低所测量的（PMID:31285370，18757409）。患者的BAP1缺失与较高的转移率相关（PMID:24633195）。
var_description: BAP1 deletions result in partial or complete loss of the protein (PMID: 26246155). These mutations have been found in uveal melanomas, lung cancer, and other cancers. Loss of BAP1 in lung cancer and uveal melanoma cell lines was demonstrated to be oncogenic as measured by global methylation changes to the genome and the reduced ability to suppress the cell cycle (PMID: 31285370, 18757409). BAP1 loss in patients was shown to be associated with higher rates of metastases (PMID: 24633195).

var_description_zh: BAP1 I47F突变位于蛋白质的催化泛素C-末端水解酶结构域。该突变在体外的表达表明，通过与野生型相比降低的蛋白质稳定性（pMID:26680512）来测量，该突变是失活的。
var_description: The BAP1 I47F mutation is located in the catalytic ubiquitin C-terminal hydrolase domain of the protein. Expression of this mutation in vitro demonstrated that it is inactivating as measured by decreased protein stability compared to wildtype (PMID: 26680512).

var_description_zh: BAP1 C91S突变位于蛋白质的催化泛素C-末端水解酶结构域。该突变在体外和乳腺癌细胞系中的表达表明，通过去泛素酶活性的丧失和细胞增殖的减少（PMID:19815555，28935764）来测量，该突变是失活的。
var_description: The BAP1 C91S mutation is located in the catalytic ubiquitin C-terminal hydrolase domain of the protein. Expression of this mutation in vitro and in breast cancer cell lines demonstrated that it is inactivating as measured by loss of deubiquitinase activity and reduced cell proliferation (PMID: 19815555, 28935764).

var_description_zh: BAP1 E685V突变位于蛋白质的核定位信号中。在恶性胸膜间皮瘤中发现了这种突变。该突变在恶性胸膜间皮瘤细胞中的表达表明，如通过受损的靶mRNA剪接（PMID:25830670）所测量的，其是失活的。
var_description: The BAP1 E685V mutation is located in the nuclear localization signal of the protein. This mutation has been found in malignant pleural mesothelioma. Expression of this mutation in malignant pleural mesothelioma cells demonstrated that it is inactivating as measured by impaired target mRNA splicing (PMID: 25830670).

var_description_zh: 涉及BCL2的融合通常在滤泡性淋巴瘤中发现，并且通常发生在转录单位中，从而在重排过程中分裂外显子（PMID:3874430）。BCL2基因编码一种抗凋亡蛋白。该基因与更具转录活性的基因座（最常见的是免疫球蛋白重链）融合，导致其过度表达和功能增强。BCL2过表达导致线粒体膜稳定，凋亡减少，最终导致肿瘤发生（PMID:23939148）。BCL2融合已在大多数滤泡性淋巴瘤患者（PMID:3874430）以及高级别弥漫性大B细胞淋巴瘤患者亚群（AKA中得到鉴定。双重打击B细胞淋巴瘤）（PMID:23892979）。
var_description: Fusions involving BCL2 are commonly found in follicular lymphoma and usually occur in the transcriptional unit, thus splitting the exon during rearrangement (PMID: 3874430). The BCL2 gene codes for an anti-apoptotic protein. Fusion of this gene with a more transcriptionally-active locus, most commonly the immunoglobulin heavy chain, results in overexpression and an increase of its function. BCL2 overexpression leads to stabilization of mitochondrial membranes, a decrease in apoptosis and, ultimately, oncogenesis (PMID: 23939148). BCL2 fusions have been identified in the majority of patients with follicular lymphoma (PMID: 3874430), as well as in a subset of patients with high-grade diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (aka. ‘double-hit B-cell lymphoma) (PMID:23892979).

var_description_zh: ATM R146K突变位于该蛋白的催化泛素C末端水解酶结构域。该突变已在转移性葡萄膜黑色素瘤中发现（PMID:24970262）。该突变尚未进行功能表征；然而，该突变的计算模型表明，通过破坏BAP1基因的正常剪接，它很可能是失活的。
var_description: The ATM R146K mutation is located in the catalytic ubiquitin C-terminal hydrolase domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in metastatic uveal melanomas (PMID: 24970262). This mutation has not been functionally characterized; however, computational modeling of this mutation demonstrated that it is likely inactivating as measured by disruption of normal splicing of the BAP1 gene.

var_description_zh: BAP1 F170I突变位于蛋白质的催化泛素C-末端水解酶结构域。在食管鳞状细胞癌中发现了这种突变。该突变在成纤维细胞和骨肉瘤细胞系中的表达表明，通过降低的去泛素化活性和BAP1蛋白的错误定位（PMID:26081045）来测量，该突变是失活的。
var_description: The BAP1 F170I mutation is located in the catalytic ubiquitin C-terminal hydrolase domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma. Expression of this mutation in fibroblast and osteosarcoma cell lines demonstrated that it is inactivating as measured by diminished deubiquitinating activity and mislocalization of the BAP1 protein (PMID: 26081045).

var_description_zh: BCL2 N172S突变位于蛋白质的BCL2家族结构域中。该突变已在弥漫性大B细胞淋巴瘤中发现，是一个具有统计学意义的热点（PMID:21796119）。BCL2 N172S的计算机分析表明该突变是可耐受的和中性的（PMID:31490001）。
var_description: The BCL2 N172S mutation is located in the BCL2 family domain of the protein. This mutation has been identified in diffuse large B-cell lymphoma and is a statistically significant hotspot (PMID: 21796119). In silico analysis of BCL2 N172S suggests that the mutation is tolerable and neutral (PMID: 31490001).

var_description_zh: BCL2 G101V突变位于蛋白的BH3结构域。该突变已在慢性淋巴细胞白血病（CLL）中发现（PMID:30514704）。体外试验表明，与野生型对照相比，该突变降低了BCL2对BCL2抑制剂Venetoclax的亲和力，并适度影响Venetoclax的敏感性（PMID:30514704）。结构建模显示，G101V突变取代了相邻的残基E152以容纳更大的侧链，导致Venetoclax与BCL2的结合减少（PMID:31160589）。BCL2 G101V突变已在患者中被鉴定为对Venetoclax的耐药突变（PMID:30514704）。
var_description: The BCL2 G101V mutation is located in the BH3 domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in chronic lymphoblastic leukemia (CLL) (PMID: 30514704). In vitro assays demonstrate that this mutation reduces the affinity of BCL2 to the BCL2 inhibitor venetoclax and modestly impacts venetoclax sensitivity compared to wildtype controls (PMID: 30514704). Structural modeling shows that the G101V mutation displaces the neighboring residue E152 to accommodate a bulkier side chain, leading to reduced binding of venetoclax to BCL2 (PMID: 31160589). The BCL2 G101V mutation has been identified in patients as a resistance mutation to venetoclax (PMID: 30514704).

var_description_zh: BCL2 p59S突变位于蛋白的柔性环域中。该突变已在淋巴瘤患者中发现（PMID:1339299）。体外实验已经证明，与野生型对照相比，通过减少的凋亡来测量，该突变是激活的（PMID:9651399）。
var_description: The BCL2 P59S mutation is located in a flexible loop domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in patients with lymphomas (PMID: 1339299). In vitro experiments have demonstrated that this mutation is activating as measured by reduced apoptosis compared to wildtype controls (PMID: 9651399).

var_description_zh: BCL2 K22R突变位于蛋白的BH4结构域。该突变已在弥漫性大B细胞淋巴瘤中被鉴定，并且是统计学上显著的热点（PMID:28481359）。用表达BCL2 K22R的293T细胞进行的体外研究表明，与野生型（PMID:34824248）相比，通过753B诱导的多泛素化测定，该突变可能是中性的。
var_description: The BCL2 K22R mutation is located in the BH4 domain of the protein. This mutation has been identified in diffuse large B-cell lymphoma and is a statistically significant hotspot (PMID: 28481359). In vitro studies with 293T cells expressing BCL2 K22R demonstrate that the mutation is likely neutral as measured by 753b-induced polyubiquitination comparable to wildtype (PMID: 34824248).

var_description_zh: BCL2 N172Q突变位于该蛋白的BCL2家族结构域中。该突变已在弥漫性大B细胞淋巴瘤中被鉴定，并且是具有统计学意义的热点（PMID:28481359）。BCL2 N172Q的计算机分析表明，该突变是可耐受的，并且具有比野生型更低的结合亲和力（PMID:31490001）。
var_description: The BCL2 N172Q mutation is located in the BCL2 family domain of the protein. This mutation has been identified in diffuse large B-cell lymphoma and is a statistically significant hotspot (PMID: 28481359). In silico analysis of BCL2 N172Q suggests that the mutation is tolerable and has lower binding affinity than wildtype (PMID: 31490001).

var_description_zh: 急性髓系白血病患者的BCOR缺失与不良预后相关（PMID:2212066）。使用AML患者样本的实验研究表明，BCOR蛋白的缺失与细胞增殖和髓系分化增加有关（PMID:26847029，28827447）。使用CRISPR/Cas9敲除MYC-造血祖细胞中的BCOR，当移植到受辐射小鼠中时，与单独的MYC诱导的淋巴瘤发生相比，导致淋巴瘤发生增加（PMID:28262675）。
var_description: BCOR deletions in patients with acute myeloid leukemia are associated with inferior outcome (PMID: 2212066). Experimental studies using AML patient samples suggest that loss of BCOR protein is associated with increased cell proliferation and myeloid differentiation (PMID: 26847029, 28827447). Knockout of BCOR in Myc-hematopoietic progenitor cells using CRISPR/Cas9 led to increased lymphomagenesis compared to Myc-induced lymphomagenesis alone when transplanted into irradiated mice (PMID: 28262675).

var_description_zh: IgH-BCL2融合源于IgH基因座和BCL2之间的复发性t（14；18）（q32；q21）染色体易位，被认为是滤泡性淋巴瘤的主要致癌驱动因素（PMID:3874430）。涉及免疫球蛋白（Ig）基因的染色体易位在非霍奇金淋巴瘤中经常发生（PMID:10910891）。该易位将BCL2置于IgH启动子的控制之下，导致BCL2蛋白的过表达（PMID:3874430，2875799，3500184）。BCL2易位是在所谓的“双重打击”淋巴瘤中发现的与MYC易位相关的最常见的继发性改变（PMID:23939148，23892979）。BCL2的过表达导致凋亡激活剂（如Bim蛋白）的螯合和对激活凋亡内在途径的化疗剂的敏感性丧失（PMID:18202696）。
var_description: The IGH-BCL2 fusion results from a recurrent t(14;18)(q32;q21) chromosomal translocation between the IGH locus and BCL2, thought to be the primary oncogenic driver of follicular lymphoma (PMID: 3874430). Chromosomal translocations involving immunoglobulin (IG) genes occur frequently in Non-Hodgkin's lymphoma (PMID: 10910891). This translocation places BCL2 under the control of the IGH promoter, resulting in overexpression of the BCL2 protein (PMID: 3874430, 2875799, 3500184). BCL2 translocations are the most frequent secondary alteration found in connection with MYC translocations in so-called "double-hit" lymphomas (PMID: 23939148, 23892979). Overexpression of BCL2 results in sequestration of apoptotic activators such as the Bim protein and loss of sensitivity to chemotherapeutic agents that activate the intrinsic pathway of apoptosis (PMID: 18202696).

var_description_zh: BCL2 G33R突变位于该蛋白的BH4结构域。该突变已在滤泡性淋巴瘤中发现（PMID:25452615）。体外研究表明，与野生型对照（PMID:25452615）相比，通过增加BCL2对促凋亡蛋白的结合亲和力和减少凋亡来测量，该突变是激活的。
var_description: The BCL2 G33R mutation is located in the BH4 domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in follicular lymphomas (PMID: 25452615). In vitro studies have demonstrated that this mutation is activating as measured by increased BCL2 binding affinity to proapoptotic proteins and reduced apoptosis compared to wildtype controls (PMID: 25452615).

var_description_zh: BCOR内部串联重复（BCOR-ITDs）位于外显子15的C-末端多梳组环指同源物UB-样折叠鉴别器结构域。在肾透明细胞肉瘤、婴儿圆细胞肉瘤和高级别子宫肉瘤中发现了这种改变（PMID:26573325，26516930，29200103，26945340，26493387）。携带BCOR-ITDs的肿瘤的免疫组织化学具有显著的核染色（PMID:26573325，29200103）。转录组分析表明，与野生型BCOR相比，BCOR-ITDs具有富集同源盒蛋白的基因标记（PMID:26573325），并且可能改变肿瘤的甲基化和基因表达（PMID:26516930）。
var_description: BCOR internal tandem duplications (BCOR-ITDs) are located in exon 15 in the C-terminal polycomb-group RING finger homologue Ub-like fold discriminator domain. This alteration has been found in clear cell sarcoma of the kidney, round cell sarcomas of infancy and high grade uterine sarcomas (PMID: 26573325, 26516930, 29200103, 26945340, 26493387). Immunohistochemistry of tumors harboring BCOR-ITDs have prominent nuclear staining (PMID: 26573325, 29200103). Transcriptome analysis demonstrated that BCOR-ITDs have a gene signature enriched for homeobox proteins compared to wildtype BCOR (PMID: 26573325), and may alter methylation and gene expression of tumors (PMID: 26516930).

var_description_zh: BRAF P348T突变位于该蛋白的未知功能域。用BA/F3细胞和表达BRAF p348T的MCF10A细胞进行的体外研究表明，通过与野生型（PMID:29533785）相比的细胞增殖和生存力测量，突变可能是中性的。
var_description: The BRAF P348T mutation is located in an unknown functional domain of the protein. In vitro studies with Ba/F3 cells and MCF10A cells expressing BRAF P348T demonstrate that the mutation is likely neutral as measured by cell proliferation and viability comparable to wildtype (PMID: 29533785).

var_description_zh: BCL2 A131T突变位于蛋白的未知功能域。该突变已在滤泡性淋巴瘤中发现，并且是一个具有统计学意义的热点（PMID:28481359）。BCL2 A131T的计算机分析表明该突变可能是中性的（PMID:31490001）。
var_description: The BCL2 A131T mutation is located in an unknown functional domain of the protein. This mutation has been identified in follicular lymphoma and is a statistically significant hotspot (PMID: 28481359). In silico analysis of BCL2 A131T suggests that the mutation is likely neutral (PMID: 31490001).

var_description_zh: BRAF V600A突变（也称为V599A）位于蛋白质激酶结构域的激活片段中。该突变已在前列腺癌中鉴定（PMID:16721785）。用表达BRAF V600A的HEK293细胞进行的体外研究表明，通过与野生型（PMID:26744778）相比的磷酸化测定，该突变可能是中性的。
var_description: The BRAF V600A mutation (also known as V599A) is located in the activation segment of the kinase domain of the protein. This mutation has been identified in prostate cancer (PMID: 16721785).
