In vitro studies with HEK293 cells expressing BRAF V600A demonstrate that the mutation is likely neutral as measured by phosphorylation comparable to wildtype (PMID: 26744778).

var_description_zh: BCOR的截短突变在人类疾病中以种系（眼-面-心-牙或OFCD综合征）和体细胞（急性髓系白血病（AML）骨髓增生异常综合征，视网膜母细胞瘤）突变的形式出现，导致蛋白表达减少（PMID:22012066，24047651，25550361，22237022）。使用AML患者样本的实验研究表明，BCOR蛋白的缺失可增强细胞增殖和骨髓分化（PMID:26847029）。
var_description: Truncating mutations in BCOR occur as both germline (oculofaciocardiodental or OFCD syndrome) and somatic (acute myeloid leukemia (AML) myelodysplastic syndrome, retinoblastoma) mutations in human disease, leading to reduced protein expression (PMID: 22012066, 24047651, 25550361, 22237022). Experimental studies using AML patient samples suggest loss of BCOR protein enhances cell proliferation and myeloid differentiation (PMID: 26847029).

var_description_zh: BRAF N412S突变位于该蛋白的未知功能域。该突变已在肺腺癌中鉴定（PMID:28481359）。一名携带BRAF N412S的肺腺癌患者接受了纳武单抗治疗，并显示病情稳定（PMID:34963703），尽管该患者本身没有功能特征。
var_description: The BRAF N412S mutation is located in an unknown functional domain of the protein. This mutation has been identified in lung adenocarcinoma (PMID: 28481359). Although not functionally characterized per se, a patient with lung adenocarcinoma harboring BRAF N412S was treated with nivolumab and demonstrated stable disease (PMID: 34963703).

var_description_zh: II类BRAF L485F突变位于蛋白外显子11的激酶结构域（PMID:31515458）。该突变已在心脏-面部-皮肤综合征中发现（PMID:16474404，16439621）。该突变在NIH-3T3细胞中的表达表明，与野生型BRAF（PMID:16474404）相比，通过下游MAPK途径转录靶（例如，ELK）的显著增加的转录来测量，该突变是激活的。用表达BRAF L485F的293T细胞进行的临床前研究证明了对LY3009120治疗的敏感性（通过抑制ERK信号测定），以及对达拉非尼、PLX8394和维莫非尼治疗的抗性（通过持续ERK信号测定）（PMID:34108213）。在一项临床研究中，一名携带BRAF L485F的转移性结直肠癌患者接受了西妥昔单抗和伊立替康的联合治疗，结果显示病情稳定，无进展生存期为6.3个月（PMID:31515458）。
var_description: The class II BRAF L485F mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 11 of the protein (PMID: 31515458). This mutation has been found in cardio-facio-cutaneous syndrome (PMID: 16474404, 16439621). Expression of this mutation in NIH-3T3 cells demonstrated that it is activating as measured by significantly increased transcription of downstream MAPK pathway transcriptional targets (e.g., ELK) compared to wildtype BRAF (PMID: 16474404). Preclinical studies with 293T cells expressing BRAF L485F demonstrated sensitivity to treatment with LY3009120, as measured by inhibition of ERK signaling, and resistance to treatment with dabrafenib, PLX8394 and vemurafenib, as measured by persistent ERK signaling (PMID: 34108213). In a clinical study, a patient with metastatic colorectal cancer harboring BRAF L485F was treated with a combination therapy of cetuximab plus irinotecan and demonstrated stable disease with a progression-free survival of 6.3 months (PMID: 31515458).

var_description_zh: BRAF R462E突变位于BRAF蛋白的激酶结构域。体外研究表明，与野生型（PMID:25155755）相比，通过CRAF活性和下游信号测定，BRAF L597S突变可能被激活。
var_description: The BRAF R462E mutation is located in the kinase domain of the BRAF protein. In vitro studies have demonstrated that the BRAF L597S mutation is likely activating as measured by CRAF activity and downstream signaling compared to wildtype (PMID: 25155755).

var_description_zh: KIAA1549-BRAF融合蛋白由7号染色体上的内部串联重复事件产生，其融合KIAA1549的外显子1-16和BRAF的外显子9-18。该融合包含BRAF激酶结构域，但不包括负责Ras结合和自动抑制的BRAF CR1结构域（PMID:18974108，24345920）。在毛细胞性星形细胞瘤中发现了这种融合（PMID:18974108，24345920）。该融合蛋白在NIH-3T3细胞中的表达表明，与野生型BRAF（pMID:18974108）相比，通过组成型激酶活性和在软琼脂中增加的锚定非依赖性生长来测量，该融合蛋白是活化的。KIAA1549-BRAF融合蛋白以二聚体形式发挥作用，因此在体外对RAF抑制剂如维莫非尼不敏感（PMID:23533272）。临床前证据表明，这些癌蛋白可能是第二代RAF抑制剂的靶标，据报道，第二代RAF抑制剂抑制RAF二聚体，而不是诱导其反式激活RAF（如维莫非尼等较老的抑制剂）（PMID:23533272）。体外研究表明，携带KIAA1549-BRAF融合蛋白的儿童星形细胞瘤细胞系对第一代RAF抑制剂的治疗具有抗性（PMID:23533272，26072686）。在司美替尼治疗25例WHO I级毛细胞性星形细胞瘤患者（携带KIAA1549-BRAF融合或BRAF V600E突变）的II期临床试验中，9例患者（36%[95%CI:18-57%]）出现持续部分缓解（PMID:31151904）。
var_description: The KIAA1549-BRAF fusion protein results from an internal tandem duplication event on chromosome 7 that fuses exons 1-16 of KIAA1549 and exons 9-18 of BRAF. This fusion contains the BRAF kinase domain, but excludes the BRAF CR1 domain responsible for RAS binding and auto-inhibition (PMID: 18974108, 24345920). This fusion has been found in pilocytic astrocytoma (PMID: 18974108, 24345920). Expression of this fusion in NIH-3T3 cells demonstrated that it is activating as measured by constitutive kinase activity and increased anchorage independent growth in soft agar compared to wildtype BRAF (PMID: 18974108). KIAA1549-BRAF fusion protein functions as a dimer and is therefore not sensitive to RAF inhibitors such as vemurafenib in vitro (PMID: 23533272). Preclinical evidence suggests that these oncoproteins may be targeted by second-generation RAF inhibitors, which are reported to inhibit RAF dimers rather than induce their transactivation of RAF (as is the case with older inhibitors such as vemurafenib) (PMID: 23533272). In vitro studies have suggested that pediatric astrocytoma cell lines harboring the KIAA1549-BRAF fusion are resistant to treatment with first generation RAF inhibitors (PMID: 23533272, 26072686). In a Phase II clinical trial of selumetinib in 25 patients with WHO grade I pilocytic astrocytoma harboring either the KIAA1549-BRAF fusion or the BRAF V600E mutation, nine patients (36% [95% CI:18-57%]) had a sustained partial response (PMID: 31151904).

var_description_zh: BRAF L485W突变位于蛋白质的激酶结构域（PMID:35117215）。该突变已在膀胱腺癌中被鉴定，并且是统计学上显著的热点（PMID:28481359）。这种突变的致癌效应和生物学效应有相互矛盾的证据。用表达BRAF L485W的BA/F3和MCF10A细胞进行的体外研究表明，与野生型（PMID:29533785）相比，通过在一个细胞系中降低的细胞活力来测量，该突变是失活的。相反，BRAF L485W已被引用为活化II类BRAF突变，并且由于对MAPK靶向抑制剂的敏感性而被认为是非典型活化突变（PMID:35977349，35117215，31015311）。临床研究表明，BRAF L485W对MAPK通路抑制敏感，这是通过一名携带突变的胆囊癌患者进行测量的，该患者对ERK1/2激酶抑制剂ulixertinib表现出敏感性，这是通过长达一年的治疗完全反应（PMID:29247021）进行测量的。
var_description: The BRAF L485W mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein (PMID: 35117215). This mutation has been identified in bladder adenocarcinoma and is a statistically significant hotspot (PMID: 28481359). The oncogenic and biologic effect of this mutation has conflicting evidence. An in vitro study with Ba/F3 and MCF10A cells expressing BRAF L485W demonstrates the mutation is inactivating as measured by decreased cellular viability in one cell line compared to wildtype (PMID: 29533785). In contrast, BRAF L485W has been cited as an activating class II BRAF mutation and is suggested to be an atypical activating mutation due to sensitivity to MAPK targeting inhibitors (PMID: 35977349, 35117215, 31015311). Clinical studies suggest that BRAF L485W is sensitive to MAPK pathway inhibition as measured by a patient with gallbladder cancer harboring the mutation demonstrating sensitivity to the ERK1/2 kinase inhibitor ulixertinib as measured by a year-long complete response to treatment (PMID: 29247021).

var_description_zh: II类BRAF L 485_p490delinsy突变位于该蛋白（PMID:33019809）外显子11的激酶结构域中。该突变已在非小细胞肺癌中鉴定（PMID:12068308）。虽然该变体尚未得到功能验证，但用表达BRAF L 485_p490delinsy的非小细胞肺癌细胞系和小鼠模型进行的临床前研究表明，如通过抑制细胞增殖所测量的，对LY3009120和曲美替尼治疗的敏感性，以及如通过持续的MEK和ERK途径激活所测量的对维莫非尼的抗性（PMID:26732095）。
var_description: The class II BRAF L485_P490delinsY mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 11 of the protein (PMID: 33019809). This mutation has been identified in non-small lung cancer (PMID: 12068308). While this variant has not been functionally validated, preclinical studies with non-small lung cancer cell lines and mouse models expressing BRAF L485_P490delinsY demonstrated sensitivity to treatment with LY3009120 and trametinib as measured by inhibition of cellular proliferation, and resistance to vemurafenib as measured by sustained MEK and ERK pathway activation (PMID: 26732095).

var_description_zh: BRAF L678I突变位于该蛋白的激酶结构域。用表达BRAF L678I的MCF10A细胞进行的体外研究表明，通过与野生型（PMID:29533785）相比降低的细胞增殖和生存力来测量，该突变是失活的。
var_description: The BRAF L678I mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein. In vitro studies with MCF10A cells expressing BRAF L678I demonstrate that the mutation is inactivating as measured by decreased cell proliferation and viability comparable to wildtype (PMID: 29533785).

var_description_zh: ZNF767-BRAF融合源于ZNF767的外显子1与BRAF的外显子11的融合。用表达ZNF767-BRAF的裸鼠进行的体内研究表明，与野生型相比，通过快速肿瘤生长（PMID:28092667）测量，融合是活化的。用表达ZNF767-BRAF的PMM细胞进行的临床前研究证明了曲美替尼、BKM120、LEE011、曲美替尼+BKM120和曲美替尼+LEE011治疗的敏感性，如通过抑制细胞生长所测量的（PMID:28092667）。一名携带ZNF767-BRAF的黑色素瘤患者接受维莫非尼治疗，并表现出耐药性，在治疗的两周内出现快速进展（PMID:28092667）。
var_description: The ZNF767-BRAF fusion results from the fusion of exon 1 of ZNF767 with exon 11 of BRAF. In vivo studies with nude mice expressing ZNF767-BRAF demonstrate that the fusion is activating as measured by rapid tumor growth compared to wildtype (PMID: 28092667). Preclinical studies with PMM cells expressing ZNF767-BRAF demonstrated sensitivity to treatment with trametinib, BKM120, LEE011, trametinib plus BKM120 and trametinib plus LEE011 as measured by inhibition of cell growth (PMID: 28092667). A patient with melanoma harboring ZNF767-BRAF was treated with vemurafenib and demonstrated resistance, with rapid progression within two weeks of treatment (PMID: 28092667).

var_description_zh: BRAF R239Q突变位于蛋白的锌指结构域。该突变已在黑色素瘤中鉴定（PMID:28481359）。尽管本身没有功能特征，但对携带BRAF R239Q和BRAF L597S的患者来源的黑色素瘤细胞系进行的临床前研究表明，通过降低细胞增殖和肿瘤生长（PMID:29903896），患者对比尼替尼联合恩可拉非尼、达拉非尼联合曲美替尼、单药恩可拉非尼和单药比尼替尼的治疗具有敏感性。
var_description: The BRAF R239Q mutation is located in the zinc-finger domain of the protein. This mutation has been identified in melanoma (PMID: 28481359). Although not functionally characterized per se, preclinical studies with patient-derived melanoma cell lines harboring BRAF R239Q and BRAF L597S demonstrated sensitivity to treatment with binimetinib plus encorafenib, dabrafenib plus trametinib, single agent encorafenib and single agent binimetinib as measured by reduced cellular proliferation and tumor growth (PMID: 29903896).

var_description_zh: II类BRAF T599R突变位于蛋白外显子15的激酶结构域（PMID:33019809）。该突变已在心面皮肤综合征和甲状腺癌中发现（PMID:19206169，25120313）。BRAF T599R在NIH3T3细胞中的表达表明，与野生型BRAF（pMID:19206169）相比，通过集落形成和下游MAPK途径激活的增加来测量，它是激活的。
var_description: The class II BRAF T599R mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 15 of the protein (PMID: 33019809). This mutation has been found in cardio-facio-cutaneous syndrome and thyroid carcinoma (PMID: 19206169, 25120313). Expression of BRAF T599R in NIH3T3 cells demonstrated that it is activating as measured by increased colony formation and downstream MAPK pathway activation compared to wildtype BRAF (PMID: 19206169).

var_description_zh: BRAF P490del突变位于该蛋白外显子11的激酶结构域。该突变在人细胞系中的表达表明，通过与野生型（PMID:26996308）相当的激酶活性测量，它可能是中性的。
var_description: The BRAF P490del mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 11 of the protein. Expression of this mutation in a human cell line demonstrated that it is likely neutral as measured by kinase activity comparable to wildtype (PMID: 26996308).

var_description_zh: BRAF S363F突变位于该蛋白的未知功能域。该突变已在黑色素瘤中鉴定（PMID:28467829）。尽管未对其本身进行功能表征，但对携带BRAF S363F和BRAF K601E的黑色素瘤细胞系进行的临床前研究表明，通过降低细胞增殖（PMID:29903896），对比尼替尼联合恩可拉非尼、达拉非尼联合曲美替尼、曲美替尼联合维莫非尼、单一药物恩可拉非尼、单一药物比尼替尼、单一药物曲美替尼和单一药物考比替尼的治疗具有敏感性。
var_description: The BRAF S363F mutation is located in an unknown functional domain of the protein. This mutation has been identified in melanoma (PMID: 28467829). Although not functionally characterized per se, preclinical studies with melanoma cell lines harboring BRAF S363F and BRAF K601E demonstrated sensitivity to treatment with binimetinib plus encorafenib, dabrafenib plus trametinib, trametinib plus vemurafenib, single agent encorafenib, single agent binimetinib, single agent trametinib and single agent cobimetinib as measured by reduced cellular proliferation (PMID: 29903896).

var_description_zh: PAPSS1-BRAF融合蛋白由融合PAPSS1的外显子1-5和BRAF的外显子9-18的染色体4和7的融合产生（PMID:24345920）。该融合包含BRAF激酶结构域，但不包括负责Ras结合和自动抑制的BRAF CR1结构域（PMID:15630448）。已在黑色素瘤中发现这种融合（PMID:24345920）。该融合蛋白在293H细胞中的表达表明，通过下游MEK和ERK的激活来测量其激活，这与BRAF V600E（pMID:24345920）相当。体外实验表明，PAPSS1-BRAF融合蛋白对维莫非尼具有耐药性，但对曲美替尼敏感，这是通过药物治疗后MEK和ERK磷酸化的变化来衡量的（PMID:24345920）。
var_description: The PAPSS1-BRAF fusion protein results from a fusion of chromosomes 4 and 7 that fuses exons 1-5 of PAPSS1 and exons 9-18 of BRAF (PMID: 24345920). This fusion contains the BRAF kinase domain, but excludes the BRAF CR1 domain responsible for RAS binding and auto-inhibition (PMID:15630448). This fusion has been found in melanoma (PMID: 24345920). Expression of this fusion in 293H cells demonstrated that it is activating as measured by activation of downstream MEK and ERK that is comparable to BRAF V600E (PMID: 24345920). In vitro experiments have suggested that the PAPSS1-BRAF fusion is resistant to vemurafenib but sensitive to trametinib as measured by changes in MEK and ERK phosphorylation upon drug treatment (PMID: 24345920).

var_description_zh: BRAF Q609H突变位于该蛋白的激酶结构域。用BA/F3细胞和表达BRAF Q609H的MCF10A细胞进行的体外研究表明，通过与野生型（PMID:29533785）相比的细胞增殖和生存力测量，突变可能是中性的。
var_description: The BRAF Q609H mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein. In vitro studies with Ba/F3 cells and MCF10A cells expressing BRAF Q609H demonstrate that the mutation is likely neutral as measured by cell proliferation and viability comparable to wildtype (PMID: 29533785).

var_description_zh: CUL1-BRAF融合蛋白由7号染色体的框内易位产生，其将CUL1的外显子1-7与BRAF的外显子9-18融合（PMID:26324360）。CUL1-BRAF融合蛋白含有BRAF激酶结构域，但缺少负责Ras结合和自动抑制的BRAF CR1结构域。在低级别浆液性卵巢癌中发现了这种融合（PMID:26324360）。虽然该融合尚未得到功能验证，但含有BRAF激酶结构域（不包括CR1结构域）的其他融合已被证明是活化的和致癌的（PMID:22745804，25985019，15630448）。一名携带CUL1-BRAF融合基因的低度严重卵巢癌患者对司美替尼和紫杉醇的联合治疗获得了持续的完全缓解（PMID:26324360）。在一项针对低级别浆液性卵巢癌患者的研究中，一名接受卡铂和紫杉醇治疗的CUL1-BRAF融合患者在接受司美替尼和紫杉醇联合治疗后出现持续完全缓解（PMID:26324360）。
var_description: The CUL1-BRAF fusion protein results from an in-frame translocation of chromosome 7 that fuses exons 1-7 of CUL1 with exons 9-18 of BRAF (PMID: 26324360). The CUL1-BRAF fusion protein contains the BRAF kinase domain, but lacks the BRAF CR1 domain that is responsible for RAS-binding and auto-inhibition. This fusion has been found in low-grade serous ovarian cancer (PMID: 26324360). While this fusion has not been functionally validated, other fusions that contain the BRAF kinase domain an exclude the CR1 domain have been shown to be activating and oncogenic (PMID: 22745804, 25985019, 15630448). A patient with low-grade serious ovarian cancer harboring the CUL1-BRAF fusion achieved a sustained complete response to combination selumetinib and paclitaxel (PMID: 26324360). In a study of patients with low-grade serous ovarian cancer, a patient with a CUL1-BRAF fusion who progressed on carboplatin and paclitaxel had a sustained complete response to treatment with combined selumetinib and paclitaxel (PMID: 26324360).

var_description_zh: BRAF R389C突变位于蛋白质的未知功能域。该突变已在结直肠癌中鉴定（PMID:25344691）。用表达BRAF R389C的BA/F3和MCF10A细胞进行的体外研究表明，如通过与野生型（PMID:29533785）相当的细胞增殖和生存力所测量的，突变可能是中性的。
var_description: The BRAF R389C mutation is located in an unknown functional domain of the protein. This mutation has been identified in colorectal cancer (PMID: 25344691). In vitro studies with Ba/F3 and MCF10A cells expressing BRAF R389C demonstrate that the mutation is likely neutral as measured by cell proliferation and viability comparable to wildtype (PMID: 29533785).

var_description_zh: BRAF X 380_剪接突变位于蛋白质的未知功能域。一名携带BRAF X 380_剪接和KRAS G12C的肺腺癌患者接受了阿替佐利单抗治疗，并表现出疾病进展（PMID:34963703），尽管该患者本身没有功能特征。
var_description: The BRAF X380_splice mutation is located in an unknown functional domain of the protein. Although not functionally characterized per se, a patient with lung adenocarcinoma harboring BRAF X380_splice and KRAS G12C was treated with atezolizumab and demonstrated progressive disease (PMID: 34963703).

var_description_zh: BRAF V600M突变位于BRAF激酶结构域。该突变已在黑色素瘤中发现（PMID:25382067，22536370）。体外研究表明，该突变类似于其他1类BRAF V600突变，激活不依赖于Ras的下游MAPK途径，如通过与野生型相比，V600E突变细胞中磷酸化MEK水平增加和Ras-GTP水平降低所测量的（PMID:26343582，28783719）。BRAF V600M突变使BRAF以单体形式组成性激活，并且对维莫非尼的抑制敏感（PMID:28783719，25382067，26343582）。然而，正如几项研究（PMID:22536370，23579220，25382067）所指出的，BRAF V600M突变是否真的发生在癌症中，或者先前的测序研究是否将V600R二核苷酸变化（7号染色体：位置140453136 AC>CT）错误地称为单核苷酸变化（7号染色体：位置140453137 C>T），尚不清楚。
var_description: The BRAF V600M mutation is located in the BRAF kinase domain. This mutation has been found in melanoma (PMID: 25382067, 22536370). In vitro studies have demonstrated that this mutation, similar to other class 1 BRAF V600 mutations, activates the downstream MAPK pathway independent of RAS, as measured by increased levels of phosphorylated MEK and decreased RAS-GTP in V600E mutant cells compared to wildtype (PMID: 26343582, 28783719). The BRAF V600M mutation renders BRAF constitutively activated in monomeric form and is sensitive to inhibition by vemurafenib (PMID: 28783719, 25382067, 26343582). However, It is unknown whether the BRAF V600M mutation actually arises in cancer as noted by several studies (PMID: 22536370, 23579220, 25382067) or previous sequencing studies miscalled a V600R dinucleotide change (chromosome 7: position 140453136 AC > CT) as a single nucleotide change (chromosome 7: position 140453137 C >T).

var_description_zh: II类BRAF N 486_p490del突变位于蛋白外显子11的激酶结构域（PMID:33019809）。该突变已在卵巢癌细胞系和胰腺癌患者中发现（PMID:18060073，26996308，31519698）。该突变在人细胞系中的表达表明，其通过与野生型相比增加的激酶活性和下游信号传导所测量的CRAF和二聚体非依赖性机制激活（pMID:26996308）。用表达BRAF N 486_p490del的胰腺导管腺癌的患者来源的异种移植模型进行的临床前研究表明，曲美替尼和LY3009120单独或联合治疗的敏感性通过降低肿瘤生长来衡量（PMID:34011980）。携带该突变的胰腺癌患者对BRAF抑制剂达拉非尼（PMID:31519698）治疗有部分反应。在一份病例报告中，两名携带BRAF N 486_P490del的朗格汉斯细胞组织细胞增生症患者接受了曲美替尼治疗，其中一名患者表现出完全缓解，无进展生存期超过18个月，而另一名患者表现出病情稳定，无进展生存期超过12个月（PMID:32991018）。在另一个病例报告中，一名携带BRAF N 486_P490DEL的转移性胰腺导管腺癌患者接受了达拉非尼和曲美替尼的联合治疗，并显示出部分缓解（PMID:36505826）。
var_description: The class II BRAF N486_P490del mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 11 of the protein (PMID: 33019809). This mutation has been found in an ovarian cancer cell line and in patients with pancreatic cancer (PMID: 18060073, 26996308, 31519698). Expression of this mutation in a human cell line demonstrated that it is activating via a CRAF- and dimer-independent mechanism as measured by increased kinase activity and downstream signaling compared to wildtype (PMID: 26996308). Preclinical studies with patient-derived xenograft models of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma expressing BRAF N486_P490del demonstrated sensitivity to treatment with trametinib and LY3009120 alone or in combination as measured by reduced tumor growth (PMID: 34011980). A patient with pancreatic cancer harboring this mutation had a partial response to treatment with the BRAF inhibitor dabrafenib (PMID: 31519698). In a case report, two patients with Langerhans cell histiocytosis harboring BRAF N486_P490del were treated with trametinib and one patient demonstrated a complete response with a progression-free survival of over 18 months while the second patient demonstrated stable disease with a progression-free survival of over twelve months (PMID: 32991018). In another case report, a patient with metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma harboring BRAF N486_P490del was treated with a combination therapy of dabrafenib plus trametinib and demonstrated partial response (PMID: 36505826).

var_description_zh: III类BRAF D594E突变位于该蛋白外显子15的激酶结构域。该突变已在非小细胞肺癌和弥漫性大B细胞淋巴瘤中发现（PMID:28947956，32877514）。用表达BRAF D594的条件性基因敲入小鼠进行的体内研究表明，该突变通过CRAF激活MAPK途径（PMID:20978 199）。与野生型BRAF（PMID:28947956）相比，BRAF D594E在HEK293细胞中的表达表明其被激活，如通过增加的下游ERK信号传导所测量的。体外研究表明，该突变对达拉非尼具有耐药性，这是通过药物治疗后MAPK途径激活增加来衡量的，但对曲美替尼敏感，这是通过药物治疗后MAPK途径激活减少来衡量的（PMID:28947956）。由于BRAF D594E是一种激酶死亡突变，提示其对维莫非尼治疗不敏感（PMID:28026870）。
var_description: The class III BRAF D594E mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 15 of the protein. This mutation has been found in non-small cell lung cancer and diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (PMID: 28947956, 32877514). In vivo studies with conditional knock-in mice expressing BRAF D594 demonstrate that the mutation activates the MAPK pathway through CRAF (PMID: 20978199). Expression of BRAF D594E in HEK293 cells demonstrated that it is activating as measured by increased downstream ERK signaling compared to wildtype BRAF (PMID: 28947956). In vitro studies have suggested that this mutation is resistant to dabrafenib, as measured by increased MAPK pathway activation upon drug treatment, but sensitive to trametinib, as measured by decreased MAPK pathway activation upon drug treatment (PMID: 28947956). As BRAF D594E is a kinase-dead mutation, it is suggested to be insensitive to treatment with vemurafenib (PMID: 28026870).

var_description_zh: SLC45A3-BRAF融合是由SLC45A3的未翻译外显子1和BRAF的外显子8的染色体间重排融合产生的。用过表达SLC45A3-BRAF的裸鼠进行的体内研究表明，与载体对照（pMID:20526349）相比，如通过快速肿瘤生长所测量的，融合是激活的。用表达该融合蛋白的RWPE细胞进行的临床前研究证明了用Raf激酶抑制剂索拉非尼和MEK抑制剂U0126治疗的敏感性，如通过治疗后集落生长减少所测量的（PMID:20526349）。
var_description: The SLC45A3-BRAF fusion results from inter-chromosomal rearrangement fusing untranslated exon 1 of SLC45A3 and exon 8 of BRAF. In vivo studies with nude mice overexpressing SLC45A3-BRAF demonstrate that the fusion is activating as measured by rapid tumor growth compared to vector control (PMID: 20526349). Preclinical studies with RWPE cells expressing this fusion demonstrated sensitivity to treatment with RAF kinase inhibitor sorafenib and MEK inhibitor U0126 as measured by decreased colony growth following treatment (PMID: 20526349).

var_description_zh: BRAF L 485_p490delINSF突变位于该蛋白外显子11的激酶结构域中。虽然该变体尚未得到功能验证，但该氨基酸范围内的另一个缺失（L 485_P490del）已显示为功能获得性和致癌性（PMID:26732095）。在细胞系和小鼠模型中的实验证明，BRAFα-C螺旋inDel突变体，例如L 485_p490delinSF，对维莫非尼不敏感，并且在药物治疗后维持MAPK途径的活性（PMID:26732095）。
var_description: The BRAF L485_P490delinsF mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 11 of the protein. While this variant has not been functionally validated, another deletion in this amino acid range (L485_P490del) has been shown to be gain-of-function and oncogenic (PMID: 26732095). Experiments in cell lines and mouse models demonstrate that BRAF alpha-C helix indel mutants, such as L485_P490delinsF, are insensitive to vemurafenib and maintain activity of the MAPK pathway upon drug treatment (PMID: 26732095)

var_description_zh: III类BRAF N581I突变位于蛋白外显子15的激酶结构域（PMID:28783719）。该突变在肺癌和外阴恶性黑色素瘤中已有报道（PMID:22969966，26202550，15917418）。在生物化学上，已经证明BRAF N581I突变体作为与CRAF的二聚体发出信号，在其MAPK途径的激活中是Ras依赖性的，并且在肿瘤中，通常与放大Ras信号的另一驱动机制共同发生（PMID:28783719）。因此，在黑色素瘤中，与其他III类BRAF突变体相似，预期N581I变体与活化Ras突变或NF1失活同时发生，而在非小细胞肺癌或结肠直肠癌中，该突变很可能与蛋白水平的受体酪氨酸激酶（RTK）过度活化有关（PMID:28783719）。虽然该突变对靶向抑制剂如曲美替尼的MEK抑制敏感，但对RAF单体抑制剂如维莫非尼（PMID:28783719）不敏感。在一份病例报告中，一名携带BRAF N581I的转移性结直肠癌患者接受了西妥昔单抗和伊立替康的联合治疗，病情稳定，无进展生存期为10.3个月（PMID:31515458）。
var_description: The class III BRAF N581I mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 15 of the protein (PMID: 28783719). This mutation has been reported in lung cancer and vulval malignant melanoma (PMID: 22969966, 26202550, 15917418). Biochemically, it has been demonstrated that the BRAF N581I mutant signals as a dimer with CRAF, is RAS-dependent in its activation of the MAPK pathway, and, in tumors, would typically co-occur with another driver mechanism that amplifies RAS signaling (PMID: 28783719). Thus, in melanoma, the N581I variant, similar to other class III BRAF mutants, would be expected to co-occur with activating RAS mutation or NF1 inactivation, whereas in non-small cell lung or colorectal cancers, this mutation would most likely be associated with receptor tyrosine kinase (RTK) hyperactivation at the protein level (PMID: 28783719). While this mutation is sensitive to MEK inhibition by targeted inhibitors such as trametinib, it is insensitive to RAF monomer inhibitors such as vemurafenib (PMID: 28783719). In a case report, a patient with metastatic colorectal cancer harboring BRAF N581I was treated with a combination therapy of cetuximab plus irinotecan and demonstrated stable disease with a progression-free survival of 10.3 months (PMID: 31515458).

var_description_zh: BRAF A762V突变位于蛋白质的未知功能域。该突变已在结直肠癌中鉴定（PMID:29316426）。用表达BRAF A762V的BA/F3和MCF10A细胞进行的体外研究表明，通过与野生型（PMID:29533785）相当的转化和增殖测量，突变可能是中性的。
var_description: The BRAF A762V mutation is located in an unknown functional domain of the protein. This mutation has been identified in colorectal cancer (PMID: 29316426). In vitro studies with Ba/F3 and MCF10A cells expressing BRAF A762V demonstrate that the mutation is likely neutral as measured by transformation and proliferation comparable to wildtype (PMID: 29533785).

var_description_zh: II类BRAF K601E突变位于蛋白外显子15的激酶结构域（PMID:28783719，26343582）。该突变在黑色素瘤中复发（PMID:22798288，26643848）。BRAF K601E突变的生物学特征表明，它们独立于Ras激活下游MAPK途径，并使BRAF作为与CRAF和其自身的二聚体具有活性（PMID:22798288，20179705，26343582）。用表达BRAF K601E的结直肠癌的患者来源的异种移植模型进行的临床前研究证明了对使用或不使用西妥昔单抗的PLX8394治疗的敏感性（通过肿瘤生长减少来测量），以及对西妥昔单抗和维莫非尼治疗的抗性（通过治疗后肿瘤生长不减少来测量）（PMID:30559419，31515458）。一名患有转移性BRAF K601E突变黑色素瘤的患者对MEK抑制剂曲美替尼（PMID:28344857）完全缓解。在一份病例报告中，一名携带BRAF K601E的肺腺癌患者接受了达拉非尼和曲美替尼的联合治疗，并显示出部分缓解，无进展生存期为9个月（PMID:34590045）。在另一份病例报告中，一名携带BRAF K601E的甲状腺乳头状癌患者接受了索拉非尼和狄诺塞麦的联合治疗，并显示完全缓解（PMID:35630083）。在一项II期试验中，一名携带BRAF K601E的黑色素瘤患者接受了曲美替尼治疗，并显示出部分缓解，无进展生存期为32周（PMID:23248257）。在另一项II期试验中，6名携带BRAF K601E的晚期实体瘤患者接受了维莫非尼治疗，但对治疗无临床反应（PMID:29320312）。在一项I期试验中，两名携带BRAF K601E的黑色素瘤患者接受了达拉非尼治疗，但对治疗无临床反应（PMID:22608338）。
var_description: The class II BRAF K601E mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 15 of the protein (PMID: 28783719, 26343582). This mutation is recurrent in melanoma (PMID: 22798288, 26643848). Biological characterization of BRAF K601E mutations demonstrated that they activate the downstream MAPK pathway independently of RAS and render BRAF active as a dimer with CRAF and itself (PMID: 22798288, 20179705, 26343582). Preclinical studies with patient-derived xenograft models of colorectal cancer expressing BRAF K601E demonstrated sensitivity to treatment with PLX8394 with or without cetuximab as measured by reduced tumor growth, and resistance to treatment with cetuximab and vemurafenib as measured by no reduction in tumor growth upon treatment (PMID: 30559419, 31515458). A patient with metastatic BRAF K601E-mutated melanoma achieved a complete response to the MEK inhibitor trametinib (PMID: 28344857). In a case report, a patient with lung adenocarcinoma harboring BRAF K601E was treated with a combination therapy of dabrafenib plus trametinib and demonstrated partial response with a progression-free survival of nine months (PMID: 34590045). In another case report, a patient with papillary thyroid carcinoma harboring BRAF K601E was treated with a combination therapy of sorafenib plus denosumab and demonstrated a complete response (PMID: 35630083). In a Phase II trial, a patient with melanoma harboring BRAF K601E was treated with trametinib and demonstrated partial response with a progression-free survival of 32 weeks (PMID: 23248257). In another Phase II trial, six patients with advanced solid tumors harboring BRAF K601E were treated with vemurafenib and did not clinically respond to treatment (PMID: 29320312). In a Phase I trial, two patients with melanoma harboring BRAF K601E were treated with dabrafenib and did not clinically respond to treatment (PMID: 22608338).

var_description_zh: III类BRAF K483M突变位于BRAF蛋白的激酶结构域（PMID:15035987）。体外研究表明，与野生型相比，通过CRAF激活和下游信号传导测量，该突变可能是激活的（PMID:15035987，23533272）。用表达BRAF K483M的D04细胞进行的临床前研究表明，通过抑制MEK激活（PMID:20141835），对索拉非尼治疗具有敏感性。
var_description: The class III BRAF K483M mutation is located in the kinase domain of the BRAF protein (PMID: 15035987). In vitro studies have demonstrated that this mutation is likely activating as measured by CRAF activation and downstream signaling compared to wildtype (PMID: 15035987, 23533272). Preclinical studies with D04 cells expressing BRAF K483M demonstrated sensitivity to treatment with sorafenib as measured by inhibition of MEK activation (PMID: 20141835).

var_description_zh: BRAF M517V突变位于该蛋白的激酶结构域。计算机分析表明，该突变导致对维莫非尼的耐药性（PMID:35215249）。
var_description: The BRAF M517V mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein. In silico analysis suggests that the mutation contributes to resistance against vemurafenib (PMID: 35215249).

var_description_zh: BRAF M620I突变位于该蛋白的激酶结构域。该突变已在肺腺癌中鉴定（PMID:28481359）。计算机分析表明该突变具有激活和破坏性（PMID:34588906）。
var_description: The BRAF M620I mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein. This mutation has been identified in lung adenocarcinoma (PMID: 28481359). In silico analysis suggests that the mutation is activating and damaging (PMID: 34588906).

var_description_zh: II类BRAF E586K突变位于蛋白外显子15的激酶结构域（PMID:33019809）。该突变已在肺腺癌中鉴定（PMID:31534501）。该突变在COS细胞中的表达表明，与野生型BRAF（PMID:15035987）相比，通过增加的体外激酶活性来测量，该突变是活化的。用表达BRAF E586K的HEK293细胞进行的临床前研究证明了用pan-RAF抑制剂LY3009120治疗的敏感性，如通过抑制磷酸-MEK和-ERK活性（PMID:26343583）所测量的。
var_description: The class II BRAF E586K mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 15 of the protein (PMID: 33019809). This mutation has been identified in lung adenocarcinoma (PMID: 31534501). Expression of this mutation in COS cells demonstrated that it is activating as measured by increased in vitro kinase activity compared to wildtype BRAF (PMID: 15035987). Preclinical studies with HEK293 cells expressing BRAF E586K demonstrated sensitivity to treatment with pan-RAF inhibitor LY3009120 as measured by inhibited phospho-MEK and -ERK activities (PMID: 26343583).

var_description_zh: II类BRAF Q257R突变位于该蛋白（PMID:33019809）外显子6的富含半胱氨酸的区域。该突变已在心脏-面部-皮肤综合征中发现（PMID:16474404，16439621）。与野生型BRAF（PMID:16474404）相比，该突变在NIH-3T3细胞中的表达证明该突变是激活的，如通过下游MAPK途径转录靶标（例如，ELK）的转录增加所测量的。当在斑马鱼胚胎中表达时，Q257R突变导致与BRAF V600E相同的异常延伸表型，表明其可能在体内激活（PMID:19376813）。
var_description: The class II BRAF Q257R mutation is located in the cysteine-rich domain in exon 6 of the protein (PMID: 33019809). This mutation has been found in cardio-facio-cutaneous syndrome (PMID: 16474404, 16439621). Expression of this mutation in NIH-3T3 cells demonstrated that this mutation is activating as measured by increased transcription of downstream MAPK pathway transcriptional targets (e.g., ELK) compared to wildtype BRAF (PMID: 16474404). When expressed in zebrafish embryos, the Q257R mutation causes the same aberrant elongation phenotype as BRAF V600E, suggesting that it is likely activating in vivo (PMID: 19376813).

var_description_zh: BRAF E695K突变位于该蛋白的激酶结构域。该突变已在浆细胞骨髓瘤中鉴定（PMID:30545397）。用表达BRAF E695K的MCF10A细胞进行的体外研究表明，通过与野生型相比增加的转化能力（PMID:29533785）来测量，突变是激活的。
var_description: The BRAF E695K mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein. This mutation has been identified in plasma cell myeloma (PMID: 30545397). In vitro studies with MCF10A cells expressing BRAF E695K demonstrate that the mutation is activating as measured by increased transformation ability compared to wildtype (PMID: 29533785).

var_description_zh: BRAF S419Y突变位于该蛋白的未知功能域。用BA/F3细胞和表达BRAF S419Y的MCF10A细胞进行的体外研究表明，如通过与野生型（PMID:29533785）相当的细胞增殖和生存力所测量的，突变可能是中性的。
var_description: The BRAF S419Y mutation is located in an unknown functional domain of the protein. In vitro studies with Ba/F3 cells and MCF10A cells expressing BRAF S419Y demonstrate that the mutation is likely neutral as measured by cell proliferation and viability comparable to wildtype (PMID: 29533785).

var_description_zh: II类BRAF K601T突变位于蛋白外显子15的激酶结构域（PMID:28783719，26343582）。这种突变在毛细胞白血病和多发性骨髓瘤中已有报道（PMID:25938346，26090869）。BRAF K601T的生化特征表明，其激活不依赖于Ras的下游MAPK途径，并使BRAF作为与CRAF和其自身的二聚体具有活性（PMID:26343582）。虽然该突变对靶向抑制剂（如曲美替尼）的MEK抑制敏感，但对RAF单体抑制剂（如维莫非尼）不敏感（PMID:28783719，26343582，22798288）。
var_description: The class II BRAF K601T mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 15 of the protein (PMID: 28783719, 26343582). This mutation has been reported in hairy cell leukemia and multiple myeloma (PMID: 25938346, 26090869). Biochemical characterization of BRAF K601T has demonstrated that it activates the downstream MAPK pathway independent of RAS and renders BRAF active as a dimer with CRAF and itself (PMID: 26343582). While this mutation is sensitive to MEK inhibition by targeted inhibitors such as trametinib, it is insensitive to RAF monomer inhibitors such as vemurafenib (PMID: 28783719, 26343582, 22798288).

var_description_zh: BRAF T470P突变位于该蛋白的激酶结构域。计算机分析表明该突变是破坏性的和激活的（PMID:24037001）。
var_description: The BRAF T470P mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein. In silico analysis suggests that the mutation is damaging and activating (PMID: 24037001).

var_description_zh: BRAF T310I突变位于蛋白质的未知功能域。该突变已在神经胶质瘤中鉴定（PMID:18772396）。用表达BRAF T310I的SKBR3细胞进行的体外研究表明，通过与野生型相比ERK磷酸化的增加来测量，该突变是激活的（PMID:31158244）。用表达该突变的SKBR3细胞进行的临床前研究表明，通过持续的ERK磷酸化（PMID:31158244）来测量对达拉非尼治疗的抗性。
var_description: The BRAF T310I mutation is located in an unknown functional domain of the protein. This mutation has been identified in glioma (PMID: 18772396). In vitro studies with SkBr3 cells expressing BRAF T310I demonstrate that the mutation is activating as measured by an increase in ERK phosphorylation compared to wildtype (PMID: 31158244). Preclinical studies with SkBr3 cells expressing this mutation demonstrate resistance to treatment with dabrafenib as measured by sustained ERK phosphorylation (PMID: 31158244).

var_description_zh: II类BRAF L505H突变位于蛋白外显子12的激酶结构域（PMID:33019809）。该突变已在前列腺癌中发现（PMID:24283590）。该突变在293T细胞或RWPE-1前列腺细胞中的表达表明，与野生型BRAF（pMID:24283590）相比，通过MEK和ERK的下游活化增加以及在软琼脂中的集落形成增加来测量，该突变是活化的。BRAF L505H的体外和体内研究表明，该突变对维莫非尼具有抗性，这是通过在维莫非尼抗性筛选中L505H突变的发生、在表达该突变的细胞中用维莫非尼治疗后持续的MAPK通路信号传导以及在携带该突变的黑色素瘤细胞的异种移植模型中持续的肿瘤生长来测量的（PMID:24283590，24112705）。在一项研究中，一名携带BRAF L505H的转移性黑色素瘤患者在接受维莫非尼治疗后出现疾病进展（PMID:25515853）。然而，体外研究表明，BRAF L505H对司美替尼敏感，这是通过药物治疗后MAPK通路信号减少来衡量的（PMID:24283590）。
var_description: The class II BRAF L505H mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 12 of the protein (PMID: 33019809). This mutation has been found in prostate cancer (PMID: 24283590). Expression of this mutation in 293T cells or RWPE-1 prostate cells demonstrated that it is activating as measured by increased downstream activation of MEK and ERK as well as increased colony formation in soft agar compared to wildtype BRAF (PMID: 24283590). In vitro and in vivo studies of BRAF L505H suggest that this mutation is resistant to vemurafenib as measured by the occurrence of the L505H mutation in a vemurafenib resistance screen, sustained MAPK pathway signaling upon treatment with vemurafenib in cells expressing the mutation and sustained tumor growth in a xenograft model of melanoma cells harboring this mutation (PMID: 24283590, 24112705). In one study, one patient with metastatic melanoma harboring BRAF L505H had progressive disease in response to vemurafenib treatment (PMID: 25515853). In vitro studies, however, suggest that BRAF L505H is sensitive to selumetinib as measured by decreased MAPK pathway signaling upon drug treatment (PMID: 24283590).

var_description_zh: III类BRAF G466A突变位于蛋白外显子11的激酶结构域（PMID:28783719，15035987，28783719）。该突变已在黑色素瘤和肺腺癌中鉴定（PMID:12068308，28481359）。BRAF G466A突变的生物学特征已经证明，它在MAPK途径的激活中是Ras依赖性的，与CRAF作为二聚体发出信号，并且通常与另一种放大Ras信号的驱动机制共同发生（PMID:15035987，28783719）。因此，当在黑色素瘤中观察到BRAF G466A时，它通常与活化Ras突变或NF1失活同时发生，而当在非小细胞肺癌或结肠直肠癌中观察到时，它与蛋白水平的受体酪氨酸激酶（RTK）过度活化有关（PMID:28783719）。一名携带BRAF G466A的非小细胞肺癌患者在接受维莫非尼治疗后未出现临床治疗反应，并表现出疾病进展（PMID:31959346）。携带BRAF G466A的晚期实体瘤患者接受曲美替尼治疗，并表现出疾病进展或稳定（PMID:31924734）。在一份病例报告中，一名携带BRAF G466A的转移性Bellini导管癌患者接受曲美替尼联合达拉非尼治疗，治疗后病情稳定11个月（PMID:33669326）。在一项Ib期试验中，一名携带BRAF G466A的转移性非小细胞肺癌患者接受了ERK1/2抑制剂LTT462和BRAF/CRAF抑制剂LXH 254的联合治疗，治疗后肿瘤减少25%，病情稳定（摘要：Wolf等人摘要#1387P，肿瘤学年鉴2020.https：//www.annalsofoncology.org/article/S0923-7534%2820%2941697-7/fulltext）。
var_description: The class III BRAF G466A mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 11 of the protein (PMID: 28783719, 15035987, 28783719). This mutation has been identified in melanoma and lung adenocarcinoma (PMID: 12068308, 28481359). Biological characterization of the BRAF G466A mutation has demonstrated that it is RAS dependent in its activation of the MAPK pathway, signals as a dimer with CRAF, and typically co-occurs with another driver mechanism that amplifies RAS signaling (PMID: 15035987, 28783719). Thus, when BRAF G466A is observed in melanoma, it typically co-occurs with an activating RAS mutation or NF1 inactivation, whereas when observed in non-small cell lung or colorectal cancers, it is associated with receptor tyrosine kinase (RTK) hyperactivation at the protein level (PMID: 28783719). A patient with non-small cell lung cancer harboring BRAF G466A treated with vemurafenib did not clinically respond to treatment and demonstrated progressive disease (PMID: 31959346). Patients with advanced solid tumors harboring BRAF G466A were treated with trametinib and demonstrated either progressive or stable disease (PMID: 31924734). In a case report, a patient with metastatic Bellini duct carcinoma harboring BRAF G466A treated with trametinib plus dabrafenib demonstrated 11 months of stable disease following treatment (PMID: 33669326). In a Phase Ib trial, a patient with metastatic non-small cell lung cancer harboring BRAF G466A was treated with combination therapy of the ERK1/2 inhibitor LTT462 and the BRAF/CRAF inhibitor LXH 254 and demonstrated stable disease with a 25% tumor reduction following treatment (Abstract: Wolf et al. Abstract# 1387p, Annals of Oncology 2020. https://www.annalsofoncology.org/article/S0923-7534%2820%2941697-7/fulltext).

var_description_zh: BRAF G421V突变位于该蛋白的未知功能域。用BA/F3细胞和表达BRAF G421V的MCF10A细胞进行的体外研究表明，如通过与野生型（PMID:29533785）相当的细胞增殖和生存力所测量的，突变可能是中性的。
var_description: The BRAF G421V mutation is located in an unknown functional domain of the protein. In vitro studies with Ba/F3 cells and MCF10A cells expressing BRAF G421V demonstrate that the mutation is likely neutral as measured by cell proliferation and viability comparable to wildtype (PMID: 29533785).

var_description_zh: BRAF D380H突变位于蛋白的未知功能域。用BA/F3细胞和表达BRAF D380H的MCF10A细胞进行的体外研究表明，通过与野生型（PMID:29533785）相比的细胞增殖和生存力测量，突变可能是中性的。
var_description: The BRAF D380H mutation is located in an unknown functional domain of the protein. In vitro studies with Ba/F3 cells and MCF10A cells expressing BRAF D380H demonstrate that the mutation is likely neutral as measured by cell proliferation and viability comparable to wildtype (PMID: 29533785).

var_description_zh: BRAF T529I突变位于蛋白外显子13的激酶结构域。这种改变被认为是一种看门人突变，因为已知其他激酶中类似残基的突变会导致对结合在ATP结合口袋中的药物产生耐药性（PMID:15573099）。该突变在COS7细胞中的表达表明，通过与野生型BRAF（PMID:20538618）相当的激酶活性测量，它可能是中性的。然而，BRAF V600E在COS7细胞中的表达表明，该突变赋予对RAF抑制剂如维莫非尼的抗性，但保持对MEK抑制剂的敏感性（PMID:20538618）。
var_description: The BRAF T529I mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 13 of the protein. This alteration is considered a gatekeeper mutation as mutations at the analogous residue in other kinases are known to cause resistance to drugs that bind in the ATP-binding pocket (PMID: 15573099). Expression of this mutation in COS7 cells demonstrated it is likely neutral as measured by kinase activity comparable to wildtype BRAF (PMID: 20538618). However, expression with BRAF V600E in COS7 cells demonstrated that this mutation confers resistance to RAF inhibitors such as vemurafenib, but maintains sensitivity to MEK inhibitors (PMID: 20538618).

var_description_zh: BRAF Y472C突变位于蛋白外显子11的激酶结构域。在非小细胞肺癌中发现该突变（PMID:22649091）。该突变在COS7、H661或H226细胞中的表达表明，尽管激酶活性受损（PMID:22649091），但与野生型BRAF相比，通过增加的下游MEK和ERK活化来测量，该突变是活化的。与其他激酶失活BRAF突变类似，Y472C突变体通过反式激活CRAF促进下游致癌信号传导（通过MEK/ERK途径），因此被认为在临床环境中可能致癌（PMID:22649091）。在一项II期试验中，一名携带BRAF Y472C的非小细胞肺癌患者接受了达沙替尼治疗，并显示出完全缓解（PMID:20855820）。
var_description: The BRAF Y472C mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 11 of the protein. This mutation is found in non-small cell lung cancer (PMID: 22649091). Expression of this mutation in COS7, H661, or H226 cells demonstrated that it is activating as measured by increased downstream MEK and ERK activation compared to wildtype BRAF, despite having impaired kinase activity (PMID: 22649091). Similar to other kinase-inactivating BRAF mutations, the Y472C mutant promotes downstream oncogenic signaling (via MEK/ERK pathway) by transactivating CRAF, and therefore is considered to be likely oncogenic in the clinical setting (PMID: 22649091). In a Phase II trial, a patient with non-small cell lung cancer harboring BRAF Y472C was treated with dasatinib and demonstrated a complete response (PMID: 20855820).

var_description_zh: I类激活外显子15 BRAF V600E突变位于BRAF蛋白的激酶结构域中，并且在黑色素瘤、肺癌和甲状腺癌等中高度复发（PMID:28783719，26091043，25079552，23833300，25417114，28783719，12068308）。该突变已被全面的生物学表征，并已显示激活不依赖于Ras的下游MAPK途径（PMID:15035987，12068308，19251651，26343582），使BRAF以单体形式组成性激活（PMID:20179705），并保持对RAF单体抑制剂如维莫非尼和达拉非尼的敏感性（PMID:26343582，28783719，20179705，30351999）。
var_description: The class I activating exon 15 BRAF V600E mutation is located in the kinase domain of the BRAF protein and is highly recurrent in melanoma, lung and thyroid cancer, among others (PMID: 28783719, 26091043, 25079552, 23833300, 25417114, 28783719, 12068308). This mutation has been comprehensively biologically characterized and has been shown to activate the downstream MAPK pathway independent of RAS (PMID: 15035987, 12068308, 19251651, 26343582), to render BRAF constitutively activated in monomeric form (PMID: 20179705), and to retain sensitivity to RAF monomer inhibitors such as vemurafenib and dabrafenib (PMID:26343582, 28783719, 20179705, 30351999).

var_description_zh: II类BRAF L597Q突变位于蛋白外显子15的激酶结构域（PMID:28783719，26343582）。该突变在黑色素瘤中复发（PMID:12068308，15035987，26643848）。BRAF L597Q的生物学特征表明其激活不依赖于Ras的下游MAPK途径，并使BRAF作为与CRAF和其自身的二聚体具有活性（PMID:12068308，15035987，22798288，26343582，28783719）。对表达BRAF L597Q的患者来源的结肠腺癌细胞进行的临床前研究表明，曲美替尼、司美替尼、AZD8931和曲美替尼联合西妥昔单抗治疗对肿瘤生长的抑制作用具有敏感性（PMID:31704811）。在一项I期试验中，一名携带BRAF L597Q的肺癌患者接受了BVD-523治疗，并显示出部分缓解（PMID:29247021）。在一项II期试验中，一名携带BRAF L597Q的黑色素瘤患者接受了曲美替尼治疗，结果显示部分缓解，肿瘤缩小38%，持续无进展生存期为8.3个月（PMID:33861486）。在另一项II期试验中，一名携带BRAF L597Q的晚期实体瘤患者接受了维莫非尼治疗，但未出现临床治疗反应（PMID:29320312）。
var_description: The class II BRAF L597Q mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 15 of the protein (PMID: 28783719, 26343582). This mutation is recurrent in melanoma (PMID: 12068308, 15035987, 26643848). Biological characterization of BRAF L597Q demonstrated that it activates the downstream MAPK pathway independent of RAS and renders BRAF active as a dimer with CRAF and itself (PMID: 12068308, 15035987, 22798288, 26343582, 28783719). Preclinical studies with patient-derived colon adenocarcinoma cells expressing BRAF L597Q demonstrated sensitivity to treatment with trametinib, selumetinib, AZD8931 and trametinib plus cetuximab as measured by inhibition of tumor growth (PMID: 31704811). In a Phase I trial, a patient with lung cancer harboring BRAF L597Q was treated with BVD-523 and demonstrated partial response (PMID: 29247021). In a Phase II trial, a patient with melanoma harboring BRAF L597Q was treated with trametinib and demonstrated partial response with a 38% tumor reduction and ongoing progression-free survival of 8.3 months (PMID: 33861486). In another Phase II trial, a patient with an advanced solid tumor harboring BRAF L597Q was treated with vemurafenib and did not clinically respond to treatment (PMID: 29320312).

var_description_zh: BRAF N49I突变位于蛋白的N末端。用BA/F3细胞和表达BRAF N49I的MCF10A细胞进行的体外研究表明，通过与野生型（PMID:29533785）相比的细胞增殖和生存力测量，突变可能是中性的。
var_description: The BRAF N49I mutation is located in the N-terminus of the protein. In vitro studies with Ba/F3 cells and MCF10A cells expressing BRAF N49I demonstrate that the mutation is likely neutral as measured by cell proliferation and viability comparable to wildtype (PMID: 29533785).

var_description_zh: BRAF Q201H突变位于蛋白外显子4的Ras结合域。已在卵巢癌细胞系（PMID:18060073）中发现该突变。虽然该突变尚未得到功能验证，但SIFT预测软件预测该突变可能是中性的（PMID:18060073）。
var_description: The BRAF Q201H mutation is located in the RAS-binding domain in exon 4 of the protein. This mutation has been found in an ovarian cancer cell line (PMID: 18060073). While this mutation has not been functionally validated, SIFT prediction software predicted that this mutation would likely be neutral (PMID: 18060073).

var_description_zh: CSTF3-BRAF融合由保留BRAF完整激酶结构域的染色体重排产生。一名携带BRAF V600E的转移性黑色素瘤患者接受了达拉非尼加曲美替尼治疗，并在疾病进展后获得了CSTF3-BRAF作为继发性耐药突变（PMID:28539463），尽管该患者本身没有功能特征。
var_description: The CSTF3-BRAF fusion results from a chromosomal rearrangement that retains the full kinase domain of BRAF. Although not functionally characterized per se, a patient with metastatic melanoma harboring BRAF V600E was treated with dabrafenib plus trametinib and acquired CSTF3-BRAF as a secondary resistance mutation following disease progression (PMID: 28539463).

var_description_zh: BRAF A728V突变位于该蛋白第18外显子的C末端。该突变已在甲状腺乳头状癌中鉴定（PMID:19176457）。与野生型BRAF（PMID:15035987）相比，该突变在COS细胞中的表达表明其被激活，如通过增加的磷酸化ERK水平和增加的激酶活性所测量的。
var_description: The BRAF A728V mutation is located in the C-terminal end of exon 18 of the protein. This mutation has been identified in papillary thyroid carcinoma (PMID: 19176457).  Expression of this mutation in COS cells demonstrated that it is activating as measured by increased phosphorylated ERK levels and increased kinase activity compared to wildtype BRAF (PMID: 15035987).

var_description_zh: III类BRAF D594G突变位于蛋白外显子15的激酶结构域（PMID:28783719）。该突变已在结直肠癌和黑色素瘤等中发现（PMID:26498038，28481359）。尽管具有低活性激酶活性，但体外研究表明，与野生型相比，通过增加的CRAF二聚化和下游信号传导来测量，该突变可能是激活的（PMID:20141835，26498038，28783719）。用表达BRAF D594G的WM3670细胞进行的临床前研究证明了对维莫非尼和PLX8394治疗的抗性（通过持续的MEK、ERK和Akt活性测量），以及对SIJ1777治疗的敏感性（通过Akt和MAPK抑制测量）（PMID:33917428）。在一份病例报告中，一名携带BRAF D594G的低级别浆液性卵巢癌患者接受了曲美替尼治疗，并表现出轻微的临床反应（PMID:35198414）。
var_description: The class III BRAF D594G mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 15 of the protein (PMID: 28783719). This mutation has been found in colorectal cancer and melanomas, among others (PMID: 26498038, 28481359). Despite having hypoactive kinase activity, in vitro studies have demonstrated that this mutation is likely activating as measured by increased CRAF dimerization and downstream signaling compared to wildtype (PMID: 20141835, 26498038, 28783719). Preclinical studies with WM3670 cells expressing BRAF D594G demonstrated resistance to treatment with vemurafenib and PLX8394, as measured by persistent MEK, ERK and AKT activity, and sensitivity to treatment with SIJ1777, as measured by AKT and MAPK inhibition (PMID: 33917428). In a case report, a patient with low-grade serous ovarian cancer harboring BRAF D594G was treated with trametinib and demonstrated minimal clinical response (PMID: 35198414).

var_description_zh: BRAF V600L突变（也称为V599L）位于蛋白质激酶结构域的激活片段中。该突变已在结直肠癌中鉴定（PMID:22586484）。用表达BRAF V600L的MCF10A细胞进行的体外研究表明，通过与野生型相比增加的细胞增殖和生存力（PMID:29533785）来测量，该突变是激活的。
var_description: The BRAF V600L mutation (also known as V599L) is located in the activation segment of the kinase domain of the protein. This mutation has been identified in colorectal cancer (PMID: 22586484). In vitro studies with MCF10A cells expressing BRAF V600L demonstrate that the mutation is activating as measured by increased cell proliferation and viability compared to wildtype (PMID: 29533785).

var_description_zh: II类BRAF G469R突变位于蛋白外显子11的激酶结构域（PMID:28783719，26343582）。在非小细胞肺癌、慢性淋巴细胞白血病、黑色素瘤和一系列其他癌症类型中已报道了该突变（PMID:26498038，24920063，16096377，26150740，26619011）。BRAF G469R突变的生物学特征表明，其激活不依赖于Ras的下游MAPK途径，使BRAF作为与CRAF和其自身的二聚体具有活性（PMID:26343582，28783719，20179705）。虽然对靶向抑制剂如曲美替尼的MEK抑制敏感，但该突变对RAF单体抑制剂如维莫非尼不敏感（PMID:26343582，28783719，18794803，26343582，28783719）。在一项II期试验中，一名携带BRAF G469R和KIT G12V的黑色素瘤患者接受了曲美替尼治疗，病情稳定，无进展生存期为22.3个月（PMID:33861486）。
var_description: The class II BRAF G469R mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 11 of the protein (PMID: 28783719, 26343582). This mutation has been reported in non-small cell lung cancer, chronic lymphocytic leukemia, melanoma and a range of other cancer types (PMID: 26498038, 24920063, 16096377, 26150740, 26619011). Biological characterization of the BRAF G469R mutation demonstrated that it activates the downstream MAPK pathway independent of RAS renders BRAF active as a dimer with CRAF and itself (PMID: 26343582, 28783719, 20179705). While sensitive to MEK inhibition by targeted inhibitors such as trametinib, this mutation is insensitive to RAF monomer inhibitors such as vemurafenib (PMID: 26343582, 28783719, 18794803, 26343582, 28783719). In a Phase II trial, a patient with melanoma harboring BRAF G469R and KIT G12V was treated with trametinib and demonstrated stable disease with a progression-free survival of 22.3 months (PMID: 33861486).

var_description_zh: III类BRAF F595L突变位于蛋白外显子11的激酶结构域（PMID:28783719）。该突变在组织细胞肉瘤、结直肠癌和心面皮肤综合征中已有报道（PMID:26582644，15150094，26150740）。BRAF F595L突变的生物学特征已经证明，它在MAPK途径的激活中是Ras依赖性的，与CRAF作为二聚体发出信号，并且通常与另一种放大Ras信号的驱动机制共同发生（PMID:28783719，15035987，15150094）。因此，当在黑色素瘤中观察到BRAF F595L时，它通常与活化Ras突变或NF1失活同时发生，而当在非小细胞肺癌或结肠直肠癌中观察到时，它与蛋白水平的受体酪氨酸激酶（RTK）过度活化有关（PMID:28783719，20141835）。虽然该突变对靶向抑制剂如曲美替尼的MEK抑制敏感，但对RAF单体抑制剂如维莫非尼不敏感（PMID:28783719，26582644）。一名携带BRAF F595L的转移性结直肠癌患者接受了FOLFOX联合帕尼单抗治疗，部分缓解，无进展生存期为10.2个月（PMID:31515458）。
var_description: The class III BRAF F595L mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 11 of the protein (PMID: 28783719). This mutation has been reported in histiocytic sarcoma, colorectal cancer and cardio-facio-cutaneous syndrome (PMID: 26582644, 15150094, 26150740). Biological characterization of the BRAF F595L mutation has demonstrated that it is RAS dependent in its activation of the MAPK pathway, signals as a dimer with CRAF, and typically co-occurs with another driver mechanism that amplifies RAS signaling (PMID: 28783719, 15035987, 15150094). Thus, when BRAF F595L is observed in melanoma, it typically co-occurs with an activating RAS mutation or NF1 inactivation, whereas when observed in non-small cell lung or colorectal cancers, it is associated with receptor tyrosine kinase (RTK) hyperactivation at the protein level (PMID: 28783719, 20141835). While this mutation is sensitive to MEK inhibition by targeted inhibitors such as trametinib, it is insensitive to RAF monomer inhibitors such as vemurafenib (PMID: 28783719, 26582644). A patient with metastatic colorectal cancer harboring BRAF F595L was treated with a combination therapy of FOLFOX plus panitumumab and experienced partial response with a progression-free survival of 10.2 months (PMID: 31515458).

var_description_zh: BRAF E451K突变位于该蛋白的未知功能域。用表达BRAF E451K的SKBR3细胞进行的体外研究表明，通过与野生型相比增加的ERK磷酸化来测量，该突变是激活的（PMID:31158244）。用表达该突变的SKBR3细胞进行的临床前研究表明，通过治疗后持续的ERK磷酸化测定，该突变对达拉非尼具有抗性（PMID:31158244）。
var_description: The BRAF E451K mutation is located in an unknown functional domain of the protein. In vitro studies with SkBr3 cells expressing BRAF E451K demonstrate that the mutation is activating as measured by increased ERK phosphorylation compared to wildtype (PMID: 31158244). Preclinical studies with SkBr3 cells expressing this mutation demonstrate that the mutation is resistant to dabrafenib as measured by sustained ERK phosphorylation following treatment (PMID: 31158244).

var_description_zh: III类BRAF G596R突变位于蛋白外显子15的激酶结构域（PMID:28783719）。该突变已在黑色素瘤、肺癌和结肠直肠癌中报道（PMID:14678966，26498038）。BRAF G596R突变的生物学特征已经证明，它在MAPK途径的激活中是Ras依赖性的，与CRAF作为二聚体发出信号，并且通常与另一种放大Ras信号的驱动机制共同发生（PMID:15035987，28783719，16364920）。因此，在黑色素瘤中，与其他III类BRAF突变体相似，G596R变体预计与活化Ras突变或NF1失活同时发生，而在非小细胞肺癌或结肠直肠癌中，该突变很可能与蛋白水平的受体酪氨酸激酶（RTK）过度活化有关（PMID:28783719）。用表达BRAF G596R的结直肠癌细胞进行的临床前研究表明，通过抑制细胞增殖来测定对PLX8394、RMC-4550和曲美替尼联合达拉非尼治疗的敏感性，以及通过持续的ERK和MEK激活来测定对维莫非尼治疗的抗性（PMID:30559419，30104724，28947956，28783719）。在一项II期临床试验中，一名非小细胞肺癌患者接受了维莫非尼治疗，但未出现临床治疗反应（PMID:31959346）。
var_description: The class III BRAF G596R mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 15 of the protein (PMID: 28783719). This mutation has been reported in melanoma, lung cancer and colorectal cancer (PMID: 14678966, 26498038). Biological characterization of the BRAF G596R mutation has demonstrated that it is RAS dependent in its activation of the MAPK pathway, signals as a dimer with CRAF, and typically co-occurs with another driver mechanism that amplifies RAS signaling (PMID: 15035987, 28783719, 16364920). Thus, in melanoma, the G596R variant, similar to other class III BRAF mutants, would be expected to co-occur with activating RAS mutation or NF1 inactivation, whereas in non-small cell lung or colorectal cancers, this mutation would most likely be associated with receptor tyrosine kinase (RTK) hyperactivation at the protein level (PMID: 28783719). Preclinical studies with colorectal cancer cells expressing BRAF G596R demonstrated sensitivity to treatment with PLX8394, RMC-4550 and trametinib plus dabrafenib as measured by inhibition of cellular proliferation, and resistance to treatment with vemurafenib as measured by persistent ERK and MEK activation (PMID: 30559419, 30104724,  28947956, 28783719). In a Phase II trial, a patient with non-small cell lung cancer was treated with vemurafenib and did not clinically respond to treatment (PMID: 31959346).

var_description_zh: BRAF S364L突变位于该蛋白的未知功能域。用BA/F3细胞和表达BRAF S364L的MCF10A细胞进行的体外研究表明，通过与野生型（PMID:29533785）相比的细胞增殖和生存力测量，突变可能是中性的。
var_description: The BRAF S364L mutation is located in an unknown functional domain of the protein. In vitro studies with Ba/F3 cells and MCF10A cells expressing BRAF S364L demonstrate that the mutation is likely neutral as measured by cell proliferation and viability comparable to wildtype (PMID: 29533785).

var_description_zh: BRAF H568D突变位于该蛋白的激酶结构域。用表达BRAF H568D的HEK293T细胞进行的体外研究表明，与野生型（PMID:29666306）相比，通过激酶活性的丧失来测量，该突变是失活的。具有低激酶活性的BRAF突变或激酶死亡的BRAF突变是III类突变，并且可能激活作为支架的CRAF，导致MEK调节的信号增加（PMID:20141835）。
var_description: The BRAF H568D mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein. In vitro studies with HEK293T cells expressing BRAF H568D demonstrate that the mutation is inactivating as measured by a loss of kinase activity compared to wildtype (PMID: 29666306). BRAF mutations with low kinase activity or those that are kinase-dead are Class III mutations and can possibly activate CRAF as a scaffold, resulting in increased MEK-regulated signaling (PMID: 20141835).

var_description_zh: II类BRAF L597V突变位于蛋白外显子15的激酶结构域（PMID:28783719，26343582）。该突变在黑色素瘤中复发（PMID:12068308，15035987，26643848）。BRAF L597V突变的生物学特征表明其激活不依赖于Ras的下游MAPK途径，并使BRAF作为与CRAF和其自身的二聚体具有活性（PMID:12068308，15035987，22798288，26343582，28783719，20179705）。用表达BRAF L597V的患者来源的肺腺癌细胞进行的临床前研究证明了对达拉非尼联合曲美替尼、曲美替尼、BGB-283和LXH 254治疗的敏感性（通过细胞增殖抑制测定），以及对达拉非尼、恩可拉非尼、维莫非尼、Tak-580、LY3214996、MK-8353、GDC-0994和BVD-523治疗的抗性（通过药物治疗后持续的细胞增殖测定）（PMID:32540409）。在一项II期试验中，一名携带BRAF L597V的子宫内膜腺癌患者接受了曲美替尼治疗，结果显示病情稳定，无进展生存期为7.9个月（PMID:31924734）。
var_description: The class II BRAF L597V mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 15 of the protein (PMID: 28783719, 26343582). This mutation is recurrent in melanoma (PMID: 12068308, 15035987, 26643848). Biological characterization of BRAF L597V mutation demonstrated that it activates the downstream MAPK pathway independent of RAS and renders BRAF active as a dimer with CRAF and itself (PMID: 12068308, 15035987, 22798288, 26343582, 28783719, 20179705). Preclinical studies with patient-derived lung adenocarcinoma cells expressing BRAF L597V demonstrated sensitivity to treatment with dabrafenib plus trametinib, trametinib, BGB-283 and LXH 254, as measured by cellular proliferation inhibition, and resistance to treatment with dabrafenib, encorafenib, vemurafenib, TAK-580, LY3214996, MK-8353, GDC-0994 and BVD-523, as measured by sustained cellular proliferation upon drug treatment (PMID: 32540409). In a Phase II trial, a patient with endometrial adenocarcinoma harboring BRAF L597V was treated with trametinib and demonstrated stable disease with a progression-free survival of 7.9 months (PMID: 31924734).

var_description_zh: BRAF H574Q突变位于蛋白质激酶结构域的外显子14。该突变已在神经胶质瘤和黑色素瘤中鉴定（PMID:34625582，28972077）。一项评估罕见体细胞突变对肺癌的影响的研究显示，转染了BRAF H574Q突变的细胞表现出ERK磷酸化的显著增加，与BRAF V600E突变（PMID:27478040）相当。
var_description: The BRAF H574Q mutation is located in exon 14 of the kinase domain of the protein. This mutation has been identified in glioma and melanoma (PMID: 34625582, 28972077). A study evaluating the effects of rare somatic mutations in lung cancers showed that cells transfected with BRAF H574Q mutation display a robust increase in ERK phosphorylation, comparable to BRAF V600E mutation (PMID: 27478040).

var_description_zh: BRAF I 592_A598dup突变位于该蛋白外显子15的激酶结构域中。该突变已在甲状腺乳头状癌、腹股沟腺病和原发性黑色素瘤中被鉴定，并且是具有统计学意义的热点（PMID:27571181，28800030）。该突变尚未在体外进行功能鉴定。基于两名具有涉及A598残基的罕见BRAF外显子15插入突变（BRAF A 598_T599insv和V 600_K601delinse（PMID:28800030））的患者的临床获益，BRAF外显子15突变对MAPK导向的靶向治疗组合治疗敏感。
var_description: The BRAF I592_A598dup mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 15 of the protein. This mutation has been identified in papillary thyroid carcinoma, inguinal adenopathy and primary melanoma, and is a statistically significant hotspot (PMID: 27571181, 28800030 ). This mutation has not been functionally characterized in vitro. BRAF exon 15 mutations are sensitive to treatment with combination MAPK-directed targeted therapy based on the clinical benefit of two patients with rare BRAF exon 15 insertion mutations involving the A598 residue, BRAF A598_T599insV and V600_K601delinsE (PMID: 28800030).

var_description_zh: BRAF T599INSTT突变位于蛋白外显子15的激酶结构域。该突变已在毛细胞型星形细胞瘤中发现（PMID:21190184）。该突变在HEK293细胞或MCF-10A细胞中的表达表明，通过激酶活性和与BRAF V600E突变（PMID:21190184）相当的接触抑制的变化来测量，该突变是激活的。
var_description: The BRAF T599insTT mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 15 of the protein. This mutation has been found in pilocytic astrocytoma (PMID: 21190184). Expression of this mutation in HEK293 cells or MCF-10A cells demonstrated that this mutation is activating as measured by kinase activity and changes in contact inhibition comparable to the BRAF V600E mutation (PMID: 21190184).

var_description_zh: BRAF扩增在癌症中是一种罕见的事件，在黑色素瘤和神经胶质瘤中发生的频率非常低（cBioportal，MSKCC，2017年4月）。已经证明，黑色素瘤细胞中野生型BRAF的扩增导致该蛋白的过度表达和MAPK途径的组成型激活，表现为ERK磷酸化的BRAF依赖性增加，以及细胞增殖的增加（PMID:15467732）。BRAF过度表达与胶质瘤的增殖增加有关（PMID:25618114）。BRAF V600E等位基因的扩增已被描述为黑色素瘤中通过MAPK途径过度激活对MEK/RAF抑制剂产生抗性的机制（PMID:22395615，24055054，21098728）。
var_description: BRAF amplification is a rare event in cancer and has been found to occur at very low frequency in melanoma and glioma (cBioPortal, MSKCC, April 2017). It has been demonstrated that amplification of wildtype BRAF in melanoma cells leads to overexpression of the protein and constitutive activation of MAPK pathway, demonstrated as a BRAF-dependent increase in ERK phosphorylation, as well as an increase in cell proliferation (PMID: 15467732). BRAF overexpression has been associated with increased proliferation in gliomas (PMID: 25618114). Amplification of BRAF V600E allele has been described as a mechanism of resistance to MEK/RAF inhibitors in melanoma via MAPK pathway hyperactivation (PMID: 22395615, 24055054, 21098728).

var_description_zh: SND1-BRAF融合蛋白由7号染色体的重排产生，并将SND1的外显子1-16与BRAF的外显子9-18融合。SND1-BRAF融合蛋白含有BRAF激酶结构域，但缺少负责Ras结合和自动抑制的BRAF CR1结构域（PMID:24345920）。SND1-BRAF在肺腺癌细胞系H1299或胃癌细胞系GTL16中的表达表明，与野生型BRAF（PMID:22745804，25985019）相比，通过下游MEK和ERK信号蛋白的激活增加来测量，该融合是活化的。SND1-BRAF在BA/F3细胞中的表达表明，通过IL-3非依赖性生长（PMID:25266736）测量，该融合正在转化。体外研究表明，这种融合对MEK抑制敏感，这是通过用曲美替尼（PMID:25266736）处理后细胞活力降低来测量的。
var_description: The SND1-BRAF fusion protein results from a rearrangement of chromosome 7 and fuses exons 1-16 of SND1 with exons 9-18 of BRAF. The SND1-BRAF fusion protein contains the BRAF kinase domain, but lacks the BRAF CR1 domain that is responsible for RAS-binding and auto-inhibition (PMID: 24345920). Expression of SND1-BRAF in a lung adenocarcinoma cell line, H1299, or a gastric cancer cell line, GTL16, demonstrated that this fusion is activating as measured by increased activation of downstream MEK and ERK signaling proteins compared to wildtype BRAF (PMID: 22745804, 25985019). Expression of SND1-BRAF in Ba/F3 cells demonstrated that this fusion is transforming as measured by IL-3-independent growth (PMID: 25266736). In vitro studies suggest that this fusion is sensitive to MEK inhibition, as measured by decreased cell viability upon treatment with trametinib (PMID: 25266736).

var_description_zh: II类BRAF K499E突变位于蛋白外显子12的激酶结构域（PMID:33019809）。该突变已在心脏-面部-皮肤综合征中发现（PMID:16474404，16439621）。该突变在NIH-3T3细胞中的表达表明，与野生型BRAF（PMID:16474404）相比，通过下游MAPK途径转录靶（例如，ELK）的显著增加的转录来测量，该突变是激活的。
var_description: The class II BRAF K499E mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 12 of the protein (PMID: 33019809). This mutation has been found in cardio-facio-cutaneous syndrome (PMID: 16474404, 16439621). Expression of this mutation in NIH-3T3 cells demonstrated that it is activating as measured by significantly increased transcription of downstream MAPK pathway transcriptional targets (e.g., ELK) compared to wildtype BRAF (PMID: 16474404).

var_description_zh: BRAF融合通常由染色体易位产生，所述染色体易位将伴侣基因的N-末端与BRAF的C-末端（外显子9-18，含有激酶结构域）融合，使得融合蛋白排除BRAF CR1调节结构域（PMID:15630448），从而产生组成型活性BRAF激酶。已经在黑色素瘤、前列腺癌、胃癌和多种其他癌症中发现了这些II类超活化BRAF融合（PMID:28783719，26343582，24345920，20526349，25985019，26324360，18974108）。不同BRAF融合蛋白的生物学表征表明，它们激活不依赖于Ras的下游MAPK途径（PMID:24345920，21424530，22745804，21424530，18974108，26343582），使BRAF作为与CRAF的同源或异源二聚体二聚体具有活性（PMID:26343582），同时对靶向抑制剂如曲美替尼的MEK抑制敏感（PMID:24345920，28783719，26343582，26314551），对RAF单体抑制剂如维莫非尼和达拉非尼（PMID:26343582，28783719）不敏感。在接受奥西替尼治疗的EGFR突变型肺癌患者的治疗后样本的多项研究中发现了BRAF融合（PMID:30257958，30073261）。
var_description: BRAF fusions generally arise from chromosomal translocations that fuse the N-terminal end of a partner gene with the C-terminal end of BRAF (exons 9-18, containing the kinase domain), such that the fusion protein excludes the BRAF CR1 regulatory domain (PMID:15630448), thereby resulting in a constitutively active BRAF kinase. These class II hyperactivating BRAF fusions have been found in melanoma, prostate cancer, gastric cancer, and multiple other cancers (PMID: 28783719, 26343582, 24345920, 20526349, 25985019, 26324360, 18974108). Biological characterization of diverse BRAF fusion proteins demonstrate that they activate the downstream MAPK pathway independent of RAS (PMID: 24345920, 21424530, 22745804, 21424530, 18974108, 26343582), render BRAF active as a homo- or heterodimer dimer with CRAF (PMID: 26343582), and, while sensitive to MEK inhibition by targeted inhibitors such as trametinib (PMID: 24345920, 28783719, 26343582, 26314551), are insensitive to RAF monomer inhibitors such as vemurafenib and dabrafenib (PMID: 26343582, 28783719). BRAF fusions have been found across multiple studies in post-treatment samples of patients with EGFR-mutant lung cancer who progressed on osimertinib (PMID: 30257958, 30073261).

var_description_zh: BRAF L597P突变位于该蛋白的激酶结构域。该突变已在黑色素瘤中鉴定（PMID:23890154）。对表达BRAF L597P的患者来源的肝内胆管癌类器官进行的体外研究表明，通过持续细胞增殖测定，对乐伐替尼、Temuterkib和舒尼替尼治疗具有耐药性，通过抑制细胞增殖测定，对曲美替尼和考比替尼治疗具有敏感性（PMID:36867406）。
var_description: The BRAF L597P mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein. This mutation has been identified in melanoma (PMID: 23890154). In vitro studies with patient-derived intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma organoids expressing BRAF L597P demonstrated resistance to treatment with lenvatinib, temuterkib and sunitinib as measured by sustained cellular proliferation, and sensitivity to treatment with trametinib and cobimetinib, as measured by inhibition of cellular proliferation (PMID: 36867406).

var_description_zh: BRAF V 487_p492delINSA突变位于该蛋白外显子11的激酶结构域。用表达BRAF V 487_p492delinsA的BxPC-3细胞进行的体外研究表明，通过与野生型相比增加的途径活化和细胞增殖来测量，该突变是活化的（PMID:26732095）。在细胞系和小鼠模型中的实验证明，BRAFα-C螺旋inDel突变体，例如V 487_p492delinsA，对维莫非尼不敏感，并且在药物治疗后维持MAPK途径的活性（PMID:26732095）。
var_description: The BRAF V487_P492delinsA mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 11 of the protein. In vitro studies with BxPC-3 cells expressing BRAF V487_P492delinsA demonstrate that the mutation is activating as measured by increased pathway activation and cellular proliferation compared to wildtype (PMID: 26732095). Experiments in cell lines and mouse models demonstrate that BRAF alpha-C helix indel mutants, such as V487_P492delinsA, are insensitive to vemurafenib and maintain activity of the MAPK pathway upon drug treatment (PMID: 26732095).

var_description_zh: JHDM1D-BRAF融合是将JHDM1D的外显子13和BRAF的外显子4融合的染色体重排，导致RAF的Ras结合结构域部分丢失。用表达JHDM1D-BRAF的AZD-R细胞进行的体外研究证明，如通过治疗后的持续细胞增殖所测量的，该融合体对用FGFR抑制剂AZD4547、NVP-BGJ398和PD173074的治疗具有抗性（PMID:30045926）。用表达该融合蛋白的AZD-R细胞进行的临床前研究证明了对MEK抑制剂CH4987655、曲美替尼和PD0325901治疗的敏感性，如通过治疗后细胞活力降低所测量的（PMID:30045926）。
var_description: The JHDM1D-BRAF fusion is a chromosomal rearrangement fusing exon 13 of JHDM1D and exon 4 of BRAF, resulting in the loss of part of the RAS-binding domain of RAF. In vitro studies with AZD-R cells expressing JHDM1D-BRAF demonstrate that the fusion is resistant to treatment with FGFR inhibitors AZD4547, NVP-BGJ398 and PD173074 as measured by sustained cellular proliferation following treatment (PMID: 30045926). Preclinical studies with AZD-R cells expressing this fusion demonstrated sensitivity to treatment with MEK inhibitors CH4987655, trametinib and PD0325901 as measured by decreased cell viability following treatment (PMID: 30045926).

var_description_zh: BRAF I326V突变位于BRAF蛋白的柔性铰链区。该突变在努南综合征中被发现为种系突变（PMID:17603482）。体外研究表明，与野生型（PMID:17603482）相比，通过下游信号测定，该突变可能是中性的。在一项临床研究中，一名携带BRAF I326V的结直肠癌患者接受了帕尼单抗和伊立替康加S-1治疗，并显示疾病进展（PMID:30463788）。
var_description: The BRAF I326V mutation is located in the flexible hinge domain of the BRAF protein. This mutation has been found as a germline mutation in Noonan Syndrome (PMID: 17603482). In vitro studies have demonstrated that this mutation is likely neutral as measured by downstream signaling compared to wildtype (PMID: 17603482). In a clinical study, a patient with colorectal cancer harboring BRAF I326V was treated with panitumumab and irinotecan plus S-1 and demonstrated progressive disease (PMID: 30463788).

var_description_zh: II类BRAF L597S突变位于蛋白质的激酶结构域（PMID:33019809）。在黑色素瘤和其他癌症中发现了这种突变（PMID:26643848）。体外研究表明，与野生型（PMID:22798288）相比，通过增加的下游信号来测量，该突变可能被激活。在细胞系中的药效研究表明，BRAF L597S突变可能对RAF抑制剂维莫非尼和MEK抑制剂曲美替尼（PMID:22798288）敏感。在对曲美替尼、变构MEK抑制剂Tak-733以及达拉非尼和曲美替尼联合治疗（PMID:24933606，22798288，29903896）有阳性反应的患者中也发现了BRAF L597S突变。
var_description: The class II BRAF L597S mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein (PMID: 33019809). This mutation has been found in melanoma, among other cancers (PMID: 26643848). In vitro studies have demonstrated that this mutation is likely activating as measured by increased downstream signaling compared to wildtype (PMID: 22798288). Drug efficacy studies in cell lines demonstrated that the BRAF L597S mutation might be sensitive to the RAF inhibitor vemurafenib and the MEK inhibitor trametinib (PMID: 22798288). The BRAF L597S mutation has also been identified in patients with positive responses to trametinib, the allosteric MEK inhibitor TAK-733 and combined dabrafenib and trametinib treatment (PMID: 24933606, 22798288, 29903896).

var_description_zh: III类BRAF G466E突变发生在蛋白外显子11的激酶结构域中（PMID:15035987，28783719）。该突变已在黑色素瘤、肺癌、结肠直肠癌和慢性粒单核细胞白血病中报道（PMID:28481359，15046639，27790118，24446311）。BRAF G466E突变的生物学特征已经证明，它在MAPK途径的激活中是Ras依赖性的，与CRAF作为二聚体发出信号，并且通常与另一种放大Ras信号的驱动机制共同发生（PMID:15035987，15046639，28783719）。因此，当在黑色素瘤中观察到BRAF G466E时，它通常与活化Ras突变或NF1失活同时发生，而当在非小细胞肺癌或结肠直肠癌中观察到时，它与蛋白水平的受体酪氨酸激酶（RTK）过度活化有关（PMID:28783719）。用表达BRAF G466E的黑色素瘤细胞系进行的临床前研究证明了对AZ628和Tak-632治疗的敏感性（通过降低细胞增殖来测量），以及对PLX7904、维莫非尼和达拉非尼治疗的不敏感性（通过延长细胞活力来测量）（PMID:27523909）。在一项临床研究中，两名携带BRAF G466E的转移性结直肠癌患者接受了帕尼单抗和伊立替康的联合治疗，结果显示部分缓解，无进展生存期为8.3个月（PMID:31515458）。在一份病例报告中，一名携带BRAF G466E的黑色素瘤患者接受了易普利姆玛治疗，并表现出疾病进展（PMID:27790118）。
var_description: The class III BRAF G466E mutation occurs in the kinase domain in exon 11 of the protein (PMID: 15035987, 28783719). This mutation has been reported in melanoma, lung cancer, colorectal cancer and chronic myelomonocytic leukemia (PMID: 28481359, 15046639, 27790118, 24446311). Biological characterization of the BRAF G466E mutation has demonstrated that it is RAS dependent in its activation of the MAPK pathway, signals as a dimer with CRAF, and typically co-occurs with another driver mechanism that amplifies RAS signaling (PMID: 15035987, 15046639, 28783719). Thus, when BRAF G466E is observed in melanoma, it typically co-occurs with an activating RAS mutation or NF1 inactivation, whereas when observed in non-small cell lung or colorectal cancers, it is associated with receptor tyrosine kinase (RTK) hyperactivation at the protein level (PMID: 28783719). Preclinical studies with melanoma cell lines expressing BRAF G466E demonstrated sensitivity to treatment with AZ628 and TAK-632 as measured by reduced cell proliferation, and insensitivity to treatment with PLX7904, vemurafenib and dabrafenib, as measured by prolonged cell viability (PMID: 27523909). In a clinical study, two patients with metastatic colorectal cancer harboring BRAF G466E were treated with combination therapy of panitumumab and irinotecan and demonstrated partial response with a progression-free survival of 8.3 months (PMID: 31515458). In a case report, a patient with melanoma harboring BRAF G466E was treated with ipilimumab and demonstrated progressive disease (PMID: 27790118).

var_description_zh: III类BRAF D594V突变位于蛋白外显子15的激酶结构域（PMID:33019809）。该突变已在结直肠癌和心脏-面部-皮肤（CFC）综合征中发现（PMID:16439621，14678966）。该突变在D04或COS7细胞中的表达表明，尽管激酶死亡，该突变通过与CRAF的二聚化激活MAPK途径，如通过下游MEK和ERK磷酸化所测量的（PMID:15035987，14678966）。当在斑马鱼胚胎中表达时，BRAF D594V突变导致与BRAF V600E相同的异常延伸表型，表明其可能在体内激活（PMID:19376813）。
var_description: The class III BRAF D594V mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 15 of the protein (PMID: 33019809). This mutation has been found in colorectal cancer and cardio-facio-cutaneous (CFC) syndrome (PMID: 16439621, 14678966). Expression of this mutation in D04 or COS7 cells demonstrated that, despite being kinase-dead, the mutation activates the MAPK pathway through dimerization with CRAF as measured by downstream MEK and ERK phosphorylation (PMID: 15035987, 14678966). When expressed in zebrafish embryos, the BRAF D594V mutation causes the same aberrant elongation phenotype as BRAF V600E, suggesting that it is likely activating in vivo (PMID: 19376813).

var_description_zh: BRAF L 485_Q494del突变位于该蛋白外显子11的激酶结构域。虽然该变体尚未得到功能验证，但该氨基酸范围内的另一个缺失（L 485_p490del）已显示为功能获得性和致癌性（PMID:26732095）。在细胞系和小鼠模型中的实验表明，BRAFα-C螺旋InDel突变体，如L 485_Q494Del，对维莫非尼不敏感，并在药物治疗后保持MAPK途径的活性（PMID:26732095）。
var_description: The BRAF L485_Q494del mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 11 of the protein. While this variant has not been functionally validated, another deletion in this amino acid range (L485_P490del) has been shown to be gain-of-function and oncogenic (PMID: 26732095). Experiments in cell lines and mouse models demonstrate that BRAF alpha-C helix indel mutants, such as L485_Q494del, are insensitive to vemurafenib and maintain activity of the MAPK pathway upon drug treatment (PMID: 26732095)

var_description_zh: BRAF G469del突变位于蛋白外显子11的激酶结构域。在非小细胞肺癌中发现了这种突变（PMID:23833300）。该突变在NIH-3T3细胞中的表达表明，尽管与野生型BRAF相比，体外激酶活性和体内下游MEK和ERK活化降低，但与野生型BRAF相比，集落形成轻度增加（pMID:23833300）。
var_description: The BRAF G469del mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 11 of the protein. This mutation has been found in non-small cell lung cancer (PMID: 23833300). Expression of this mutation in NIH-3T3 cells demonstrated that though in vitro kinase activity and in vivo downstream MEK and ERK activation were decreased compared to wildtype BRAF, colony formation was mildly increased compared to wildtype BRAF (PMID: 23833300).

var_description_zh: BRAF E501G突变位于蛋白外显子12的激酶结构域。该突变已在心脏-面部-皮肤（CFC）综合征中发现（PMID:16439621）。BRAF E501G在NIH-3T3细胞中的表达表明，该突变是轻微的功能丧失，因此可能不是致癌的，如通过与野生型BRAF（PMID:26065894，16474404，16439621）相当或更少的下游ELK转录形式的MAPK途径激活所测量的。
var_description: The BRAF E501G mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 12 of the protein. This mutation has been found in cardio-facio-cutaneous (CFC) syndrome (PMID: 16439621). Expression of BRAF E501G in NIH-3T3 cells demonstrated that this mutation is slightly loss of function and therefore likely not oncogenic, as measured by MAPK pathway activation in the form of downstream ELK transcription comparable to or less than wildtype BRAF (PMID: 26065894, 16474404, 16439621).

var_description_zh: I类激活外显子15 BRAF V600D突变位于该蛋白的激酶结构域（PMID:28783719）。该突变在黑色素瘤中复发（PMID:26091043，23579220，22614978）。BRAF V600D突变的全面生物学表征表明，该突变独立于Ras激活下游MAPK途径，并使BRAF以单体形式组成性激活（PMID:15035987，12068308，19251651，26343582，20179705）。用表达BRAF V600D的黑色素瘤细胞进行的临床前研究表明，用CCT196969、CCT241161、AZ628、Tak-632、PLX7904、维莫非尼、达拉非尼、ASTX029和考比替尼+HM95573治疗的敏感性通过MEK和ERK磷酸化和细胞增殖的抑制来测量（PMID:25500121，17210691，27523909，33953400，34330842）。在一份病例报告中，一名携带BRAF V600D的毛细胞性星形细胞瘤患者接受单药达拉非尼治疗，随后接受达拉非尼联合曲美替尼治疗，病情稳定（PMID:28784858）。在一项II期临床试验中，一名携带BRAF V600D的非小细胞肺癌患者接受了维莫非尼治疗，结果显示部分缓解，无进展生存期为3.8个月（PMID:31959346）。
var_description: The class I activating exon 15 BRAF V600D mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein (PMID: 28783719). This mutation is recurrent in melanoma (PMID: 26091043, 23579220, 22614978). Comprehensive biological characterization of the BRAF V600D mutation has demonstrated that this mutation activates the downstream MAPK pathway independently of RAS and renders BRAF constitutively activated in monomeric form (PMID: 15035987, 12068308, 19251651, 26343582, 20179705). Preclinical studies with melanoma cells expressing BRAF V600D demonstrate sensitivity to treatment with CCT196969, CCT241161, AZ628, TAK-632, PLX7904, vemurafenib, dabrafenib, ASTX029 and cobimetinib plus HM95573 as measured by inhibition of MEK and ERK phosphorylation and cellular proliferation (PMID: 25500121, 17210691, 27523909, 33953400, 34330842). In a case report, a patient with pilocytic astrocytoma harboring BRAF V600D was treated with single-agent dabrafenib then subsequently treated with combination therapy of dabrafenib plus trametinib and demonstrated stable disease (PMID: 28784858). In a Phase II trial, a patient with non-small cell lung cancer harboring BRAF V600D was treated with vemurafenib and demonstrated partial response with a progression-free survival of 3.8 months (PMID: 31959346).

var_description_zh: II类BRAF P 490_Q494del突变位于蛋白质外显子11中的激酶结构域（摘要：Severson等人摘要#40p，肿瘤学年鉴2022.https：//www.annalsofoncology.org/article/S0923-7534%2822%2900058-8/fulltext）。该突变已在胰腺癌中发现（PMID:26996308）。该突变在人细胞系中的表达表明，与野生型相比，通过增加的激酶活性和下游信号传导（PMID:26996308）来测量，该突变是激活的。
var_description: The class II BRAF P490_Q494del mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 11 of the protein (Abstract: Severson et al. Abstract #40P, Annals of Oncology 2022. https://www.annalsofoncology.org/article/S0923-7534%2822%2900058-8/fulltext). This mutation has been found in pancreatic cancer (PMID: 26996308). Expression of this mutation in a human cell line demonstrated that it is activating as measured by increased kinase activity and downstream signaling compared to wildtype (PMID: 26996308).

var_description_zh: II类BRAF K601N突变位于蛋白外显子15的激酶结构域（PMID:28783719，26343582）。该突变已在黑色素瘤和多发性骨髓瘤中鉴定（PMID:12068308，15035987，25178945，23273605，24270325）。BRAF K601N的生物学特征表明，它独立于RAS激活下游MAPK途径，并使BRAF作为与CRAF和其自身的二聚体具有活性（PMID:26343582，20179705）。用表达BRAF K601N的NIH3T3和SK-Mel-239细胞进行的临床前研究证明了对用LY3009120和PLX8394治疗的敏感性，如通过降低的增殖所测量的（PMID:26732095，30559419）。在一项Ib期试验中，一名携带BRAF K601N的非小细胞肺癌患者接受了LTT462和LXH 254的联合治疗，并显示出未经证实的部分缓解（摘要：Wolf等人摘要#1387P，肿瘤学年鉴2020。https：//www.annalsofoncology.org/article/S0923-7534%2820%2941697-7/fulltext）。在一项II期临床试验中，两名携带BRAF K601N的非小细胞肺癌患者接受了维莫非尼治疗，但对治疗无临床反应（PMID:31959346）。
var_description: The class II BRAF K601N mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 15 of the protein (PMID: 28783719, 26343582). This mutation has been identified in melanoma and multiple myeloma (PMID: 12068308, 15035987, 25178945, 23273605, 24270325). Biological characterization of BRAF K601N demonstrated that it activates the downstream MAPK pathway independently of RAS and renders BRAF active as a dimer with CRAF and itself (PMID: 26343582, 20179705). Preclinical studies with NIH3T3 and SK-MEL-239 cells expressing BRAF K601N demonstrated sensitivity to treatment with LY3009120 and PLX8394 as measured by reduced proliferation (PMID: 26732095, 30559419). In a Phase Ib trial, a patient with non-small cell lung cancer harboring BRAF K601N was treated with combination therapy of LTT462 and LXH 254 and demonstrated an unconfirmed partial response (Abstract: Wolf et al. Abstract# 1387p, Annals of Oncology 2020. https://www.annalsofoncology.org/article/S0923-7534%2820%2941697-7/fulltext). In a Phase II trial, two patients with non-small cell lung cancer harboring BRAF K601N were treated vemurafenib and did not clinically respond to treatment (PMID: 31959346).

var_description_zh: BRAF P367R突变发生在该基因的第8外显子。一项评估肺癌中罕见体细胞突变的影响的研究显示，与野生型相比，转染了BRAF p367R突变的细胞表现出ERK磷酸化的轻度增加（pMID:27478040）。
var_description: The BRAF P367R mutation occurs in exon 8 of the gene. A study evaluating the effects of rare somatic mutations in lung cancers showed that cells transfected with BRAF P367R mutation display a mild increase in ERK phophorylation compared to wildtype (PMID: 27478040).

var_description_zh: BRAF A 598_T599insv突变位于该蛋白的激酶结构域中。虽然该突变尚未进行功能表征，但携带该突变的黑色素瘤患者对达拉非尼和曲美替尼的联合治疗有部分反应（PMID:28800030）。
var_description: The BRAF A598_T599insV mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein. While this mutation has not been functionally characterized, a patient with melanoma harboring this mutation had a partial response to treatment with the combination of dabrafenib and trametinib (PMID: 28800030).

var_description_zh: II类BRAF L597R突变位于蛋白质的激酶结构域（PMID:33019809）。在黑色素瘤和其他癌症中发现了这种突变（PMID:26643848）。体外研究表明，与野生型（PMID:22798288）相比，通过增加的下游信号来测量，该突变可能被激活。在细胞系中的药效研究表明，BRAF L597R突变可能对RAF抑制剂维莫非尼和MEK抑制剂曲美替尼（PMID:22798288）敏感。在对曲美替尼和变构MEK抑制剂Tak-733（PMID:24933606）有阳性反应的患者中也发现了BRAF L597R突变。在一份病例报告中，一名携带BRAF L597R的黑色素瘤患者接受维莫非尼治疗，结果显示部分缓解，皮肤和肺结节生长抑制30%（PMID:23715574）。在另一份病例报告中，一名携带BRAF L597R的肺腺癌患者接受了达拉非尼和曲美替尼的联合治疗，并显示出部分缓解，无进展生存期为12个月（PMID:32540409）。在另一份病例报告中，一名携带BRAF L597R的结直肠癌患者接受了帕尼单抗联合FOLFIRI的联合治疗，结果显示病情稳定，无进展生存期为16.5个月（PMID:31515458）。
var_description: The class II BRAF L597R mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein (PMID: 33019809). This mutation has been found in melanoma, among other cancers (PMID: 26643848). In vitro studies have demonstrated that this mutation is likely activating as measured by increased downstream signaling compared to wildtype (PMID: 22798288). Drug efficacy studies in cell lines demonstrated that the BRAF L597R mutation might be sensitive to the RAF inhibitor vemurafenib and the MEK inhibitor trametinib (PMID: 22798288). The BRAF L597R mutation has also been identified in patients with positive responses to trametinib and the allosteric MEK inhibitor TAK-733 (PMID: 24933606). In a case report, a patient with melanoma harboring BRAF L597R was treated with vemurafenib and demonstrated partial response with 30% growth inhibition of skin and lung nodules (PMID: 23715574). In another case report, a patient with lung adenocarcinoma harboring BRAF L597R was treated with a combination therapy of dabrafenib and trametinib and demonstrated partial response with a progression-free survival of twelve months (PMID: 32540409). In another case report, a patient with colorectal cancer harboring BRAF L597R was treated with a combination therapy of panitumumab plus FOLFIRI and demonstrated stable disease with a progression-free survival of 16.5 months (PMID: 31515458).

var_description_zh: PCBP2-BRAF融合源于PCBP2基因的3 '末端与BRAF基因的5 '末端的融合。虽然这种改变本身还没有被功能表征，但许多其他BRAF融合已被证明是致癌的，这表明PCBP2-BRAF融合可能是致癌的（PMID:24345920，21424530，22745804，21424530，18974108，26343582）。在一项对服用奥西替尼进展的非小细胞肺癌患者的研究中，一名患者携带PCBP2-BRAF融合（PMID:30257958）。在从该患者产生的细胞系中敲低BRAF导致细胞生长减少和对奥西替尼的再敏感（PMID:30257958）。虽然这些细胞对BRAF抑制剂达拉非尼和LXH245不敏感，但它们对MEK抑制剂曲美替尼（PMID:30257958）敏感。
var_description: The PCBP2-BRAF fusion results from the fusion of the 3' end of the PCBP2 gene with the 5' end of the BRAF gene. While this alteration has not been functionally characterized per se, many other BRAF fusions have been shown to be oncogenic suggesting that the PCBP2-BRAF fusion is likely oncogenic (PMID: 24345920, 21424530, 22745804, 21424530, 18974108, 26343582). In a study of patients with non-small cell lung cancer who progressed on osimertinib, one patient harbored the PCBP2-BRAF fusion (PMID: 30257958). Knockdown of BRAF in a cell line created from this patient led to a reduction of cell growth and resensitization to osimertinib (PMID: 30257958). While these cells were insensitive to the BRAF inhibitors dabrafenib and LXH245, they were sensitive to the MEK inhibitor trametinib (PMID: 30257958).
