var_description_zh: III类BRAF G596V突变位于蛋白外显子15的激酶结构域（PMID:33198372）。该突变已在心脏-面部-皮肤综合征中发现（PMID:16439621）。该突变体在HEK293T细胞中的表达表明其具有受损的激酶活性，并且在本文中不能诱导下游MEK和ERK活化（PMID:16439621）。然而，当在斑马鱼胚胎中表达时，G596V突变导致与BRAF V600E相同的异常延伸表型，这表明它可能在体内发育过程中以类似于BRAF激活突变体的方式发挥作用（PMID:19376813）。在一项II期试验中，一名携带BRAF G596V的非小细胞肺癌患者接受了维莫非尼治疗，并显示出部分缓解（PMID:26200454）。
var_description: The class III BRAF G596V mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 15 of the protein (PMID: 33198372). This mutation has been found in cardio-facio-cutaneous syndrome (PMID: 16439621). Expression of this mutant in HEK293T cells demonstrated it has impaired kinase activity and is not able to induce downstream MEK and ERK activation in this context (PMID: 16439621). However, when expressed in zebrafish embryos, the G596V mutation causes the same aberrant elongation phenotype as BRAF V600E, suggesting that it might function in a manner similar to BRAF activating mutants during development in vivo (PMID: 19376813). In a Phase II trial, a patient with non-small cell lung cancer harboring BRAF G596V was treated with vemurafenib and demonstrated a partial response (PMID: 26200454).

var_description_zh: III类BRAF N581S突变位于蛋白外显子15的激酶结构域（PMID:28783719）。该突变在肺癌、结直肠癌和黑色素瘤中已有报道（PMID:26498038）。BRAF N581S突变的生物学特征已经证明，它在MAPK途径的激活中是Ras依赖性的，与CRAF作为二聚体发出信号，并且通常与放大Ras信号的另一驱动机制共同发生（PMID:15035987，28783719）。因此，在黑色素瘤中，与其他III类BRAF突变体相似的N581S变体预计将与激活Ras突变或NF1失活同时发生，而在非小细胞肺癌或结肠直肠癌中，该突变很可能与蛋白水平的受体酪氨酸激酶（RTK）过度激活有关（PMID:28783719）。用表达BRAF N581S的患者来源的肺腺癌细胞进行的临床前研究表明，PF-477736加PF3644022的联合治疗对细胞凋亡增加（PMID:26140595）具有敏感性。在一项II期试验中，两名携带BRAF N581S的肺腺癌和妇科癌症患者接受了曲美替尼治疗，分别表现为疾病进展和疾病稳定（PMID:31924734）。在一份病例报告中，一名携带BRAF N581S的转移性结直肠癌患者接受了西妥昔单抗联合FOLFIRI的联合治疗，并显示出部分缓解，无进展生存期为16个月（PMID:31515458）。在另一项II期临床试验中，两名携带突变的晚期实体瘤患者接受了维莫非尼治疗，但未出现临床治疗反应（PMID:29320312）。
var_description: The class III BRAF N581S mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 15 of the protein (PMID:28783719). This mutation has been reported in lung cancer, colorectal cancer and melanoma (PMID: 26498038). Biological characterization of the BRAF N581S mutation has demonstrated that it is RAS dependent in its activation of the MAPK pathway, signals as a dimer with CRAF, and typically co-occurs with another driver mechanism that amplifies RAS signaling (PMID: 15035987, 28783719). Thus, in melanoma, the N581S variant, similar to other class III BRAF mutants, would be expected to co-occur with activating RAS mutation or NF1 inactivation, whereas in non-small cell lung or colorectal cancers, this mutation would most likely be associated with receptor tyrosine kinase (RTK) hyperactivation at the protein level (PMID: 28783719).  Preclinical studies with patient-derived lung adenocarcinoma cells expressing BRAF N581S demonstrated sensitivity to treatment with a combination therapy of PF-477736 plus PF3644022 as measured by increased apoptosis (PMID: 26140595). In a Phase II trial, two patients with lung adenocarcinoma and gynecologic cancer harboring BRAF N581S were treated with trametinib and demonstrated progressive disease and stable disease, respectively (PMID: 31924734). In a case report, a patient with metastatic colorectal cancer harboring BRAF N581S was treated with a combination therapy of cetuximab plus FOLFIRI and demonstrated partial response with a progression-free survival of sixteen months (PMID: 31515458). In another Phase II trial, two patients with advanced solid tumors harboring the mutation were treated with vemurafenib and did not clinically respond to treatment (PMID: 29320312).

var_description_zh: BRAF T599DUP突变位于蛋白外显子15的激酶结构域。该突变已在黑色素瘤和毛细胞性星形细胞瘤中发现（PMID:19363522，21190184，29456854）。该突变在HEK293、NIH-3T3或MCF-10A细胞中的表达证明该突变是激活的，如通过激酶活性、锚定非依赖性生长和与BRAF V600E相当的接触抑制的变化所测量的（PMID:19363522，21190184，23833300）。在一份病例报告中，4名携带BRAF T599DUP的转移性黑色素瘤患者接受了达拉非尼和曲美替尼的联合治疗，并显示出部分缓解（PMID:353 19964）。另一名携带BRAF T599DUP的转移性黑色素瘤患者接受了比尼替尼和恩可拉非尼的联合治疗，并显示出部分缓解和至少9个月的无进展生存期（PMID:353 19964）。另外两名携带BRAF T599DUP的转移性黑色素瘤患者接受了维莫非尼治疗，并表现出疾病进展（PMID:353 19964）。在另一份病例报告中，一名转移性结直肠癌患者接受了帕尼单抗联合FOLFOX的联合治疗，并表现出疾病进展（PMID:31515458）。
var_description: The BRAF T599dup mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 15 of the protein. This mutation has been found in melanoma and pilocytic astrocytoma (PMID: 19363522, 21190184, 29456854). Expression of this mutation in HEK293, NIH-3T3 or MCF-10A cells demonstrated that this mutation is activating as measured by kinase activity, anchorage-independent growth and changes in contact inhibition comparable to BRAF V600E (PMID: 19363522, 21190184, 23833300). In a case report, four patients with metastatic melanoma harboring BRAF T599dup were treated with a combination therapy of dabrafenib plus trametinib and demonstrated partial response (PMID: 35319964). Another patient with metastatic melanoma harboring BRAF T599dup was treated with a combination therapy of binimetinib plus encorafenib and demonstrated a partial response and a progression-free survival of at least nine months (PMID: 35319964). Two other patients with metastatic melanoma harboring BRAF T599dup were treated with vemurafenib and demonstrated progressive disease (PMID: 35319964). In another case report, a patient with metastatic colorectal cancer was treated with a combination therapy of panitumumab plus FOLFOX and demonstrated progressive disease (PMID: 31515458).

var_description_zh: BRAF R682W突变位于该蛋白的激酶结构域。该突变已在肺腺癌中鉴定（PMID:22980975）。用表达BRAF R682W和EGFR外显子19框内缺失突变的PC9细胞进行的临床前研究表明，通过治疗后持续的细胞活力（PMID:27478040）测量，该突变对厄洛替尼治疗具有抗性。
var_description: The BRAF R682W mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein. This mutation has been identified in lung adenocarcinoma (PMID: 22980975). Preclinical studies with PC9 cells expressing BRAF R682W and EGFR exon 19 in-frame deletion mutations demonstrated that the mutation is resistant to treatment with erlotinib as measured by sustained cellular viability following treatment (PMID: 27478040).

var_description_zh: BRAF W604C突变位于蛋白质的激酶结构域。该突变已在黑色素瘤中鉴定（PMID:28467829）。一名携带BRAF W604C和BRAF G469A的肺腺癌患者接受了达拉非尼联合曲美替尼治疗，尽管其本身没有功能特征，但病情稳定，无进展生存期为15个月（PMID:30926357）。
var_description: The BRAF W604C mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein. This mutation has been identified in melanoma (PMID: 28467829). Although not functionally characterized per se, a patient with lung adenocarcinoma harboring BRAF W604C and BRAF G469A was treated with dabrafenib plus trametinib and demonstrated stable disease with a progression-free survival of fifteen months (PMID: 30926357).

var_description_zh: BRAF T529M突变位于蛋白外显子13的激酶结构域。这种改变被认为是一种看门人突变，因为已知其他激酶中类似残基的突变会导致对结合在ATP结合口袋中的药物产生耐药性（PMID:15573099）。该突变在COS7细胞中的表达表明，通过与野生型BRAF（PMID:20538618）相当的激酶活性测量，它可能是中性的。然而，BRAF V600E在COS7细胞中的表达表明，该突变赋予对RAF抑制剂如维莫非尼的抗性，但保持对MEK抑制剂的敏感性（PMID:20538618）。
var_description: The BRAF T529M mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 13 of the protein. This alteration is considered a gatekeeper mutation as mutations at the analogous residue in other kinases are known to cause resistance to drugs that bind in the ATP-binding pocket (PMID: 15573099). Expression of this mutation in COS7 cells demonstrated it is likely neutral as measured by kinase activity comparable to wildtype BRAF (PMID: 20538618). However, expression with BRAF V600E in COS7 cells demonstrated that this mutation confers resistance to RAF inhibitors such as vemurafenib, but maintains sensitivity to MEK inhibitors (PMID: 20538618).

var_description_zh: BRAF N 486_V487del突变位于该蛋白外显子11的激酶结构域。该突变在人细胞系中的表达表明，通过与野生型相比适度增加的激酶活性（PMID:26996308）来测量，它可能是激活的。
var_description: The BRAF N486_V487del mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 11 of the protein. Expression of this mutation in a human cell line demonstrated that it is likely activating as measured by modestly increased kinase activity compared to wildtype (PMID: 26996308).

var_description_zh: BRAF V 487_p490del突变位于该蛋白外显子11的激酶结构域。该突变在人细胞系中的表达表明，与野生型（PMID:26996308）相比，通过增加的激酶活性来测量，它可能是激活的。
var_description: The BRAF V487_P490del mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 11 of the protein. Expression of this mutation in a human cell line demonstrated that it is likely activating as measured by increased kinase activity compared to wildtype (PMID: 26996308).

var_description_zh: FAM131B-BRAF融合是7号染色体上2.5Mb缺失的结果，其将FAM131B基因的前两个外显子与BRAF基因的外显子9-18融合（PMID:21424530）。该融合包含BRAF激酶结构域，但不包括负责Ras结合和自动抑制的BRAF CR1结构域（PMID:15630448）。在毛细胞型星形细胞瘤和儿童低级别胶质瘤中发现了FAM131B-BRAF融合（PMID:21424530，25040262）。与野生型BRAF（pMID:21424530）相比，该突变在NIH-3T3细胞中的表达表明其被激活，如通过增加的下游MEK磷酸化和降低的接触抑制所测量的。用小鼠和表达FAM131B-BRAF的NIH3T3细胞进行的临床前研究证明了曲美替尼治疗的敏感性，如通过抑制的肿瘤生长和不依赖于贴壁的生长所测量的；然而，在长期治疗后观察到获得性抗性（PMID:29156677）。FAM131B-BRAF被认为通过增强PI3K/Akt/mTOR通路信号传导以克服MEK抑制来获得对MEK抑制剂司美替尼、比美替尼和曲美替尼的耐药性（PMID:29156677）。在表达FAM131B-BRAF的小鼠中，mTOR抑制剂依维莫司与曲美替尼的联合治疗延长了肿瘤抑制并延迟了获得性耐药（PMID:29156677）。
var_description: The FAM131B-BRAF fusion is the result of a 2.5 Mb deletion on chromosome 7 which fuses the first two exons of the FAM131B gene with exons 9-18 of the BRAF gene (PMID: 21424530). This fusion contains the BRAF kinase domain, but excludes the BRAF CR1 domain responsible for RAS binding and auto-inhibition (PMID:15630448). The FAM131B-BRAF fusion has been found in pilocytic astrocytomas and pediatric low-grade gliomas (PMID: 21424530, 25040262). Expression of this mutation in NIH-3T3 cells demonstrated that it is activating, as measured by increased downstream MEK phosphorylation and decreased contact inhibition compared to wildtype BRAF (PMID: 21424530). Preclinical studies with mice and NIH3T3 cells expressing FAM131B-BRAF demonstrate sensitivity to treatment with trametinib as measured by suppressed tumor growth and anchorage-independent growth; however, acquired resistance was observed following prolonged treatment (PMID: 29156677). FAM131B-BRAF is suggested to acquire resistance against MEK inhibitors selumetinib, binimetinib and trametinib through enhancing PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway signaling to overcome MEK inhibition (PMID: 29156677). Combination treatment of mTOR inhibitor everolimus with trametinib in mice expressing FAM131B-BRAF prolonged tumor suppression and delayed acquired resistance (PMID: 29156677).

var_description_zh: BRAF S122Y突变位于蛋白质的SBC基序中。该突变已在骨肉瘤中鉴定（PMID:28481359）。用表达BRAF S122Y的293T细胞进行的体外研究表明，与野生型（PMID:36585710）相比，通过减少的SPOP介导的泛素化和增加的MAPK/ERK级联激活，突变被激活。
var_description: The BRAF S122Y mutation is located in the SBC motif of the protein. This mutation has been identified in osteosarcoma (PMID: 28481359). In vitro studies with 293T cells expressing BRAF S122Y demonstrate that the mutation is activating as measured by reduced SPOP-mediated ubiquitination and increased MAPK/ERK cascade activation compared to wildtype (PMID: 36585710).

var_description_zh: II类BRAF G469V突变位于蛋白外显子11的激酶结构域（PMID:28783719，26343582）。该突变在非小细胞肺癌和膀胱癌中已有报道（PMID:25870796，27388325，23401075）。BRAF G469V突变的生物学特征表明，它独立于Ras激活下游MAPK途径，并使BRAF作为与CRAF和其自身的二聚体具有活性（PMID:26343582，28783719，20179705）。用表达BRAF G469V的SKBR3细胞进行的临床前研究证明了对维莫非尼治疗的抗性，如通过治疗后持续的MEK和ERK激活所测量的（PMID:26343582）。在一份病例报告中，两名携带BRAF G469V的转移性结直肠癌患者接受了帕尼单抗联合FOLFOX或西妥昔单抗联合伊立替康治疗，两种治疗方案均显示部分缓解，无进展生存期分别为18.9个月和10.9个月（PMID:31515458）。在另一个病例报告中，一名携带BRAF G469V的肺腺癌患者接受了曲美替尼和达拉非尼的联合治疗，并在治疗9周后出现进展（PMID:32540409）。在另一份病例报告中，一名携带BRAF G469V的肝细胞癌和非小细胞肺癌患者接受了索拉非尼治疗，结果显示肺部完全缓解且肝细胞癌稳定（PMID:27388325）。
var_description: The class II BRAF G469V mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 11 of the protein (PMID: 28783719, 26343582). This mutation has been reported in non-small cell lung cancer and bladder cancer (PMID: 25870796, 27388325, 23401075). Biological characterization of the BRAF G469V mutation demonstrated that it activates the downstream MAPK pathway independently of RAS and renders BRAF active as a dimer with CRAF and itself (PMID: 26343582, 28783719, 20179705). Preclinical studies with SKBR3 cells expressing BRAF G469V demonstrated resistance to treatment with vemurafenib as measured by persistent MEK and ERK activation following treatment (PMID: 26343582). In a case report, two patients with metastatic colorectal cancer harboring BRAF G469V were treated with either panitumumab plus FOLFOX or cetuximab plus irinotecan and both treatment options demonstrated partial response with a progression-free survival of 18.9 months and 10.9 months, respectively (PMID: 31515458). In another case report, a patient with lung adenocarcinoma harboring BRAF G469V was treated with combination therapy of trametinib and dabrafenib and progressed after nine weeks of treatment (PMID: 32540409). In another case report, a patient with hepatocellular carcinoma and non-small cell lung cancer harboring BRAF G469V was treated with sorafenib and demonstrated a complete response in the lung and stability of the hepatocellular carcinoma (PMID: 27388325).

var_description_zh: II类BRAF G464E突变位于蛋白外显子11的激酶结构域（PMID:28783719，26343582）。该突变在结直肠癌中已有报道（PMID:15150094）。BRAF G464E突变的生物学特征表明其激活不依赖于Ras的下游MAPK途径，并使BRAF作为与CRAF的二聚体具有活性（PMID:15035987，23680146，15150094，26343582，20179705，16364920）。用表达BRAF G464E的癌细胞系进行的临床前研究证明了对维莫非尼的抗性，如通过治疗后延长的ERK信号传导所测量的（PMID:26343582，28783719，26343582）。一名携带BRAF G464E的梭形细胞癌患者接受曲美替尼治疗后病情稳定，无进展生存期为6.9个月（PMID:31924734）。
var_description: The class II BRAF G464E mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 11 of the protein (PMID: 28783719, 26343582). This mutation has been reported in colorectal cancer (PMID: 15150094). Biological characterization of the BRAF G464E mutation demonstrated it activates the downstream MAPK pathway independent of RAS and renders BRAF active as a dimer with CRAF (PMID: 15035987, 23680146, 15150094, 26343582, 20179705, 16364920). Preclinical studies with cancer cell lines expressing BRAF G464E demonstrate resistance to vemurafenib as measured by prolonged ERK signaling following treatment (PMID: 26343582, 28783719, 26343582). A patient with spindle cell carcinoma harboring BRAF G464E treated with trametinib resulted in stable disease with a progression-free survival of 6.9 months (PMID: 31924734).

var_description_zh: II类BRAF R462I突变位于蛋白外显子11的激酶结构域（PMID:35050937）。该突变已在结直肠癌中发现（PMID:15150094）。该突变在NIH-3T3或IEC-6细胞中的表达证明该突变是中性的，如通过激酶活性、焦点形成和细胞增殖所测量的，与野生型BRAF相当（PMID:15150094，15035987）。此外，该突变在HRAS G12V中的表达未能激活MAPK途径，无论是作为单体还是作为CRAF的二聚体，这表明它没有被激活（PMID:15150094）。
var_description: The class II BRAF R462I mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 11 of the protein (PMID: 35050937). This mutation has been found in colorectal cancer (PMID: 15150094). Expression of this mutation in NIH-3T3 or IEC-6 cells demonstrated that this mutation is neutral as measured by kinase activity, foci-formation and cell proliferation comparable to wildtype BRAF (PMID: 15150094, 15035987). Additionally, expression of this mutation with HRAS G12V failed to activate the MAPK pathway either as a monomer or a dimer with CRAF, suggesting it is not activating (PMID: 15150094).

var_description_zh: BRAF N 486_T491delinsk突变位于该蛋白的激酶结构域。该突变已在组织细胞肿瘤中发现（PMID:30867592）。该突变在BA/F3细胞中的表达表明，与野生型BRAF（PMID:30867592）相比，该突变在体外通过增加的下游ERK信号传导、细胞因子非依赖性生长和MEK1/2抑制剂敏感性而被激活。一名携带BRAF N 486_T491delinsk突变的组织细胞病患者对MEK1/2抑制剂考比替尼（PMID:30867592）治疗完全应答。
var_description: The BRAF N486_T491delinsK mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in histiocytic neoplasms (PMID: 30867592). Expression of this mutation in Ba/F3 cells demonstrates that it is activating as measured by increased downstream ERK signaling, cytokine-independent growth, and MEK1/2-inhibitor sensitivity in vitro compared to wildtype BRAF (PMID: 30867592). A patient with histiocytic disease harboring the BRAF N486_T491delinsK mutation had a complete response to treatment with the MEK1/2 inhibitor cobimetinib (PMID: 30867592).

var_description_zh: BRAF A712T突变位于该蛋白的激酶结构域。该突变已在结直肠癌中鉴定（PMID:27149842）。用BA/F3细胞和表达BRAF A712T的MCF10A细胞进行的体外研究表明，如通过与野生型（PMID:29533785）相当的细胞增殖和生存力所测量的，突变可能是中性的。
var_description: The BRAF A712T mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein. This mutation has been identified in colorectal cancer (PMID: 27149842). In vitro studies with Ba/F3 cells and MCF10A cells expressing BRAF A712T demonstrate that the mutation is likely neutral as measured by cell proliferation and viability comparable to wildtype (PMID: 29533785).

var_description_zh: BRAF R509H突变位于蛋白外显子13的激酶结构域。该突变位于蛋白质的二聚体界面。该突变在293H细胞中的表达表明其失活，如蛋白质二聚化减少和下游细胞信号传导减少所示（PMID:20179705）。
var_description: The BRAF R509H mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 13 of the protein. This mutation lies along the dimer interface of the protein. Expression of this mutation in 293H cells demonstrated that it is inactivating, as shown by decreased protein dimerization and decreased downstream cell signaling (PMID: 20179705).

var_description_zh: BRAF L64I突变位于蛋白质的N末端。用BA/F3细胞和表达BRAF L64I的MCF10A细胞进行的体外研究表明，如通过与野生型（PMID:29533785）相当的细胞增殖和生存力所测量的，突变可能是中性的。
var_description: The BRAF L64I mutation is located in the N-terminus of the protein. In vitro studies with Ba/F3 cells and MCF10A cells expressing BRAF L64I demonstrate that the mutation is likely neutral as measured by cell proliferation and viability comparable to wildtype (PMID: 29533785).

var_description_zh: II类BRAF I463S突变位于蛋白外显子11的激酶结构域（PMID:33019809）。该突变已在结直肠癌中发现（PMID:15150094）。该突变在NIH-3T3或IEC-6细胞中的表达证明其可能是中性的，如通过激酶活性、焦点形成和细胞增殖所测量的，与野生型BRAF相当（PMID:15150094，15035987）。此外，BRAF I463S与HRAS G12V的表达不会导致MAPK途径激活的增加，无论是单独作为单体还是通过与CRAF的二聚化（PMID:15150094）。
var_description: The class II BRAF I463S mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 11 of the protein (PMID: 33019809). This mutation has been found in colorectal cancer (PMID: 15150094). Expression of this mutation in NIH-3T3 or IEC-6 cells demonstrated that it is likely neutral, as measured by kinase activity, foci formation, and cell proliferation comparable to wildtype BRAF (PMID: 15150094, 15035987). Additionally, expression of BRAF I463S with HRAS G12V does not lead to increased MAPK pathway activation either alone as a monomer or through dimerization with CRAF (PMID: 15150094).

var_description_zh: BRAF E648Q突变位于该蛋白的激酶结构域。用表达BRAF E648Q的MCF10A细胞进行的体外研究表明，通过与野生型（PMID:29533785）相比降低的细胞增殖和生存力来测量，该突变是失活的。
var_description: The BRAF E648Q mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein. In vitro studies with MCF10A cells expressing BRAF E648Q demonstrate that the mutation is inactivating as measured by decreased cell proliferation and viability comparable to wildtype (PMID: 29533785).

var_description_zh: BRAF S616Y突变位于该蛋白的激酶结构域。一名携带BRAF S616Y的鳞状细胞癌患者接受了纳武单抗治疗，并显示出完全缓解（PMID:34963703），尽管该患者本身没有功能特征。
var_description: The BRAF S616Y mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein. Although not functionally characterized per se, a patient with squamous cell carcinoma harboring BRAF S616Y was treated with nivolumab and demonstrated a complete response (PMID: 34963703).

var_description_zh: III类BRAF D594H错义突变发生在该蛋白（PMID:28783719）外显子15的激酶结构域中。该突变在黑色素瘤、肺癌和结肠直肠癌中已有报道（PMID:28481359）。BRAF D594H突变的生物学特征表明，它在MAPK途径的激活中是Ras依赖性的，与CRAF作为二聚体发出信号，并且通常与另一种放大Ras信号的驱动机制共同发生（PMID:28783719）。因此，当在黑色素瘤中观察到BRAF D594H时，它通常与活化Ras突变或NF1失活同时发生，而当在非小细胞肺癌或结肠直肠癌中观察到时，它与蛋白水平的受体酪氨酸激酶（RTK）过度活化有关（PMID:28783719，20141835）。虽然该突变对靶向抑制剂如曲美替尼的MEK抑制敏感，但对RAF单体抑制剂如维莫非尼（PMID:28783719）不敏感。
var_description: The class III BRAF D594H missense mutation occurs in the kinase domain in exon 15 of the protein (PMID: 28783719). This mutation has been reported in melanoma, lung and colorectal cancers (PMID: 28481359). Biological characterization of the BRAF D594H mutation has demonstrated that it is RAS dependent in its activation of the MAPK pathway, signals as a dimer with CRAF, and typically co-occurs with another driver mechanism that amplifies RAS signaling (PMID: 28783719). Thus, when BRAF D594H is observed in melanoma, it typically co-occurs with an activating RAS mutation or NF1 inactivation, whereas when observed in non-small cell lung or colorectal cancers, it is associated with receptor tyrosine kinase (RTK) hyperactivation at the protein level (PMID: 28783719, 20141835). While this mutation is sensitive to MEK inhibition by targeted inhibitors such as trametinib, it is insensitive to RAF monomer inhibitors such as vemurafenib (PMID: 28783719).

var_description_zh: BRAF K205Q突变位于该蛋白的RBD结构域。该突变已在结直肠癌中鉴定（PMID:22810696）。用BA/F3细胞和表达BRAF K205Q的MCF10A细胞进行的体外研究表明，通过与野生型（PMID:29533785）相比的细胞增殖和生存力测量，突变可能是中性的。
var_description: The BRAF K205Q mutation is located in the RBD domain of the protein. This mutation has been identified in colorectal cancer (PMID: 22810696). In vitro studies with Ba/F3 cells and MCF10A cells expressing BRAF K205Q demonstrate that the mutation is likely neutral as measured by cell proliferation and viability comparable to wildtype (PMID: 29533785).

var_description_zh: BRAF M117L突变位于蛋白质的未知功能域。该突变已在肺腺癌中鉴定（PMID:28481359）。一名携带BRAF M117L的肺腺癌患者接受了易普利姆玛（伊匹单抗）联合纳武单抗（纳武单抗）治疗，病情稳定（PMID:34963703）。
var_description: The BRAF M117L mutation is located in an unknown functional domain of the protein. This mutation has been identified in lung adenocarcinoma (PMID: 28481359). Although not functionally characterized per se, a patient with lung adenocarcinoma harboring BRAF M117L was treated with ipilimumab plus nivolumab and demonstrated stable disease (PMID: 34963703).

var_description_zh: II类BRAF G464V突变位于蛋白外显子11的激酶结构域（PMID:28783719，26343582）。该突变已在黑色素瘤、结肠直肠癌和乳腺癌中报道（PMID:15035987，15150094，17314276）。BRAF G464V突变的生物学特征表明其激活不依赖于Ras的下游MAPK途径，并使BRAF作为与CRAF的二聚体具有活性（PMID:15035987，12068308，15150094，26343582，20179705）。用表达BRAF G464V的KRAS突变HEK293细胞进行的临床前研究证明了用RAF抑制剂CMPD A治疗的敏感性，如通过降低的磷酸化ERK水平所测量的（PMID:23680146）。一名携带BRAF G464V的肺腺癌患者接受曲美替尼治疗后无反应，并表现出疾病进展（PMID:31924734）。两名携带BRAF G464V的晚期实体瘤患者接受了维莫非尼治疗，但对治疗没有客观反应（PMID:29320312）。
var_description: The class II BRAF G464V mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 11 of the protein (PMID: 28783719, 26343582). This mutation has been reported in melanoma, colorectal cancer and breast cancer (PMID: 15035987, 15150094, 17314276). Biological characterization of the BRAF G464V mutation demonstrated it activates the downstream MAPK pathway independent of RAS and renders BRAF active as a dimer with CRAF (PMID:  15035987, 12068308, 15150094, 26343582, 20179705). Preclinical studies with KRAS-mutant HEK293 cells expressing BRAF G464V demonstrated sensitivity to treatment with RAF inhibitor Cmpd A as measured by reduced phosphorylated ERK levels (PMID: 23680146). A patient with lung adenocarcinoma harboring BRAF G464V treated with trametinib did not respond to treatment and demonstrated progressive disease (PMID: 31924734). Two patients with advanced solid tumors harboring BRAF G464V were treated with vemurafenib and did not have an objective response to treatment (PMID: 29320312).

var_description_zh: BRAF T529N突变位于蛋白外显子13的激酶结构域。这种改变被认为是一种看门人突变，因为已知其他激酶中类似残基的突变会导致对结合在ATP结合口袋中的药物产生耐药性（PMID:15573099）。该突变在COS7细胞中的表达表明，通过与野生型BRAF（PMID:20538618）相当的激酶活性测量，它可能是中性的。然而，BRAF V600E在COS7细胞中的表达表明，该突变赋予对RAF抑制剂如维莫非尼的抗性，但保持对MEK抑制剂的敏感性（PMID:20538618）。
var_description: The BRAF T529N mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 13 of the protein. This alteration is considered a gatekeeper mutation as mutations at the analogous residue in other kinases are known to cause resistance to drugs that bind in the ATP-binding pocket (PMID: 15573099). Expression of this mutation in COS7 cells demonstrated it is likely neutral as measured by kinase activity comparable to wildtype BRAF (PMID: 20538618). However, expression with BRAF V600E in COS7 cells demonstrated that this mutation confers resistance to RAF inhibitors such as vemurafenib, but maintains sensitivity to MEK inhibitors (PMID: 20538618).

var_description_zh: BRAF A 489_p490del突变位于该蛋白外显子11的激酶结构域。该突变在人细胞系中的表达表明，通过与野生型相比适度增加的激酶活性（PMID:26996308）来测量，它可能是激活的。
var_description: The BRAF A489_P490del mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 11 of the protein. Expression of this mutation in a human cell line demonstrated that it is likely activating as measured by modestly increased kinase activity compared to wildtype (PMID: 26996308).

var_description_zh: III类BRAF G596S突变位于蛋白质的激酶结构域中，并且是统计学上显著的热点（PMID:33198372）。用表达BRAF G596S的BA/F3细胞进行的体外研究表明，通过与野生型相比增加的转化能力（PMID:29533785）来测量，该突变是激活的。计算机分析表明BRAF G596S对维莫非尼耐药（PMID:35215249）。
var_description: The class III BRAF G596S mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein and is a statistically significant hotspot (PMID: 33198372). In vitro studies with Ba/F3 cells expressing BRAF G596S demonstrate that the mutation is activating as measured by increased transformation ability compared to wildtype (PMID: 29533785). In silico analysis suggests that BRAF G596S is resistant to vemurafenib (PMID: 35215249).

var_description_zh: III类BRAF D594N突变发生在蛋白外显子15的激酶结构域中（PMID:28783719）。该突变已在非小细胞肺癌和黑色素瘤中发现（PMID:22798288，23833300，26498038，28783719，28947956）。BRAF D594N突变的生物学特征已经证明，它在MAPK途径的激活中是Ras依赖性的，与CRAF作为二聚体发出信号，并且通常与另一种放大Ras信号的驱动机制共同发生（PMID:28783719，26498038）。因此，当在黑色素瘤中观察到BRAF D594N时，它通常与活化Ras突变或NF1失活同时发生，而当在非小细胞肺癌或结肠直肠癌中观察到时，它与蛋白水平的受体酪氨酸激酶（RTK）过度活化有关（PMID:28783719）。虽然该突变对靶向抑制剂如曲美替尼的MEK抑制敏感，但对RAF单体抑制剂如维莫非尼（PMID:28783719）不敏感。在一份病例报告中，一名EGFR阳性、Met扩增的非小细胞肺癌患者在接受奥西替尼联合克唑替尼（PMID:36136993）联合治疗后，获得了BRAF D594N继发性耐药突变。患者对奥西替尼联合曲美替尼（PMID:36136993）的联合治疗有临床反应。
var_description: The class III BRAF D594N mutation occurs in the kinase domain in exon 15 of the protein (PMID: 28783719). This mutation has been found in non-small cell lung cancer and melanoma (PMID: 22798288, 23833300, 26498038, 28783719, 28947956). Biological characterization of the BRAF D594N mutation has demonstrated that it is RAS dependent in its activation of the MAPK pathway, signals as a dimer with CRAF, and typically co-occurs with another driver mechanism that amplifies RAS signaling (PMID: 28783719, 26498038). Thus, when BRAF D594N is observed in melanoma, it typically co-occurs with an activating RAS mutation or NF1 inactivation, whereas when observed in non-small cell lung or colorectal cancers, it is associated with receptor tyrosine kinase (RTK) hyperactivation at the protein level (PMID: 28783719). While this mutation is sensitive to MEK inhibition by targeted inhibitors such as trametinib, it is insensitive to RAF monomer inhibitors such as vemurafenib (PMID: 28783719). In a case report, a patient with EGFR-positive, MET-amplified non-small cell lung cancer acquired BRAF D594N as a secondary resistance mutation in response to combination treatment with osimertinib plus crizotinib (PMID: 36136993). The patient demonstrated clinical response to combination treatment with osimertinib plus trametinib (PMID: 36136993).

var_description_zh: BRAF L613F突变位于蛋白的锌指结构域。用表达BRAF L613F的MCF10A细胞进行的体外研究表明，通过与野生型相比增加的转化能力（PMID:29533785）来测量，突变是激活的。
var_description: The BRAF L613F mutation is located in the zinc finger domain of the protein. In vitro studies with MCF10A cells expressing BRAF L613F demonstrate that the mutation is activating as measured by increased transformation ability compared to wildtype (PMID: 29533785).

var_description_zh: III类BRAF N581Y突变位于外显子13中BRAF的激酶结构域（PMID:30224342）。这种非经典BRAF突变已在结肠直肠细胞系筛选和黑色素瘤患者中鉴定（PMID:19474002，26084293）。用表达BRAF N581Y的BA/F3细胞进行的体外研究表明，通过与野生型相比增加的细胞活力（PMID:32540409）来测量，该突变被激活。携带该突变的HT-55结肠癌细胞系对用GDC-0879 Raf激酶抑制剂（PMID:19276360）处理不敏感。
var_description: The class III BRAF N581Y mutation is located in the kinase domain of BRAF in exon 13 (PMID: 30224342). This noncanonical BRAF mutation has been identified in a screen of colorectal cell lines and in a patient with melanoma (PMID: 19474002, 26084293). In vitro studies with Ba/F3 cells expressing BRAF N581Y demonstrate that the mutation is activating as measured by increased cell viability compared to wildtype (PMID: 32540409). The HT-55 colon cancer cell line harboring this mutation was insensitive to treatment with the GDC-0879 RAF kinase inhibitor (PMID: 19276360).

var_description_zh: BRAF R271H突变位于蛋白的锌指结构域。该突变已在前列腺癌中鉴定（PMID:28825054）。用表达BRAF R271H的BA/F3和MCF10A细胞进行的体外研究表明，通过与野生型（PMID:29533785）相比的细胞增殖和生存力测量，该突变可能是中性的。
var_description: The BRAF R271H mutation is located in the zinc-finger domain of the protein. This mutation has been identified in prostate cancer (PMID: 28825054). In vitro studies with Ba/F3 and MCF10A cells expressing BRAF R271H demonstrate that the mutation is likely neutral as measured by cellular proliferation and viability comparable to wildtype (PMID: 29533785).

var_description_zh: BRAF N 486_T488del突变位于该蛋白外显子11的激酶结构域。该突变已在非小细胞肺癌中得到鉴定（PMID:36200799）。该突变在人细胞系中的表达表明，通过与野生型相比增加的激酶活性（PMID:26996308）来测量，它可能是激活的。
var_description: The BRAF N486_T488del mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 11 of the protein. This mutation has been identified in non-small cell lung cancer (PMID: 36200799). Expression of this mutation in a human cell line demonstrated that it is likely activating as measured by increased kinase activity compared to wildtype (PMID: 26996308).

var_description_zh: BRAF G606W突变位于该蛋白的激酶结构域。该突变已在肺腺癌中鉴定（PMID:28481359）。用表达BRAF G606W的MCF10A细胞进行的体外研究表明，通过与野生型相比降低的转化能力（PMID:29533785）来测量，该突变是失活的。
var_description: The BRAF G606W mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein. This mutation has been identified in lung adenocarcinoma (PMID: 28481359). In vitro studies with MCF10A cells expressing BRAF G606W demonstrate that the mutation is inactivating as measured by decreased transformation ability compared to wildtype (PMID: 29533785).

var_description_zh: BRAF A246P突变位于蛋白外显子6的富含半胱氨酸区域。该突变见于心脏-面部-皮肤（CFC）综合征（PMID:16474404）。BRAF A246P在同时表达ERK依赖性荧光素酶构建体的NIH-3T3细胞中的表达表明该突变是激活的，如通过与野生型BRAF（PMID:16474404）相比增加的荧光素酶活性所测量的。用BRAF A246P进行的单分子结合试验也证明，通过与野生型相比增加的Ras结合亲和力（PMID:24409384）测量，该突变被激活。对表达BRAF A246P的斑马鱼胚胎进行的临床前研究表明，MEK抑制剂CI-1040和PD0325901对CFC发育的预防作用（PMID:19376813）具有敏感性。
var_description: The BRAF A246P mutation is located in the cysteine-rich domain in exon 6 of the protein. This mutation is found in cardio-facio-cutaneous (CFC) syndrome (PMID: 16474404). Expression of BRAF A246P in NIH-3T3 cells engineered to concurrently express an ERK-dependent luciferase construct demonstrated that this mutation is activating, as measured by increased luciferase activity compared to wildtype BRAF (PMID: 16474404). Single-molecule binding assays with BRAF A246P also demonstrate that the mutation is activating as measured by increased RAS binding affinity compared to wildtype (PMID: 24409384). Preclinical studies with zebrafish embryos expressing BRAF A246P demonstrated sensitivity to treatment with MEK inhibitors CI-1040 and PD0325901 as measured by the prevention of CFC development (PMID: 19376813).

var_description_zh: II类BRAF G469A突变位于蛋白外显子11的激酶结构域（PMID:28783719，26343582）。该突变在黑色素瘤、非小细胞肺癌和心面皮肤综合征中已有报道（PMID:12068308，23833300，16439621）。BRAF G469A突变的生物学特征表明，它独立于Ras激活下游MAPK途径，并使BRAF作为与CRAF和其自身的二聚体具有活性（PMID:12068308，23833300，26343582，20179705，22510884）。BRAF G469A在药物敏感的EGFR突变细胞中的异位表达赋予了对EGFR TKIs的抗性，该抗性通过加入MEK抑制剂（PMID:22773810）而被克服。用表达BRAF G469A的患者来源的肺腺癌细胞进行的临床前研究表明，通过抑制细胞生长，对LXH 254、lifirafenib和达拉非尼加曲美替尼的治疗具有敏感性，通过持续细胞生长（PMID:32540409），对LY3214996、MK-8353、ravoxertinib、ulixertinib、Tak-580、维莫非尼和达拉非尼的治疗具有抗性。在一项临床研究中，携带BRAF G469A的转移性结直肠癌患者接受西妥昔单抗联合FOLFIRI、西妥昔单抗联合伊立替康或帕尼单抗联合伊立替康治疗，各治疗组病情稳定，无进展生存期分别为4.4个月、3.5个月和4.0个月（PMID:31515458）。在一项I期试验中，一名头颈癌患者和一名小肠癌患者（均携带BRAF G469A）接受了ulixertinib治疗，并显示出部分缓解（PMID:29247021）。在一项II期试验中，一名携带BRAF G469A的肺腺癌患者接受了曲美替尼治疗，病情稳定，无进展生存期为20.4个月（PMID:31924734）。在另一项II期试验中，两名携带BRAF G469A的晚期实体瘤患者接受了维莫非尼治疗，但未出现临床治疗反应（PMID:29320312）。
var_description: The class II BRAF G469A mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 11 of the protein (PMID: 28783719, 26343582). This mutation has been reported in melanoma, non-small cell lung cancer and cardio-facio-cutaneous syndrome (PMID: 12068308, 23833300, 16439621). Biological characterization of the BRAF G469A mutation demonstrated that it activates the downstream MAPK pathway independently of RAS and renders BRAF active as a dimer with CRAF and itself (PMID: 12068308, 23833300, 26343582, 20179705, 22510884). Ectopic expression of BRAF G469A in drug-sensitive EGFR-mutant cells conferred resistance to EGFR TKIs that was overcome by addition of a MEK inhibitor (PMID: 22773810). Preclinical studies with patient-derived lung adenocarcinoma cells expressing BRAF G469A demonstrated sensitivity to treatment with LXH 254, lifirafenib and dabrafenib plus trametinib, as measured by inhibition of cell growth, and resistance to treatment with LY3214996, MK-8353, ravoxertinib, ulixertinib, TAK-580, vemurafenib and dabrafenib, as measured by persistent cell growth (PMID: 32540409). In a clinical study, patients with metastatic colorectal cancer harboring BRAF G469A were treated with cetuximab plus FOLFIRI, cetuximab plus irinotecan or panitumumab plus irinotecan and each treatment group demonstrated stable disease with a progression-free survival of 4.4 months, 3.5 months and 4.0 months, respectively (PMID: 31515458). In a Phase I trial, a patient with head and neck cancer and a patient with small bowel cancer, both harboring BRAF G469A, were treated with ulixertinib and demonstrated partial response (PMID: 29247021). In a Phase II trial, a patient with lung adenocarcinoma harboring BRAF G469A was treated with trametinib and demonstrated stable disease with a progression-free survival of 20.4 months (PMID: 31924734). In another Phase II trial, two patients with advanced solid tumors harboring BRAF G469A were treated with vemurafenib and did not clinically respond to treatment (PMID: 29320312).

var_description_zh: GTF2I-BRAF融合蛋白由7号染色体上的重排产生，将GTF21的外显子1-19连接到内含子9 BRAF，从而保留了BRAF的完整激酶结构域。GTF2I-BRAF融合已在黑色素瘤和毛细胞性星形细胞瘤中鉴定（PMID:26314551，28448514）。当在人胚胎肾细胞系中表达时，与野生型BRAF相比，融合蛋白提高了磷酸化ERK的基础水平（pMID:28448514）。在毛细胞型星形细胞瘤患者中检测到融合，免疫组织化学证实该患者肿瘤组织中磷酸化ERK升高（PMID:28448514）。
var_description: The GTF2I-BRAF fusion protein results from a rearrangement on chromosome 7, joining exons 1-19 of GTF21 to intron 9 BRAF, thus retaining the full kinase domain of BRAF. The GTF2I-BRAF fusion has been identified in melanoma and pilocytic astrocytoma (PMID: 26314551, 28448514). When expressed in a human embryonic kidney cell line, the fusion protein elevated basal levels of phosphorylated ERK compared to the wildtype BRAF (PMID: 28448514). The fusion was detected in a patient with pilocytic astrocytoma and immunohistochemistry confirmed elevated phospho-ERK in tumor tissue from this patient (PMID: 28448514).

var_description_zh: III类BRAF G466R突变位于蛋白外显子11的激酶结构域（PMID:28783719）。该突变已在肺腺癌和黑色素瘤中鉴定（PMID:24297085，21788131）。该突变在NIH3T3细胞中的表达证明该突变可能是激活的，如通过增加的下游ERK激活所测量的（PMID:15046639）。虽然该突变在体外的激酶活性低于野生型BRAF，但它可能通过与CRAF的二聚化作用激活下游ERK（PMID:15035987，16364920）。一名携带BRAF G466R的IV期肺腺癌患者接受司美替尼治疗，总生存期为9.1个月（PMID:25273224）。在一份病例报告中，一名携带BRAF G466R的非小细胞肺癌患者接受了达拉非尼和曲美替尼的联合治疗，但对治疗没有临床反应（摘要：Citarella等。癌症医学概要2022。https：//pcm.amegroups.com/article/view/6792/html#B19）。另一名携带BRAF G466R的非小细胞肺癌患者接受了纳武单抗和安罗替尼的联合治疗，并表现出疾病进展，无进展生存期为两个月（PMID:32411601）。在一项II期试验中，一名携带BRAF G466R和NRAS Q61H的黑色素瘤患者接受了多西他赛和司美替尼的联合治疗，结果显示病情稳定，无进展生存期为7个月（PMID:31839677）。
var_description: The class III BRAF G466R mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 11 of the protein (PMID: 28783719). This mutation has been identified in lung adenocarcinoma and melanoma (PMID: 24297085, 21788131). Expression of this mutation in NIH3T3 cells demonstrated that this mutation is likely activating as measured by increased downstream ERK activation (PMID: 15046639). While this mutation has kinase activity in vitro less than wildtype BRAF, it likely activates downstream ERK through dimerization with CRAF (PMID: 15035987, 16364920). A patient with stage IV lung adenocarcinoma harboring BRAF G466R was treated with selumetinib and demonstrated an overall survival of 9.1 months (PMID: 25273224). In a case report, a patient with non-small cell lung cancer harboring BRAF G466R was treated with a combination therapy of dabrafenib plus trametinib and did not clinically respond to treatment (Abstract: Citarella et al. Precis Cancer Med 2022. https://pcm.amegroups.com/article/view/6792/html#B19). Another patient with non-small cell lung cancer harboring BRAF G466R was treated with a combination therapy of nivolumab plus anlotinib and demonstrated progressive disease with a progression-free survival of two months (PMID: 32411601). In a Phase II trial, a patient with melanoma harboring BRAF G466R and NRAS Q61H was treated with a combination therapy of docetaxel plus selumetinib and demonstrated stable disease with a progression-free survival of seven months (PMID: 31839677).

var_description_zh: II类BRAF K601Q突变位于蛋白外显子15的激酶结构域（PMID:33019809）。该突变已在心-面-皮肤综合征患者中发现（PMID:19206169）。该突变在NIH-3T3细胞中的表达表明，与野生型BRAF相比，通过增加的下游途径激活来测量其激活，尽管程度低于BRAF V600E（pMID:19206169）。用表达BRAF K601Q的黑色素瘤细胞进行的临床前研究表明，通过治疗后持续的MEK和ERK磷酸化（PMID:35045286），对维莫非尼治疗具有抗性。
var_description: The class II BRAF K601Q mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 15 of the protein (PMID: 33019809). This mutation has been found in patients with cardio-facio-cutaneous syndrome (PMID: 19206169). Expression of this mutation in NIH-3T3 cells demonstrated that it is activating as measured by increased downstream pathway activation compared to wildtype BRAF, though to a lesser extent than BRAF V600E (PMID: 19206169). Preclinical studies with melanoma cells expressing BRAF K601Q demonstrated resistance to treatment with vemurafenib as measured by sustained MEK and ERK phosphorylation following treatment (PMID: 35045286).

var_description_zh: II类BRAF G464R突变位于蛋白外显子11的激酶结构域（PMID:33019809）。该突变已在黑色素瘤中发现（PMID:15046639）。该突变在NIH-3T3细胞中的表达表明，与野生型BRAF相比，该突变是激活的，如通过增加的下游途径激活所测量的，尽管程度低于BRAF V600E（PMID:15046639）。用表达BRAF G464R的BA/F3和MCF10A细胞进行的体外研究表明，通过与野生型相比增加的细胞活力和增殖（PMID:29533785）来测量，该突变被激活。在一例携带BRAF G464R和KRAS G12S的转移性结直肠癌患者的病例报告中，该患者接受贝伐单抗联合FOLFIRI治疗，随后接受贝伐单抗联合FOLFOXIRI治疗，两种治疗方案后均出现乙状结肠疾病复发（PMID:31183211）。
var_description: The class II BRAF G464R mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 11 of the protein (PMID: 33019809). This mutation has been found in melanoma (PMID: 15046639). Expression of this mutation in NIH-3T3 cells demonstrated that this mutation is activating as measured by increased downstream pathway activation compared to wildtype BRAF, though to a lesser extent than BRAF V600E (PMID: 15046639). In vitro studies with Ba/F3 and MCF10A cells expressing BRAF G464R demonstrate that the mutation is activating as measured by increased cell viability and proliferation compared to wildtype (PMID: 29533785). In a case report for a patient with metastatic colorectal cancer harboring BRAF G464R and KRAS G12S, the patient was treated with bevacizumab plus FOLFIRI and then later treated with bevacizumab plus FOLFOXIRI and demonstrated recurrent disease in the sigmoid colon following both treatment regimens (PMID: 31183211).

var_description_zh: III类BRAF K483E突变发生在BRAF蛋白的酪氨酸激酶结构域（PMID:33019809）。该突变已在诊断为儿童低分化癌的患者中鉴定（PMID:27799065）。该变体在293T细胞中的过表达导致MEK1/2的活化，然而，该活化与野生型BRAF（PMID:27799065）的过表达相当。由于缺乏BRAF K483E激酶活性（PMID:27799065），激活可能通过BRAF或CRAF的变构激活发生。表达BRAF K483E的患者来源的结肠直肠癌类器官的临床前研究证明了对比尼替尼治疗的敏感性（通过降低细胞活力来测量）和对西妥昔单抗治疗的耐药性（通过细胞活力无变化来测量）（PMID:33060766）。
var_description: The class III BRAF K483E mutation occurs in the tyrosine kinase domain of the BRAF protein (PMID: 33019809). This mutation has been identified in a patient diagnosed with pediatric poorly differentiated carcinoma (PMID: 27799065). Overexpression of this variant in 293T cells resulted in activation of MEK1/2, however, the activation was comparable to overexpression of wildtype BRAF (PMID: 27799065). Activation likely occurs via allosteric activation of BRAF or CRAF because of the lack of BRAF K483E kinase activity (PMID: 27799065). Preclinical studies with patient-derived colorectal cancer organoids expressing BRAF K483E demonstrated sensitivity to treatment with binimetinib as measured by decreased cell viability, and resistance to treatment with cetuximab as measured by no change in cell viability (PMID: 33060766).

var_description_zh: BRAF H725Y突变位于该蛋白的未知功能域。该突变已在Merkel细胞癌中鉴定（PMID:28481359）。用表达BRAF H725Y的MCF10A细胞进行的体外研究表明，通过与野生型相比增加的转化能力（PMID:29533785）来测量，该突变是激活的。
var_description: The BRAF H725Y mutation is located in an unknown functional domain of the protein. This mutation has been identified in merkel cell carcinoma (PMID: 28481359). In vitro studies with MCF10A cells expressing BRAF H725Y demonstrate that the mutation is activating as measured by increased transformation ability compared to wildtype (PMID: 29533785).

var_description_zh: P61BRAF（V600E）突变是BRAF mRNA转录物选择性剪接的产物，其含有V600E突变，但消除了该基因的外显子4-8（PMID:22113612）。该突变编码截短的16kDa BRAF蛋白，其具有V600E突变但缺乏Ras结合结构域并组成型二聚化（PMID:22113612）。该突变已在黑色素瘤中发现（PMID:22113612）。与其组成型二聚化的能力一致，该突变的体外研究表明其对维莫非尼具有抗性，如通过持续MAPK途径信号传导和药物治疗后的细胞增殖所测量的（PMID:22113612）。在一项研究中，19名对维莫非尼耐药的黑色素瘤患者中有6名携带p61BRAF（V600E）突变（PMID:22113612）。在第二项研究中，在几个患者来源的异种移植物中发现了BRAF剪接变异体，这些移植物是由使用BRAF抑制剂（PMID:27320919）的患者产生的。
var_description: The p61BRAF(V600E) mutation is the product of alternative splicing of the BRAF mRNA transcript, which contains the V600E mutation but eliminates exons 4-8 of the gene (PMID: 22113612). This mutation encodes a truncated, 16 kDa BRAF protein that has the V600E mutation but lacks the RAS binding domain and constitutively dimerizes (PMID: 22113612). This mutation has been found in melanoma (PMID: 22113612). In concordance with its ability to constitutively dimerize, in vitro studies of this mutation suggest that it is resistant to vemurafenib, as measured by persistent MAPK pathway signaling and cell proliferation upon drug treatment (PMID: 22113612). In one study, six out of nineteen patients with melanomas that were resistant to vemurafenib harbored the p61BRAF(V600E) mutation (PMID: 22113612). In a second study, BRAF splice variants were found in several patient-derived xenografts that were generated from patients who progressed on BRAF inhibitors (PMID: 27320919).

var_description_zh: BRAF V 600_K601InSDFGLAT改变位于该蛋白外显子15的激酶结构域中。在甲状腺乳头状癌中发现了这种突变（PMID:17297294）。该突变在NIH-3T3细胞中的表达表明，与野生型BRAF（PMID:17297294）相比，通过增加的下游途径激活和集落形成来测量，该突变是激活的。
var_description: The BRAF V600_K601insDFGLAT alteration is located in the kinase domain in exon 15 of the protein. This mutation has been found in papillary thyroid cancer (PMID: 17297294). Expression of this mutation in NIH-3T3 cells demonstrated that it is activating as measured by increased downstream pathway activation and colony formation compared to wildtype BRAF (PMID: 17297294).

var_description_zh: III类BRAF G596D突变位于蛋白外显子15的激酶结构域（PMID:28783719）。该突变在宫颈腺癌和食管胃癌中已有报道（PMID:17360030，23481512）。在生物化学上，已经证明BRAF G596D突变体作为与CRAF的二聚体发出信号，在其MAPK途径的激活中是Ras依赖性的，并且在肿瘤中，通常与放大Ras信号的另一驱动机制共同发生（PMID:28783719）。因此，与其他III类BRAF突变体一样，在黑色素瘤中，预期G596D变体与活化Ras突变或NF1失活同时发生，而在非小细胞肺癌和结肠直肠癌中，该突变很可能与蛋白水平的受体酪氨酸激酶（RTK）过度活化有关（PMID:28783719）。虽然该突变对靶向抑制剂如曲美替尼的MEK抑制敏感，但对RAF单体抑制剂如维莫非尼（PMID:28783719）不敏感。用表达BRAF G596D的SKBR3细胞进行的临床前研究表明，通过治疗后持续的ERK磷酸化（PMID:31158244）来测量对达拉非尼治疗的抗性。
var_description: The class III BRAF G596D mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 15 of the protein (PMID: 28783719). This mutation has been reported in cervical adenocarcinoma and esophagogastric cancer (PMID: 17360030, 23481512). Biochemically, it has been demonstrated that the BRAF G596D mutant signals as a dimer with CRAF, is RAS-dependent in its activation of the MAPK pathway, and, in tumors, would typically co-occur with another driver mechanism that amplifies RAS signaling (PMID: 28783719). Thus, like other class III BRAF mutants, in melanoma, the G596D variant would be expected to co-occur with activating RAS mutation or NF1 inactivation, whereas in non-small cell lung and colorectal cancers, this mutation would most likely be associated with receptor tyrosine kinase (RTK) hyperactivation at the protein level (PMID: 28783719). While this mutation is sensitive to MEK inhibition by targeted inhibitors such as trametinib, it is insensitive to RAF monomer inhibitors such as vemurafenib (PMID: 28783719). Preclinical studies with SKBR3 cells expressing BRAF G596D demonstrate resistance to treatment with dabrafenib as measured by sustained ERK phosphorylation following treatment (PMID: 31158244).

var_description_zh: ARMC10-BRAF融合蛋白结合了ARMC10的N末端和BRAF的C末端，保留了BRAF的激酶结构域。该融合蛋白在散发性微卫星不稳定性高的结直肠癌患者中发现（PMID:30279230）。该融合蛋白在NIH3T3细胞中的表达表明，与单独表达BRAF（pmid:30279230）相比，该融合蛋白被激活，如集落形成和途径激活增加所示。用表达ARMC10-BRAF的患者来源的异种移植物模型进行的临床前研究表明，用MEK抑制剂曲美替尼和ERK抑制剂SCH772984治疗的敏感性通过治疗后的肿瘤消退和磷酸化ERK降低来衡量（PMID:30254212）。
var_description: The ARMC10-BRAF fusion protein combines the N-terminus of ARMC10 with the C-terminus of BRAF, preserving the kinase domain of BRAF. This fusion protein is found in patients with sporadic microsatellite instability-high colorectal cancers (PMID: 30279230). Expression of this fusion protein in NIH3T3 cells demonstrated that it was activating as shown by increased colony formation and pathway activation compared to expression of BRAF alone (PMID: 30279230). Preclinical studies with patient-derived xenograft models expressing ARMC10-BRAF demonstrated sensitivity to treatment with MEK inhibitor trametinib and ERK inhibitor SCH772984 as measured by tumor regression and decreased phosphorylated ERK following treatment (PMID: 30254212).

var_description_zh: BRAF V639I突变位于该蛋白的激酶结构域。用BA/F3细胞和表达BRAF V639I的MCF10A细胞进行的体外研究表明，通过与野生型（PMID:29533785）相比的细胞增殖和生存力测量，突变可能是中性的。
var_description: The BRAF V639I mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein. In vitro studies with Ba/F3 cells and MCF10A cells expressing BRAF V639I demonstrate that the mutation is likely neutral as measured by cell proliferation and viability comparable to wildtype (PMID: 29533785).

var_description_zh: BRAF F294L突变位于蛋白质的未知功能域。该突变已在结直肠癌中鉴定（PMID:28481359）。用表达BRAF F294L的BA/F3和MCF10A细胞进行的体外研究表明，通过与野生型（PMID:29533785）相比的细胞增殖和生存力测量，突变可能是中性的。
var_description: The BRAF F294L mutation is located in an unknown functional domain of the protein. This mutation has been identified in colorectal cancer (PMID: 28481359). In vitro studies with Ba/F3 and MCF10A cells expressing BRAF F294L demonstrate that the mutation is likely neutral as measured by cellular proliferation and viability comparable to wildtype (PMID: 29533785).

var_description_zh: III类BRAF N581T突变位于蛋白质的激酶结构域（PMID:31515458）。该突变已在弥漫性大B细胞淋巴瘤中发现，是一个具有统计学意义的热点（PMID:32187361）。用表达BRAF N581T的BA/F3和MCF10A细胞进行的体外研究表明，通过与野生型（PMID:29533785）相比的细胞活力和增殖测量，突变可能是中性的。在一份病例报告中，一名携带BRAF N581T的转移性结直肠癌患者接受了西妥昔单抗联合FOLFOX的联合治疗，结果显示部分缓解，无进展生存期为1.4个月（PMID:31515458）。
var_description: The class III BRAF N581T mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein (PMID: 31515458). This mutation has been identified in diffuse large B-cell lymphoma and is a statistically significant hotspot (PMID: 32187361). In vitro studies with Ba/F3 and MCF10A cells expressing BRAF N581T demonstrate that the mutation is likely neutral as measured by cell viability and proliferation comparable to wildtype (PMID: 29533785). In a case report, a patient with metastatic colorectal cancer harboring BRAF N581T was treated with a combination therapy of cetuximab plus FOLFOX and demonstrated partial response with a progression-free survival of 1.4 months (PMID: 31515458).

var_description_zh: BRAF S607F突变位于该蛋白的激酶结构域。该突变已在基底细胞癌中鉴定（PMID:26950094）。用表达BRAF S607F的HEK293细胞进行的体外研究表明，通过与野生型（PMID:32059434）相当的ERK磷酸化测定，该突变可能是中性的。
var_description: The BRAF S607F mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein. This mutation has been identified in basal cell carcinoma (PMID: 26950094). In vitro studies with HEK293 cells expressing BRAF S607F demonstrate that the mutation is likely neutral as measured by ERK phosphorylation comparable to wildtype (PMID: 32059434).

var_description_zh: BRAF W531C突变位于蛋白外显子6的富含半胱氨酸区域。该突变已在心-面-皮肤综合征患者中发现（PMID:19206169）。关于这种突变的生物学效应和致癌效应，存在相互矛盾的证据。该突变在NIH-3T3细胞中的表达表明该突变可能是中性的，如通过与野生型BRAF（PMID:19206169）相当的下游途径激活所测量的。然而，用BA/F3和MCF10A细胞进行的体外研究和用表达BRAF W531C的果蝇进行的体内研究表明，如通过增加的MEK和ERK信号传导和细胞增殖（PMID:29533785，33855281）所测量的，该突变被激活。
var_description: The BRAF W531C mutation is located in the cysteine-rich domain in exon 6 of the protein. This mutation has been found in patients with cardio-facio-cutaneous syndrome (PMID: 19206169). There is conflicting evidence on the biological and oncogenic effect of this mutation. Expression of this mutation in NIH-3T3 cells demonstrated that this mutation is likely neutral, as measured by downstream pathway activation comparable to wildtype BRAF (PMID: 19206169). However, in vitro studies with Ba/F3 and MCF10A cells and in vivo studies with drosophila expressing BRAF W531C demonstrate that the mutation is activating as measured by increased MEK and ERK signaling and cellular proliferation (PMID: 29533785, 33855281).

var_description_zh: III类BRAF R558Q突变位于蛋白质的激酶结构域（PMID:31515458）。该突变已在结直肠癌中鉴定（PMID:28481359）。用表达BRAF R558Q的小鼠胚胎成纤维细胞进行的体外研究表明，与野生型相比，通过增加的ERK信号（pMID:31515458）测量，该突变被激活。在一项临床试验中，一名携带BRAF R558Q的转移性结直肠癌患者接受了西妥昔单抗联合伊立替康治疗，结果显示完全缓解，无进展生存期为37.7个月（PMID:31515458）。
var_description: The class III BRAF R558Q mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein (PMID: 31515458). This mutation has been identified in colorectal cancer (PMID: 28481359). In vitro studies with mouse embryonic fibroblasts expressing BRAF R558Q demonstrate that the mutation is activating as measured by increased ERK signaling compared to wildtype (PMID: 31515458). In a clinical trial, a patient with metastatic colorectal cancer harboring BRAF R558Q was treated with combination cetuximab plus irinotecan and demonstrated complete response with a progression-free survival of 37.7 months (PMID: 31515458).

var_description_zh: II类BRAF V471F突变位于蛋白外显子11的激酶结构域（PMID:33019809）。该突变在293T细胞中的表达表明，与野生型BRAF（PMID:25348715）相比，该突变是激活的，如通过增加的下游途径激活和中等转化活性所测量的。尽管该突变是激酶死亡的，但它通过与CRAF二聚化来激活MAPK途径（PMID:25348715）。
var_description: The class II BRAF V471F mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 11 of the protein (PMID: 33019809). Expression of this mutation in 293T cells demonstrated that this mutation is activating as measured by increased downstream pathway activation and moderate transforming activity compared to wildtype BRAF (PMID: 25348715). Though this mutation is kinase-dead, it activates the MAPK pathway by dimerizing with CRAF (PMID: 25348715).

var_description_zh: III类BRAF S467L突变发生在蛋白外显子11的激酶结构域中（PMID:28783719）。该突变已在黑色素瘤中报道（PMID:24710085，25651238，26498038，26559571）。在生物化学上，已经证明BRAF S467L突变体信号作为与CRAF的二聚体，在其MAPK途径的激活中是Ras依赖性的，并且在肿瘤中，通常与放大Ras信号的另一驱动机制共同发生（PMID:28783719）。因此，III类BRAF突变体如BRAF S467L变体通常预期与黑色素瘤中的活化Ras突变或NF1失活同时发生，而在非小细胞肺癌或结肠直肠癌中，该突变很可能与蛋白水平的受体酪氨酸激酶（RTK）过度活化有关（PMID:28783719）。
var_description: The class III BRAF S467L mutation occurs in the kinase domain in exon 11 of the protein (PMID: 28783719). This mutation has been reported in melanoma (PMID: 24710085, 25651238, 26498038, 26559571). Biochemically, it has been demonstrated that the BRAF S467L mutant signals as a dimer with CRAF, is RAS-dependent in its activation of the MAPK pathway, and, in tumors, would typically co-occur with another driver mechanism that amplifies RAS signaling (PMID: 28783719). Therefore, class III BRAF mutants like the BRAF S467L variant would be generally expected to co-occur with activating RAS mutations or NF1 inactivation in melanomas, whereas in non-small cell lung or colorectal cancers, this mutation will most likely be associated with receptor tyrosine kinase (RTK) hyperactivation at the protein level (PMID: 28783719).

var_description_zh: BRAF A598T突变位于BRAF蛋白的激酶结构域。该突变已在神经胶质瘤中鉴定（PMID:32996219）。体外实验已经证明，通过与野生型对照相比降低的BRAF激酶活性来测量，IS突变是失活的（PMID:22926515，32059434）。
var_description: The BRAF A598T mutation is located in the kinase domain of the BRAF protein. This mutation has been identified in glioma (PMID: 32996219). In vitro experiments have demonstrated that is mutation is inactivating as measured by reduced BRAF kinase activity compared to wildtype controls (PMID: 22926515, 32059434).

var_description_zh: BRAF E228V突变位于该蛋白的未知功能域。用BA/F3细胞和表达BRAF E228V的MCF10A细胞进行的体外研究表明，通过与野生型（PMID:29533785）相比的细胞增殖和生存力测量，突变可能是中性的。
var_description: The BRAF E228V mutation is located in an unknown functional domain of the protein. In vitro studies with Ba/F3 cells and MCF10A cells expressing BRAF E228V demonstrate that the mutation is likely neutral as measured by cell proliferation and viability comparable to wildtype (PMID: 29533785).

var_description_zh: III类BRAF G466V错义突变位于蛋白外显子11的激酶结构域（PMID:15035987，28783719）。该突变已在黑色素瘤、肺癌、结肠直肠癌和心面皮肤综合征中报道（PMID:28481359，15046639，26498038，16439621，22649091）。BRAF G466V突变的生物学特征已经证明，它在MAPK途径的激活中是Ras依赖性的，与CRAF作为二聚体发出信号，并且通常与另一种放大Ras信号的驱动机制共同发生（PMID:15035987，26498038，22649091，16364920，24202393，28783719）。因此，当在黑色素瘤中观察到BRAF G466V时，它通常与活化Ras突变或NF1失活同时发生，而当在非小细胞肺癌或结肠直肠癌中观察到时，它与蛋白水平的受体酪氨酸激酶（RTK）过度活化有关（PMID:28783719）。用表达BRAF G466V的肺癌细胞系进行的临床前研究证明了对Tak-632、TAE226和RMC-4550治疗的敏感性，如通过治疗后细胞增殖的抑制和ERK磷酸化的降低所测量的（PMID:26090892，27523909，30104724）。用表达BRAF G466V的患者来源的异种移植结直肠癌模型进行的其他临床前研究表明，通过持续的ERK磷酸化和不能抑制肿瘤生长来测量对PLX8394治疗的抗性，以及通过降低肿瘤生长和抑制ERK磷酸化来测量对西妥昔单抗治疗的敏感性（PMID:30559419）。在一项II期临床试验中，3名携带BRAF G466V的非小细胞肺癌患者接受了维莫非尼治疗，但对治疗无临床反应（PMID:31959346）。在另一项II期试验中，一名携带BRAF G466V的肺腺癌患者接受了曲美替尼治疗，并表现出疾病进展（PMID:31924734）。在一份病例报告中，一名携带BRAF G466V的转移性结直肠癌患者接受了伊立替康和帕尼单抗的联合治疗，并显示出部分缓解，无进展生存期为6.1个月（PMID:31515458）。
var_description: The class III BRAF G466V missense mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 11 of the protein (PMID: 15035987, 28783719). This mutation has been reported in melanoma, lung cancer, colorectal cancer and cardio-facio-cutaneous syndrome (PMID: 28481359, 15046639, 26498038, 16439621, 22649091). Biological characterization of the BRAF G466V mutation has demonstrated that it is RAS dependent in its activation of the MAPK pathway, signals as a dimer with CRAF, and typically co-occurs with another driver mechanism that amplifies RAS signaling (PMID: 15035987, 26498038, 22649091, 16364920, 24202393, 28783719). Thus, when BRAF G466V is observed in melanoma, it typically co-occurs with an activating RAS mutation or NF1 inactivation, whereas when observed in non-small cell lung or colorectal cancers, it is associated with receptor tyrosine kinase (RTK) hyperactivation at the protein level (PMID: 28783719). Preclinical studies with lung cancer cell lines expressing BRAF G466V demonstrated sensitivity to treatment with TAK-632, TAE226 and RMC-4550 as measured by inhibition of cell proliferation and reduced ERK phosphorylation following treatment (PMID: 26090892, 27523909, 30104724). Other preclinical studies with patient-derived xenograft colorectal cancer models expressing BRAF G466V demonstrated resistance to treatment with PLX8394 as measured by continued ERK phosphorylation and inability to suppress tumor growth, and sensitivity to treatment with cetuximab as measured by reduced tumor growth and inhibition of ERK phosphorylation (PMID: 30559419). In a Phase II trial, three patients with non-small cell lung cancer harboring BRAF G466V were treated with vemurafenib and did not clinically respond to treatment (PMID: 31959346). In another Phase II trial, a patient with lung adenocarcinoma harboring BRAF G466V was treated with trametinib and demonstrated progressive disease (PMID: 31924734). In a case report, a patient with metastatic colorectal cancer harboring BRAF G466V was treated with a combination therapy of irinotecan plus panitumumab and demonstrated a partial response with a progression-free survival of 6.1 months (PMID: 31515458).

var_description_zh: TRIM24-BRAF融合蛋白由7号染色体的倒位产生，该倒位融合了TRIM24的外显子1-9和BRAF的外显子9-18（PMID:24345920）。该融合包含BRAF激酶结构域，但不包括负责Ras结合和自动抑制的BRAF CR1结构域（PMID:15630448）。已在黑色素瘤中发现这种融合（PMID:24345920）。该融合蛋白在293H细胞中的表达表明，通过下游MEK和ERK的激活来测量其激活，这与BRAF V600E（pMID:24345920）相当。体外实验表明，TRIM24-BRAF融合物对维莫非尼具有耐药性，但对曲美替尼敏感，这是通过药物治疗后MEK和ERK磷酸化的变化来衡量的（PMID:24345920）。
var_description: The TRIM24-BRAF fusion protein results from an inversion of chromosome 7 that fuses exons 1-9 of TRIM24 and exons 9-18 of BRAF (PMID: 24345920). This fusion contains the BRAF kinase domain, but excludes the BRAF CR1 domain responsible for RAS binding and auto-inhibition (PMID:15630448). This fusion has been found in melanoma (PMID: 24345920). Expression of this fusion in 293H cells demonstrated that it is activating as measured by activation of downstream MEK and ERK that is comparable to BRAF V600E (PMID: 24345920). In vitro experiments have suggested that the TRIM24-BRAF fusion is resistant to vemurafenib but sensitive to trametinib as measured by changes in MEK and ERK phosphorylation upon drug treatment (PMID: 24345920).

var_description_zh: BRAF V600delinsym突变位于蛋白外显子15的激酶结构域。该突变已在甲状腺乳头状癌中发现（PMID:22752848）。与野生型BRAF（PMID:22752848）相比，该突变在NIH-3T3细胞中的表达表明其被激活，如通过增加的激酶活性和增加的细胞增殖所测量的。
var_description: The BRAF V600delinsYM mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 15 of the protein. This mutation has been found in papillary thyroid carcinoma (PMID: 22752848). Expression of this mutation in NIH-3T3 cells demonstrated that it is activating as measured by increased kinase activity and increased cell proliferation compared to wildtype BRAF (PMID: 22752848).

var_description_zh: BRAF L245F突变位于蛋白的锌指结构域。用表达BRAF L245F的BA/F3细胞进行的体外研究表明，通过与野生型相比增加的转化能力（PMID:29533785）来测量，该突变是激活的。
var_description: The BRAF L245F mutation is located in the zinc finger domain of the protein. In vitro studies with Ba/F3 cells expressing BRAF L245F demonstrate that the mutation is activating as measured by increased transformation ability compared to wildtype (PMID: 29533785).

var_description_zh: BRAF R671Q突变位于BRAF蛋白的激酶结构域。该突变已在结直肠癌等中发现（PMID:27048246）。体外研究表明，与野生型（PMID:28174173）相比，通过增加的下游信号来测量，该突变可能被激活。
var_description: The BRAF R671Q mutation is located in the kinase domain of the BRAF protein. This mutation has been found in colorectal cancers, among others (PMID: 27048246). In vitro studies have demonstrated that this mutation is likely activating as measured by increased downstream signaling compared to wildtype (PMID: 28174173).

var_description_zh: BRAF A320T突变位于蛋白质的未知功能域。用BA/F3细胞和表达BRAF A320T的MCF10A细胞进行的体外研究表明，如通过与野生型（PMID:29533785）相当的细胞增殖和生存力所测量的，突变可能是中性的。
var_description: The BRAF A320T mutation is located in an unknown functional domain of the protein. In vitro studies with Ba/F3 cells and MCF10A cells expressing BRAF A320T demonstrate that the mutation is likely neutral as measured by cell proliferation and viability comparable to wildtype (PMID: 29533785).

var_description_zh: I类（PMID:28783719）激活外显子15 BRAF V600G突变位于该蛋白的激酶结构域中。该突变已在心-面-皮肤综合征（CFC）、肺癌和食管胃癌中发现（PMID:26287849）。已知BRAF的V600位的取代，包括常见的BRAF V600E突变，是活化的和致癌的（PMID:12068308，16273091，15035987）。与野生型BRAF（PMID:20735442）相比，该突变在293T细胞中的表达表明该突变是激活的，如通过增加的下游ERK激活和增加的下游MAPK途径转录靶标（例如ELK）的转录所测量的。一名携带BRAF V600G突变的非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）患者在接受vemutafenib治疗后病情稳定，而一名携带BRAF V600G突变的肉瘤患者和一名食管胃癌患者在接受维莫非尼治疗后病情进展（PMID:26287849）。
var_description: The class I (PMID: 28783719) activating exon 15 BRAF V600G mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in cardio-facio-cutaneous syndrome (CFC), lung cancer and esophagogastric cancer (PMID: 26287849). Substitutions at position V600 of BRAF, including the common BRAF V600E mutation, are known to be activating and oncogenic (PMID: 12068308, 16273091, 15035987). Expression of this mutation in 293T cells demonstrated that this mutation is activating as measured by increased downstream ERK activation and increased transcription of downstream MAPK pathway transcriptional targets (e.g. ELK) compared to wildtype BRAF (PMID: 20735442). A patient with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) harboring the BRAF V600G mutation had stable disease in response to treatment with vemutafenib, while a patient with sarcoma and a patient with esophagogastric cancer both harboring the BRAF V600G mutation had progressive disease in response to vemurafenib (PMID: 26287849).

var_description_zh: BRAF M517I突变位于该蛋白的激酶结构域。用表达BRAF M517I的MCF10A细胞进行的体外研究表明，通过与野生型（PMID:29533785）相比降低的细胞增殖和生存力来测量，该突变是失活的。
var_description: The BRAF M517I mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein. In vitro studies with MCF10A cells expressing BRAF M517I demonstrate that the mutation is inactivating as measured by decreased cell proliferation and viability comparable to wildtype (PMID: 29533785).

var_description_zh: BRAF T274A突变位于蛋白的锌指结构域。一名携带BRAF T274A、KRAS G12D和突变型NF1的肺腺癌患者接受了纳武单抗治疗，并表现出疾病进展（PMID:34963703），但其本身并未进行功能表征。
var_description: The BRAF T274A mutation is located in the zinc finger domain of the protein. Although not functionally characterized per se, a patient with lung adenocarcinoma harboring BRAF T274A, KRAS G12D and mutant NF1 was treated with nivolumab and demonstrated progressive disease (PMID: 34963703).

var_description_zh: BRAF G469L突变位于外显子11的蛋白激酶结构域。虽然该突变尚未进行功能表征，但该位置的其他取代（例如，G469R）已被证明是激活和致癌的（PMID:24920063）。该突变发现于一名对维莫非尼治疗无效的非小细胞肺癌患者（PMID:24035431）。
var_description: The BRAF G469L mutation is located in the protein's kinase domain in exon 11. While this mutation has not been functionally characterized, other substitutions at this position (e.g., G469R) have been shown to be activating and oncogenic (PMID: 24920063 ). This mutation was found in a patient with non-small cell lung cancer who failed to respond to treatment with vemurafenib (PMID: 24035431).

var_description_zh: II类BRAF L 485_p490del突变位于蛋白外显子11的激酶结构域（pmid:36686670）。该突变在HEK293或NIH-3T3细胞中的表达表明，通过与BRAF V600E（pMID:26732095）相当的软琼脂中的激酶活性和集落形成测量，该突变是活化的。然而，在人类细胞系中的第二项研究表明，该突变具有与野生型BRAF相当的激酶活性（PMID:26996308）。该突变依赖于BRAF同源二聚体的形成，因为BRAF L 485_p490del不能作为单体激活下游MAPK途径效应子（PMID:26732095）。用表达BRAF L 485_p490del的NIH3T3细胞进行的临床前研究证明了对LY3009120治疗的敏感性（通过MEK和ERK磷酸化的抑制来测量）和对维莫非尼治疗的抗性（通过持续的MEK和ERK信号传导和增殖来测量）（PMID:26732095）。在一份病例报告中，一名携带BRAF L 485_p490del和PD-L1表达扩增的转移性黑色素瘤患者接受了曲美替尼和达拉非尼的联合治疗，并显示出部分缓解，无进展生存期为18个月（PMID:36686670）。
var_description: The class II BRAF L485_P490del mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 11 of the protein (PMID: 36686670). Expression of this mutation in HEK293 or NIH-3T3 cells demonstrated that it is activating as measured by kinase activity and colony formation in soft agar comparable to BRAF V600E (PMID: 26732095). However, a second study in human cell lines demonstrated that this mutation has kinase activity comparable to wildtype BRAF (PMID: 26996308). This mutation is dependent on BRAF homodimer formation, as BRAF L485_P490del fails to activate downstream MAPK pathway effectors as a monomer (PMID: 26732095). Preclinical studies with NIH3T3 cells expressing BRAF L485_P490del demonstrated sensitivity to treatment with LY3009120, as measured by inhibition of MEK and ERK phosphorylation, and resistance to treatment with vemurafenib, as measured by sustained MEK and ERK signaling and proliferation (PMID: 26732095). In a case report, a patient with metastatic melanoma harboring BRAF L485_P490del and amplified PD-L1 expression was treated with a combination therapy of trametinib and dabrafenib and demonstrated partial response with a progression-free survival of 18 months (PMID: 36686670).

var_description_zh: II类BRAF T 488_p492del突变位于蛋白质（的外显子11中的激酶结构域。摘要#40p，肿瘤学年鉴2022。https：//www.annalsofoncology.org/article/S0923-7534%2822%2900058-8/fulltext）。该突变已在胰腺癌中发现（PMID:26996308）。与野生型（PMID:26996308）相比，该突变在人细胞系中的表达表明其被激活，如通过增加的激酶活性和下游信号传导所测量的。
var_description: The class II BRAF T488_P492del mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 11 of the protein (Abstract: Severson et al. Abstract #40P, Annals of Oncology 2022. https://www.annalsofoncology.org/article/S0923-7534%2822%2900058-8/fulltext). This mutation has been found in pancreatic cancer (PMID: 26996308). Expression of this mutation in a human cell line demonstrated that it is activating as measured by increased kinase activity and downstream signaling compared to wildtype (PMID: 26996308).

var_description_zh: BRAF R 506_K507insvlr突变（也称为BRAF V504_R506dup）位于蛋白质外显子13的激酶结构域中。该突变已在毛细胞型星形细胞瘤中发现（PMID:23817572）。该突变在NIH-3T3细胞中的表达表明，与野生型BRAF（PMID:23817572）相比，通过增加的下游途径激活来测量其激活。用表达BRAF R 506_K507INSVLR的HEK293T细胞进行的临床前研究表明，如通过抑制ERK信号传导所测量的，对曲美替尼治疗的敏感性，以及如通过持续的ERK信号传导所测量的，对PLX8394、达拉非尼、维莫非尼、LY3009120和索拉非尼治疗的抗性（PMID:34108213）。
var_description: The BRAF R506_K507insVLR mutation (also referred to as BRAF V504_R506dup) is located in the kinase domain in exon 13 of the protein. This mutation has been found in pilocytic astrocytoma (PMID: 23817572). Expression of this mutation in NIH-3T3 cells demonstrated that it is activating as measured by increased downstream pathway activation compared to wildtype BRAF (PMID: 23817572). Preclinical studies with HEK293T cells expressing BRAF R506_K507insVLR demonstrated sensitivity to treatment with trametinib as measured by inhibition of ERK signaling, and resistance to treatment with PLX8394, dabrafenib, vemurafenib, LY3009120 and sorafenib as measured by sustained ERK signaling (PMID: 34108213).

var_description_zh: AGAP3-BRAF融合蛋白由7号染色体上的倒位产生，将AGAP3的外显子1-9与BRAF基因的3片段连接。AGAP3-BRAF融合蛋白含有完整的BRAF激酶结构域，但缺少调节Ras结合结构域和富含半胱氨酸（CR1）结构域，它们负责BRAF与Ras的结合和自动抑制。已在黑色素瘤、结肠直肠癌和卵巢浆液性癌中发现该融合蛋白（PMID:26314551，28539463，30279230，34568720）。与野生型BRAF（PMID:30279230）相比，该融合蛋白在NIH3T3细胞中的表达证明其被激活，如通过增加的MAPK途径活性和细胞生长所测量的。通过体外集落形成和细胞增殖（PMID:28539463）测定，该融合蛋白在细胞系中的表达证明其对曲美替尼敏感，但对维莫非尼不敏感。一名患有BRAF V600E突变的转移性黑色素瘤的患者，在对BRAF抑制剂维莫非尼的初始反应后出现疾病复发，随后接受达拉非尼联合曲美替尼（RAF抑制剂联合MEK抑制剂）治疗，并在两个月内出现部分反应（PMID:28539463）。
var_description: The AGAP3-BRAF fusion protein results from an inversion on chromosome 7, joining exons 1-9 of AGAP3 with a 3' segment of the BRAF gene. The AGAP3-BRAF fusion protein contains the full BRAF kinase domain, but lacks the regulatory RAS-binding domain and the cysteine-rich (CR1) domain, which are responsible for BRAF binding to RAS and auto-inhibition. This fusion protein has been found in melanoma, colorectal cancer and ovarian serous carcinoma (PMID: 26314551, 28539463, 30279230, 34568720).  Expression of this fusion in NIH3T3 cells demonstrated that it is activating as measured by increased MAPK pathway activity and cellular growth compared to wildtype BRAF (PMID: 30279230). Expression of this fusion in cell lines demonstrated that it is sensitive to trametinib but not vemurafenib as measured by in vitro colony formation and cell proliferation (PMID: 28539463). A patient with BRAF V600E-mutated metastatic melanoma, who experienced disease relapse after an initial response to the BRAF inhibitor Vemurafenib, was subsequently treated with dabrafenib plus trametinib (RAF inhibitor plus MEK inhibitor), and had a partial response for a period of two months (PMID: 28539463).

var_description_zh: AKAP9-BRAF融合蛋白由融合AKAP9的外显子1-8和BRAF的外显子9-18的7号染色体的倒位产生。该融合包含BRAF激酶结构域，但不包括负责Ras结合和自动抑制的BRAF CR1结构域（PMID:15630448）。与野生型BRAF相比，AKAP9-BRAF在COS7细胞中的表达通过增加的激酶活性证明其被激活，并且与野生型BRAF相比，AKAP9-BRAF在NIH-3T3细胞中的表达通过增加的焦点形成证明其被转化（PMID:15630448）。
var_description: The AKAP9-BRAF fusion protein results from an inversion of chromosome 7 that fuses exons 1-8 of AKAP9 and exons 9-18 of BRAF. This fusion contains the BRAF kinase domain, but excludes the BRAF CR1 domain responsible for RAS binding and auto-inhibition (PMID:15630448). Expression of AKAP9-BRAF in COS7 cells demonstrated that it is activating as measured by increased kinase activity compared to wildtype BRAF, and expression of AKAP9-BRAF in NIH-3T3 cells demonstrated that it is transforming as measured by increased foci formation compared to wildtype BRAF (PMID:15630448).

var_description_zh: BRAF T 488_p490del突变位于该蛋白外显子11的激酶结构域。该突变在人细胞系中的表达表明，通过与野生型（PMID:26996308）相当的激酶活性测量，它可能是中性的。
var_description: The BRAF T488_P490del mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 11 of the protein. Expression of this mutation in a human cell line demonstrated that it is likely neutral as measured by kinase activity comparable to wildtype (PMID: 26996308).

var_description_zh: BRAF S151A突变位于蛋白质外显子3中的Ras结合域附近。该突变在NHEM细胞中的表达表明其可能被激活，如通过BRAF与NRAS的结合增加所测量的（PMID:21478863）。由于BRAF的S151残基是ERK对BRAF进行负调节磷酸化的可疑位点，预计该丝氨酸突变为丙氨酸将导致BRAF活性增加（PMID:21478863）。
var_description: The BRAF S151A mutation is located proximal to the RAS-binding domain in exon 3 of the protein. Expression of this mutation in NHEM cells demonstrated that it is likely activating, as measured by increased binding of BRAF to NRAS (PMID: 21478863). As the S151 residue of BRAF is a suspected site of negative-regulatory phosphorylation of BRAF by ERK, mutation of this serine to alanine would be predicted to result in increased BRAF activity (PMID: 21478863).

var_description_zh: AGK-BRAF融合蛋白由7号染色体的倒位产生，其将AGK的前两个外显子与BRAF的外显子8-18融合。AGK-BRAF融合蛋白含有完整的BRAF激酶结构域，但缺少调节Ras结合结构域和富含半胱氨酸（CR1）结构域，它们负责BRAF与Ras的结合和自动抑制（PMID:23890088，24135138）。在黑色素瘤、神经胶质瘤、肺癌、卵巢浆液性癌和儿童切尔诺贝利后甲状腺癌中发现了这种融合（PMID:23890088，24135138，26314551，34568720）。AGK-BRAF在小鼠成纤维细胞中的表达表明，与GFP对照（pMID:24135138）相比，通过在软琼脂中增加的生长和集落形成来测量，该融合是激活和转化的。AGK-BRAF在黑色素瘤细胞系中的体外研究表明，这种融合对索拉非尼敏感，但对维莫非尼不敏感，这是通过药物治疗后的细胞活力来衡量的（PMID:23890088）。在174例对EGFR酪氨酸激酶抑制剂（TKIs）原发性耐药的EGFR突变型肺腺癌中，有3例观察到AGK-BRAF融合。在H1975（EGFR L858R+T790M）、PC9（EGFR Ex19Del）和HCC827（EGFR Ex19Del）细胞系中诱导AGK-BRAF融合的功能研究表明，融合赋予了对EGFR TKIs生长抑制的抗性（PMID:30831205）。
var_description: The AGK-BRAF fusion protein results from an inversion of chromosome 7, which fuses the first two exons of AGK with exons 8-18 of BRAF. The AGK-BRAF fusion protein contains the full BRAF kinase domain, but lacks the regulatory RAS-binding domain and the cysteine-rich (CR1) domain, which are responsible for BRAF binding to RAS and auto-inhibition (PMID: 23890088, 24135138). This fusion has been found in melanoma, glioma, lung cancer, ovarian serous carcinoma and pediatric post-Chernobyl thyroid cancer (PMID: 23890088, 24135138, 26314551, 34568720). Expression of AGK-BRAF in mouse fibroblasts demonstrated that this fusion is activating and transforming as measured by increased growth and colony formation in soft agar compared to GFP control (PMID: 24135138). In vitro studies of AGK-BRAF in melanoma cell lines suggest that this fusion is sensitive to sorafenib but not vemurafenib as measured by cell viability upon drug treatment (PMID: 23890088). AGK-BRAF fusion was observed in 3 of 174 EGFR-mutant lung adenocarcinoma with primary resistance to EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitors (TKIs).  Functional studies with the induction of AGK-BRAF fusion in H1975 ( EGFR L858R + T790M), PC9 (EGFR ex19del) and HCC827 (EGFR ex19del) cell lines demonstrated that the fusion conferred resistance to growth inhibition by EGFR TKIs (PMID: 30831205).

var_description_zh: II类BRAF G469S突变位于蛋白外显子11的激酶结构域（PMID:31470866）。该突变已在恶性黑色素瘤中鉴定，并且是统计学上显著的热点（PMID:16096377）。用表达BRAF G469S的HEK293T细胞进行的体外研究表明，通过与野生型相比增加的磷酸化MEK和ERK水平（PMID:28947956）测量，该突变被激活。在一份病例报告中，一名携带BRAF G469S的转移性黑色素瘤患者接受了曲美替尼和达拉非尼的联合治疗，病情稳定，无进展生存期为3个月（PMID:31569065）。在一项II期试验中，一名携带BRAF G469S的黑色素瘤患者接受了比尼替尼和恩可拉非尼的联合治疗，并显示出未经证实的部分缓解（摘要：Rose等人摘要#531P，肿瘤学年鉴2021。https：//www.annalsofoncology.org/article/S0923-7534%2821%2903282-8/fulltext）。
var_description: The class II BRAF G469S mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 11 of the protein (PMID: 31470866). This mutation has been identified in malignant melanoma and is a statistically significant hotspot (PMID: 16096377). In vitro studies with HEK293T cells expressing BRAF G469S demonstrate that the mutation is activating as measured by increased phosphorylated MEK and ERK levels compared to wildtype (PMID: 28947956). In a case report, a patient with metastatic melanoma harboring BRAF G469S was treated with a combination therapy of trametinib plus dabrafenib and demonstrated stable disease with a progression-free survival of three months (PMID: 31569065). In a Phase II trial, a patient with melanoma harboring BRAF G469S was treated with combination therapy of binimetinib and encorafenib and demonstrated an unconfirmed partial response (Abstract: Rose et al. Abstract# 531P, Annals of Oncology 2021. https://www.annalsofoncology.org/article/S0923-7534%2821%2903282-8/fulltext).

var_description_zh: BRAF N 486_T491del突变位于该蛋白外显子11的激酶结构域。该突变在人细胞系中的表达表明，通过与野生型相比适度增加的激酶活性（PMID:26996308）来测量，它可能是激活的。
var_description: The BRAF N486_T491del mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 11 of the protein. Expression of this mutation in a human cell line demonstrated that it is likely activating as measured by modestly increased kinase activity compared to wildtype (PMID: 26996308).

var_description_zh: III类BRAF D287H突变发生在该蛋白（PMID:28783719）外显子6的富含半胱氨酸的区域。BRAF D287H突变的生物学特征已经证明，它在MAPK途径的激活中是Ras依赖性的，与CRAF作为二聚体发出信号，并且通常与另一种放大Ras信号的驱动机制共同发生（PMID:26343582，28783719）。在黑色素瘤中，D287H变异体与其他III类BRAF突变体相似，预计与激活Ras突变或NF1失活同时发生，而在非小细胞肺癌或结肠直肠癌中，该突变很可能与蛋白水平的受体酪氨酸激酶（RTK）过度激活有关（PMID:28783719）。虽然该突变对靶向抑制剂如曲美替尼的MEK抑制敏感，但对RAF单体抑制剂如维莫非尼（PMID:28783719）不敏感。
var_description: The class III BRAF D287H mutation occurs in the cysteine-rich domain in exon 6 of the protein (PMID: 28783719). Biological characterization of the BRAF D287H mutation has demonstrated that it is RAS dependent in its activation of the MAPK pathway, signals as a dimer with CRAF, and typically co-occurs with another driver mechanism that amplifies RAS signaling (PMID: 26343582, 28783719). In melanoma, the D287H variant, similar to other class III BRAF mutants, would be expected to co-occur with activating RAS mutation or NF1 inactivation, whereas in non-small cell lung or colorectal cancers, this mutation would most likely be associated with receptor tyrosine kinase (RTK) hyperactivation at the protein level (PMID: 28783719). While this mutation is sensitive to MEK inhibition by targeted inhibitors such as trametinib, it is insensitive to RAF monomer inhibitors such as vemurafenib (PMID: 28783719).

var_description_zh: BRAF L485Y突变位于该蛋白的激酶结构域。用表达BRAF L485Y的HT29细胞进行的体外研究证明了对用GDC0879处理的抗性，如通过处理后的持续细胞增殖所测量的（PMID:19276360）。
var_description: The BRAF L485Y mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein. In vitro studies with HT29 cells expressing BRAF L485Y demonstrated resistance to treatment with GDC0879 as measured by sustained cellular proliferation following treatment (PMID: 19276360).

var_description_zh: III类BRAF G469E突变位于蛋白外显子11的激酶结构域（PMID:28783719）。该突变已在黑色素瘤、肺癌、结肠直肠癌和心面皮肤综合征中报道（PMID:26498038，18794803，16439621）。BRAF G469E突变的生物学特征已经证明，它在MAPK途径的激活中是Ras依赖性的，与CRAF作为二聚体发出信号，并且通常与另一种放大Ras信号的驱动机制共同发生（PMID:15035987，28783719，15150094，22510884）。因此，在黑色素瘤中，与其他III类BRAF突变体相似，G469E变体预计将与激活Ras突变或NF1失活同时发生，而在非小细胞肺癌或结肠直肠癌中，该突变很可能与蛋白水平的受体酪氨酸激酶（RTK）过度激活有关（PMID:28783719）。用表达BRAF G469E的黑色素瘤细胞进行的临床前研究证明了对索拉非尼治疗的敏感性（通过抑制生长和诱导凋亡来测量）和对U0126治疗的抗性（通过持续细胞生长来测量）（PMID:18794803）。在一项II期临床试验中，一名携带BRAF G469E的乳腺导管癌患者接受了曲美替尼治疗，结果显示部分缓解，肿瘤缩小50%（PMID:31924734）。
var_description: The class III BRAF G469E mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 11 of the protein (PMID: 28783719). This mutation has been reported in melanoma, lung cancer, colorectal cancer and cardio-facio-cutaneous syndrome (PMID: 26498038, 18794803, 16439621). Biological characterization of the BRAF G469E mutation has demonstrated that it is RAS dependent in its activation of the MAPK pathway, signals as a dimer with CRAF, and typically co-occurs with another driver mechanism that amplifies RAS signaling (PMID: 15035987, 28783719, 15150094, 22510884). Thus, in melanoma, the G469E variant, similar to other class III BRAF mutants, would be expected to co-occur with activating RAS mutation or NF1 inactivation, whereas in non-small cell lung or colorectal cancers, this mutation would most likely be associated with receptor tyrosine kinase (RTK) hyperactivation at the protein level (PMID: 28783719). Preclinical studies with melanoma cells expressing BRAF G469E demonstrated sensitivity to treatment with sorafenib, as measured by inhibition of growth and induced apoptosis, and resistance to treatment with U0126, as measured by persistent cell growth (PMID: 18794803). In a Phase II trial, a patient with breast ductal carcinoma harboring BRAF G469E was treated with trametinib and demonstrated partial response with a 50% tumor size reduction (PMID: 31924734).

var_description_zh: BRAF激酶结构域（BRAF-KDD）的复制发生在内含子9的断裂点，并导致外显子10-18的复制，以产生具有第二个激酶结构域和可选的3非翻译区的约140kDa的蛋白质。在肺癌、黑色素瘤和其他肿瘤中发现了这种改变（PMID:32913992，27320919，26562024）。用表达BRAF-KDD的HEK293T细胞进行的体外研究表明，与对照相比，通过增加的下游MAPK途径信号传导所测量的突变是激活的（PMID:27320919）。对携带BRAF-KDD的多种肿瘤类型的临床样品的测序数据的分析也证明，通过增加的BRAF mRNA和CCND1表达测量，突变被激活，证明MAPK信号的激活增加（PMID:26562024）。基于BRAF-KDD在BRAF V600E阳性细胞中的临床前研究，预测BRAF-KDD的致癌功能是二聚化依赖性的，该研究显示了对pan-RAF二聚化抑制剂LY3009120（PMID:27320919）的敏感性。在表达激酶结构域复制的BRAF V600E阳性细胞中敲低BRAF-KDD表明恢复了对BRAF抑制剂如达拉非尼的敏感性（PMID:27320919）。
var_description: Duplication of the BRAF kinase domain (BRAF-KDD) occurs from a breakpoint in intron 9 and results in a duplication of exons 10-18 to generate a protein that is approximately 140 kDa with a second kinase domain and an alternative 3' untranslated region. This alteration has been found in lung cancer, melanoma and others (PMID: 32913992, 27320919, 26562024). In vitro studies with HEK293T cells expressing BRAF-KDD demonstrate that the mutation is activating as measured by increased downstream MAPK pathway signaling compared to control (PMID: 27320919). Analysis from sequencing data of clinical samples across multiple tumor types harboring BRAF-KDD also demonstrates that the mutation is activating as measured by increased BRAF mRNA and CCND1 expression, demonstrating increased activation of MAPK signaling (PMID: 26562024). The oncogenic function of BRAF-KDD is predicted to be dimerization-dependent based on preclinical studies of BRAF-KDD in BRAF V600E-positive cells demonstrating sensitivity to pan-RAF dimerization inhibitor LY3009120 (PMID: 27320919). Knockdown of BRAF-KDD in BRAF V600E-positive cells expressing the kinase domain duplication demonstrated restored sensitivity to BRAF inhibitors such as dabrafenib (PMID: 27320919).

var_description_zh: BRAF G615R突变位于该蛋白的激酶结构域。用表达BRAF G615R的MCF10A细胞进行的体外研究表明，通过与野生型（PMID:29533785）相比降低的细胞增殖和生存力来测量，该突变是失活的。
var_description: The BRAF G615R mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein. In vitro studies with MCF10A cells expressing BRAF G615R demonstrate that the mutation is inactivating as measured by decreased cell proliferation and viability comparable to wildtype (PMID: 29533785).

var_description_zh: BRAF T241P突变位于蛋白外显子6的富含半胱氨酸区域。该突变已在心脏-面部-皮肤综合征（CFC）中发现（PMID:19206169）。该突变在NIH-3T3细胞中的表达表明，与野生型BRAF（pMID:19206169）相比，通过MEK和ERK的适度增加的激活和轻微增加的集落形成来测量，该突变可能是激活的。
var_description: The BRAF T241P mutation is located in the cysteine-rich domain in exon 6 of the protein. This mutation has been found in cardio-facio-cutaneous syndrome (CFC) (PMID: 19206169). Expression of this mutation in NIH-3T3 cells demonstrated that it is likely activating as measured by moderately increased activation of MEK and ERK and slightly increased colony formation compared to wildtype BRAF (PMID: 19206169).

var_description_zh: III类BRAF G596C突变位于BRAF蛋白的激酶结构域（PMID:28947956）。该突变已在非小细胞肺癌等中发现（PMID:28947956）。体外实验已经证明，通过与野生型对照相比增加的下游信号来测量，该突变是激活的（PMID:28947956）。BRAF G596C突变赋予对RAF抑制剂达拉非尼的抗性，但保留对MEK抑制剂曲美替尼的敏感性，如通过MAPK途径激活所测量的（PMID:28947956）。
var_description: The class III BRAF G596C mutation is located in the kinase domain of the BRAF protein (PMID: 28947956). This mutation has been found in non-small cell lung cancers, among others (PMID: 28947956). In vitro experiments have demonstrated that this mutation is activating as measured by increased downstream signaling compared to wildtype controls (PMID: 28947956). The BRAF G596C mutation confers resistance to the RAF inhibitor dabrafenib, but retains sensitivity to MEK inhibitor trametinib, as measured by MAPK pathway activation (PMID: 28947956).

var_description_zh: BRAF N486del突变位于蛋白外显子11的激酶结构域。该突变在人细胞系中的表达表明，通过与野生型（PMID:26996308）相当的激酶活性测量，它可能是中性的。
var_description: The BRAF N486del mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 11 of the protein. Expression of this mutation in a human cell line demonstrated that it is likely neutral as measured by kinase activity comparable to wildtype (PMID: 26996308).

var_description_zh: BRAF E501K突变位于BRAF蛋白的激酶结构域。该突变在努南综合征和心面皮肤综合征中被发现为种系突变（PMID:17603482，16474404）。体外研究表明，与对照相比，通过具有第二个BRAF突变的细胞系中降低的BRAF激酶活性来测量，该突变可能失活（PMID:17603482）。然而，另一项体外研究发现，与野生型相比，下游途径输出增加（PMID:16474404）。在泛癌症基因组数据分析（PMID:33507258）中，由于携带突变的肿瘤中Ras调控基因的富集，BRAF E501K被认为是Ras依赖性的。
var_description: The BRAF E501K mutation is located in the kinase domain of the BRAF protein. This mutation has been found as a germline mutation in Noonan syndrome and cardio-facio-cutaneous syndrome (PMID: 17603482, 16474404).
