In vitro studies have demonstrated that this mutation might be inactivating as measured by decreased BRAF kinase activity in a cell line with a second BRAF mutation compared to controls (PMID: 17603482). However, another in vitro study found increased downstream pathway output compared to wildtype (PMID: 16474404). BRAF E501K is suggested to be RAS-dependent due to enrichment of RAS regulatory genes in tumors harboring the mutation in a pan-cancer genomic data analysis (PMID: 33507258).

var_description_zh: BRAF P162S突变位于该蛋白的RBD结构域。该突变已在胆道癌中鉴定（PMID:29360550）。用表达BRAF p162S的BA/F3和MCF10A细胞进行的体外研究表明，通过与野生型（PMID:29533785）相比的细胞增殖和生存力测量，该突变可能是中性的。
var_description: The BRAF P162S mutation is located in the RBD domain of the protein. This mutation has been identified in biliary tract cancer (PMID: 29360550). In vitro studies with Ba/F3 and MCF10A cells expressing BRAF P162S demonstrate that the mutation is likely neutral as measured by cellular proliferation and viability comparable to wildtype (PMID: 29533785).

var_description_zh: III类BRAF D594Y突变位于该蛋白（PMID:30224342）外显子15的激酶结构域中。该突变已在肺腺癌和卵巢癌中鉴定（PMID:28481359，31477716）。对BRAF改变的肺癌患者的分析表明，BRAF D594Y具有受损的激酶功能（PMID:32913992）。作为BRAF III类突变，提示BRAF D594Y对靶向抑制剂（如曲美替尼）抑制MEK敏感，而对RAF单体抑制剂（如维莫非尼）不敏感（PMID:28783719）。
var_description: The class III BRAF D594Y mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 15 of the protein (PMID: 30224342). This mutation has been identified in lung adenocarcinoma and ovarian cancer (PMID: 28481359, 31477716). Analysis of patients with BRAF-altered lung cancers demonstrated that BRAF D594Y has impaired kinase function (PMID: 32913992). As a BRAF class III mutation, it is suggested that BRAF D594Y is sensitive to MEK inhibition by targeted inhibitors such as trametinib and insensitive to RAF monomer inhibitors such as vemurafenib (PMID: 28783719).

var_description_zh: BRAF I572F突变位于该蛋白的激酶结构域。该突变已在肺腺癌中鉴定（PMID:28481359）。一名携带BRAF I572F和KRAS G12V的肺腺癌患者接受了纳武单抗治疗，并表现出疾病进展（PMID:34963703），尽管该患者本身没有功能特征。
var_description: The BRAF I572F mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein. This mutation has been identified in lung adenocarcinoma (PMID: 28481359). Although not functionally characterized per se, a patient with lung adenocarcinoma harboring BRAF I572F and KRAS G12V was treated with nivolumab and demonstrated progressive disease (PMID: 34963703).

var_description_zh: MKRN1-BRAF融合由融合MKRN1的外显子1-4和BRAF的外显子11-18的7号染色体的倒位产生（PMID:23817572）。该融合体包含BRAF激酶结构域，但不包括负责Ras结合和自动抑制的富含半胱氨酸（CR1）结构域（PMID:15630448）。该突变已在小儿毛细胞性星形细胞瘤、结直肠癌、头颈癌和卵巢浆液性癌中发现（PMID:23817572，26314551，26324360，34568720）。虽然该融合尚未得到功能验证，但含有BRAF的外显子11-18的其他融合（例如，AKAP9-BRAF，KIAA1549-BRAF）已被证明是活化的和致癌的（PMID:15630448，18974108，23817572）。在一名低级别浆液性卵巢癌患者中检测到MKRN1-BRAF融合，该患者对司美替尼和紫杉醇的联合治疗获得了持续的完全缓解（PMID:26324360，34568720）。
var_description: The MKRN1-BRAF fusion results from an inversion of chromosome 7 that fuses exons 1-4 of MKRN1 and exons 11-18 of BRAF (PMID: 23817572). This fusion contains the BRAF kinase domain but excludes the BRAF cysteine-rich (CR1) domain responsible for RAS binding and auto-inhibition (PMID:15630448). This mutation has been found in pediatric pilocytic astrocytoma, colorectal cancer, head and neck cancer, and ovarian serous cancer (PMID: 23817572, 26314551, 26324360, 34568720). While this fusion has not been functionally validated, other fusions that contain exons 11-18 of BRAF (e.g., AKAP9-BRAF, KIAA1549-BRAF) have been shown to be activating and oncogenic (PMID: 15630448, 18974108, 23817572). The MKRN1-BRAF fusion was detected in a patient with low-grade serous ovarian cancer who achieved a sustained complete response to combination selumetinib and paclitaxel (PMID: 26324360, 34568720).

var_description_zh: CLCN6-BRAF融合由融合CLCN6的外显子2和BRAF的外显子11的染色体重排产生，保留了BRAF激酶结构域。这种融合已在毛细胞性星形细胞瘤中得到鉴定（PMID:23817572）。用表达ClCN6-BRAF的NIH3T3细胞进行的体外研究表明，通过与载体对照相比增加的磷酸化ERK水平（pMID:29156677）来测量，融合是活化的。用表达融合蛋白的NIH3T3细胞进行的临床前研究表明，通过抑制集落形成（PMID:29156677），曲美替尼对治疗具有敏感性。
var_description: The CLCN6-BRAF fusion results from a chromosomal rearrangement fusing exon 2 of CLCN6 and exon 11 of BRAF, retaining the BRAF kinase domain. This fusion has been identified in pilocytic astrocytoma (PMID: 23817572). In vitro studies with NIH3T3 cells expressing CLCN6-BRAF demonstrate that the fusion is activating as measured by increased phosphorylated ERK levels compared to vector control (PMID: 29156677). Preclinical studies with NIH3T3 cells expressing the fusion demonstrated sensitivity to treatment with trametinib as measured by inhibition of colony formation (PMID: 29156677).

var_description_zh: II类BRAF T599I突变位于蛋白质外显子15中的激酶结构域（摘要：Severson等人摘要#40p，肿瘤学年鉴2022.https：//www.annalsofoncology.org/article/S0923-7534%2822%2900058-8/fulltext）。该突变在COS细胞中的表达表明，与野生型BRAF（PMID:15035987）相比，通过增加的激酶活性和下游ERK激活来测量，该突变是激活的。在一份病例报告中，一名携带BRAF T599I的转移性黑色素瘤患者接受了维莫非尼治疗，并显示出对治疗的临床反应（PMID:29232305）。
var_description: The class II BRAF T599I mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 15 of the protein (Abstract: Severson et al. Abstract #40P, Annals of Oncology 2022. https://www.annalsofoncology.org/article/S0923-7534%2822%2900058-8/fulltext). Expression of this mutation in COS cells demonstrated that it is activating as measured by increased kinase activity and downstream ERK activation compared to wildtype BRAF (PMID: 15035987). In a case report, a patient with metastatic melanoma harboring BRAF T599I was treated with vemurafenib and demonstrated a clinical response to treatment (PMID: 29232305).

var_description_zh: BRAF W450L突变位于BRAF蛋白的激酶结构域。该突变已在肺癌等中发现（PMID:27478040）。体外研究表明，与野生型（PMID:27478040）相比，通过下游信号测定，该突变可能是中性的。
var_description: The BRAF W450L mutation is located in the kinase domain of the BRAF protein. This mutation has been found in lung cancers, among others (PMID: 27478040). In vitro studies have demonstrated that this mutation is likely neutral as measured by downstream signaling compared to wildtype (PMID: 27478040).

var_description_zh: BRAF P367S突变位于该蛋白的未知功能域。该突变已在黑色素瘤中鉴定（PMID:24265153）。用表达BRAF p367S的BA/F3细胞进行的体外研究表明，通过与野生型相比增加的转化能力（PMID:29533785）来测量，突变是激活的。
var_description: The BRAF P367S mutation is located in an unknown functional domain of the protein. This mutation has been identified in melanoma (PMID: 24265153). In vitro studies with Ba/F3 cells expressing BRAF P367S demonstrate that the mutation is activating as measured by increased transformation ability compared to wildtype (PMID: 29533785).

var_description_zh: I类激活外显子15 BRAF V600R错义突变位于BRAF蛋白的激酶结构域（PMID:28783719）。BRAF V600R是第三个最常见的突变，发生在5-7%的BRAF突变黑色素瘤患者中（PMID:22536370，23237741，22614978）。BRAF V600R突变的全面生物学表征表明，该突变独立于Ras激活下游MAPK途径，并使BRAF以单体形式组成性激活（PMID:15035987，28783719，26343582，20179705）。用表达BRAF V600R的黑色素瘤细胞进行的临床前研究证明了对AZ628、Tak-632、PLX7904、维莫非尼和达拉非尼治疗的敏感性，如通过细胞增殖抑制所测量的（PMID:27523909）。在一份病例报告中，一名携带BRAF V600R的黑色素瘤患者接受了达拉非尼和曲美替尼的联合治疗，并显示出部分缓解，无进展生存期为52.2个月（PMID:36039514）。在另一份病例报告中，一名携带BRAF V600R的黑色素瘤患者接受了达拉非尼治疗，结果显示部分缓解，病变减少，无进展生存期为7个月（PMID:27255157）。
var_description: The class I activating exon 15 BRAF V600R missense mutation is located in the kinase domain of the BRAF protein (PMID: 28783719). BRAF V600R is the third most common mutation occurring in 5-7% of patients with BRAF-mutant melanoma (PMID: 22536370, 23237741, 22614978). Comprehensive biological characterization of the BRAF V600R mutation has demonstrated that this mutation activates the downstream MAPK pathway independently of RAS and renders BRAF constitutively activated in monomeric form (PMID: 15035987, 28783719, 26343582, 20179705). Preclinical studies with melanoma cells expressing BRAF V600R demonstrate sensitivity to treatment with AZ628, TAK-632, PLX7904, vemurafenib and dabrafenib as measured by inhibition of cellular proliferation (PMID: 27523909). In a case report, a patient with melanoma harboring BRAF V600R was treated with a combination therapy of dabrafenib plus trametinib and demonstrated partial response with a progression-free survival of 52.2 months (PMID: 36039514). In another case report, a patient with melanoma harboring BRAF V600R was treated with dabrafenib and demonstrated partial response with lesion reduction and progression-free survival of seven months (PMID: 27255157).

var_description_zh: I类（PMID:28783719）激活外显子15 BRAF V600K错义突变位于BRAF蛋白的激酶结构域中。BRAF V600改变（主要是V600E）在肺癌（PMID:25079552，23833300）和甲状腺癌（PMID:25417114）等癌症中复发。在转移性黑色素瘤中，V600K突变的频率仅次于最常见的BRAF改变V600E（PMID:26091043）。对携带激活BRAF突变的转移性黑色素瘤患者的临床病理特征和预后的分析显示，与V600E相比，V600K突变与男性、年龄较大（中位年龄）、头/颈部原发肿瘤位置、较短的IV期疾病间隔时间和较短的IV期疾病诊断时间的总生存期显著相关（PMID:23922205，22535154）。BRAF V600K突变（PMID:15035987，26343582）的综合生物学特征表明，该突变独立于Ras激活下游MAPK途径（PMID:19251651，26343582），使BRAF以单体形式组成性激活（PMID:20179705），并保持对RAF单体抑制剂如维莫非尼的敏感性（PMID:26343582，28783719，20179705）。初步研究表明，由于对MAPK途径的依赖性降低，BRAF V600K突变肿瘤可能对BRAF和MEK的联合抑制以及BRAF V600E肿瘤没有反应，但需要进一步的研究来验证这一发现（PMID:30630828）。
var_description: The class I (PMID: 28783719) activating exon 15 BRAF V600K missense mutation is located in the kinase domain of the BRAF protein. BRAF V600 alterations (predominantly V600E) are recurrent in lung (PMID: 25079552, 23833300) and thyroid (PMID: 25417114) cancers, among others. In metastatic melanoma, frequency of V600K mutation is second only to V600E, the most common BRAF alteration (PMID: 26091043). Analysis of clinicopathologic features and outcome in patients with metastatic melanoma harboring activating BRAF mutations revealed that, compared to V600E, V600K mutation was significantly associated with male sex, older age (median age, head/neck primary tumor location, shorter interval to stage IV disease, and shorter overall survival from the time of diagnosis of stage IV disease (PMID: 23922205, 22535154). Comprehensive biological characterization of BRAF V600K mutation (PMID: 15035987, 26343582) has demonstrated that this mutation activates the downstream MAPK pathway independently of RAS (PMID: 19251651, 26343582), renders BRAF constitutively activated in monomeric form (PMID: 20179705) and retains sensitivity to RAF monomer inhibitors such as vemurafenib (PMID: 26343582, 28783719, 20179705). Preliminary studies suggest that BRAF V600K mutant tumors may not respond to combined BRAF and MEK inhibition as well as BRAF V600E tumors due to a decreased reliance on the MAPK pathway, though further studies are needed to validate this finding (PMID: 30630828).

var_description_zh: BRAF L514V突变位于蛋白的激酶结构域的ATP结合口袋中。该突变是在一名BRAF V600E突变型间变性神经节细胞胶质瘤患者中发现的，该患者在接受达拉非尼治疗后出现进展（PMID:29880583）。该突变在人类细胞中与BRAF V600E的顺式共表达表明，它正在激活，促进二聚化，并赋予对I型αC-OUT/DFG-IN BRAF抑制剂如维莫非尼和达拉非尼的抗性（PMID:29880583）。BRAF L514V突变显示对RAF二聚体抑制剂如BGB3245（PMID:29880583）的抑制敏感。
var_description: The BRAF L514V mutation is located in the ATP binding pocket of the kinase domain of the protein. This mutation was found in a patient with BRAF V600E-mutant anaplastic ganglioglioma who progressed on treatment with dabrafenib (PMID: 29880583). Co-expression of this mutation in human cells with BRAF V600E in cis demonstrated that it is activating, promotes dimerization, and confers resistance to type I αC-OUT/DFG-IN BRAF inhibitors such as vemurafenib and dabrafenib (PMID: 29880583). The BRAF L514V mutation was shown to be sensitive to inhibition with RAF dimer inhibitors, such as BGB3245 (PMID: 29880583).

var_description_zh: BRAF-pJA2融合蛋白由pJA2的外显子7与BRAF的外显子11融合产生，保留了BRAF激酶结构域。这种融合已经在EGFR突变肺癌中得到鉴定（PMID:30831205）。用表达BRAF-pJA2的H1975和PC9细胞进行的临床前研究表明，通过治疗后的持续细胞活力（PMID:30831205）测量，融合对奥西替尼治疗具有抗性。
var_description: The BRAF-PJA2 fusion protein results from exon 7 of PJA2 fusing with exon 11 of BRAF, retaining the BRAF kinase domain. This fusion has been identified in EGFR-mutant lung cancer (PMID: 30831205). Preclinical studies with H1975 and PC9 cells expressing BRAF-PJA2 demonstrated the fusion is resistant to treatment with osimertinib as measured by sustained cell viability following treatment (PMID: 30831205).

var_description_zh: BRAF L485S突变位于该蛋白的激酶结构域。尽管没有对其本身进行功能表征，但用表达BRAF L485S的A375细胞进行的体外研究表明，如通过持续细胞生长（PMID:31925410）所测量的，该突变赋予对达拉非尼治疗的抗性。
var_description: The BRAF L485S mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein. Although not functionally characterized per se, in vitro studies with A375 cells expressing BRAF L485S demonstrate that the mutation confers resistance to treatment with dabrafenib as measured by sustained cell growth (PMID: 31925410).

var_description_zh: BRAF K698R突变位于该蛋白的激酶结构域。用BA/F3细胞和表达BRAF K698R的MCF10A细胞进行的体外研究表明，如通过与野生型（PMID:29533785）相当的细胞增殖和生存力所测量的，突变可能是中性的。
var_description: The BRAF K698R mutation is located in the kinase domain of the protein. In vitro studies with Ba/F3 cells and MCF10A cells expressing BRAF K698R demonstrate that the mutation is likely neutral as measured by cell proliferation and viability comparable to wildtype (PMID: 29533785).

var_description_zh: III类BRAF D594A突变位于蛋白外显子15的激酶结构域（PMID:20141835，28783719）。该突变已在黑色素瘤、肺癌和结直肠癌中反复发现（PMID:20141835，28481359）。BRAF D594A突变的生物学特征已经证明，它在MAPK途径的激活中是Ras依赖性的，与CRAF作为二聚体发出信号，并且通常与另一种放大Ras信号的驱动机制共同发生（PMID:20141835，28783719）。因此，当在黑色素瘤中观察到BRAF D594A时，它通常与活化Ras突变或NF1失活同时发生，而当在非小细胞肺癌或结肠直肠癌中观察到时，它与蛋白水平的受体酪氨酸激酶（RTK）过度活化有关（PMID:28783719，20141835）。虽然该突变对靶向抑制剂如曲美替尼的MEK抑制敏感，但对RAF单体抑制剂如维莫非尼（PMID:28783719）不敏感。
var_description: The class III BRAF D594A mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 15 of the protein (PMID: 20141835, 28783719). This mutation has been recurrently found in melanoma, lung and colorectal cancers (PMID: 20141835, 28481359). Biological characterization of the BRAF D594A mutation has demonstrated that it is RAS dependent in its activation of the MAPK pathway, signals as a dimer with CRAF, and typically co-occurs with another driver mechanism that amplifies RAS signaling (PMID: 20141835, 28783719). Thus, when BRAF D594A is observed in melanoma, it typically co-occurs with an activating RAS mutation or NF1 inactivation, whereas when observed in non-small cell lung or colorectal cancers, it is associated with receptor tyrosine kinase (RTK) hyperactivation at the protein level (PMID: 28783719, 20141835). While this mutation is sensitive to MEK inhibition by targeted inhibitors such as trametinib, it is insensitive to RAF monomer inhibitors such as vemurafenib (PMID: 28783719).

var_description_zh: III类BRAF S467A突变位于蛋白（PMID:35050937）外显子11的激酶结构域中。该突变已在心脏-面部-皮肤综合征中发现（PMID:16439621）。与野生型BRAF（PMID:16439621）相比，该突变在293T细胞中的表达表明该突变是激活的，如通过下游MAPK效应子的激活增加所测量的。当在斑马鱼胚胎中表达时，BRAF S467A突变导致与BRAF V600E相同的异常延伸表型，表明其可能在体内激活（PMID:19376813）。
var_description: The class III BRAF S467A mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 11 of the protein (PMID: 35050937). This mutation has been found in cardio-facio-cutaneous syndrome (PMID: 16439621). Expression of this mutation in 293T cells demonstrated that this mutation is activating as measured by increased activation of downstream MAPK effectors compared to wildtype BRAF (PMID: 16439621). When expressed in zebrafish embryos, the BRAF S467A mutation causes the same aberrant elongation phenotype as BRAF V600E, suggesting that it is likely activating in vivo (PMID: 19376813).

var_description_zh: SEPT3-BRAF融合是由于染色体重排融合了SEPT3的外显子10和BRAF的外显子8，保留了完整的激酶结构域，失去了BRAF的抑制性RBD结构域。用表达SEPT3-BRAF的患者来源的异种移植物模型进行的体内研究表明，通过与野生型相比增加的细胞增殖和侵袭来测量，融合是活化的（PMID:30254212）。
var_description: The SEPT3-BRAF fusion results from chromosomal rearrangement fusing exon 10 of SEPT3 and exon 8 of BRAF, retaining the full kinase domain and losing the inhibitory RBD domain of BRAF. In vivo studies with patient-derived xenograft models expressing SEPT3-BRAF demonstrate that the fusion is activating as measured by increased cellular proliferation and invasion compared to wildtype (PMID: 30254212).

var_description_zh: BRAF G258V突变位于蛋白的锌指结构域。该突变已在神经胶质瘤中鉴定（PMID:28852847）。用表达BRAF G258V的BA/F3细胞进行的体外研究表明，通过与野生型相比增加的转化能力（PMID:29533785）来测量，该突变是激活的。
var_description: The BRAF G258V mutation is located in the zinc finger domain of the protein. This mutation has been identified in glioma (PMID: 28852847). In vitro studies with Ba/F3 cells expressing BRAF G258V demonstrate that the mutation is activating as measured by increased transformation ability compared to wildtype (PMID: 29533785).

var_description_zh: BRAF N 486_A489del突变位于该蛋白外显子11的激酶结构域。该突变在人细胞系中的表达表明，通过与野生型相比适度增加的激酶活性（PMID:26996308）来测量，它可能是激活的。
var_description: The BRAF N486_A489del mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 11 of the protein. Expression of this mutation in a human cell line demonstrated that it is likely activating as measured by modestly increased kinase activity compared to wildtype (PMID: 26996308).

var_description_zh: III类BRAF F247L突变位于BRAF蛋白的Ras结合和激酶自动抑制结构域（PMID:31515458）。该突变已在结直肠癌等中发现（PMID:31515458）。体外研究表明，与野生型相比，该突变通过增加的下游信号传导而被激活（PMID:28512244，29533785）。一名携带BRAF F247L的转移性结直肠癌患者接受了FOLFIRI联合西妥昔单抗治疗，结果显示完全缓解，无进展生存期为12.6个月（PMID:31515458）。
var_description: The class III BRAF F247L mutation is located in the RAS binding and kinase autoinhibitory domain of the BRAF protein (PMID: 31515458). This mutation has been found in colorectal cancers, among others (PMID: 31515458). In vitro studies have demonstrated that this mutation is activating as measured by increased downstream signaling compared to wildtype (PMID: 28512244, 29533785). A patient with metastatic colorectal cancer harboring BRAF F247L was treated with a combination therapy of FOLFIRI plus cetuximab and demonstrated a complete response with a progression-free survival of 12.6 months (PMID: 31515458).

var_description_zh: II类BRAF A598V突变位于蛋白（PMID:34794740）外显子15的激酶结构域中。在甲状腺乳头状癌中发现了这种突变（PMID:19200582）。患者样品中BRAF A598V的体外研究表明，与野生型BRAF相比，通过增加的磷酸化MEK和ERK水平测量，该突变被激活（PMID:19200582）。用表达BRAF A598V的患者来源的循环肿瘤细胞进行的临床前研究表明，通过治疗后的持续检测（PMID:33731038），对BRAF/MEK抑制剂达拉非尼和曲美替尼的联合治疗具有耐药性。
var_description: The class II BRAF A598V mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 15 of the protein (PMID: 34794740). This mutation has been found in papillary thyroid carcinoma (PMID: 19200582). In vitro studies of BRAF A598V in patient samples have demonstrated that this mutation is activating as measured by increased phosphorylated MEK and ERK levels compared to wildtype BRAF (PMID: 19200582). Preclinical studies with patient-derived circulating tumor cells expressing BRAF A598V demonstrate resistance to combination treatment with BRAF/MEK inhibitors dabrafenib and trametinib as measured by sustained detection following treatment (PMID: 33731038).

var_description_zh: III类低激活外显子6 BRAF V459L错义突变发生在该蛋白的富含半胱氨酸结构域（PMID:28783719）。该突变在肺癌和黑色素瘤中已有报道（PMID:12460918）。BRAF V459L作为与CRAF的二聚体发出信号，在其MAPK途径的激活中是Ras依赖性的，并且在肿瘤中，通常与放大Ras信号的另一驱动机制共同发生（PMID:28783719）。因此，与其他III类BRAF突变体一样，在黑色素瘤中，预期V459L变体与激活Ras突变或NF1失活同时发生，而在非小细胞肺癌和结肠直肠癌中，该突变很可能与蛋白水平的受体酪氨酸激酶（RTK）过度激活有关（PMID:28783719）。虽然该突变对靶向抑制剂（如曲美替尼）的MEK抑制敏感，但对RAF单体抑制剂（如维莫非尼）不敏感。
var_description: The class III hypoactivating exon 6 BRAF V459L missense mutation occurs in the cysteine-rich domain of the protein (PMID: 28783719). This mutation has been reported in lung cancer and melanoma (PMID: 12460918). BRAF V459L signals as a dimer with CRAF, is RAS-dependent in its activation of the MAPK pathway, and, in tumors, would typically co-occur with another driver mechanism that amplifies RAS signaling (PMID: 28783719). Thus, like other class III BRAF mutants, in melanoma, the V459L variant would be expected to co-occur with activating RAS mutation or NF1 inactivation, whereas in non-small cell lung and colorectal cancers, this mutation would most likely be associated with receptor tyrosine kinase (RTK) hyperactivation at the protein level (PMID: 28783719). While this mutation is sensitive to MEK inhibition by targeted inhibitors such as trametinib, it is insensitive to RAF monomer inhibitors such as vemurafenib.

var_description_zh: BRAF T 599_V600insv突变位于该蛋白外显子15的激酶结构域。在甲状腺乳头状癌中发现了这种突变（PMID:16501605）。与野生型BRAF相比，BRAF T 599_V600insv在HEK293或NIH-3T3细胞中的表达证明其正在活化和转化，如通过增加的激酶活性、增加的下游途径活化和增加的病灶形成所测量的（pMID:16501605）。
var_description: The BRAF T599_V600insV mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 15 of the protein. This mutation has been found in papillary thyroid carcinoma (PMID: 16501605). Expression of BRAF T599_V600insV in HEK293 or NIH-3T3 cells demonstrated that it is activating and transforming as measured by increased kinase activity, increased downstream pathway activation, and increased foci formation compared to wildtype BRAF (PMID: 16501605).

var_description_zh: BRAF p731S突变位于该蛋白的未知功能域。该突变已在黑色素瘤中鉴定（PMID:22817889）。用表达BRAF p731S的BA/F3细胞进行的体外研究表明，通过与野生型相比增加的转化能力（PMID:29533785）来测量，该突变是激活的。
var_description: The BRAF P731S mutation is located in an unknown functional domain of the protein. This mutation has been identified in melanoma (PMID: 22817889). In vitro studies with Ba/F3 cells expressing BRAF P731S demonstrate that the mutation is activating as measured by increased transformation ability compared to wildtype (PMID: 29533785).

var_description_zh: BRAF E46K突变位于蛋白的N末端。用表达BRAF E46K的293FT细胞进行的体外研究表明，与野生型（PMID:31606273）相比，通过增加与HRAs的结合来测量，该突变被激活。
var_description: The BRAF E46K mutation is located in the N-terminus of the protein. In vitro studies with 293FT cells expressing BRAF E46K demonstrate that the mutation is activating as measured by increased binding to HRAS compared to wildtype (PMID: 31606273).

var_description_zh: BRAF T401I突变位于蛋白质的未知功能域。用BA/F3细胞和表达BRAF T401I的MCF10A细胞进行的体外研究表明，如通过与野生型（PMID:29533785）相当的细胞增殖和生存力所测量的，突变可能是中性的。
var_description: The BRAF T401I mutation is located in an unknown functional domain of the protein. In vitro studies with Ba/F3 cells and MCF10A cells expressing BRAF T401I demonstrate that the mutation is likely neutral as measured by cell proliferation and viability comparable to wildtype (PMID: 29533785).

var_description_zh: BRAF F259L突变位于蛋白的锌指结构域。该突变已在结直肠癌中鉴定（PMID:28002797）。用BA/F3细胞和表达BRAF F259L的MCF10A细胞进行的体外研究表明，如通过与野生型（PMID:29533785）相当的细胞增殖和生存力所测量的，突变可能是中性的。
var_description: The BRAF F259L mutation is located in the zinc finger domain of the protein. This mutation has been identified in colorectal cancer (PMID: 28002797). In vitro studies with Ba/F3 cells and MCF10A cells expressing BRAF F259L demonstrate that the mutation is likely neutral as measured by cell proliferation and viability comparable to wildtype (PMID: 29533785).

var_description_zh: GNAI1-BRAF融合由融合GNAI1的外显子1和BRAF的外显子10的染色体重排产生。这种融合已在毛细胞性星形细胞瘤中得到鉴定（PMID:23817572）。用表达GNAI1-BRAF的NIH3T3细胞进行的体外研究表明，通过与载体对照相比增加的磷酸化ERK水平（pMID:29156677）来测量，融合是活化的。用表达融合蛋白的NIH3T3细胞进行的临床前研究证明了曲美替尼治疗的敏感性，如通过集落形成的抑制所测量的（PMID:29156677）。
var_description: The GNAI1-BRAF fusion results from a chromosomal rearrangement fusing exon 1 of GNAI1 and exon 10 of BRAF. This fusion has been identified in pilocytic astrocytoma (PMID: 23817572). In vitro studies with NIH3T3 cells expressing GNAI1-BRAF demonstrate that the fusion is activating as measured by increased phosphorylated ERK levels compared to vector control (PMID: 29156677). Preclinical studies with NIH3T3 cells expressing the fusion demonstrated sensitivity to treatment with trametinib as measured by inhibition of colony formation (PMID: 29156677).

var_description_zh: ZKSCAN1-BRAF融合蛋白将ZKSCAN1的N末端与BRAF的C末端连接，产生含有BRAF激酶结构域但缺少BRAFCR1调节结构域的融合蛋白。虽然这种融合尚未得到功能验证，但其他缺乏BRAF CR1调节域的BRAF融合（如KIAA 1549-BRAF融合）已被证明具有激活和致癌作用。在一名对MEK抑制剂曲美替尼（PMID:26314551）有反应的Spitzoid黑色素瘤患者中发现了ZKSCAN1-BRAF融合。
var_description: The ZKSCAN1-BRAF fusion joins the N-terminus of ZKSCAN1 with the C-terminus of BRAF, resulting in a fusion protein containing the BRAF kinase domain but lacking the BRAF CR1 regulatory domain. While this fusion has not been functionally validated, other BRAF fusions lacking the BRAF CR1 regulatory domain (e.g. KIAA 1549-BRAF fusion) have been shown to be activating and oncogenic. The ZKSCAN1-BRAF fusion was found in a patient with spitzoid melanoma who responded to the MEK inhibitor trametinib (PMID: 26314551).

var_description_zh: BRAF A762E突变位于该蛋白的未知功能域。虽然该突变本身尚未得到功能验证，但用表达BRAF A762E的A549细胞进行的体外研究表明，该突变赋予对EGFR抑制剂厄洛替尼的抗性，如通过治疗后的持续细胞活力所测量的（PMID:27478040）。
var_description: The BRAF A762E mutation is located in an unknown functional domain of the protein. While this mutation has not been functionally validated per se, in vitro studies with A549 cells expressing BRAF A762E demonstrated that the mutation confers resistance to EGFR inhibitor erlotinib as measured by sustained cell viability following treatment (PMID: 27478040).

var_description_zh: BRAF A33T突变位于该蛋白的未知功能域。该突变已在结直肠癌中鉴定（PMID:28481359）。用表达BRAF A33T的小鼠胚胎成纤维细胞进行的体外研究表明，通过与野生型（PMID:31515458）相比的ERK激活测量，该突变可能是中性的。
var_description: The BRAF A33T mutation is located in an unknown functional domain of the protein. This mutation has been identified in colorectal cancer (PMID: 28481359). In vitro studies with mouse embryonic fibroblasts expressing BRAF A33T demonstrate that the mutation is likely neutral as measured by ERK activation comparable to wildtype (PMID: 31515458).

var_description_zh: BRAF F468C突变位于蛋白外显子11的激酶结构域。该突变已在结直肠癌中发现（PMID:15150094）。该突变在NIH-3T3细胞中的表达表明，与野生型BRAF（PMID:15150094）相比，通过增加的体外激酶活性、增加的增殖和增加的病灶形成来测量，该突变是活化的。
var_description: The BRAF F468C mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 11 of the protein. This mutation has been found in colorectal cancer (PMID: 15150094). Expression of this mutation in NIH-3T3 cells demonstrated that it is activating as measured by increased in vitro kinase activity, increased proliferation and increased foci formation compared to wildtype BRAF (PMID: 15150094).

var_description_zh: III类BRAF N581D突变位于蛋白质外显子15中的激酶结构域，并且是统计学上显著的热点（PMID:3010472）。该突变在心脏-面部-皮肤综合征（PMID:16474404）中发现。该突变在NIH-3T3细胞中的表达表明，与野生型BRAF（PMID:16474404）相比，通过下游MAPK通路靶基因（例如，ELK）的转录测量，该突变可能是中性的。用表达BRAF N581D的非小细胞肺癌的患者来源的异种移植模型进行的临床前研究证明，如通过肿瘤生长抑制（PMID:30104724）所测量的，对用RMC-4550治疗的敏感性。
var_description: The class III BRAF N581D mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 15 of the protein and is a statistically significant hotspot (PMID: 3010472). This mutation is found in cardio-facio-cutaneous syndrome (PMID: 16474404). Expression of this mutation in NIH-3T3 cells demonstrated that it is likely neutral as measured by transcription of downstream MAPK pathway target genes (e.g., ELK) comparable to wildtype BRAF (PMID: 16474404). Preclinical studies with patient-derived xenograft models of non-small cell lung cancer expressing BRAF N581D demonstrated sensitivity to treatment with RMC-4550 as measured by tumor growth inhibition (PMID: 30104724).

var_description_zh: BRAF L584F突变位于BRAF蛋白的激酶结构域。该突变已在黑色素瘤以及其他癌症中发现（PMID:23658559，26386083）。体外研究表明，与野生型相比，通过对RAF抑制的敏感性测量，该突变可能被激活（PMID:23658559）。
var_description: The BRAF L584F mutation is located in the kinase domain of the BRAF protein. This mutation has been found in melanoma, as well as other cancers (PMID: 23658559, 26386083). In vitro studies have demonstrated that this mutation may be activating as measured by sensitivity to RAF inhibition compared to wildtype (PMID: 23658559).

var_description_zh: BRAF R239L突变位于蛋白的锌指结构域。一名携带BRAF R239L和KRAS G12C的肺腺癌患者接受了纳武单抗治疗，并显示病情稳定（PMID:34963703），尽管该患者本身没有功能特征。
var_description: The BRAF R239L mutation is located in the zinc finger domain of the protein. Although not functionally characterized per se, a patient with lung adenocarcinoma harboring BRAF R239L and KRAS G12C was treated with nivolumab and demonstrated stable disease (PMID: 34963703).

var_description_zh: BRAF G478C突变位于蛋白外显子12的激酶结构域。该突变被工程化以模拟ARAF G331C突变（PMID:22926515）。该突变在COS-7细胞中的表达证明该突变是失活的，如与野生型BRAF（PMID:22926515）相比激酶活性消失所示。
var_description: The BRAF G478C mutation is located in the kinase domain in exon 12 of the protein. This mutation was engineered to mimic the ARAF G331C mutation (PMID: 22926515). Expression of this mutation in COS-7 cells demonstrated that this mutation is inactivating, as shown by abolished kinase activity compared to wildtype BRAF (PMID: 22926515).

var_description_zh: PPFIBP2-BRAF融合蛋白将PPFIBP2的N-末端与BRAF的C-末端连接，产生含有BRAF激酶结构域但缺少BRAFCR1调节结构域的融合蛋白。虽然这种融合尚未得到功能验证，但其他缺乏BRAF CR1调节域的BRAF融合（如KIAA 1549-BRAF融合）已被证明具有激活和致癌作用。PPFIBP2-BRAF融合是在一名转移性黑色素瘤患者中发现的，该患者对曲美替尼抑制MEK有反应（PMID:26072686）。
var_description: The PPFIBP2-BRAF fusion joins the N-terminus of PPFIBP2 with the C-terminus of BRAF resulting in a fusion protein containing the BRAF kinase domain but lacking the BRAF CR1 regulatory domain. While this fusion has not been functionally validated, other BRAF fusions lacking the BRAF CR1 regulatory domain (e.g. KIAA 1549-BRAF fusion) have been shown to be activating and oncogenic. The PPFIBP2-BRAF fusion was found in a patient with metastatic melanoma who responded to MEK inhibition with trametinib (PMID: 26072686).

var_description_zh: BRAF E275K突变位于蛋白外显子6的富含半胱氨酸区域。该突变已在心脏-面部-皮肤综合征中发现（PMID:19206169）。该突变在NIH-3T3细胞中的表达表明，尽管与野生型BRAF（PMID:19206169）相比MEK和ERK磷酸化降低，但通过集落形成增加来测量，该突变是活化的。
var_description: The BRAF E275K mutation is located in the cysteine-rich domain in exon 6 of the protein. This mutation has been found in cardio-facio-cutaneous syndrome (PMID: 19206169). Expression of this mutation in NIH-3T3 cells demonstrated that it is activating as measured by increased colony formation despite decreased MEK and ERK phosphorylation compared to wildtype BRAF (PMID: 19206169).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 D1739Y突变位于蛋白的BRCT结构域。在已知有乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中鉴定的117种不同的BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，D1739Y变异体被证明具有严重的折叠缺陷、结合活性受损、结合特异性受损和转录活性受损（PMID:20516115）。在57个未鉴定的BRCA1变异体的结构分析中，预测D1739Y与癌症相关（PMID:15172985）。
var_description: The BRCA1 D1739Y mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. In a study of 117 distinct BRCA1 missense variants identified in patients with a known family history of breast or ovarian cancer, the D1739Y variant was demonstrated to have severe folding defect, compromised binding activity, compromised binding specificity and compromised transcriptional activity (PMID: 20516115). In a structural analysis of 57 uncharacterized BRCA1 variants, D1739Y was predicted to be cancer-associated (PMID: 15172985).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 D96N突变位于蛋白质的RING结构域。该突变破坏了BRCA1与E2泛素缀合酶UbcH5A（PMID:16403807）的结合。然而，尚不清楚BRCA1肿瘤抑制是否需要E3连接酶活性（PMID:22034435）。
var_description: The BRCA1 D96N mutation is located in the RING domain of the protein. This mutation disrupts binding of BRCA1 to the E2 ubiquitin-conjugating enzyme UbcH5a (PMID: 16403807). However, it is unknown whether E3 ligase activity is required for BRCA1 tumor suppression (PMID: 22034435).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 N1647K突变位于蛋白的BRCT结构域。在具有已知乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中鉴定的117种不同的BRCA1错义变异体的研究表明，通过无折叠缺陷、正常结合活性、正常结合特异性和正常转录活性（PMID:20516115）测量，该突变是中性的。
var_description: The BRCA1 N1647K mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. A study of 117 distinct BRCA1 missense variants identified in patients with a known family history of breast or ovarian cancer, demonstrated that this mutation is neutral as measured by no folding defect, normal binding activity, normal binding specificity and normal transcriptional activity (PMID: 20516115).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 A1669S突变位于蛋白质的BRCT结构域。在已知有乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中发现的117个不同的BRCA1错义变异的研究中，该变异被证明对BRCA1功能几乎没有影响（PMID:20516115）。在斯堪的纳维亚乳腺癌和卵巢癌家族中鉴定的8种BRCA1变异体的单独研究中，显示A1669S具有与野生型BRCA1相同的活性（PMID:11157798）。另一项对97种BRCA1变异体的研究显示，M1652I具有正常的BRCA1转录激活，不太可能与癌症相关（PMID:15172985）。
var_description: The BRCA1 A1669S mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. In a study of 117 distinct BRCA1 missense variants identified in patients with a known family history of breast or ovarian cancer, this variant was demonstrated to have little effect on BRCA1 function (PMID: 20516115). In a separate study of 8 BRCA1 variants identified in Scandinavian breast and ovarian cancer families, A1669S was shown to have the same activity as wild type BRCA1 (PMID: 11157798). Another study of 97 BRCA1 variants showed that M1652I had normal transcriptional activation of BRCA1 and was not likely cancer-associated (PMID: 15172985).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 E1735K突变位于蛋白的BRCT结构域。在57个未鉴定的BRCA1变异体的结构分析中，由于E1735K存在于遗传性乳腺癌家族中，因此预测其与癌症相关（PMID:15172985，9809041）。然而，在一项意义未知的BRCA1变异体的单独研究中，基于其对顺铂的敏感性，E1735K对BRCA1功能的影响尚无定论（PMID:23867111）。
var_description: The BRCA1 E1735K mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. In a structural analysis of 57 uncharacterized BRCA1 variants, E1735K was predicted to be cancer-associated due to its presence in a family with inherited breast cancer (PMID: 15172985, 9809041). However, in a separate study of BRCA1 variants of unknown significance, E1735K had an inconclusive effect on BRCA1 function based on its sensitivity to cisplatin (PMID: 23867111).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 D1739V突变位于蛋白的BRCT结构域。在已知有乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中鉴定的117种不同BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，D1739V变异体被证明具有严重的折叠缺陷、结合活性受损、结合特异性受损和转录活性受损（PMID:20516115）。在一项意义未知的BRCA1变异体的研究中，基于其顺铂反应，D1739V被认为对BRCA1功能具有有害影响（PMID:23867111）。
var_description: The BRCA1 D1739V mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. In a study of 117 distinct BRCA1 missense variants identified in patients with a known family history of breast or ovarian cancer, the D1739V variant was demonstrated to have severe folding defect, compromised binding activity, compromised binding specificity and compromised transcriptional activity (PMID: 20516115). In a study of BRCA1 variants of unknown significance, D1739V was suggested to have a deleterious effect on BRCA1 function based on its cisplatin response (PMID: 23867111).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 S1448G突变可能是中性的。在一项意义未知的BRCA1变异体的研究中，基于其顺铂反应，该变异体被认为是中性的（PMID:23867111）。
var_description: The BRCA1 S1448G mutation is likely neutral. In a study of BRCA1 variants of unknown significance, this variant was suggested to be neutral based on its cisplatin response (PMID: 23867111).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 R1443G突变可能是中性的。在对22种BRCA1变体的研究中，R1443G在酵母和人类细胞中显示出与野生型BRCA1（PMID:17308087）相当的转录活性。在一项意义未知的BRCA1变异体的研究中，R1443G基于其顺铂反应被认为是中性的（PMID:23867111）。
var_description: The BRCA1 R1443G mutation is likely neutral. In a study of 22 BRCA1 variants, R1443G was shown to have comparable transcriptional activity in yeast and human cells to wildtype BRCA1 (PMID: 17308087). In a study of BRCA1 variants of unknown significance, R1443G was suggested to be neutral based on its cisplatin response (PMID: 23867111).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 V1736A突变位于蛋白质的BRCT结构域。在已知有乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中鉴定的117种不同的BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，V1736A变异体被证明具有严重的折叠缺陷、正常的结合活性、不确定的结合特异性和受损的转录活性（PMID:20516115）。在对22种BRCA1变异体的单独研究中，V1736A显示在酵母和人类细胞中引起BRCA1转录活性降低（PMID:17308087）。在57个未鉴定的BRCA1变异体的结构分析中，预测V1736A与癌症相关（PMID:15172985）。在小菌落表型分析中，预测V1736A对BRCA1结构和/或功能有负面影响（PMID:15004537）。在另一项意义未知的BRCA1变异体研究中，V1736A在体外试验中未能拯救同源重组（PMID:23867111）。
var_description: The BRCA1 V1736A mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein . In a study of 117 distinct BRCA1 missense variants identified in patients with a known family history of breast or ovarian cancer, the V1736A variant was demonstrated to have severe folding defect, normal binding activity, uncertain binding specificity and compromised transcriptional activity (PMID: 20516115). In a separate study of 22 BRCA1 variants, V1736A was shown to cause decreased BRCA1 transcriptional activity in yeast and human cells (PMID: 17308087). In a structural analysis of 57 uncharacterized BRCA1 variants, V1736A was predicted to be cancer-associated (PMID: 15172985). In a small colony phenotype assay, V1736A was predicted to negatively affect BRCA1 structure and/or function (PMID: 15004537). In a separate study of BRCA1 variants of unknown significance, V1736A failed to rescue homologous recombination in an in vitro assay (PMID: 23867111).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 N810Y位于BRCA1蛋白的EIN3（乙烯不敏感3）结构域中。体外研究表明，与野生型（PMID:23867111）相比，该突变可能是中性的，这是通过在顺铂敏感性测定中的反应来测量的。
var_description: The BRCA1 N810Y is located in the EIN3 (ethylene insensitive 3) domain of the BRCA1 protein. In vitro studies have demonstrated that this mutation is likely neutral as measured by response in a cisplatin sensitivity assay compared to wildtype (PMID: 23867111).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 E1836K突变位于蛋白的BRCT结构域。在已知有乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中鉴定的117种不同的BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，证明E1836K变异体没有折叠缺陷、结合活性受损、结合特异性受损和转录活性不确定（PMID:20516115）。在另一项研究中，结构分析表明BRCA1 E1836不会显著降低肽结合（PMID:21473589）。另外的功能分析表明，BRCA1 E1836在加入丝裂霉素（MMC）后表现出野生型同源重组效率和正常定位，尽管它在磷酸肽结合中表现出轻微缺陷（PMID:30257991）。
var_description: The BRCA1 E1836K mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. In a study of 117 distinct BRCA1 missense variants identified in patients with a known family history of breast or ovarian cancer, the E1836K variant was demonstrated to have no folding defect, compromised binding activity, compromised binding specificity and uncertain transcriptional activity (PMID: 20516115). In a separate study, structural analysis demonstrated that BRCA1 E1836 does not dramatically reduce peptide binding (PMID: 21473589). Additional functional assays showed that BRCA1 E1836 demonstrates wildtype homologous recombination efficiency and normal localization following the addition of mitomycin (MMC), although it does display a minor defect in phosphopeptide binding (PMID: 30257991).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 A1789T突变位于蛋白质的BRCT结构域。BRCA1 A1789T促进酵母中的细胞生长和菌落大小，并在一个受乳腺癌和卵巢癌影响的家族中与疾病共分离。（PMID:18680205）。在一项意义未知的BRCA1变异体的研究中，基于其顺铂反应，A1789T被认为对BRCA1功能具有有害影响（PMID:23867111）。
var_description: The BRCA1 A1789T mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. BRCA1 A1789T promoted cell growth and colony size in yeast and cosegregated with disease in a family affected by breast and ovarian cancer. (PMID: 18680205). In a study of BRCA1 variants of unknown significance, A1789T was suggested to have a deleterious effect on BRCA1 function based on its cisplatin response (PMID: 23867111).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 R1589H突变可能是中性的。在对7个意义不明的BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，R1589H具有与野生型BRCA1（PMID:23613828）相当的结构和转录活性。
var_description: The BRCA1 R1589H mutation is likely neutral. In a study of 7 BRCA1 missense variants of uncertain significance, R1589H had comparable structure and transcriptional activity to wild type BRCA1 (PMID: 23613828).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 M18K突变位于蛋白的RING结构域。BRCA1 M18K突变破坏了BRCA1与E2泛素缀合酶UbcH5A（PMID:16403807）的结合。然而，尚不清楚BRCA1肿瘤抑制是否需要E3连接酶活性（PMID:22034435）。
var_description: The BRCA1 M18K mutation is located in the RING domain of the protein. The BRCA1 M18K mutation disrupts binding of BRCA1 to the E2 ubiquitin-conjugating enzyme UbcH5a (PMID: 16403807). However, it is unknown whether E3 ligase activity is required for BRCA1 tumor suppression (PMID: 22034435).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 S186Y突变位于蛋白质的核定位序列之外。在一项意义未知的BRCA1变异体的研究中，基于其顺铂反应，S186Y被认为是中性的（PMID:23867111）。在一项评估29个BRCA1错义突变在两个DNA修复途径中的功能的研究中，该变体显示出拯救功能性同源重组DNA修复，并在双链断裂DNA修复的单链退火途径中具有完全活性（PMID:23161852）。
var_description: The BRCA1 S186Y mutation is located outside of the nuclear localization sequence of the protein. In a study of BRCA1 variants of unknown significance, S186Y was suggested to be neutral based on its cisplatin response (PMID: 23867111). In a study evaluating the function of 29 BRCA1 missense mutations in two DNA repair pathways, this variant was shown to rescue functional homologous recombination DNA repair and to be fully active in the single-strand annealing pathway of double-strand break DNA repair (PMID: 23161852).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 F79S突变的功能尚无定论。BRCA1 F79S突变破坏了BRCA1与E2泛素缀合酶UbcH5A（PMID:16403807）的结合。然而，尚不清楚BRCA1肿瘤抑制是否需要E3连接酶活性（PMID:22034435）。
var_description: The BRCA1 F79S mutation is of inconclusive function. The BRCA1 F79S mutation disrupts binding of BRCA1 to the E2 ubiquitin-conjugating enzyme UbcH5a (PMID: 16403807). However, it is unknown whether E3 ligase activity is required for BRCA1 tumor suppression (PMID: 22034435).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 V1741G突变位于蛋白质的BRCT结构域。在已知有乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中鉴定的117种不同BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，V1741G变异体被证明没有折叠缺陷、结合活性受损、结合特异性受损和转录活性不确定（PMID:20516115）。然而，在57个未鉴定的BRCA1变异体的结构分析中，V1741G被预测为良性突变，因为它与患者中的另一个BRCA1突变同时发生（PMID:15172985，12497638）。
var_description: The BRCA1 V1741G mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. In a study of 117 distinct BRCA1 missense variants identified in patients with a known family history of breast or ovarian cancer, the V1741G variant was demonstrated to have no folding defect, compromised binding activity, compromised binding specificity and uncertain transcriptional activity (PMID: 20516115). However, in a structural analysis of 57 uncharacterized BRCA1 variants, V1741G was predicted to be a benign mutation due to its co-occurrence with another BRCA1 mutation in a patient (PMID: 15172985, 12497638).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 I124V突变的功能尚无定论。在一项评估29个BRCA1错义突变在两个DNA修复途径中的功能的研究中，虽然该变体显示出恢复功能性同源重组DNA修复，但它也显示出在双链断裂DNA修复的单链退火途径中有缺陷（PMID:23161852）。
var_description: The BRCA1 I124V mutation is of inconclusive function. In a study evaluating the function of 29 BRCA1 missense mutations in two DNA repair pathways, while this variant was shown to restore functional homologous recombination DNA repair, it was also shown to be defective in the single-strand annealing pathway of double-strand break DNA repair (PMID: 23161852).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 Y179C突变位于蛋白质的核定位序列之外。这种突变的功能数据相互矛盾。在通过计算算法鉴定为破坏BRCA1功能/潜在有害的7种错义BRCA1变体的研究中，基于酵母同源重组活性测定（PMID:18680205）证实Y179C是潜在有害的。然而，在一项评估29个BRCA1错义突变在两个DNA修复途径中的功能的研究中，显示Y179C可恢复功能性同源重组DNA修复，并在双链断裂DNA修复的单链退火途径中具有完全活性（PMID:23161852）。
var_description: The BRCA1 Y179C mutation is located outside of the nuclear localization sequence of the protein. There is conflicting functional data for this mutation. In a study of 7 missense BRCA1 variants identified by a computational algorithm as disruptive to BRCA1 function/potentially deleterious, Y179C was confirmed to be potentially deleterious based on a yeast homologous recombination activity assay (PMID: 18680205). However, In a study evaluating the function of 29 BRCA1 missense mutations in two DNA repair pathways, Y179C was shown to restore functional homologous recombination DNA repair and to be fully active in the single-strand annealing pathway of double-strand break DNA repair (PMID: 23161852).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 D1778H突变位于蛋白的BRCT结构域。在57个未鉴定的BRCA1变异体的结构分析中，基于D1778N发生在没有乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中，预测其为良性突变（PMID:15172985，9809041）。然而，尚未进行功能研究。
var_description: The BRCA1 D1778H mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. In a structural analysis of 57 uncharacterized BRCA1 variants, D1778N was predicted to be a benign mutation based on its occurrence in a patient with no family history of breast or ovarian cancer (PMID: 15172985, 9809041). However, functional studies have not been conducted.

var_description_zh: BRCA1 V1833M突变位于蛋白质的BRCT结构域。与野生型BRCA1（PMID:18992264）相比，其在酵母和哺乳动物细胞中的转录活性降低。在已知有乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中鉴定的117种不同的BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，V1833M变异体被证明具有严重的折叠缺陷、正常的结合活性、正常的结合特异性和受损的转录活性（PMID:20516115）。在小菌落表型分析中，预测V1888M对BRCA1结构和/或功能有负面影响（PMID:15004537）。在57个未鉴定的BRCA1变异体的结构分析中，尽管在乳腺癌和卵巢癌家族中发现了V1833M，但预测其为良性突变（PMID:15172985，12142080）。
var_description: The BRCA1 V1833M mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. It was functionally demonstrated to have reduced transcriptional activity in yeast and mammalian cells as compared to wild type BRCA1 (PMID: 18992264). In a study of 117 distinct BRCA1 missense variants identified in patients with a known family history of breast or ovarian cancer, the V1833M variant was demonstrated to have severe folding defect, normal binding activity, normal binding specificity and compromised transcriptional activity (PMID: 20516115). In a small colony phenotype assay, V1888M was predicted to negatively affect BRCA1 structure and/or function (PMID: 15004537). In a structural analysis of 57 uncharacterized BRCA1 variants, V1833M was predicted to be a benign mutation despite being found in a family with breast and ovarian cancer (PMID: 15172985, 12142080).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 C360R突变位于蛋白质的富含丝氨酸的区域。在一项意义未知的BRCA1变异体研究中，基于其顺铂反应，该变异体对BRCA1功能没有影响（PMID:23867111）。
var_description: The BRCA1 C360R mutation is located in the serine-rich domain of the protein. In a study of BRCA1 variants of unknown significance, this variant had no effect on BRCA1 function based on its cisplatin response (PMID: 23867111).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 L1786P突变位于蛋白质的BRCT结构域。该突变已在乳腺癌中鉴定（PMID:29113215）。关于这种变异体的致癌功能存在相互矛盾的证据。BRCA1 L1786P的体外HDR分析表明，与野生型相比，通过HDR活性的丧失来测量，突变是失活的（PMID:26689913）。与野生型相比，该突变的体外转录激活试验也证明该突变是失活的，如通过降低的转录激活所测量的（PMID:30765603）。相反，用表达BRCA1 L1786P的BRCA1缺陷型HCC1937细胞进行的体外研究表明，通过与野生型（PMID:29113215）相当的细胞生长和细胞凋亡测量，突变是中性的。
var_description: The BRCA1 L1786P mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. This mutation has been identified in breast cancer (PMID: 29113215). There is conflicting evidence on the oncogenic function of this variant. In vitro HDR assays of BRCA1 L1786P demonstrate that the mutation is inactivating as measured by loss of HDR activity compared to wildtype (PMID: 26689913). In vitro transcriptional activation assays with this mutation also demonstrate that the mutation is inactivating as measured by reduced transcriptional activation compared to wildtype (PMID: 30765603). In contrast, in vitro studies with BRCA1-deficient HCC1937 cells expressing BRCA1 L1786P demonstrate that the mutation is neutral as measured by cell growth and cellular apoptosis comparable to wildtype (PMID: 29113215).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 C39S突变位于蛋白质的RING结构域。BRCA1 C39S突变破坏了BRCA1与E2泛素缀合酶UbcH5A（PMID:16403807）的结合。然而，尚不清楚BRCA1肿瘤抑制是否需要E3连接酶活性（PMID:22034435）。
var_description: The BRCA1 C39S mutation is located in the RING domain of the protein. The BRCA1 C39S mutation disrupts binding of BRCA1 to the E2 ubiquitin-conjugating enzyme UbcH5a (PMID: 16403807). However, it is unknown whether E3 ligase activity is required for BRCA1 tumor suppression (PMID: 22034435).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 E33A突变位于蛋白的RING结构域。在基于酵母的分析中，BRCA1 E33A突变已被证明降低了BRCA1的功能，并被预测对人类细胞中的BRCA1结构或功能有显著影响（PMID:21922593）。
var_description: The BRCA1 E33A mutation is located in the RING domain of the protein. The BRCA1 E33A mutation has been shown to have decreased BRCA1 function in yeast-based assays and would be predicted to have significant impact on BRCA1 structure or function in human cells (PMID: 21922593).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 H1686R突变位于蛋白质的BRCT结构域。在一项意义未知的BRCA1变异体的研究中，基于其顺铂反应，H1686R被认为对BRCA1功能具有有害影响（PMID:23867111）。
var_description: The BRCA1 H1686R mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. In a study of BRCA1 variants of unknown significance, H1686R was suggested to have a deleterious effect on BRCA1 function based on its cisplatin response (PMID: 23867111).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 G1738R突变位于蛋白的BRCT结构域。在已知有乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中鉴定的117种不同的BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，G1738R变异体被证明具有严重的折叠缺陷、结合活性受损、结合特异性受损和转录活性受损（PMID:20516115）。在对22种BRCA1变异体的单独研究中，G1738R显示在酵母和人类细胞中引起BRCA1转录活性降低（PMID:17308087）。在57个未鉴定的BRCA1变异体的结构分析中，G1738R被预测为与癌症相关，因为它是完全保守位置的大结构变化（PMID:15172985）。
var_description: The BRCA1 G1738R mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. In a study of 117 distinct BRCA1 missense variants identified in patients with a known family history of breast or ovarian cancer, the G1738R variant was demonstrated to have severe folding defect, compromised binding activity, compromised binding specificity and compromised transcriptional activity (PMID: 20516115). In a separate study of 22 BRCA1 variants, G1738R was shown to cause decreased BRCA1 transcriptional activity in yeast and human cells (PMID: 17308087). In a structural analysis of 57 uncharacterized BRCA1 variants, G1738R was predicted to be cancer-associated due to it being a large structural change in a completely conserved position (PMID: 15172985).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 Y105C突变是一种中性突变。在一项意义未知的BRCA1变异体的研究中，基于其顺铂反应，该变异体被认为是中性的（PMID:23867111）。在一项评估29个BRCA1错义突变在两个DNA修复途径中的功能的研究中，该变体显示出拯救功能性同源重组DNA修复，并在双链断裂DNA修复的单链退火途径中具有中间活性（PMID:23161852）。

In a study of BRCA1 variants of unknown significance, this variant was suggested to be neutral based on its cisplatin response (PMID: 23867111). In a study evaluating the function of 29 BRCA1 missense mutations in two DNA repair pathways, this variant was shown to rescue functional homologous recombination DNA repair and to have intermediate activity in the single-strand annealing pathway of double-strand break DNA repair (PMID: 23161852).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 T77M突变的功能尚无定论。该突变不破坏BRCA1与E2泛素缀合酶UbcH5A（PMID:16403807）的结合。目前尚不清楚BRCA1肿瘤抑制是否需要E3连接酶活性（PMID:22034435）。
var_description: The BRCA1 T77M mutation is of inconclusive function. This mutation did not disrupt binding of BRCA1 to the E2 ubiquitin-conjugating enzyme UbcH5a (PMID: 16403807). It is unknown whether E3 ligase activity is required for BRCA1 tumor suppression (PMID: 22034435).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 T1852S突变位于蛋白质的BRCT结构域。在57个未鉴定的BRCA1变异体的结构分析中，T1852S被预测为良性突变（PMID:15172985），但尚未进行功能验证。
var_description: The BRCA1 T1852S mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. In a structural analysis of 57 uncharacterized BRCA1 variants, T1852S was predicted to be a benign mutation (PMID: 15172985), but has not been functionally validated.

var_description_zh: BRCA1 C39Y突变位于蛋白的RING结构域。在基于酵母的测定中显示BRCA1 C39Y促进细胞集落生长（PMID:21922593）。在同源定向重组（HDR）分析中，BRCA1 C39Y显示导致非功能性同源修复（PMID:20103620）。在同一作者的另一项研究中，BRCA1 C39Y也被证明在双链断裂DNA修复的单链退火途径中存在缺陷（PMID:23161852）。BRCA1 C39Y突变破坏了BRCA1与E2泛素缀合酶UbcH5A（PMID:16403807）的结合。然而，尚不清楚BRCA1肿瘤抑制是否需要E3连接酶活性（PMID:22034435）。
var_description: The BRCA1 C39Y mutation is located in the RING domain of the protein. BRCA1 C39Y was shown to promote cell colony growth in a yeast-based assay (PMID: 21922593). In a homology-directed recombination (HDR) assay, BRCA1 C39Y was shown to result in non-functional homologous repair (PMID: 20103620). In a separate study by the same authors, BRCA1 C39Y was also demonstrated be defective in the single-strand annealing pathway of double-strand break DNA repair (PMID: 23161852). The BRCA1 C39Y mutation disrupts binding of BRCA1 to the E2 ubiquitin-conjugating enzyme UbcH5a (PMID: 16403807). However, it is unknown whether E3 ligase activity is required for BRCA1 tumor suppression (PMID: 22034435).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 A1830T突变位于蛋白质的BRCT结构域。在已知有乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中鉴定的117种不同的BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，证明A1830T变异体没有折叠缺陷、具有正常的结合活性、不确定的结合特异性和正常的转录活性（PMID:20516115）。

var_description: The BRCA1 R1758G mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. In a structural analysis of 57 uncharacterized BRCA1 variants, R1758G was predicted to be a benign mutation based on its occurrence in families with no history of breast or ovarian cancer (PMID: 15172985, 9544765), but has not been functionally validated.

var_description_zh: BRCA1 S1651F突变位于蛋白的BRCT结构域。在已知有乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中鉴定的117种不同的BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，证明S1651F变异体没有折叠缺陷、正常结合活性、正常结合特异性和正常转录活性（PMID:20516115）。在一项意义未知的BRCA1变异体的研究中，该变异体能够在体外试验中拯救同源重组，达到与野生型BRCA1相当的水平（PMID:23867111）。

var_description_zh: BRCA1 G1656D突变位于蛋白质的BRCT结构域。在已知有乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中鉴定的117种不同的BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，G1656D变异体被证明没有折叠缺陷、结合活性受损、结合特异性受损和转录活性不确定（PMID:20516115）。
var_description: The BRCA1 G1656D mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. var_description: The BRCA1 V1534M mutation is likely neutral. var_description: The BRCA1 N1819Y mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. In a small colony phenotype assay, N1819Y was not predicted to affect BRCA1 structure and/or function (PMID: 15004537), but has not been otherwise functionally investigated.

var_description_zh: BRCA1 W1718S突变位于蛋白质的BRCT结构域。在已知有乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中鉴定的117种不同的BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，W1718S变异体被证明具有严重的折叠缺陷、结合活性受损、结合特异性受损和转录活性受损（PMID:20516115）。在57个未鉴定的BRCA1变异体的结构分析中，预测W1718S与癌症相关（PMID:15172985）。对该基因的计算机分析表明，该突变可能会削弱剪接位点的强度。然而，该基因的体外细胞系表达表明其对BRCA1的选择性剪接没有影响（PMID:25724305）。

In a study of 117 distinct BRCA1 missense variants identified in patients with a known family history of breast or ovarian cancer, the W1718S variant was demonstrated to have severe folding defect, compromised binding activity, compromised binding specificity and compromised transcriptional activity (PMID: 20516115). In a structural analysis of 57 uncharacterized BRCA1 variants, W1718S was predicted to be cancer-associated (PMID: 15172985). In silico analysis of the gene suggested that this mutation may weaken splice site strength; however, in vitro cell line expression of the gene demonstrated that it had no effect on alternative splicing for BRCA1 (PMID: 25724305).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 R1751Q突变位于蛋白的BRCT结构域。在已知有乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中鉴定的117种不同BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，证明R1751Q变异体具有轻度折叠缺陷、正常结合活性、正常结合特异性和正常转录活性（PMID:20516115）。在57个未鉴定的BRCA1变异体的结构分析中，R1751Q被预测为良性（PMID:15172985，9150149）。

var_description_zh: BRCA1 S1497A突变位于蛋白的细胞周期蛋白依赖性激酶共有位点。关于该突变的功能和致癌作用存在相互矛盾的证据。用表达BRCA1 S1497A的BRCA1基因敲除小鼠胚胎干细胞进行的体外研究表明，与野生型相比，突变是激活的，这是通过对γ-射线的反应中增加的蛋白表达和基因组不稳定性来测量的（PMID:19770520）。用表达BRCA1 S1497A的BRCA1缺陷型小鼠胚胎干细胞进行的其他体外研究表明，通过与野生型（PMID:23867111）相当的顺铂应答和增殖来测量，该突变可能是中性的。
var_description: The BRCA1 S1497A mutation is located in the cyclin-dependent kinase consensus site of the protein. There is conflicting evidence on the functional and oncogenic effect of this mutation. In vitro studies with BRCA1 knockout mouse embryonic stem cells expressing BRCA1 S1497A demonstrate that the mutation is activating as measured by increased protein expression and genomic instability in response to γ-irradiation compared to wildtype (PMID: 19770520). Other in vitro studies with BRCA1-deficient mouse embryonic stem cells expressing BRCA1 S1497A demonstrate that this mutation is likely neutral as measured by cisplatin response and proliferation comparable to wildtype (PMID: 23867111).

var_description: The BRCA1 W1718C mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. var_description: The BRCA1 L147F mutation is located next to the splice site in exon 7. There is conflicting data for this mutation. var_description_zh: BRCA1 L1407P突变位于蛋白的卷曲螺旋结构域。在13个BRCA1变异体的研究中，L1407P显示转录激活显著降低（PMID:15689452）。在一项意义未知的BRCA1变异体研究中，L1407P在联合PARP抑制剂/顺铂试验中出现功能障碍，表明其可能是一种有害突变（PMID:23867111）。BRCA1的丝氨酸簇域包括氨基酸1280-1524，并且是响应DNA损伤的ATM/ATR激酶磷酸化的主要位点（PMID:15770685）。临床报道该区域的突变（M1400V，L1407P，M1411T）抑制BRCA1和PALB2之间的相互作用；由于PALB2作为支架将BRCA1和BRCA2结合在一起，形成在DNA修复过程中参与同源重组（HR）的复合物，这些突变导致受损的DNA双链断裂修复和致癌效应（PMID:19369211，16793542）。
var_description: The BRCA1 L1407P mutation is located in the coiled-coil domain of the protein. In a study of thirteen BRCA1 variants, L1407P showed significantly decreased transcription activation (PMID: 15689452). In a study of BRCA1 variants of unknown significance, L1407P had functional impairment in the combined PARP inhibitor/cisplatin assay, indicating it as a possible deleterious mutation (PMID: 23867111). The serine cluster domain of BRCA1 encompasses amino acids 1280-1524 and is the primary site for phosphorylation by ATM/ATR kinases in response to DNA damage (PMID: 15770685). Clinically reported mutations in this region (M1400V, L1407P, M1411T) inhibit the interaction between BRCA1 and PALB2; since PALB2 acts as a scaffold to bring together BRCA1 and BRCA2, forming a complex that is involved in homologous recombination (HR) during DNA repair, these mutations lead to impaired DNA double strand break repair and an oncogenic effect (PMID: 19369211, 16793542).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 A1823T突变位于蛋白质的BRCT结构域。在已知有乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中鉴定的117种不同的BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，该变异体被证明具有正常折叠、正常结合活性、正常结合特异性和正常转录活性（PMID:20516115）。在对57个未鉴定的BRCA1变异体的结构分析中，尽管在具有乳腺癌和卵巢癌病史的家族中发现了A1823T，但预测其为良性突变（PMID:15172985，12142080）。然而，尽管饱和基因组编辑研究将这种变体归类为功能缺失（PMID:30209399），并且Clinvar（NIH）表明这种改变是致病性的（https：//www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/clinvar/variation/37632/；accessed Feb 4，2019）。
var_description: The BRCA1 A1823T mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. In a study of 117 distinct BRCA1 missense variants identified in patients with a known family history of breast or ovarian cancer, this variant was demonstrated to have normal folding, normal binding activity, normal binding specificity and normal transcriptional activity (PMID: 20516115). In a structural analysis of 57 uncharacterized BRCA1 variants, A1823T was predicted to be a benign mutation despite being found in a family with a history of breast and ovarian cancer (PMID: 15172985, 12142080). However, while a saturation genome editing study classified this variant as being loss-of-function (PMID: 30209399), and ClinVar (NIH) suggests that this alteration is pathogenic (https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/clinvar/variation/37632/; accessed Feb 4, 2019).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 C1697R突变位于BRCT结构域。在已知有乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中鉴定的117种不同的BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，C1697R变异体被证明具有严重的折叠缺陷、不确定的结合活性、不确定的结合特异性和受损的转录活性（PMID:20516115）。在斯堪的纳维亚乳腺癌和卵巢癌家族中鉴定的8种BRCA1变异体的单独研究中，C1697R显示与野生型BRCA1相比具有转录活性的丧失（PMID:11157798）。另一项对94个BRCA1变异体的研究表明，C1697R没有BRCA1的转录激活，并且与癌症相关（PMID:15172985）。
var_description: The BRCA1 C1697R mutation is located in the BRCT domain. In a study of 117 distinct BRCA1 missense variants identified in patients with a known family history of breast or ovarian cancer, the C1697R variant was demonstrated to have severe folding defect, uncertain binding activity, uncertain binding specificity and compromised transcriptional activity (PMID: 20516115). In a separate study of 8 BRCA1 variants identified in Scandinavian breast and ovarian cancer families, C1697R was shown to have loss of transcriptional activity compared to wild type BRCA1 (PMID: 11157798). Another study of 94 BRCA1 variants showed that C1697R had no transcriptional activation of BRCA1 and was cancer-associated (PMID: 15172985).

In vitro studies with MCF-10A cells expressing BRCA1 I379M have demonstrated that this mutation is neutral as measured by similar radiosensitivity, chromosomal instability, polyploid fractions and centrosome number compared to wildtype (PMID: 26246475).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 G1706A突变位于蛋白质的BRCT结构域。在已知有乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中鉴定的117种不同的BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，G1706A变异体被证明没有折叠缺陷、正常结合活性、正常结合特异性和正常转录活性（PMID:20516115）。在对13个BRCA1变异体的单独研究中，G1706A显示转录激活轻微降低（PMID:15689452）。另一项对97种BRCA1变异体的研究显示，G1706A导致BRCA1的转录激活，并且该变异体与癌症的相关性未知（PMID:15172985）。对2种BRCA1变异体的研究显示，G1706A具有与野生型BRCA1（PMID:15923272）相当的蛋白质稳定性、转录反式激活和亚细胞定位。在一项意义未知的BRCA1变异体的研究中，G1706A在体外试验中拯救了同源重组，其水平与野生型BRCA1相当（PMID:23867111）。
var_description: The BRCA1 G1706A mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. In a study of 117 distinct BRCA1 missense variants identified in patients with a known family history of breast or ovarian cancer, the G1706A variant was demonstrated to have no folding defect, normal binding activity, normal binding specificity and normal transcriptional activity (PMID: 20516115). In a separate study of 13 BRCA1 variants, G1706A showed slightly decreased transcription activation (PMID: 15689452). Another study of 97 BRCA1 variants showed G1706A to result in transcriptional activation of BRCA1 and that this variant was of unknown cancer association (PMID: 15172985). A study of 2 BRCA1 variants showed G1706A to have protein stability, transcriptional transactivation, and subcellular localization comparable to wildtype BRCA1(PMID: 15923272). In a study of BRCA1 variants of unknown significance, G1706A rescued homologous recombination in an in vitro assay to levels comparable to wildtype BRCA1 (PMID: 23867111).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 M18T突变位于蛋白的RING结构域。在基于酵母的测定中，与野生型BRCA1相比，BRCA1 M18T在AS中显示出显著的集落大小增加，表明其肿瘤抑制作用丧失（PMID:21922593）。在一项意义未知的BRCA1变异体的研究中，基于其顺铂反应，M18T被认为对BRCA1功能具有有害影响（PMID:23867111）。在同源定向重组（HDR）分析中，BRCA1 M18T显示导致非功能性同源修复（PMID:20103620）。在同一作者的另一项研究中，BRCA1 M18T也被证明在双链断裂DNA修复的单链退火途径中存在缺陷（PMID:23161852）。

var_description_zh: BRCA1 M1400V突变的功能尚无定论。在一项意义未知的BRCA1变异体的研究中，基于其顺铂反应，该变异体被认为是中性的（PMID:23867111）。然而，BRCA1的丝氨酸簇结构域包括氨基酸1280-1524，并且是响应DNA损伤的ATM/ATR激酶磷酸化的主要位点（PMID:15770685）。临床报道该区域的突变（M1400V，L1407P，M1411T）抑制BRCA1和PALB2之间的相互作用；由于PALB2作为支架将BRCA1和BRCA2结合在一起，形成在DNA修复过程中参与同源重组（HR）的复合物，这些突变导致受损的DNA双链断裂修复和致癌效应（PMID:19369211，16793542）。
var_description: The BRCA1 M1400V mutation is of inconclusive function. In a study of BRCA1 variants of unknown significance, this variant was suggested to be neutral based on its cisplatin response (PMID: 23867111). However, the serine cluster domain of BRCA1 encompasses amino acids 1280-1524 and is the primary site for phosphorylation by ATM/ATR kinases in response to DNA damage (PMID: 15770685). Clinically reported mutations in this region (M1400V, L1407P, M1411T) inhibit the interaction between BRCA1 and PALB2; since PALB2 acts as a scaffold to bring together BRCA1 and BRCA2, forming a complex that is involved in homologous recombination (HR) during DNA repair, these mutations lead to impaired DNA double strand break repair and an oncogenic effect (PMID: 19369211, 16793542).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 H1746Q突变位于蛋白质的BRCT结构域。在一项意义未知的BRCA1变异体的研究中，通过顺铂反应（PMID:23867111）测量，该变异体对BRCA1功能的影响尚不清楚。
var_description: The BRCA1 H1746Q mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. In a study of BRCA1 variants of unknown significance, this variant had an unclear effect on BRCA1 function as measured by cisplatin response (PMID: 23867111).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 Q1756FS突变（在文献中也描述为5382insC）位于蛋白质的BRCT结构域中。到70岁时，这种变异的乳腺癌相关风险为56%，卵巢癌为16%，前列腺癌为16%（PMID:9145676）。它是BRCA1中已知的有害突变，其消除了蛋白质的BRCT结构域（PMID:23867111，15569676，14729053）。在细胞对电离辐射（IR）反应的研究中，与野生型BRCA1相比，BRCA1 5382insC突变体降低了BRCA1在DNA损伤和修复位点的定位（PMID:15569676）。与野生型BRCA1（PMID:14729053）相比，BRCA1 5382insC显示将BRCA1定位从细胞核转移到细胞质，可能有助于抑制该突变体中的核DNA修复和转录功能。最常见的德系犹太人BRCA1创始者突变是185delAG（E23FS）和5382insC（Q1756FS），存在于大约3%的人群中（PMID:14576434）。通过BRCA1 5382STOP突变在小鼠中对该变体进行建模表明，该变体不仅使动物易患乳腺肿瘤，而且还损害了对铂类药物和PARP抑制剂治疗的反应（PMID:27454287）。
var_description: The BRCA1 Q1756fs mutation (also described in literature as 5382insC) is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. This variant carries an associated risk of 56% for breast cancer, 16% for ovarian cancer and 16% for prostate cancer by age 70 (PMID: 9145676). It is a known deleterious mutation in BRCA1 that abolishes the BRCT-domain of the protein (PMID: 23867111, 15569676, 14729053). In a study of cell response to ionizing radiation (IR), the BRCA1 5382insC mutant decreased localization of BRCA1 to sites of DNA damage and repair as compared to wild type BRCA1 (PMID: 15569676). BRCA1 5382insC was shown to shift BRCA1 localization from the nucleus to the cytoplasm, likely contributing to inhibition of nuclear DNA repair and transcription function in this mutant as compared to wild type BRCA1 (PMID: 14729053). The most common Ashkenazi Jewish BRCA1 founder mutations are 185delAG (E23fs) and 5382insC (Q1756fs), present in approximately 3% of the population (PMID: 14576434). Modeling of this variant in mice via a BRCA1 5382stop mutation demonstrated that this variant not only predisposes animals to mammary tumors but also compromises response to treatment with platinum drugs and PARP inhibitors (PMID: 27454287).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 S1297del突变可能是中性的。在一项意义未知的BRCA1变异体的研究中，基于其顺铂反应，该变异体被认为是中性的（PMID:23867111）。
var_description: The BRCA1 S1297del mutation is likely neutral. In a study of BRCA1 variants of unknown significance, this variant was suggested to be neutral based on its cisplatin response (PMID: 23867111).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 C27A突变位于蛋白的RING结构域。在同源定向重组（HDR）分析中，BRCA1 C27A显示导致非功能性同源修复，因此表明其为有害突变（PMID:20103620）。在同一作者的另一项研究中，BRCA1 C27A也被证明在双链断裂DNA修复的单链退火途径中存在缺陷（PMID:23161852）。
var_description: The BRCA1 C27A mutation is located in the RING domain of the protein. In a homology-directed recombination (HDR) assay, BRCA1 C27A was shown to result in non-functional homologous repair, thus suggesting it as a deleterious mutation (PMID: 20103620). In a separate study by the same authors, BRCA1 C27A was also demonstrated be defective in the single-strand annealing pathway of double-strand break DNA repair (PMID: 23161852).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 M1689R突变位于蛋白质的BRCT结构域。在已知有乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中鉴定的117种不同的BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，证明M1689R变异体具有严重的折叠缺陷、结合活性受损、结合特异性受损和转录活性受损（PMID:20516115）。在57个未鉴定的BRCA1变异体的结构分析中，预测M1689R与癌症相关（PMID:15172985）。
var_description: The BRCA1 M1689R mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. In a study of 117 distinct BRCA1 missense variants identified in patients with a known family history of breast or ovarian cancer, the M1689R variant was demonstrated to have severe folding defect, compromised binding activity, compromised binding specificity and compromised transcriptional activity (PMID: 20516115). In a structural analysis of 57 uncharacterized BRCA1 variants, M1689R was predicted to be cancer-associated (PMID: 15172985).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 K1487R突变位于BRCA1蛋白的SQ-簇结构域。该突变已在一个患有乳腺癌、卵巢癌、前列腺癌和子宫癌的家族中被发现（PMID:18992264）。体外研究表明，与野生型相比，该突变具有不确定的影响，即反式激活活性降低50%，这是将BRCA1突变分类为失活或中性的界限（PMID:18992264）。
var_description: The BRCA1 K1487R mutation is located in the SQ-cluster domains of the BRCA1 protein. This mutation has been identified in a family affected by breast, ovarian, prostate and uterine cancers (PMID: 18992264). In vitro studies have demonstrated that this mutation has an inconclusive effect, as measured by a 50% reduction in transactivational activity compared to wildtype, which is borderline for classifying BRCA1 mutations as inactivating or neutral (PMID: 18992264).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 Q1811R突变位于蛋白的BRCT结构域。在已知有乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中鉴定的117种不同的BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，证明Q1811R变异体具有严重的折叠缺陷、不确定的结合活性、不确定的结合特异性和受损的转录活性（PMID:20516115）。在57个未鉴定的BRCA1变异体的结构分析中，预测Q1811R与癌症相关（PMID:15172985）。
var_description: The BRCA1 Q1811R mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. In a study of 117 distinct BRCA1 missense variants identified in patients with a known family history of breast or ovarian cancer, the Q1811R variant was demonstrated to have severe folding defect, uncertain binding activity, uncertain binding specificity and compromised transcriptional activity (PMID: 20516115). In a structural analysis of 57 uncharacterized BRCA1 variants, Q1811R was predicted to be cancer-associated (PMID: 15172985).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 T1691I突变位于蛋白质的BRCT结构域。在已知有乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中鉴定的117种不同的BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，证明T1691I变异体具有严重的折叠缺陷、正常的结合活性、受损的结合特异性和受损的转录活性（PMID:20516115）。在另一项意义未知的BRCA1变异体研究中，T1691I对BRCA1功能的影响尚不明确，这是基于其顺铂反应（PMID:23867111）。该基因的计算机模拟和体外分析表明，该突变可能会削弱剪接位点的强度，并产生除外显子17（PMID:25724305）以外的选择性剪接转录物。
var_description: The BRCA1 T1691I mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. In a study of 117 distinct BRCA1 missense variants identified in patients with a known family history of breast or ovarian cancer, the T1691I variant was demonstrated to have severe folding defect, normal binding activity, compromised binding specificity and compromised transcriptional activity (PMID: 20516115). In a separate study of BRCA1 variants of unknown significance, T1691I had an unclear effect on BRCA1 function based on its cisplatin response (PMID: 23867111). In silico and in vitro analysis of the gene suggested that this mutation may weaken splice site strength and create an alternatively-spliced transcript excluding exon 17 (PMID: 25724305).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 Y1853C突变位于蛋白质的BRCT结构域。在已知有乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中鉴定的117种不同的BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，Y1853C变异体被证明具有严重的折叠缺陷、结合活性受损、结合特异性受损和转录活性受损（PMID:20516115）。在一项对2名怀疑患有遗传性乳腺癌的日本乳腺癌患者中发现的2种BRCA1变异体的单独研究中，发现Y1853C在受影响的家族成员中共分离，并通过保守、转录和结构分析发现其具有致病性（PMID:23842040）。
var_description: The BRCA1 Y1853C mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. In a study of 117 distinct BRCA1 missense variants identified in patients with a known family history of breast or ovarian cancer, the Y1853C variant was demonstrated to have severe folding defect, compromised binding activity, compromised binding specificity and compromised transcriptional activity (PMID: 20516115). In a separate study of 2 BRCA1 variants found in 2 Japanese breast cancer patients suspected of having hereditary breast cancer, Y1853C was found to be co-segregated in affected family members and was found to be pathogenic by conservation, transcription, and structure analyses (PMID: 23842040).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 T1720I突变位于蛋白质的BRCT结构域。在小菌落表型分析中，预测T1720I不影响BRCA1结构和/或功能（PMID:15004537）。
var_description: The BRCA1 T1720I mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. In a small colony phenotype assay, T1720I was predicted not to affect BRCA1 structure and/or function (PMID: 15004537).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 G1770V突变位于蛋白的BRCT结构域。在一项对7个意义不明的BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，G1770V导致BRCT结构的显著改变和转录活性的显著降低（PMID:23613828）。在一项意义未知的BRCA1变异体研究中，G1770V在体外试验中未能拯救同源重组（PMID:23867111）。
var_description: The BRCA1 G1770V mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. In a study of seven BRCA1 missense variants of uncertain significance, G1770V was shown to cause significant alteration in BRCT structure and dramatic compromise of transcriptional activity (PMID: 23613828). In a study of BRCA1 variants of unknown significance, G1770V failed to rescue homologous recombination in an in vitro assay (PMID: 23867111).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 R170Q突变是一种中性突变。在一项评估29个BRCA1错义突变在两个DNA修复途径中的功能的研究中，该变体显示出拯救功能性同源重组DNA修复，并在双链断裂DNA修复的单链退火途径中具有中间活性（PMID:23161852）。
var_description: The BRCA1 R170Q mutation is a neutral mutation. In a study evaluating the function of 29 BRCA1 missense mutations in two DNA repair pathways, this variant was shown to rescue functional homologous recombination DNA repair and to have intermediate activity in the single-strand annealing pathway of double-strand break DNA repair (PMID: 23161852).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 M1008I突变可能是中性的。在一项意义未知的BRCA1变异体的研究中，基于其顺铂反应，该变异体被认为是中性的（PMID:23867111）。
var_description: The BRCA1 M1008I mutation is likely neutral. In a study of BRCA1 variants of unknown significance, this variant was suggested to be neutral based on its cisplatin response (PMID: 23867111).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 V1378I突变可能是中性的。在一项意义未知的BRCA1变异体的研究中，基于其顺铂反应，该变异体被认为是中性的（PMID:23867111）。
var_description: The BRCA1 V1378I mutation is likely neutral. In a study of BRCA1 variants of unknown significance, this variant was suggested to be neutral based on its cisplatin response (PMID: 23867111).

var_description_zh: BRCA1缺失发生在整个基因中，并导致BRCA1蛋白的翻译提前终止和蛋白表达减少（PMID:9354803，12670888，18501021）。BRCA1缺失的小鼠表现出对乳腺癌的易感性增加（PMID:12483515）。此外，细胞中BRCA1的缺失与基因组不稳定性和额外突变的获得有关（PMID:27452521）。
var_description: BRCA1 deletions occur throughout the entire gene and result in premature termination of translation and reduced protein expression of the BRCA1 protein (PMID: 9354803, 12670888, 18501021). Mice with BRCA1 deletion exhibit an increased susceptibility to mammary carcinomas (PMID: 12483515). Additionally, loss of BRCA1 in cells are associated with genomic instability and the acquisition of additional mutations (PMID: 27452521).

var_description_zh: BRCA1中的截短突变可导致不同的C末端截短蛋白，从而导致异常蛋白折叠，导致BRCA1蛋白功能丧失。含有BRCA1截短突变的人乳腺癌细胞系表现出非整倍性水平升高和DNA损伤反应受损。此外，截短突变已显示诱导异常蛋白定位，这可能影响重要结合配偶体的相互作用（PMID:20608970）。BRCA1截短突变的小鼠模型发生癌症，包括乳腺癌、淋巴瘤和卵巢癌（PMID:11358863，12483515，12947386）。
var_description: Truncating mutations in BRCA1 can lead to varying C-terminally truncated proteins that results in aberrant protein folding, contributing to loss of BRCA1 protein function. Human breast cancer cell lines that contain a truncating mutation in BRCA1 display elevated levels of aneuploidy and impaired DNA damage response. In addition, truncating mutations have been shown to induce aberrant protein localization, which may impact the interaction of important binding partners (PMID: 20608970). Mouse models of BRCA1 truncating mutations develop cancer, including mammary carcinomas, lymphomas and ovarian carcinomas (PMID: 11358863, 12483515, 12947386).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 C24R突变位于蛋白质的RING结构域。在同源定向重组（HDR）分析中，BRCA1 C24R显示导致非功能性同源修复，因此表明其为有害突变（PMID:20103620）。在同一作者的另一项研究中，BRCA1 C24R也被证明在双链断裂DNA修复的单链退火途径中存在缺陷（PMID:23161852）。
var_description: The BRCA1 C24R mutation is located in the RING domain of the protein. In a homology-directed recombination (HDR) assay, BRCA1 C24R was shown to result in non-functional homologous repair, thus suggesting it as a deleterious mutation (PMID: 20103620). In a separate study by the same authors, BRCA1 C24R was also demonstrated be defective in the single-strand annealing pathway of double-strand break DNA repair (PMID: 23161852).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 L52F突变位于蛋白的RING结构域。在同源定向重组（HDR）分析中，BRCA1 L52F拯救了功能性同源修复并与BARD1相互作用（PMID:20103620）。在同一作者的另一项研究中，BRCA1 L52F显示在双链断裂DNA修复的单链退火途径中具有接近野生型BRCA1的活性（PMID:23161852）。BRCA1 L52F突变破坏了BRCA1与E2泛素缀合酶UbcH5A（PMID:16403807）的结合。然而，尚不清楚BRCA1肿瘤抑制是否需要E3连接酶活性（PMID:22034435）。
var_description: The BRCA1 L52F mutation is located in the RING domain of the protein. In a homology-directed recombination (HDR) assay, BRCA1 L52F rescued functional homologous repair and interacted with BARD1 (PMID: 20103620). In a separate study by the same authors, BRCA1 L52F was shown to have activity approximating wild type BRCA1 in the single-strand annealing pathway of double-strand break DNA repair (PMID: 23161852). The BRCA1 L52F mutation disrupts binding of BRCA1 to the E2 ubiquitin-conjugating enzyme UbcH5a (PMID: 16403807). However, it is unknown whether E3 ligase activity is required for BRCA1 tumor suppression (PMID: 22034435).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 A5V突变位于蛋白的未知功能域。计算机分析表明该突变可能是良性的（PMID:35659930）。
var_description: The BRCA1 A5V mutation is located in an unknown functional domain of the protein. In silico analysis suggests that the mutation is likely benign (PMID: 35659930).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 M1R突变可能是功能缺失。BRCA1 M1R错义突变已显示破坏该基因的起始密码子并导致无蛋白产生（PMID:21922593）。
var_description: The BRCA1 M1R mutation is likely loss-of-function. The BRCA1 M1R missense mutation has been shown to disrupt the start codon of the gene and lead to no protein production (PMID: 21922593).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 E1682K突变位于蛋白的BRCT结构域。在已知有乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中鉴定的117种不同的BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，证明E1682K变异体没有折叠缺陷、正常结合活性、正常结合特异性和正常转录活性（PMID:20516115）。
var_description: The BRCA1 E1682K mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. In a study of 117 distinct BRCA1 missense variants identified in patients with a known family history of breast or ovarian cancer, the E1682K variant was demonstrated to have no folding defect, normal binding activity, normal binding specificity and normal transcriptional activity (PMID: 20516115).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 D1733G突变位于蛋白质的BRCT结构域。BRCA1 D1733G突变蛋白表现出增加的p53结合能力，导致p53功能改变（PMID:17161371）。然而，在一项对117种不同的BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，D1733G变异体被证明没有折叠缺陷、正常的结合活性、正常的结合特异性和正常的转录活性（PMID:20516115），这些错义变异体是在具有已知乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中鉴定的。在BIC数据库中鉴定的5种BRCA1变体的单独研究中，显示D1733G具有与野生型BRCA1相同的转录活性（PMID:11157798）。另一项对97种BRCA1变异体的研究显示，D1733G导致BRCA1的正常转录激活（PMID:15172985，10811118）。
var_description: The BRCA1 D1733G mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. The BRCA1 D1733G mutant protein demonstrates increased p53 binding ability, resulting in altered p53 function (PMID: 17161371). However, in a study of 117 distinct BRCA1 missense variants identified in patients with a known family history of breast or ovarian cancer, the D1733G variant was demonstrated to have no folding defect, normal binding activity, normal binding specificity and normal transcriptional activity (PMID: 20516115). In a separate study of 5 BRCA1 variants identified in the BIC database, D1733G was shown to have the same transcriptional activity as wild type BRCA1 (PMID: 11157798). Another study of 97 BRCA1 variants showed D1733G to result in normal transcriptional activation of BRCA1 (PMID: 15172985, 10811118).

var_description: The BRCA1 Y856H mutation is likely neutral. In a study of BRCA1 variants of unknown significance, this variant was suggested to be neutral based on its cisplatin response (PMID: 23867111).
