var_description: The BRCA1 S59R mutation is located in the RING domain of the protein. The BRCA1 S59R mutation disrupts binding of BRCA1 to the E2 ubiquitin-conjugating enzyme UbcH5a (PMID: 16403807). However, it is unknown whether E3 ligase activity is required for BRCA1 tumor suppression (PMID: 22034435).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 L1764P突变位于蛋白质的BRCT结构域。在具有已知的乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中鉴定的117种不同的BRCA1错义变异体的研究表明，该突变是失活的，如严重的折叠缺陷、受损的结合活性、受损的结合特异性和受损的转录活性所证明的（PMID:20516115）。在对22种BRCA1变异体的单独研究中，L1764P在酵母和人类细胞中引起BRCA1转录活性降低（PMID:17308087）。在一项意义未知的BRCA1变异体研究中，L1764P在体外试验中未能拯救同源重组（PMID:23867111）。然而，在57个未鉴定的BRCA1变异体的结构分析中，L1764P被预测为良性突变（PMID:15172985）。
var_description: The BRCA1 L1764P mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. A study of 117 distinct BRCA1 missense variants identified in patients with a known family history of breast or ovarian cancer demonstrated that this mutation is inactivating as evidenced by severe folding defect, compromised binding activity, compromised binding specificity and compromised transcriptional activity (PMID: 20516115). In a separate study of 22 BRCA1 variants, L1764P was shown to cause decreased BRCA1 transcriptional activity in yeast and human cells (PMID: 17308087). In a study of BRCA1 variants of unknown significance, L1764P failed to rescue homologous recombination in an in vitro assay (PMID: 23867111). However, in a structural analysis of 57 uncharacterized BRCA1 variants, L1764P was predicted to be a benign mutation (PMID: 15172985).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 C64G突变位于蛋白的RING结构域。在一项意义未知的BRCA1变异体的研究中，C64G在体外试验中未能拯救同源重组，表明其功能丧失（PMID:23867111）。在电离辐射对乳腺癌细胞系HCC1937的影响的研究中，BRCA1 C64G不能挽救由野生型BRCA1逆转的辐射敏感性表型，并且不能补充缺陷型双链断裂修复（PMID:10635334）。在同源定向重组（HDR）分析中，BRCA1 C64G显示导致非功能性同源修复（PMID:20103620）。在同一作者的另一项研究中，BRCA1 C64G也被证明在双链断裂DNA修复的单链退火途径中存在缺陷（PMID:23161852）。BRCA1 C64G突变破坏了BRCA1与E2泛素缀合酶UbcH5A（PMID:16403807）的结合。然而，尚不清楚BRCA1肿瘤抑制是否需要E3连接酶活性（PMID:22034435）。
var_description: The BRCA1 C64G mutation is located in the RING domain of the protein. In a study of BRCA1 variants of unknown significance, C64G failed to rescue homologous recombination in an in vitro assay, suggesting it is loss of function (PMID: 23867111). In a study of the effects of ionizing radiation on the breast cancer cell line HCC1937, BRCA1 C64G failed to rescue the radiation sensitivity phenotype reversed by wild type BRCA1 and failed to complement defective double stranded break repair (PMID: 10635334). In a homology-directed recombination (HDR) assay, BRCA1 C64G was shown to result in non-functional homologous repair (PMID: 20103620). In a separate study by the same authors, BRCA1 C64G was also demonstrated be defective in the single-strand annealing pathway of double-strand break DNA repair (PMID: 23161852). The BRCA1 C64G mutation disrupts binding of BRCA1 to the E2 ubiquitin-conjugating enzyme UbcH5a (PMID: 16403807). However, it is unknown whether E3 ligase activity is required for BRCA1 tumor suppression (PMID: 22034435).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 D695N突变可能是中性的。在一项意义未知的BRCA1变异体的研究中，基于其顺铂反应，D695N被认为是中性的（PMID:23867111）。
var_description: The BRCA1 D695N mutation is likely neutral. In a study of BRCA1 variants of unknown significance, D695N was suggested to be neutral based on its cisplatin response (PMID: 23867111).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 T1700A突变位于蛋白质的BRCT结构域。在已知有乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中鉴定的117种不同的BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，证明T1700A变异体没有折叠缺陷、结合活性受损、结合特异性受损和转录活性受损（PMID:20516115）。在对22种BRCA1变异体的单独研究中，T1700A显示在酵母和人类细胞中引起BRCA1转录活性降低（PMID:17308087）。
var_description: The BRCA1 T1700A mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. In a study of 117 distinct BRCA1 missense variants identified in patients with a known family history of breast or ovarian cancer, the T1700A variant was demonstrated to have no folding defect, compromised binding activity, compromised binding specificity and compromised transcriptional activity (PMID: 20516115). In a separate study of 22 BRCA1 variants, T1700A was shown to cause decreased BRCA1 transcriptional activity in yeast and human cells (PMID: 17308087).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 V1696L突变位于蛋白质的BRCT结构域。在已知有乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中鉴定的117种不同的BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，V1696L变异体被证明具有严重的折叠缺陷、结合活性受损、结合特异性受损和转录活性不确定（PMID:20516115）。然而，在57个未鉴定的BRCA1变异体的结构分析中，预测V1696L为良性突变（PMID:15172985）。
var_description: The BRCA1 V1696L mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. In a study of 117 distinct BRCA1 missense variants identified in patients with a known family history of breast or ovarian cancer, the V1696L variant was demonstrated to have severe folding defect, compromised binding activity, compromised binding specificity and uncertain transcriptional activity (PMID: 20516115). However, in a structural analysis of 57 uncharacterized BRCA1 variants, V1696L was predicted to be a benign mutation (PMID: 15172985).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 p142H突变位于已知功能域之外。该突变已在乳腺癌患者中发现（PMID:26085381）。在一项意义未知的BRCA1变异体的研究中，基于其顺铂反应，该变异体被认为是中性的（PMID:23867111）。在一项评估29个BRCA1错义突变在两个DNA修复途径中的功能的研究中，该变体显示出拯救功能性同源重组DNA修复，并在双链断裂DNA修复的单链退火途径中具有中间活性（PMID:23161852）。该突变在HEK293T细胞中的表达表明，通过与野生型相当的RACK1/BRCA1的免疫共沉淀测定，该突变可能是中性的（PMID:30617304）。对家族性家系中BRCA1突变的共现、共分离和杂合性缺失数据进行的多项计算机模拟研究表明，该突变具有显著的中性倾向（PMID:17924331，16489001）。然而，该突变在HEK293细胞中的表达表明，与野生型相比，该突变可能是失活的，如通过在双链断裂位点的减少和较慢的积累以及与Ku80的相互作用减少所测量的（PMID:18936166）。在一个家族性乳腺癌家族的几个成员中发现了这种突变，包括男性乳腺癌（PMID:26085381）。
var_description: The BRCA1 P142H mutation lies outside of a known functional domain. This mutation has been found in patients with breast cancer (PMID: 26085381). In a study of BRCA1 variants of unknown significance, this variant was suggested to be neutral based on its cisplatin response (PMID: 23867111). In a study evaluating the function of 29 BRCA1 missense mutations in two DNA repair pathways, this variant was shown to rescue functional homologous recombination DNA repair and to have intermediate activity in the single-strand annealing pathway of double-strand break DNA repair (PMID: 23161852). Expression of this mutation in HEK293T cells demonstrated that this mutation is likely neutral as measured by co-immunoprecipitation of RACK1/BRCA1 that is comparable to wildtype (PMID: 30617304). Multiple in silico studies looking at co-occurrence, cosegregation and loss-of-heterozygosity data of BRCA1 mutations in familial pedigrees determined this mutation to have significant odds in favor of neutrality (PMID: 17924331, 16489001). However, expression of this mutation in HEK293 cells demonstrated that this mutation is possibly inactivating as measured by diminished and slower accumulation at sites of double-strand breaks as well as diminished interaction with Ku80 compared to wildtype (PMID: 18936166). This mutation was found in several members of a family with familial breast cancer, including male breast cancer (PMID: 26085381).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 A1708V突变位于BRCT结构域。这种突变的功能数据相互矛盾。在一项对117种不同的BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，A1708V变异体被证明具有严重的折叠缺陷、受损的结合活性、受损的结合特异性和受损的转录活性（PMID:20516115），这些变异体是在具有已知的乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中鉴定的，并且位于BRCA1 BRCT结构域中。然而，其他研究已经证明该变体的功能与野生型相当或具有中间表型（PMID:18036263，26689913，30209399，30458859，30765603，28781887，27495310）。
var_description: The BRCA1 A1708V mutation is located in the BRCT domain. There is conflicting functional data for this mutation. In one study of 117 distinct BRCA1 missense variants identified in patients with a known family history of breast or ovarian cancer and located in the BRCA1 BRCT domain, the A1708V variant was demonstrated to have severe folding defect, compromised binding activity, compromised binding specificity and compromised transcriptional activity (PMID: 20516115). However, other studies have demonstrated that this variant functions comparably to wildtype or has an intermediate phenotype (PMID: 18036263, 26689913, 30209399, 30458859, 30765603, 28781887, 27495310).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 M1783T突变位于蛋白的BRCT结构域。在已知有乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中鉴定的117种不同的BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，证明M1783T变异体没有折叠缺陷、结合活性不确定、结合特异性正常和转录活性不确定（PMID:20516115）。在小菌落表型分析中，预测M1783T对BRCA1结构和/或功能有负面影响（PMID:15004537）。然而，在57个未鉴定的BRCA1变异体的结构分析中，M1783T被预测为良性突变（PMID:15172985）。
var_description: The BRCA1 M1783T mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. In a study of 117 distinct BRCA1 missense variants identified in patients with a known family history of breast or ovarian cancer, the M1783T variant was demonstrated to have no folding defect, uncertain binding activity, normal binding specificity and uncertain transcriptional activity (PMID: 20516115). In a small colony phenotype assay, M1783T was predicted to negatively affect BRCA1 structure and/or function (PMID: 15004537). However in a structural analysis of 57 uncharacterized BRCA1 variants, M1783T was predicted to be a benign mutation (PMID: 15172985).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 p1856T突变位于蛋白的BRCT结构域。在57个未鉴定的BRCA1变异体的结构分析中，p1856T被预测为良性突变（PMID:15172985），但尚未进行功能鉴定。
var_description: The BRCA1 P1856T mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. In a structural analysis of 57 uncharacterized BRCA1 variants, P1856T was predicted to be a benign mutation (PMID: 15172985), but has not been functionally characterized.

var_description_zh: BRCA1 G1738E突变位于蛋白质的BRCT结构域。在已知有乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中鉴定的117种不同的BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，G1738E变异体被证明具有严重的折叠缺陷、正常的结合活性、受损的结合特异性和受损的转录活性（PMID:20516115）。在对22种BRCA1变异体的单独研究中，G1738E显示在酵母和人类细胞中引起BRCA1转录活性降低（PMID:17308087）。在斯堪的纳维亚乳腺癌和卵巢癌家族中鉴定的8种BRCA1变体的单独研究中，G1738E显示与野生型BRCA1相比具有转录活性的丧失（PMID:11157798）。另一项对94个BRCA1变异体的研究显示，G1738E没有BRCA1的转录激活，并且具有未知的癌症相关性（PMID:15172985，10811118）。
var_description: The BRCA1 G1738E mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. In a study of 117 distinct BRCA1 missense variants identified in patients with a known family history of breast or ovarian cancer, the G1738E variant was demonstrated to have severe folding defect, normal binding activity, compromised binding specificity and compromised transcriptional activity (PMID: 20516115). In a separate study of 22 BRCA1 variants, G1738E was shown to cause decreased BRCA1 transcriptional activity in yeast and human cells (PMID: 17308087). In a separate study of 8 BRCA1 variants identified in Scandinavian breast and ovarian cancer families, G1738E was shown to have loss of transcriptional activity as compared to wild type BRCA1 (PMID: 11157798). Another study of 94 BRCA1 variants showed that G1738E had no transcriptional activation of BRCA1 and had unknown cancer association (PMID: 15172985, 10811118).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 W1837C突变位于蛋白质的BRCT结构域。在已知有乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中鉴定的117种不同BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，W1837C变异体被证明具有严重的折叠缺陷、结合活性受损、结合特异性受损和转录活性受损（PMID:20516115）。
var_description: The BRCA1 W1837C mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. In a study of 117 distinct BRCA1 missense variants identified in patients with a known family history of breast or ovarian cancer, the W1837C variant was demonstrated to have severe folding defect, compromised binding activity, compromised binding specificity and compromised transcriptional activity(PMID: 20516115).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 p1812S突变位于蛋白质的BRCT结构域。在57个未鉴定的BRCA1变异体的结构分析中，由于p1812s位于完全保留的位置（PMID:15172985），预测其与癌症相关，但尚未进行功能鉴定。
var_description: The BRCA1 P1812S mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. In a structural analysis of 57 uncharacterized BRCA1 variants, P1812S was predicted to be cancer-associated due to its location in a completely preserved position (PMID: 15172985), but has not been functionally characterized.

var_description_zh: BRCA1 D67Y突变位于蛋白的RING结构域。在一项意义未知的BRCA1变异体的研究中，基于其顺铂反应，D67Y被认为是中性的（PMID:23867111）。在同源定向重组（HDR）分析中，BRCA1 D67Y显示拯救功能性同源修复并与BARD1相互作用，因此表明其为中性突变（PMID:20103620）。在同一作者的另一项研究中，BRCA1 D67Y显示在双链断裂DNA修复的单链退火途径中具有完全活性（PMID:23161852）。然而，表达BRCA1 D67Y的MCF-10A细胞的体外研究表明，与野生型相比，该突变导致染色体不稳定性、多倍体组分和中心体数目增加（pMID:26246475）。
var_description: The BRCA1 D67Y mutation is located in the RING domain of the protein. In a study of BRCA1 variants of unknown significance, D67Y was suggested to be neutral based on its cisplatin response (PMID: 23867111). In a homology-directed recombination (HDR) assay, BRCA1 D67Y was shown to rescue functional homologous repair and interact with BARD1, thus suggesting it as a neutral mutation (PMID: 20103620). In a separate study by the same authors, BRCA1 D67Y was shown to be fully active in the single-strand annealing pathway of double-strand break DNA repair (PMID: 23161852). However, in vitro studies with MCF-10A cells expressing BRCA1 D67Y have demonstrated that this mutation results in increased chromosomal instability, polyploid fractions and centrosome number compared to wildtype (PMID: 26246475).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 D522N突变位于该基因的外显子10。该突变已在基底细胞癌中鉴定（PMID:26950094）。计算机分析表明该突变可能影响蛋白质功能（PMID:12531920）。
var_description: The BRCA1 D522N mutation is located in exon 10 of the gene. This mutation has been identified in basal cell carcinoma (PMID: 26950094). In silico analysis suggests that the mutation is likely to affect protein function (PMID: 12531920).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 E1644G突变可能是中性的。在对22种BRCA1变体的研究中，显示E1644G在酵母和人类细胞中都具有与野生型BRCA1相同水平的转录活性（PMID:17308087）。
var_description: The BRCA1 E1644G mutation is likely neutral. In a study of 22 BRCA1 variants, E1644G was shown to have the same level of transcriptional activity as wild type BRCA1 both in yeast and human cells (PMID: 17308087).

var_description: The BRCA1 E1282V mutation is likely neutral. In a study of BRCA1 variants of unknown significance, E1282V was suggested to be neutral based on its cisplatin response (PMID: 23867111).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 L1780P突变位于蛋白的BRCT结构域。在已知有乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中鉴定的117种不同的BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，L1780P变异体被证明具有严重的折叠缺陷、结合活性受损、结合特异性受损和转录活性受损（PMID:20516115）。另一项对94个BRCA1变异体的研究显示，L1780P没有BRCA1的转录激活，并且具有未知的癌症相关性（PMID:15172985，10811118）。

In a study of 117 distinct BRCA1 missense variants identified in patients with a known family history of breast or ovarian cancer, the L1780P variant was demonstrated to have severe folding defect, compromised binding activity, compromised binding specificity and compromised transcriptional activity (PMID: 20516115). Another study of 94 BRCA1 variants showed that L1780P had no transcriptional activation of BRCA1 and had unknown cancer association (PMID: 15172985, 10811118).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 M1652K突变位于蛋白的BRCT结构域。一项对94个BRCA1变异体的研究显示，M1652K没有BRCA1的转录激活，并且具有未知的癌症相关性，可能破坏了蛋白质结构中的盐桥（PMID:15172985，10811118）。在小菌落表型分析中，预测M1652K对BRCA1结构和功能有负面影响（PMID:15004537）。
var_description: The BRCA1 M1652K mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. A study of 94 BRCA1 variants showed that M1652K had no transcriptional activation of BRCA1 and had unknown cancer association, likely disrupting a salt bridge in the protein structure (PMID: 15172985, 10811118). In a small colony phenotype assay, M1652K was predicted to negatively affect BRCA1 structure and function (PMID: 15004537).

var_description_zh: BRAC1 T1349M突变位于BRCA1蛋白的已知功能域之外。计算机分析表明，该突变可能是中性的（PMID:17924331）。国际癌症研究机构（IARC）将该突变归类为非致病性突变（PMID:21990134）。
var_description: The BRAC1 T1349M mutation is located outside of a known functional domain of the BRCA1 protein. In silico analysis, has demonstrated that this mutation is likely neutral (PMID: 17924331). The International Agency for Research on Cancer (IARC) classifies this mutation as not pathogenic (PMID: 21990134).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 S308A突变的功能尚无定论。在一项意义未知的BRCA1变异体的研究中，基于其顺铂反应，该变异体对BRCA1功能的影响尚不清楚（PMID:23867111）。
var_description: The BRCA1 S308A mutation is of inconclusive function. In a study of BRCA1 variants of unknown significance, this variant had an unclear effect on BRCA1 function based on its cisplatin response (PMID: 23867111).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 M1689T突变位于蛋白质的BRCT结构域。在已知有乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中鉴定的117种不同的BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，证明M1689T变异体没有折叠缺陷、结合活性受损、结合特异性不确定和转录活性不确定（PMID:20516115）。
var_description: The BRCA1 M1689T mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. In a study of 117 distinct BRCA1 missense variants identified in patients with a known family history of breast or ovarian cancer, the M1689T variant was demonstrated to have no folding defect, compromised binding activity, uncertain binding specificity and uncertain transcriptional activity (PMID: 20516115).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 V1809A突变位于蛋白质的BRCT结构域。在已知有乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中鉴定的117种不同BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，V1809A变异体被证明没有折叠缺陷、结合活性不确定、结合特异性不确定和转录活性不确定（PMID:20516115）。在57个未鉴定的BRCA1变异体的结构分析中，V1809A被预测为良性突变（PMID:15172985）。然而，一项饱和基因组编辑研究将这种变体归类为功能缺失（PMID:30209399），并且Clinvar（NIH）表明这种改变是不确定的（https：//www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/clinvar/variation/37632/；于2月4日访问，2019）。
var_description: The BRCA1 V1809A mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. In a study of 117 distinct BRCA1 missense variants identified in patients with a known family history of breast or ovarian cancer, the V1809A variant was demonstrated to have no folding defect, uncertain binding activity, uncertain binding specificity and uncertain transcriptional activity (PMID: 20516115). In a structural analysis of 57 uncharacterized BRCA1 variants, V1809A was predicted to be a benign mutation (PMID: 15172985). However, a saturation genome editing study classified this variant as being loss-of-function (PMID: 30209399) and ClinVar (NIH) suggests that this alteration is uncertain (https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/clinvar/variation/37632/; accessed Feb 4, 2019).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 L22S突变位于蛋白的RING结构域。该突变已在遗传性乳腺癌和卵巢癌患者的种系中发现（PMID:9609997，19543972）。虽然该突变尚未进行功能表征，但计算机模拟研究已证明该突变是失活的，如通过多种计算预测方法（PMID:21990134，24489791）预测的其对蛋白质功能的有害影响所证明的。
var_description: The BRCA1 L22S mutation is located in the RING domain of the protein. This mutation has been found in the germline of patients with hereditary breast and ovarian cancers (PMID: 9609997, 19543972). While this mutation has not been functionally characterized, in silico studies have demonstrated that this mutation is inactivating as evidenced by its predicted deleterious effect on protein function by multiple computational prediction methods (PMID: 21990134, 24489791).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 D693N突变位于BRCA1蛋白的乙烯不敏感3（EIN3）结构域。该突变已在乳腺癌中发现（PMID:18284688）。计算机分析表明该突变是中性的（PMID:18284688）。
var_description: The BRCA1 D693N mutation is located in the ethylene insensitive 3 (EIN3) domain of the BRCA1 protein. This mutation has been found in breast cancer (PMID: 18284688). In silico analysis suggests that this mutation is neutral (PMID: 18284688).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 V1804D突变位于蛋白质的BRCT结构域。这种突变的功能数据相互矛盾。在已知有乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中鉴定的117种不同的BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，证明V1804D变异体没有折叠缺陷、正常结合活性、正常结合特异性和正常转录活性（PMID:20516115）。在对22种BRCA1变体的单独研究中，V1804D在酵母细胞中具有与野生型BRCA1相似的转录活性，但在人类细胞中转录活性降低（PMID:17308087）。在一项意义未知的BRCA1变异体的研究中，基于其顺铂反应，V1804D被认为是中性的（PMID:23867111）。在一项研究中，在两名没有乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的卵巢癌患者中发现了2种BRCA1变异体，与野生型BRCA1相比，V1804D的转录活性降低了60%（PMID:15350310）。在小菌落表型分析中，预测V1804D不影响BRCA1结构和/或功能（PMID:15004537）。在57个未鉴定的BRCA1变异体的结构分析中，预测V1804D与癌症相关（PMID:15172985）。
var_description: The BRCA1 V1804D mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. There is conflicting functional data for this mutation. In a study of 117 distinct BRCA1 missense variants identified in patients with a known family history of breast or ovarian cancer, the V1804D variant was demonstrated to have no folding defect, normal binding activity, normal binding specificity and normal transcriptional activity (PMID: 20516115). In a separate study of 22 BRCA1 variants, V1804D had transcriptional activity similar to wildtype BRCA1 in yeast cells but reduced transcriptional activity in human cells (PMID: 17308087). In a study of BRCA1 variants of unknown significance, V1804D was suggested to be neutral based on its cisplatin response (PMID: 23867111). In a study of 2 BRCA1 variants identified in two ovarian cancer patients without a family history of breast or ovarian cancer, V1804D had a 60% reduction in transcriptional activity as compared to wild type BRCA1 (PMID: 15350310). In a small colony phenotype assay, V1804D was not predicted to affect BRCA1 structure and/or function (PMID: 15004537). In a structural analysis of 57 uncharacterized BRCA1 variants, V1804D was predicted to be cancer-associated (PMID: 15172985).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 N1819S突变位于蛋白的BRCT结构域。在已知有乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中鉴定的117种不同的BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，证明N1819S变异体没有折叠缺陷、正常结合活性、正常结合特异性和正常转录活性（PMID:20516115）。在57个未鉴定的BRCA1变异体的结构分析中，N1819S被预测为良性突变（PMID:15172985）。
var_description: The BRCA1 N1819S mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. In a study of 117 distinct BRCA1 missense variants identified in patients with a known family history of breast or ovarian cancer, the N1819S variant was demonstrated to have no folding defect, normal binding activity, normal binding specificity and normal transcriptional activity (PMID: 20516115). In a structural analysis of 57 uncharacterized BRCA1 variants, N1819S was predicted to be a benign mutation (PMID: 15172985).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 C47G突变位于蛋白质的RING结构域。在同源定向重组（HDR）分析中，BRCA1 C47G显示导致非功能性同源修复（PMID:20103620）。在同一作者的另一项研究中，BRCA1 C47G也被证明在双链断裂DNA修复的单链退火途径中存在缺陷（PMID:23161852）。该突变破坏了BRCA1与E2泛素缀合酶UbcH5A（PMID:16403807）的结合。然而，尚不清楚BRCA1肿瘤抑制是否需要E3连接酶活性（PMID:22034435）。
var_description: The BRCA1 C47G mutation is located in the RING domain of the protein. In a homology-directed recombination (HDR) assay, BRCA1 C47G was shown to result in non-functional homologous repair (PMID: 20103620). In a separate study by the same authors, BRCA1 C47G was also demonstrated be defective in the single-strand annealing pathway of double-strand break DNA repair (PMID: 23161852). This mutation disrupts binding of BRCA1 to the E2 ubiquitin-conjugating enzyme UbcH5a (PMID: 16403807). However, it is unknown whether E3 ligase activity is required for BRCA1 tumor suppression (PMID: 22034435).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 D1739E突变位于蛋白质的BRCT结构域。尽管结构研究预测该变体是良性的（PMID:15172985），但在一项对117种不同的BRCA1错义变体的研究中，D1739E变体被证明具有严重的折叠缺陷、结合活性受损、结合特异性受损和转录活性受损（PMID:20516115），这些不同的BRCA1错义变体是在具有已知乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中鉴定的。此外，在小菌落表型分析中，预测D1739E对BRCA1结构和/或功能有负面影响（PMID:15004537）。
var_description: The BRCA1 D1739E mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. Though structural studies have predicted this variant to be benign (PMID: 15172985), in a study of 117 distinct BRCA1 missense variants identified in patients with a known family history of breast or ovarian cancer, the D1739E variant was demonstrated to have severe folding defect, compromised binding activity, compromised binding specificity and compromised transcriptional activity (PMID: 20516115). Additionally, in a small colony phenotype assay, D1739E was predicted to negatively affect BRCA1 structure and/or function (PMID: 15004537).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 G1706E突变位于蛋白质的BRCT结构域。在已知有乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中鉴定的117种不同的BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，G1706E变异体被证明具有严重的折叠缺陷、结合活性受损、结合特异性受损和转录活性不确定（PMID:20516115）。在对22种BRCA1变异体的单独研究中，G1706E显示在酵母和人类细胞中引起BRCA1转录活性降低（PMID:17308087）。在57个未鉴定的BRCA1变异体的结构分析中，预测G1706E与癌症相关（PMID:15172985）。在一项意义未知的BRCA1变异体研究中，G1706E在体外试验中未能拯救同源重组（PMID:23867111）。
var_description: The BRCA1 G1706E mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. In a study of 117 distinct BRCA1 missense variants identified in patients with a known family history of breast or ovarian cancer, the G1706E variant was demonstrated to have severe folding defect, compromised binding activity, compromised binding specificity and uncertain transcriptional activity (PMID: 20516115). In a separate study of 22 BRCA1 variants, G1706E was shown to cause decreased BRCA1 transcriptional activity in yeast and human cells (PMID: 17308087). In a structural analysis of 57 uncharacterized BRCA1 variants, G1706E was predicted to be cancer-associated (PMID: 15172985). In a study of BRCA1 variants of unknown significance, G1706E failed to rescue homologous recombination in an in vitro assay (PMID: 23867111).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 D1733Y突变位于蛋白的BRCT结构域。用表达BRCA1 D1733Y的HEK293T细胞进行的体外研究表明，通过与野生型（PMID:24845084）相比的转录活性测量，该突变可能是中性的。
var_description: The BRCA1 D1733Y mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. In vitro studies with HEK293T cells expressing BRCA1 D1733Y demonstrate that the mutation is likely neutral as measured by transcriptional activity comparable to wildtype (PMID: 24845084).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 R1699W突变位于蛋白的BRCT结构域（PMID:11573086）。在已知有乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中鉴定的117种不同的BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，证明R1699W变异体没有折叠缺陷、结合活性受损、结合特异性受损和转录活性受损（PMID:20516115）。在斯堪的纳维亚乳腺癌和卵巢癌家族中鉴定的8种BRCA1变体的单独研究中，与野生型BRCA1相比，R1699W在酵母和人类细胞中具有转录活性的丧失（PMID:11157798）。另一项对94个BRCA1变异体的研究显示，R1699W没有BRCA1的转录激活，并且与癌症相关（PMID:15172985，7939630）。然而，另一项研究表明，BRCA1 R1699W突变体易患癌症，并具有功能表型的丧失，在体内具有不良作用（PMID:12496476）。在一项意义未知的BRCA1变异体研究中，R1699W在体外试验中未能拯救同源重组（PMID:23867111）。
var_description: The BRCA1 R1699W mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein (PMID: 11573086). In a study of 117 distinct BRCA1 missense variants identified in patients with a known family history of breast or ovarian cancer, the R1699W variant was demonstrated to have no folding defect, compromised binding activity, compromised binding specificity and compromised transcriptional activity (PMID: 20516115). In a separate study of 8 BRCA1 variants identified in Scandinavian breast and ovarian cancer families, R1699W was shown to have loss of transcriptional activity in yeast and human cells as compared to wild type BRCA1 (PMID: 11157798). Another study of 94 BRCA1 variants showed that R1699W had no transcriptional activation of BRCA1 and was cancer-associated (PMID: 15172985, 7939630). Yet another study showed that the BRCA1 R1699W mutant predisposes to cancer and has a loss of function phenotype with a detererious effect in vivo (PMID: 12496476). In a study of BRCA1 variants of unknown significance, R1699W failed to rescue homologous recombination in an in vitro assay (PMID: 23867111).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 M1775V突变位于蛋白的BRCT结构域（PMID:11573086）。这种突变的功能数据相互矛盾。对97种BRCA1变异体的研究显示M1775V导致BRCA1的正常转录激活，并且该变异体具有未知的癌症相关性（PMID:15172985，8942979）。然而，一项饱和基因组编辑研究将该变体归类为功能缺失（PMID:30209399）。
var_description: The BRCA1 M1775V mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein (PMID: 11573086). There is conflicting functional data for this mutation. A study of 97 BRCA1 variants showed M1775V to result in normal transcriptional activation of BRCA1 and this variant was of unknown cancer association (PMID: 15172985, 8942979). However, a saturation genome editing study classified this variant as being loss-of-function (PMID: 30209399).

var_description: The BRCA1 P1812R mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. In a study of BRCA1 variants of unknown significance, this variant was suggested to be neutral based on its cisplatin response (PMID: 23867111).

var_description: The BRCA1 S4F mutation is of inconclusive function. In a study of BRCA1 variants of unknown significance, this variant had an unclear effect on BRCA1 function based on its cisplatin response (PMID: 23867111).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 S153R突变是一种中性突变。在一项评估29个BRCA1错义突变在两个DNA修复途径中的功能的研究中，该变体显示出拯救功能性同源重组DNA修复，并在双链断裂DNA修复的单链退火途径中具有完全活性（PMID:23161852）。
var_description: The BRCA1 S153R mutation is a neutral mutation. In a study evaluating the function of 29 BRCA1 missense mutations in two DNA repair pathways, this variant was shown to rescue functional homologous recombination DNA repair and to be fully active in the single-strand annealing pathway of double-strand break DNA repair (PMID: 23161852).

var_description: The BRCA1 H1862L mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. In a study of BRCA1 variants of unknown significance, this variant was suggested to be neutral based on its cisplatin response (PMID: 23867111).

var_description: The BRCA1 V1808A mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. var_description_zh: BRCA1 Y1703S突变位于蛋白的BRCT结构域。在对7个意义不确定的BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，该变异体显示引起BRCT结构域结构的显著改变并损害转录活性（PMID:23613828）。
var_description: The BRCA1 Y1703S mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. In a study of seven BRCA1 missense variants of uncertain significance, this variant was shown to cause significant alteration in BRCT domain structure and compromise transcriptional activity (PMID: 23613828).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 T826K突变位于蛋白质的DNA结合域。在电离辐射对乳腺癌细胞系HCC1937的影响的研究中，BRCA1 T826K不能挽救由野生型BRCA1逆转的辐射敏感性表型，并且不能补充缺陷型双链断裂修复（PMID:10635334）。然而，在一项意义未知的BRCA1变异体的研究中，基于其顺铂反应，T826K被认为是中性的（PMID:23867111）。
var_description: The BRCA1 T826K mutation is located in the DNA binding domain of the protein. In a study of the effects of ionizing radiation on the breast cancer cell line HCC1937, BRCA1 T826K failed to rescue the radiation sensitivity phenotype reversed by wildtype BRCA1 and failed to complement defective double stranded break repair (PMID: 10635334). However, in a study of BRCA1 variants of unknown significance, T826K was suggested to be neutral based on its cisplatin response (PMID: 23867111).

var_description: The BRCA1 N550H mutation is likely neutral. In a study of 7 missense BRCA1 variants predicted by a computational algorithm as disruptive to BRCA1 function, this variant had similar growth inhibitory properties as wildtype BRCA1 (PMID: 18680205).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 p1806A突变位于蛋白的BRCT结构域。在已知有乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中鉴定的117种不同的BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，证明p1806A变异体没有折叠缺陷、正常结合活性、正常结合特异性和正常转录活性（PMID:20516115）。在对22种BRCA1变体的单独研究中，p1806A在酵母和人类细胞中具有与野生型BRCA1相当的转录活性（PMID:17308087）。另一项对97种BRCA1变异体的研究显示，p1806A导致BRCA1的正常转录激活，并且具有未知的癌症相关性（PMID:15172985，10811118）。在小菌落表型分析中，预测p1806A不影响BRCA1结构和/或功能（PMID:15004537）。
var_description: The BRCA1 P1806A mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. In a study of 117 distinct BRCA1 missense variants identified in patients with a known family history of breast or ovarian cancer, the P1806A variant was demonstrated to have no folding defect, normal binding activity, normal binding specificity and normal transcriptional activity (PMID: 20516115). In a separate study of 22 BRCA1 variants, P1806A had transcriptional activity in yeast and human cells comparable to wildtype BRCA1 (PMID: 17308087). Another study of 97 BRCA1 variants showed P1806A to result in normal transcriptional activation of BRCA1 and to be of unknown cancer association (PMID: 15172985, 10811118). In a small colony phenotype assay, P1806A was not predicted to affect BRCA1 structure and/or function (PMID: 15004537).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 L165P突变可能是中性的。在一项意义未知的BRCA1变异体的研究中，基于其顺铂反应，该变异体被认为是中性的（PMID:23867111）。
var_description: The BRCA1 L165P mutation is likely neutral. In a study of BRCA1 variants of unknown significance, this variant was suggested to be neutral based on its cisplatin response (PMID: 23867111).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 D1778G突变位于蛋白的BRCT结构域。在已知有乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中鉴定的117种不同的BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，证明A1708E变异体没有折叠缺陷、正常结合活性、正常结合特异性和正常转录活性（PMID:20516115）。然而，在57个未鉴定的BRCA1变异体的结构分析中，预测D1778G与癌症相关（PMID:15172985）。该基因的计算机模拟和体外分析表明，该突变对BRCA1基因（PMID:25724305）的剪接没有影响。
var_description: The BRCA1 D1778G mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. In a study of 117 distinct BRCA1 missense variants identified in patients with a known family history of breast or ovarian cancer, the A1708E variant was demonstrated to have no folding defect, normal binding activity, normal binding specificity and normal transcriptional activity (PMID: 20516115). However, in a structural analysis of 57 uncharacterized BRCA1 variants, D1778G was predicted to be cancer-associated (PMID: 15172985). In silico and in vitro analysis of the gene suggested that this mutation has no effect on the splicing of the BRCA1 gene (PMID: 25724305).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 F1734S突变位于蛋白质的BRCT结构域。在已知有乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中鉴定的117种不同的BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，F1734S变异体被证明具有严重的折叠缺陷、不确定的结合活性、不确定的结合特异性和正常的转录活性（PMID:20516115）。在57个未鉴定的BRCA1变异体的结构分析中，预测F1734S与癌症相关（PMID:15172985）。
var_description: The BRCA1 F1734S mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. In a study of 117 distinct BRCA1 missense variants identified in patients with a known family history of breast or ovarian cancer, the F1734S variant was demonstrated to have severe folding defect, uncertain binding activity, uncertain binding specificity and normal transcriptional activity (PMID: 20516115). In a structural analysis of 57 uncharacterized BRCA1 variants, F1734S was predicted to be cancer-associated (PMID: 15172985).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 H1746N突变位于蛋白质的BRCT结构域。在已知有乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中鉴定的117种不同的BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，H1746N变异体被证明具有严重的折叠缺陷、结合活性受损、结合特异性受损和转录活性不确定（PMID:20516115）。在57个未鉴定的BRCA1变异体的结构分析中，预测H1746N与癌症相关（PMID:15172985）。
var_description: The BRCA1 H1746N mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. In a study of 117 distinct BRCA1 missense variants identified in patients with a known family history of breast or ovarian cancer, the H1746N variant was demonstrated to have severe folding defect, compromised binding activity, compromised binding specificity and uncertain transcriptional activity (PMID: 20516115). In a structural analysis of 57 uncharacterized BRCA1 variants, H1746N was predicted to be cancer-associated (PMID: 15172985).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 K1793N突变位于蛋白质的BRCT重复区。计算机分析表明该突变具有致病性并影响蛋白质折叠（PMID:36530327）。
var_description: The BRCA1 K1793N mutation is located in the BRCT repeat region of the protein. In silico analysis suggests that the mutation is pathogenic and impacts protein folding (PMID: 36530327).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 F1695L突变位于蛋白质的BRCT结构域。BRCA1 F1695L突变蛋白表现出增加的p53结合能力，导致改变的p53功能和潜在增加的致癌活性（PMID:17161371）。相反，在一项对117种不同的BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，F1695L变异体被证明没有折叠缺陷、正常的结合活性、正常的结合特异性和正常的转录活性（PMID:20516115），这些变异体是在具有已知的乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中鉴定的。在57个未鉴定的BRCA1变异体的结构分析中，F1695L被预测为良性突变（PMID:15172985）。
var_description: The BRCA1 F1695L mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. The BRCA1 F1695L mutant protein demonstrates increased p53 binding ability, resulting in altered p53 function and potentially increased oncogenic activity (PMID: 17161371). Conversely, in a study of 117 distinct BRCA1 missense variants identified in patients with a known family history of breast or ovarian cancer, the F1695L variant was demonstrated to have no folding defect, normal binding activity, normal binding specificity and normal transcriptional activity (PMID: 20516115). In a structural analysis of 57 uncharacterized BRCA1 variants, F1695L was predicted to be a benign mutation (PMID: 15172985).

var_description: The BRCA1 S1841R mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein . In a study of 117 distinct BRCA1 missense variants identified in patients with a known family history of breast or ovarian cancer, the S1841R variant was demonstrated to have severe folding defect, compromised binding activity, compromised binding specificity and compromised transcriptional activity (PMID: 20516115).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 S1613C变异体可能是中性的。该变体被证明具有与野生型BRCA1（PMID:18992264）相当的转录活性。
var_description: The BRCA1 S1613C variant is likely neutral. This variant was demonstrated to have transcriptional activity comparable to wildtype BRCA1 (PMID: 18992264).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 A1752V突变位于蛋白的BRCT结构域。在已知有乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中鉴定的117种不同的BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，证明A1752V变异体具有严重的折叠缺陷和受损的转录活性，但具有正常的结合活性和不确定的结合特异性（PMID:20516115）。
var_description: The BRCA1 A1752V mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. In a study of 117 distinct BRCA1 missense variants identified in patients with a known family history of breast or ovarian cancer, the A1752V variant was demonstrated to have severe folding defect and compromised transcriptional activity, but had normal binding activity and uncertain binding specificity (PMID: 20516115).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 I42V突变位于蛋白的RING结构域。在同源定向重组（HDR）分析中，BRCA1 I42V显示拯救功能性同源修复并与BARD1相互作用（PMID:20103620）。在同一作者的另一项研究中，BRCA1 I42V显示在双链断裂DNA修复的单链退火途径中具有完全活性（PMID:23161852）。
var_description: The BRCA1 I42V mutation is located in the RING domain of the protein. In a homology-directed recombination (HDR) assay, BRCA1 I42V was shown to rescue functional homologous repair and interact with BARD1 (PMID: 20103620). In a separate study by the same authors, BRCA1 I42V was shown to be fully active in the single-strand annealing pathway of double-strand break DNA repair (PMID: 23161852).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 G1763V突变位于蛋白的BRCT结构域。在已知有乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中鉴定的117种不同的BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，G1763V变异体被证明具有严重的折叠缺陷、结合活性受损、结合特异性受损和转录活性受损（PMID:20516115）。
var_description: The BRCA1 G1763V mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. In a study of 117 distinct BRCA1 missense variants identified in patients with a known family history of breast or ovarian cancer, the G1763V variant was demonstrated to have severe folding defect, compromised binding activity, compromised binding specificity and compromised transcriptional activity (PMID:20516115).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 F1761I突变位于蛋白质的BRCT结构域。对94个BRCA1变异体的研究显示，F1761I没有BRCA1的转录激活，并且具有未知的癌症相关性（PMID:15172985，10811118）。
var_description: The BRCA1 F1761I mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. A study of 94 BRCA1 variants showed that F1761I had no transcriptional activation of BRCA1 and had unknown cancer association (PMID: 15172985, 10811118).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 C61G突变位于蛋白的RING结构域。在一项意义未知的BRCA1变异体研究中，基于其顺铂反应，C61G被认为对BRCA1功能具有有害影响（PMID:23867111）。在同源定向重组（HDR）分析中，BRCA1 C61G显示导致非功能性同源修复（PMID:20103620）。在同一作者的另一项研究中，BRCA1 C61G也被证明在双链断裂DNA修复的单链退火途径中存在缺陷（PMID:23161852）。在细胞对电离辐射（IR）反应的研究中，与野生型BRCA1相比，BRCA1 C61G适度降低了BRCA1在DNA损伤和修复位点的定位，但仍表现出对IR的有效DNA修复反应（PMID:15569676）。BRCA1 C61G未显示导致BRCA1从细胞核到细胞质的错误定位，表明这不是该变体的核DNA修复和转录功能受损的机制（PMID:14729053）。BRCA1 C61G突变破坏了BRCA1与E2泛素缀合酶UbcH5A（PMID:16403807）的结合。然而，尚不清楚BRCA1肿瘤抑制是否需要E3连接酶活性（PMID:22034435）。用表达BRCA1 C61G的MCF-10A细胞进行的体外研究表明，与野生型（PMID:26246475）相比，通过增加的放射敏感性、染色体不稳定性、多倍体组分和中心体数目来测量，该突变是失活的。
var_description: The BRCA1 C61G mutation is located in the RING domain of the protein. In a study of BRCA1 variants of unknown significance, C61G was suggested to have a deleterious effect on BRCA1 function based on its cisplatin response (PMID: 23867111). In a homology-directed recombination (HDR) assay, BRCA1 C61G was shown to result in non-functional homologous repair (PMID: 20103620). In a separate study by the same authors, BRCA1 C61G was also demonstrated to be defective in the single-strand annealing pathway of double-strand break DNA repair (PMID: 23161852). In a study of cell response to ionizing radiation (IR), the BRCA1 C61G modestly decreased localization of BRCA1 to sites of DNA damage and repair as compared to wildtype BRCA1 but still displayed potent DNA repair response to IR (PMID: 15569676). BRCA1 C61G was not shown to cause BRCA1 mislocalization from the nucleus to the cytoplasm, indicating that this is not a mechanism of impaired nuclear DNA repair and transcription function for this variant (PMID: 14729053). The BRCA1 C61G mutation disrupts binding of BRCA1 to the E2 ubiquitin-conjugating enzyme UbcH5a (PMID: 16403807). However, it is unknown whether E3 ligase activity is required for BRCA1 tumor suppression (PMID: 22034435). In vitro studies with MCF-10A cells expressing BRCA1 C61G have demonstrated that this mutation is inactivating as measured by increased radiosensitivity, chromosomal instability, polyploid fractions and centrosome number compared to wildtype (PMID: 26246475).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 S1164I突变位于蛋白的DNA结合域和SQ簇域之间。计算机模拟和体外研究已经证明，该突变可能是失活的，如其预测的对蛋白质功能的有害影响所证明的，以及当突变体与野生型相比过表达时，增加的细胞生长和增加的同源重组水平（pMID:18680205）。
var_description: The BRCA1 S1164I mutation is located between the DNA-binding domain and SQ-cluster domain of the protein. In silico and in vitro studies have demonstrated that this mutation is likely inactivating as evidenced by its predicted deleterious effect on protein function, as well as increased cell growth and increased level of homologous recombination when the mutant is overexpressed compared to wildtype (PMID: 18680205).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 M1775R突变位于蛋白的BRCT结构域（PMID:11573086）。在已知有乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中鉴定的117种不同的BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，证明M1775R变异体没有折叠缺陷、结合活性受损、结合特异性受损和转录活性受损（PMID:20516115）。另一项对94个BRCA1变异体的研究表明，M1775R没有BRCA1的转录激活，并且与癌症相关（PMID:15172985）。在已知与乳腺癌和卵巢癌相关的4个BRCA1突变的研究中，BRCA1 M1775R显示具有显著受损的转录活性（PMID:8942979，10811118）。在小菌落表型分析中，预测M1775R负面影响BRCA1结构和/或功能（PMID:15004537，8751436）。在BRCA1抑制酵母菌落生长的研究中，M1775R使野生型BRCA1（pMID:9159158）的生长抑制功能部分失活。BRCA1 M1775R在基于酵母的测定中降低了BRCA1肿瘤抑制活性（PMID:21922593）。在电离辐射对乳腺癌细胞系HCC1937的影响的研究中，BRCA1 M1775R未能挽救由野生型BRCA1（PMID:10635334）逆转的辐射敏感性表型。在一项评估29个BRCA1错义突变在两个DNA修复途径中的功能的研究中，M1775R显示导致非功能性同源重组DNA修复，并且在双链断裂DNA修复的单链退火途径中有缺陷（PMID:23161852）。在细胞对电离辐射（IR）反应的研究中，与野生型BRCA1相比，BRCA1 M1775R突变体降低了BRCA1在DNA损伤和修复位点的定位（PMID:15569676）。与野生型BRCA1（PMID:14729053，15689452，7545954，12427738，16101277，15133502，7939630）相比，BRCA1 M1775R显示将BRCA1定位从细胞核转移到细胞质，可能有助于抑制该突变体中的核DNA修复和转录功能。
var_description: The BRCA1 M1775R mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein  (PMID: 11573086). In a study of 117 distinct BRCA1 missense variants identified in patients with a known family history of breast or ovarian cancer, the M1775R variant was demonstrated to have no folding defect, compromised binding activity, compromised binding specificity and compromised transcriptional activity (PMID: 20516115). Another study of 94 BRCA1 variants showed that M1775R had no transcriptional activation of BRCA1 and was cancer-associated (PMID: 15172985). In a study of 4 BRCA1 mutations known to be associated with breast and ovarian cancer, BRCA1 M1775R was shown to have markedly impaired transcriptional activity (PMID: 8942979, 10811118). In a small colony phenotype assay, M1775R was predicted to negatively affect BRCA1 structure and/or function (PMID: 15004537, 8751436). In a study of BRCA1 inhibition of yeast colony growth, M1775R partially inactivated growth inhibitory function of wild type BRCA1 (PMID: 9159158). BRCA1 M1775R decreased BRCA1 tumor suppressor activity in a yeast-based assay (PMID: 21922593). In a study of the effects of ionizing radiation on the breast cancer cell line HCC1937, BRCA1 M1775R failed to rescue the radiation sensitivity phenotype reversed by wild type BRCA1 (PMID: 10635334). In a study evaluating the function of 29 BRCA1 missense mutations in two DNA repair pathways, M1775R was shown to result in non-functional homologous recombination DNA repair and to be defective in the single-strand annealing pathway of double-strand break DNA repair (PMID: 23161852). In a study of cell response to ionizing radiation (IR), the BRCA1 M1775R mutant decreased localization of BRCA1 to sites of DNA damage and repair as compared to wild type BRCA1 (PMID: 15569676). BRCA1 M1775R was shown to shift BRCA1 localization from the nucleus to the cytoplasm, likely contributing to inhibition of nuclear DNA repair and transcription function in this mutant as compared to wild type BRCA1 (PMID: 14729053, 15689452, 7545954, 12427738, 16101277, 15133502, 7939630)

var_description_zh: BRCA1 G1803A突变位于蛋白质的BRCT结构域。在已知有乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中鉴定的117种不同BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，G1803A变异体被证明没有折叠缺陷、正常的结合活性、正常的结合特异性和受损的转录活性（PMID:20516115）。该基因的计算机模拟和体外分析表明，该突变可能削弱剪接位点的强度，并产生不包括外显子23（PMID:25724305）的选择性剪接转录本。然而，在57个未鉴定的BRCA1变异体的结构分析中，G1803A被预测为良性突变（PMID:15172985）。
var_description: The BRCA1 G1803A mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. In a study of 117 distinct BRCA1 missense variants identified in patients with a known family history of breast or ovarian cancer, the G1803A variant was demonstrated to have no folding defect, normal binding activity, normal binding specificity and compromised transcriptional activity (PMID: 20516115). In silico and in vitro analysis of the gene suggested that this mutation may weaken splice site strength and create an alternatively-spliced transcript excluding exon 23 (PMID: 25724305). However, in a structural analysis of 57 uncharacterized BRCA1 variants, G1803A was predicted to be a benign mutation (PMID: 15172985).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 S1473P突变可能是中性的。在对7个意义不明的BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，S1473P具有与野生型BRCA1（PMID:23613828）相当的结构和转录活性。
var_description: The BRCA1 S1473P mutation is likely neutral. In a study of 7 BRCA1 missense variants of uncertain significance, S1473P had comparable structure and transcriptional activity to wild type BRCA1 (PMID: 23613828).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 I90T突变位于蛋白的RING结构域。在一项评估29个BRCA1错义突变在两个DNA修复途径中的功能的研究中，虽然I90T被证明可以挽救功能性同源重组DNA修复，但它也被证明在双链断裂DNA修复的单链退火途径中有缺陷（PMID:23161852）。
var_description: The BRCA1 I90T mutation is located in the RING domain of the protein. In a study evaluating the function of 29 BRCA1 missense mutations in two DNA repair pathways, while I90T was shown to rescue functional homologous recombination DNA repair, it was also shown to be defective in the single-strand annealing pathway of double-strand break DNA repair (PMID: 23161852).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 Y1703H突变位于蛋白质的BRCT结构域（PMID:11573086）。对94个BRCA1变异体的研究显示，Y1703H没有BRCA1的转录激活，并且具有未知的癌症相关性（PMID:15172985，10811118）。
var_description: The BRCA1 Y1703H mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein (PMID: 11573086). A study of 94 BRCA1 variants showed that Y1703H had no transcriptional activation of BRCA1 and had unknown cancer association (PMID: 15172985, 10811118).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 Q1756C突变位于蛋白的BRCT结构域。在一项已知与乳腺癌和卵巢癌相关的4个BRCA1突变的研究中，BRCA1 Q1756C的转录活性明显受损（PMID:8942979）。
var_description: The BRCA1 Q1756C mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. In a study of 4 BRCA1 mutations known to be associated with breast and ovarian cancer, BRCA1 Q1756C was shown to have markedly impaired transcriptional activity (PMID: 8942979).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 H1805P突变位于蛋白质的BRCT结构域。在已知有乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中鉴定的117种不同的BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，H1805P变异体被证明没有折叠缺陷、正常结合活性、正常结合特异性和正常转录活性（PMID:20516115）。
var_description: The BRCA1 H1805P mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. In a study of 117 distinct BRCA1 missense variants identified in patients with a known family history of breast or ovarian cancer, the H1805P variant was demonstrated to have no folding defect, normal binding activity, normal binding specificity and normal transcriptional activity (PMID: 20516115).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 Q1826H突变位于蛋白的BRCT结构域。该变体在一个三代受乳腺癌影响的家族中被鉴定，并显示出与野生型BRCA1相当的表达和功能，尽管通过计算预测会导致异常剪接（PMID:18992264）。在已知有乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中鉴定的117种不同的BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，Q1826H变异体被证明没有折叠缺陷、结合活性不确定、结合特异性不确定和转录活性正常（PMID:20516115）。
var_description: The BRCA1 Q1826H mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. This variant was identified in a family affected by breast cancer across three generations and showed expression and function comparable to wildtype BRCA1 despite being computationally predicted to lead to aberrant splicing (PMID: 18992264). In a study of 117 distinct BRCA1 missense variants identified in patients with a known family history of breast or ovarian cancer, the Q1826H variant was demonstrated to have no folding defect, uncertain binding activity, uncertain binding specificity and normal transcriptional activity (PMID: 20516115).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 E143K突变可能是中性的。在一项评估29个BRCA1错义突变在两个DNA修复途径中的功能的研究中，该变体显示出拯救功能性同源重组DNA修复，并在双链断裂DNA修复的单链退火途径中具有中间活性（PMID:23161852）。
var_description: The BRCA1 E143K mutation is likely neutral. In a study evaluating the function of 29 BRCA1 missense mutations in two DNA repair pathways, this variant was shown to rescue functional homologous recombination DNA repair and to have intermediate activity in the single-strand annealing pathway of double-strand break DNA repair (PMID: 23161852).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 M1628T突变可能是中性的。在两个独立的研究中，BRCA1 M1628T具有与野生型BRCA1相同的转录活性（PMID:15689452，15350310）。在一项意义未知的BRCA1变异体的研究中，基于其顺铂反应，M1628T被认为是中性的（PMID:23867111）。
var_description: The BRCA1 M1628T mutation is likely neutral. In two separate studies, BRCA1 M1628T had the same transcriptional activity as wild type BRCA1 (PMID: 15689452, 15350310). In a study of BRCA1 variants of unknown significance, M1628T was suggested to be neutral based on its cisplatin response (PMID: 23867111).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 I1766S突变位于蛋白的BRCT结构域。在已知有乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中鉴定的117种不同的BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，证明I1766S变异体具有严重的折叠缺陷、正常的结合活性、受损的结合特异性和受损的转录活性（PMID:20516115）。在对22种BRCA1变异体的单独研究中，I1766S显示在酵母和人类细胞中引起BRCA1转录活性降低（PMID:17308087）。在通过计算算法鉴定为破坏BRCA1功能/潜在有害的7种错义BRCA1变异体的研究中，基于酵母同源重组活性测定证实I1766S变异体是潜在有害的，显示其活性接近已知的功能丧失对照BRCA1 C61G、A1708E和M1775R（pMID:18680205）。
var_description: The BRCA1 I1766S mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. In a study of 117 distinct BRCA1 missense variants identified in patients with a known family history of breast or ovarian cancer, the I1766S variant was demonstrated to have severe folding defect, normal binding activity, compromised binding specificity and compromised transcriptional activity (PMID: 20516115). In a separate study of 22 BRCA1 variants, I1766S was shown to cause decreased BRCA1 transcriptional activity in yeast and human cells (PMID: 17308087). In a study of 7 missense BRCA1 variants identified by a computational algorithm as disruptive to BRCA1 function/potentially deleterious, the I1766S variant was confirmed to be potentially deleterious based on a a yeast homologous recombination activity assay, showing its activity to approximate known loss of function controls BRCA1 C61G, A1708E, and M1775R (PMID: 18680205).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 p1749R突变位于蛋白的BRCT结构域。在已知有乳腺癌或卵巢癌家族史的患者中鉴定的117种不同的BRCA1错义变异体的研究中，证明p1749R变异体具有严重的折叠缺陷、结合活性受损、结合特异性受损和转录活性受损（PMID:20516115）。另一项对94个BRCA1变异体的研究表明，p1749R没有BRCA1的转录激活，并且与癌症相关（PMID:15172985，8751436）。在BRCA1抑制酵母菌落生长的研究中，已知的癌症相关p1749R突变显示促进细胞生长和增殖（PMID:9159158）。在基于酵母的分析中，BRCA1 p1749R降低了BRCA1肿瘤抑制活性（PMID:21922593）。在电离辐射对乳腺癌细胞系HCC1937的影响的研究中，BRCA1 p1749R不能挽救由野生型BRCA1逆转的辐射敏感性表型，并且不能补充缺陷型双链断裂修复（PMID:10635334）。在细胞对电离辐射（IR）反应的研究中，与野生型BRCA1相比，BRCA1 p1749R突变体降低了BRCA1在DNA损伤和修复位点的定位（PMID:15569676）。与野生型BRCA1（PMID:14729053）相比，BRCA1 p1749R显示将BRCA1定位从细胞核转移到细胞质，可能有助于抑制该突变体中的核DNA修复和转录功能。
var_description: The BRCA1 P1749R mutation is located in the BRCT domain of the protein. In a study of 117 distinct BRCA1 missense variants identified in patients with a known family history of breast or ovarian cancer, the P1749R variant was demonstrated to have severe folding defect, compromised binding activity, compromised binding specificity and compromised transcriptional activity (PMID: 20516115). Another study of 94 BRCA1 variants showed that P1749R had no transcriptional activation of BRCA1 and was cancer-associated (PMID: 15172985, 8751436). In a study of BRCA1 inhibition of yeast colony growth, the known cancer-associated P1749R mutation was shown to promote cell growth and proliferation (PMID: 9159158). BRCA1 P1749R decreased BRCA1 tumor suppressor activity in a yeast-based assay (PMID: 21922593). In a study of the effects of ionizing radiation on the breast cancer cell line HCC1937, BRCA1 P1749R failed to rescue the radiation sensitivity phenotype reversed by wild type BRCA1 and failed to complement defective double stranded break repair (PMID: 10635334). In a study of cell response to ionizing radiation (IR), the BRCA1 P1749R mutant decreased localization of BRCA1 to sites of DNA damage and repair as compared to wild type BRCA1 (PMID: 15569676). BRCA1 P1749R was shown to shift BRCA1 localization from the nucleus to the cytoplasm, likely contributing to inhibition of nuclear DNA repair and transcription function in this mutant as compared to wild type BRCA1 (PMID: 14729053).

var_description_zh: BRCA1 E23FS突变位于蛋白的RING结构域。这是BRCA1中已知的有害突变，其消除了蛋白质的RING结构域（PMID:23867111，15569676，14729053）。到70岁时，BRCA1 E23FS与乳腺癌的相关风险为56%，与卵巢癌的相关风险为16%，与前列腺癌的相关风险为16%（PMID:9145676），并且是最常见的德系犹太人BRCA1创始者突变之一（PMID:14576434）。通过BRCA1 185STOP突变在小鼠中对该变体进行建模表明，该变体不仅使动物易患乳腺肿瘤，而且还损害了对铂类药物和PARP抑制剂治疗的反应（PMID:27454287）。用表达该突变的MCF-10A细胞进行的体外研究表明，与野生型（PMID:26246475）相比，通过增加的放射敏感性、染色体不稳定性、多倍体组分和中心体数目来测量，该突变是失活的。在携带RING-less BRCA1的癌细胞中进行的体外研究也表明，RING结构域的缺失可赋予对PARP抑制剂和铂制剂的抗性（PMID:27454289）。
var_description: The BRCA1 E23fs mutation is located in the RING domain of the protein. It is a known deleterious mutation in BRCA1 that abolishes the RING-domain of the protein (PMID: 23867111, 15569676, 14729053). BRCA1 E23fs carries an associated risk of 56% for breast cancer, 16% for ovarian cancer and 16% for prostate cancer by age 70 (PMID: 9145676) and is one of the most common Ashkenazi Jewish BRCA1 founder mutations (PMID: 14576434). Modeling of this variant in mice via a BRCA1 185stop mutation demonstrated that this variant not only predisposed animals to mammary tumors but also compromised response to treatment with platinum drugs and PARP inhibitors (PMID: 27454287). In vitro studies with MCF-10A cells expressing this mutation have demonstrated that it is inactivating as measured by increased radiosensitivity, chromosomal instability, polyploid fractions and centrosome number compared to wildtype (PMID: 26246475). In vitro studies in cancer cells harboring RING-less BRCA1 also demonstrated that loss of the RING domain can confer resistance to PARP inhibitors and platinum agents (PMID: 27454289).
